[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean real-estate model house / show apartment photo collage, 4-panel brochure-style presentation for listing, sales catalog, and online 분양 안내 use.
Editorial interior showcase with a premium Korean developer brochure feel, designed to communicate layout, finishes, option details, and spatial quality at a glance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 4-panel grid fills the full 1536x1024 canvas in a balanced brochure layout, each panel occupying roughly equal visual weight with thin soft-gray separators and a polished catalog hierarchy.
- Add a realistic brochure header containing {단지명_평형}, {브로슈어_날짜}, {위치_라벨}, and a small English/Korean line such as “MODEL HOUSE PHOTO TOUR / 견본주택 포토 투어”.
- Panel 01 places the living room as the brightest hero space with TV wall, sofa, window, curtain fabric, coffee table styling, indoor plant, and a small caption tag.
- Panel 02 frames the kitchen and dining area with sink, countertop, built-in cabinetry, pendant or recessed lighting, dining table setting, and appliance details aligned for a sales-catalog read.
- Panel 03 shows the master bedroom with bed, wardrobe or dressing zone, side table, soft textiles, indirect lighting, and a warm staged residential atmosphere.
- Panel 04 presents the bathroom with vanity, mirror, tile, fixtures, towel styling, glass partition, and clean realistic reflections.
- Maintain the structure described by {패널_구성} while making each panel visually distinct but stylistically unified.
- Include a slim bottom information strip with {면적_정보}, {옵션_메모}, {분양_문의}, page number “P.04”, and a small QR-code-like square as a brochure realism detail.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header/title area — Present {단지명_평형} in a clean catalog headline position, aligned to the grid and sized for immediate readability; include “2026 모델하우스” style date information from {브로슈어_날짜}.
2. Sub-info line — Add {위치_라벨}, {면적_정보}, and a compact descriptor like “84A TYPE · SAMPLE HOUSE · INTERIOR GUIDE” beneath the main headline.
3. Panel 01 (living room) — Show a modern white living room with wood accents, sofa, TV unit, window light, sheer curtains, rug, side table, framed art, indoor plant, and caption “01 거실 LIVING ROOM”.
4. Panel 02 (kitchen/dining) — Show a pristine kitchen with sink, cabinets, countertop, dining table, chairs, tableware, subtle backsplash texture, and caption “02 주방·다이닝 KITCHEN”.
5. Panel 03 (master bedroom) — Show a calm bedroom with bed, side table, wardrobe, dressing mirror, fabric bedding, reading lamp, and caption “03 안방 MASTER ROOM”.
6. Panel 04 (bathroom) — Show a refined bathroom with vanity, mirror, tile surfaces, faucet, towels, glass shower partition, and caption “04 욕실 BATHROOM”.
7. Footer/catalog strip — Add brochure-like micro text: “분양문의 {분양_문의}”, “옵션안내 {옵션_메모}”, “PAGE 04 / INTERIOR CUT”, and a small contact/QR area.
8. Overall collage treatment — Keep all four panels synchronized in {인테리어_톤}, with consistent {조명_질감} and the same brochure-grade finish across the entire composition.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, bold for the main property label, medium for supporting labels, small regular text for captions, footer, area details, and contact information.
- Color palette: white, beige, natural wood, and accent green from {컬러_팔레트}; keep whites slightly warm rather than clinical.
- Brochure graphics: thin soft-gray separators, subtle drop shadow 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity, small room-number badges, footer dividers, and understated architectural brochure lines.
- Surface finish: smooth matte brochure print look with clean architectural edges, realistic fabrics, wood grain, tile texture, curtain folds, tabletop objects, towels, and plant details.
- Text placement should feel like a real Korean 분양 catalog page: title at top, room captions inside or just below each photo, practical information in a bottom strip.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame interior photography look, 24mm wide-angle lens at f/8 for room coverage, straight verticals, realistic perspective correction.
- Lighting: daylight from windows supplemented by warm recessed downlights, soft shadows, even exposure, and no harsh hotspot reflections.
- Color grade: warm white + beige + light oak wood + restrained green accents, with a polished developer-showroom tone.
- Rendering quality: photorealistic real-estate interior photography, credible room scale, believable furniture proportions, natural material response, and brochure-ready sharpness.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean apartment brochure interior — a refined real-estate catalog spread with the polished presentation quality of a high-end developer model home booklet, enriched with practical 분양 information and realistic staged living details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “{단지명_평형}” must appear correctly as the main property label.
- Render the following Korean brochure text clearly where appropriate: “견본주택 포토 투어”, “01 거실”, “02 주방·다이닝”, “03 안방”, “04 욕실”, “분양문의 {분양_문의}”, “옵션안내 {옵션_메모}”.
- Keep the exact 4-panel composition described by {패널_구성}.
- Each panel must read as a real staged model-house interior photo with consistent perspective, straight vertical lines, and believable residential scale.
- Interior styling must match {인테리어_톤}, lighting must match {조명_질감}, and palette must match {컬러_팔레트}.
- Include brochure realism details such as room labels, date, location, area information, page number, contact strip, and small QR-like graphic without overpowering the interior photos.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable room labels
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Distorted room geometry or impossible architecture

studio:prompts3:ours-551.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean home interior mood board, 8-style comparison layout for social sharing and design inspiration.
Magazine-like editorial mood board with layered swatches, furniture, materials, small room snippets, and realistic design-note annotations in a vertical poster format.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical 1024x1536 poster designed as a Korean interior magazine mood-board page: a top masthead/header, one large lead mood panel, and 8 compact style zones flowing down the page with clear editorial hierarchy.
- Each zone should combine {스타일목록}, {공간}, {요소콜라주}, {텍스트라벨}, and {컬러팔레트} as a cohesive mini-board, with furniture cutouts, fabric/wood/stone samples, lighting references, plant details, and small room-detail photographs.
- Background treatment: soft off-white paper texture (#F7F3EE), tactile recycled-paper grain, taped sample corners, pin marks, transparent tracing-paper overlays, and subtle catalog clipping edges.
- Add realistic editorial information: {매거진명}, {이슈번호}, {발행일}, {에디터명}, {계정명}, {해시태그}, and {저장문구} placed as small printed details, so the page feels like a real shareable design guide rather than a template.
- Composition should feel curated and lived-in: varied sample sizes, handwritten-style micro notes, small measurement ticks, material tags, fabric labels, and page-navigation details, while keeping every Korean label readable.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header band: set a concise title area reading {매거진명} / {이슈번호} / {발행일}, plus the main Korean title {메인타이틀}. Use bold Korean typography with refined magazine layout energy.
2) Lead strip under header: include a small editorial intro block with {에디터명}, {공간}, and a short Korean note about how to choose the mood by lighting, texture, and palette.
3) Main collage grid: arrange 8 style cards in a balanced vertical sequence, each card centered around one style from {스타일목록} and paired with {공간} imagery, so the comparison reads clearly from top to bottom.
4) Within each card: place {요소콜라주} as a layered arrangement of sofa/chair/table/lighting cutouts, color chips, material samples, curtain/fabric pieces, tile or wood-floor fragments, and small interior detail crops, with one dominant visual anchor per card.
5) Label zone: render {텍스트라벨} as legible caption blocks near each card, including style name, three Korean keywords, recommended room, and one tiny styling tip.
6) Palette zone: show {컬러팔레트} as horizontal chips or stacked swatches with printed color names such as 아이보리, 오크, 차콜, 모스그린, 브라스, 스톤그레이, and warm accent notes.
7) Social save footer: at the bottom, add {계정명}, {해시태그}, {저장문구}, a tiny page indicator 01/08 STYLE GUIDE, and small save/share/comment micro icons rendered as simple editorial UI marks.
8) Final polish: all content appears flatly printed or paper-layered on a curated board, with realistic paper thickness, soft shadows, tape strips, cutout edges, and precise alignment that does not obscure Korean labels.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for Korean labels; bold 700 for headings, medium 500 for supporting text, 18–28px for labels and 36–52px for header feel; optional small handwritten Korean memo style for material notes.
- Color palette: use {컬러팔레트} as the primary color logic for each style, anchored by off-white paper, charcoal text, muted wood tones, fabric beige, stone gray, and style-specific accent swatches.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px warm-gray dividers, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for layered cards, swatches, paper labels, transparent overlays, and cutout samples.
- Editorial details: include magazine-style issue metadata, small grid numbers 01–08, page indicator, handle/hashtag line, micro captions, and tiny material callouts such as 패브릭, 우드, 메탈, 세라믹, 라탄.
- Layout finish: crisp editorial alignment with tactile collage realism, varied paper layers, readable label capsules when needed, and enough visual density to look like a real interior planning board.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: overhead editorial flat lay captured like a 50mm lens on a full-frame camera, with some clipped magazine-catalog cutout realism for the interior samples.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, even exposure with no harsh specular highlights.
- Color grade: warm neutral paper base, muted Scandinavian whites, natural oak browns, stone gray, charcoal, soft moss, terracotta, brass gold, and restrained accent colors matching each style.
- Material realism: visible linen weave, oak grain, walnut grain, brushed metal, ceramic tile speckle, boucle fabric, rattan texture, matte paint chips, and translucent tracing-paper notes.

[6. MOOD]
High-end Korean interior editorial mood board — like a curated home-decor magazine spread mixed with a designer’s real studio planning board, warm, tactile, informative, and share-worthy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear clearly and correctly wherever the labels are rendered: {메인타이틀}, {스타일목록}, {공간}, {요소콜라주}, {텍스트라벨}, {컬러팔레트}, {매거진명}, {이슈번호}, {발행일}, {에디터명}, {계정명}, {해시태그}, {저장문구}.
- Render the 8 style card names clearly in Korean: 북유럽 내추럴, 한옥 모던, 미드센추리, 인더스트리얼, 보헤미안, 웜 우드, 소프트 럭셔리, 일본 와비사비.
- Include realistic printed details in Korean, for example: VOL.247, 2026년 5월호, 에디터 김서윤, 저장해두고 우리 집 톤 고르기, #거실인테리어 #무드보드 #집꾸미기.
- Ensure all 8 style cards remain consistently structured, with no broken Korean characters, no garbled typography, no missing label blocks, and no overlaps that hide the captions or palette chips.
- Keep the collage treatment flat and editorial, with realistic paper cutout edges, tactile material samples, and crisp alignment across the full page.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized portrait likenesses

studio:prompts3:ours-550.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
1-2 English lines: Real-estate site-visit review card news for social media, designed as a 9:16 Instagram story with practical liveability insights.
Editorial infographic layout that presents neighborhood, pros, cons, price, photo evidence, and save-worthy comparison cues in a trustworthy Korean magazine-card format.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main card uses a tall 9:16 portrait canvas with a polished editorial grid; top title band occupies about 14% of the frame, content blocks fill the middle 68%, and a compact summary/footer strip sits at the bottom 18%.
- Primary subject is the neighborhood/property story itself, with {매물·동네} as the central context anchor and {대표 사진} distributed across a realistic collage-like panel structure.
- Background treatment: cream paper base with subtle warm grain, charcoal dividers, amber accent tags, faint map-line texture, small annotation marks, and a tactile printed-magazine surface rather than a glossy app mockup.
- Add realistic card-news metadata: slide number “01/08”, page indicator dots, small handle “@homefield.note”, date label “2026.05 현장 기록”, and short Korean utility labels such as “실거주 체크”, “임장노트 VOL.018”, “저장하고 비교하기”.
- Use {매물·동네}, {장점 3}, {단점 2}, {가격·정보}, {대표 사진}, {컬러 톤}, {비율} placeholders naturally inside the card.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 14%): large Korean headline “부동산 임장 후기 카드뉴스”, a small series label “임장노트 VOL.018”, slide marker “01/08”, and a smaller subtitle line introducing {매물·동네} in a concise editorial tone.
- Hero information block (upper-middle 20%): place {가격·정보} in a bold statistic-style box with thin rules, left-aligned hierarchy, a small “가격·관리비·입주 가능일” label row, and tiny comparison chips like “역세권”, “생활권”, “학군”.
- Pros panel (middle-left 22%): show {장점 3} as three stacked numbered bullets with short separators, amber check icons, and small sublabels such as “교통”, “채광”, “생활편의” for a practical site-visit feel.
- Cons panel (middle-right 22%): show {단점 2} as two numbered bullets with charcoal caution markers, compact memo lines, and a small note tag “재방문 시 확인”.
- Visual montage strip (lower-middle 22%): arrange {대표 사진} as a four-part image collage with exterior facade, nearby street, interior detail, and school/station cue panels; include tiny Korean captions under each frame such as “단지 입구”, “주변 상권”, “거실 채광”, “도보 동선”.
- Footer band (bottom 18%): summarize the card with {컬러 톤} as a small palette note and {비율} as a layout stamp; include page indicator “● ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○”, micro CTA “저장하고 비교하기”, hashtags “#임장후기 #실거주리뷰 #아파트체크”, and a small credit line “editor: field note team”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for body and labels, with Pretendard SemiBold for headings and Noto Sans KR Medium for detail lines; title size should feel bold and compact, body text smaller but highly legible.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} with cream #F4EFE6, charcoal #2F2F2F, warm amber #C98A3A, muted taupe #B8AA9B, and soft gray #D8D4CD.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px charcoal rules, soft paper-edge shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 14% opacity, subtle rounded corners, layered paper tabs, small map-pin icons, and printed divider lines.
- Infographic details should look practical and lived-in: inspection memo ticks, tiny route arrows, neighborhood icons, caption bars, sticker-like amber labels, and realistic editorial spacing that still keeps hierarchy readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean editorial flat-lay and architectural-documentary feel, as if shot on a Sony A7R IV with 35mm lens for the exterior/street panels and 50mm lens for interior detail crops at f/5.6.
- Lighting: soft overcast daylight with subtle window-fill look from upper-left, gentle ambient bounce, no hard contrast, no flash glare.
- Color grade: warm cream + charcoal + amber with restrained saturation, slightly muted real-estate magazine print finish.
- Image panels should feel like genuine site-visit documentation: apartment exterior texture, street signage blur, pavement, window light, interior wall/floor material, and small environmental cues that support liveability review context.

[6. MOOD]
Trustworthy real-estate magazine review — resembling a premium Korean lifestyle editorial spread with a Kinfolk-meets-architecture digest sensibility, but enriched with practical field-note details, comparison cues, and social-card saveability.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문자열 — “부동산 임장 후기 카드뉴스”, “{매물·동네}”, “{장점 3}”, “{단점 2}”, “{가격·정보}”, “{대표 사진}”, “{컬러 톤}”, “{비율}”
- Additional Korean text may include: “임장노트 VOL.018”, “2026.05 현장 기록”, “실거주 체크”, “재방문 시 확인”, “저장하고 비교하기”, “#임장후기 #실거주리뷰”.
- All Korean text must be crisp and correctly rendered; no broken Hangul, no OCR-like corruption, no mixed spacing errors.
- Maintain the exact 9:16 portrait card-news framing with balanced editorial hierarchy, structured grid alignment, realistic photo-collage evidence, and a trustworthy real-estate review tone.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-549.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean monthly horoscope card set covering all 12 western zodiac signs on a single shareable poster.
Premium mystic magazine spread feel with modern infographic clarity, designed for Instagram carousel cover, blog hero, or printed astrology insert.
The final image should feel like a real editorial astrology page: rich star-chart details, issue metadata, small captions, credits, and tactile print texture while keeping all 12 zodiac cards readable.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header band (~14%): {헤드라인} centered with serif treatment, {서브 헤드라인} sub-line below in smaller scale, plus a small date capsule reading "{기간}" and editorial label "WESTERN ASTROLOGY REPORT".
- Add magazine-style micro details in the header: "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", tiny price text "₩7,500", and a short Korean cover blurb such as "이번 달 별의 흐름을 한눈에".
- Center grid (~62%): 3 columns x 4 rows of 12 zodiac cards arranged per {카드 레이아웃}, equal gutters and identical card dimensions.
- Each individual card divided into 3 zones (constellation art on top, sign name in middle, outlook lines on bottom) with {카드 디테일} applied to corners, badges, micro labels, and dividers.
- Bottom footer (~14%): horizontal divider with {발신 정보}, small decorative star ornaments, page label "ASTRO GUIDE 01", tiny credit line "기획·편집: 별자리 에디터", and a small barcode-like area at the lower-right.
- Background: layered soft starfield with {배경 텍스처} overlaying the entire poster, subtle grain, faint zodiac wheel arcs, tiny orbital paths, celestial dust, and a gentle paper-print finish.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone: render {헤드라인} large in classic English serif paired with Korean Myeongjo, {서브 헤드라인} smaller beneath, plus a thin gold horizontal rule with a star icon on each end.
2) Header metadata row: place "{기간}", "VOL.247", "MONTHLY HOROSCOPE", and "12 SIGNS" as small editorial labels; include two short Korean feature blurbs such as "행운의 방향 체크" and "관계·일·금전 흐름" without overpowering the main headline.
3) Card grid (3x4): 12 cards drawn from {별자리 12종}, each card same template, framed by 1px gold border with subtle inner glow, warm paper-like card fill, and refined shadow.
4) Each card top: {행성·기호 결} — delicate gold line-art constellation with bright star points connected, planet symbol placed in upper-right, faint circular astrological glyph ring behind it.
5) Each card middle: zodiac sign name in {폰트 톤} — Korean name large + English name small, centered; add a tiny date-range style label below the English name for realistic magazine detail.
6) Each card bottom: short outlook lines covering {운세 카테고리} (three to four single-line Korean sentences max, separated by hairline rules), with category labels clearly visible and small star bullets.
7) Footer zone: {발신 정보} centered between two star ornaments, edition mark, micro copyright-style line "© ASTRO NOTE", tiny social handle "@astro.note.kr", and a scannable-looking barcode block as decorative print detail.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: classic display serif (Cormorant Garamond / Playfair-style) for English sign names and editorial labels, Nanum Myeongjo for Korean text, weight balanced so the sign name dominates each card.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} — dark navy #0E1633 base, deep purple #4B2A78 accent, gold #C4A465 for stars and dividers, soft warm white #F5F1E8 for primary text.
- Borders & dividers: 1px gold rule around each card, 0.5px hairline inside between zones, 4px y-offset / 14px blur / 18% opacity drop shadow under each card.
- Star ornaments: small 4-pointed stars at consistent corners, supported by tiny moons, orbital ticks, and celestial map marks where they enhance the editorial astrology mood.

[1. PURPOSE]
Console game box mockup rendered as a realistic studio product photograph, square format, suitable for e-commerce thumbnail, portfolio showcase, or promotional key visual.
Korean-packaging-style game box with shelf-ready retail details, tactile packaging materials, readable cover information, and believable store-display presence.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {플랫폼} game box placed centered and slightly angled in a 3/4 front view, occupying about 62% of the frame height, with the front cover fully readable and the spine partially visible.
- Background: {배경} interpreted as a premium studio-packshot environment with a soft cool-gray gradient near the bottom, realistic tabletop reflections, and a grounded cast shadow under the box.
- Framing: square 1:1 product composition with enough surrounding space for a retail catalog feel while still allowing the box, spine, and small packaging details to be clearly seen.
- Surface: matte white tabletop with subtle paper grain, light dust-level texture, soft reflection along the bottom edge, and a few natural studio photography imperfections that make the product feel real.
- Packaging detail logic: build the visible cover system around {박스 표지}, {게임 제목·장르}, {시리즈명·평점}, and {컬러 톤}, including Korean retail copy, barcode zone, age-rating icon area, edition sticker, and small spine text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Box silhouette layer — Create a crisp retail box shape based on {플랫폼}, with realistic plastic case edge thickness, slight perspective, transparent sleeve reflections, tiny bevels, hinge ridge, and clean front-face readability.
2. Front cover design — Place {박스 표지} on the main face, with the game title from {게임 제목·장르} dominating the upper-middle area and the character art centered as the hero focus; add a smaller Korean genre subtitle line such as "액션 어드벤처 RPG" or "전략 시뮬레이션" where it fits the theme.
3. Retail information system — Add believable Korean package elements: an age-rating square at lower-left, a barcode block at lower-right, publisher/developer microtext, a compact price sticker reading "₩69,800", and a small label such as "초회 특전 동봉" or "디지털 사운드트랙 포함".
4. Badge system — Add {시리즈명·평점} as a small premium medal, review-score badge, or award callout near an upper corner, with star marks rendered as clean metallic graphics; include a short Korean line like "평점 9.2" or "올해의 기대작" without implying an official certification.
5. Platform identity — Integrate {플랫폼} branding cues into the box spine, top banner, and side label in an authentic console-packaging manner; allow the platform name to be readable as packaging text, with small icons, controller cues, and model-compatible color accents.
6. Back/side realism hints — On the visible spine edge, add vertical title text, a tiny catalog code such as "VOL.247-KR", a small platform strip, and thin registration marks; if a sliver of the back cover is visible, show miniature screenshot panels and caption blocks.
7. Background treatment — Use {배경} as a studio-packshot environment, with a soft cast shadow, subtle reflection, and small shelf-ready realism such as a removable round promo sticker on the shrink wrap, while keeping the product as the clear hero.
8. Color system — Apply {컬러 톤} across the title panel, accent bars, sticker highlights, spine stripe, rating block, and small UI labels, while keeping the overall box visually balanced, readable, and premium.
9. Format logic — Build the final image as a perfectly square 1:1 mockup with the box centered and the cover art fully visible, matching {비율}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a bold geometric sans for the main title (Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold, title size equivalent to 120–160 px), with compact label fonts for genre, barcode captions, edition tags, rating text, and spine microcopy (Pretendard Medium, 24–48 px depending on scale).
- Korean cover text examples: include short realistic labels such as "초회 한정판", "온라인 플레이 지원", "스토리 모드", "한국어 자막", "예약 특전", "출시일 2026.05.21", and "공식 가이드 코드 포함" where compositionally appropriate.
- Color palette: combine platform signature color cues with dark neon game accents; recommended tones include deep charcoal #12141A, electric cyan #00D7FF, violet #7B61FF, white #F7F7F5, and metallic silver #C7CCD6.
- Border/shadow: thin clean box-edge highlights, soft drop shadow with 4 px y-offset, 16 px blur, 18% opacity, and a subtle ambient contact shadow under the base; add tiny sleeve glare along the plastic wrap and realistic darkened side edges.
- Print finish: semi-matte packaging lamination with sharp CMYK-like contrast, slight paper fiber in printed areas, controlled plastic sleeve reflections, and glossy shine only on shrink-wrap edges or metallic badge accents.
- Detail density: create a believable retail package with cover title, top banner, spine text, barcode area, legal microcopy, rating block, promo sticker, and small screenshot/caption hints, all arranged with professional packaging hierarchy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product photography, 50mm lens at f/8, straight-on with a slight 10° off-axis rotation for depth, high-resolution catalog framing.
- Lighting: large softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, very soft edge rim light to separate the box from the white background, and subtle specular highlights on the plastic sleeve.
- Color grade: clean neutral white balance with subtle cool shadows, dark neon highlights, realistic CMYK print density, and restrained saturation for a premium retail mockup feel.
- Material realism: visible plastic case rim, semi-transparent sleeve reflection, printed cover paper beneath the sleeve, lightly beveled corners, tiny seam lines, and a believable barcode/price-label paper texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium game-store packaging mockup — polished catalog product shot with the realism of an actual boxed console release, combining collector-edition energy, readable Korean retail details, and high-end console display clarity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: ensure these verbatim Korean strings appear correctly where applicable: "플랫폼", "게임 제목·장르", "박스 표지", "시리즈명·평점", "배경", "컬러 톤", "비율".
- Render added Korean packaging text cleanly, including examples such as "초회 한정판", "출시일 2026.05.21", "한국어 자막", "온라인 플레이 지원", "평점 9.2", and "₩69,800" if used.
- The box must remain a single coherent product mockup, with correct perspective, straight typography, realistic packaging proportions, readable spine details, and believable plastic-case material.
- All visible text must be cleanly rendered with no broken Korean characters, no warped letters, and no fake certification seals.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

- Use {시그니처 컬러}, {로고 결}, {유니폼 디자인}, {레이아웃}, {비율} as the customizable design directions.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Logo zone (left 40%): build a bold esports team mark for {팀명}, using {로고 결} with a sharp geometric silhouette or animal-inspired emblem, rendered like a professional team identity sheet with main emblem, monochrome version, icon-only version, and small clear-space diagram.
2) Team name treatment: place {팀명} beneath or beside the emblem in a compact wordmark style, with strong spacing and clear legibility, matching a T1 / DRX / Gen.G-inspired competitive branding mood while remaining original.
3) Color system: apply {시그니처 컬러} as the main accent set against black, using controlled neon highlights on key edges, strokes, split lines, swatches, jersey trims, UI tabs, and micro labels so the identity feels premium and energetic.
4) Uniform zone (right 60%): present {유니폼 디자인} as a realistic jersey mockup, showing front and back views plus a small sleeve/collar detail inset; fabric must show breathable mesh, stitched seams, ribbed collar, sublimation print, and subtle wrinkles.
5) Sponsor and placement logic: include realistic placeholder sponsor areas such as ‘MAIN SPONSOR’, ‘GEAR PARTNER’, ‘ENERGY PARTNER’, sleeve mark blocks, player name ‘ACE’, number ‘07’, and a small back-neck team tag, all aligned to a grid like a real esports kit spec board.
6) Board information layer: add Korean section labels and metadata such as ‘2026 시즌 키트’, ‘HOME JERSEY’, ‘브랜드 가이드 V1.2’, ‘제작일 2026.05’, ‘선수명 / 번호 위치’, ‘소매 패치 영역’, ‘통기성 메쉬 원단’, and ‘공식 SNS @team_handle’.
7) Presentation polish: add subtle UI-style separators, thin lines, color-chip cards, scale marks, tiny QR-like texture block, tactical map-inspired grid fragments, and caption labels so the board reads like a professional esports brand proposal rather than a plain mockup.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for Korean labels, bold condensed sans for the team wordmark, medium weight for captions, 22–34px size range for hierarchy, with tight but readable tracking; tiny technical labels may be 10–14px but must remain clean.
- Color palette: deep black #0B0B0F, graphite #1A1D24, neon green #39FF88, electric red #FF3B30, violet #8A4DFF, cool white #F4F7FB; use {시그니처 컬러} as the accent rule across logo strokes, jersey trim, panel dividers, and swatches.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px divider lines, fine technical strokes, soft shadow 0 8px 24px at 18% opacity under the jersey mockup, subtle rim highlights on fabric folds, and restrained glow around selected neon accents.
- Surface detail: jersey fabric should look tactile with woven threads, mesh perforations, seam stitching, heat-transfer sponsor marks, collar ribbing, and slight natural garment curvature.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product visualization look, 50mm prime perspective for the jersey mockup, logo area treated as crisp vector artwork, slight top-down tilt for a presentation-board feel.
- Lighting: controlled studio softbox from upper-left at 45° with a faint rim light from the right, plus low-intensity fill to preserve black fabric texture and keep neon accents clean.
- Color grade: high-contrast esports editorial grade with black, graphite, neon green, and electric accent tones; keep whites neutral and prevent oversaturation.
- Realism cues: physical board mockup feeling with layered panels, soft contact shadows, small print imperfections, realistic cloth highlights, fabric grain, and technical annotation stickers integrated into the layout.

[6. MOOD]
High-end competitive esports brand presentation — like a polished team identity board seen in a Riot Games / major tournament sponsor deck, with sharp modern esports energy, launch-day confidence, and believable professional kit-design documentation.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: '{팀명}', 'e-Sports 팀 로고·유니폼 디자인'.
- Additional Korean text to render clearly where appropriate: ‘2026 시즌 키트’, ‘브랜드 가이드 V1.2’, ‘홈 유니폼’, ‘선수명 ACE’, ‘번호 07’, ‘제작일 2026.05’, ‘소매 패치 영역’, ‘통기성 메쉬 원단’.
- Layout invariant: left logo zone and right uniform zone must remain clearly separated, with a professional presentation-board structure enriched by realistic technical labels, swatches, sponsor placeholders, and jersey detail insets.
- Team identity requirement: the design must feel like a real esports organization BI, with crisp geometry, controlled neon accents, readable uniform placement, believable sponsor zones, and tactile jersey material.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized real-player likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Mobile game character card for fantasy RPG-style hero presentation, optimized for a 9:16 vertical mobile UI.
Premium collectible hero card with character illustration, stat panel, rarity badge, skill callout, season metadata, and game-ready UI polish for store banner, gacha screen, or character archive use.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main character occupies the left 55% of the frame as a hero focal point, with the info UI stacked on the right 30% and a slim ornate card frame along the far edge.
- Use {캐릭터 콘셉트} as the visual identity for the character render, keeping the silhouette readable, memorable, and strongly game-card oriented.
- Display the character name {캐릭터명} near the upper-left or upper-center in large Korean title typography, with {클래스·속성} as a smaller subtitle line beneath it.
- Pose must follow {포즈}, with the weapon, spell gesture, cape, or armor shape angled to create a diagonal line toward the upper right.
- Place {레벨·등급} as a premium badge cluster near the top-right corner, using star rating, elemental icon, and small metallic medallion treatment.
- Place {스탯 정보} in a right-side box with labeled rows, separators, icon dots, and compact RPG status-panel hierarchy.
- Add {카드 메타} as small collectible-card metadata near the lower-right edge, such as season label, card number, update date, or archive category.
- Place {스킬 카피} in a prominent lower-mid caption strip or skill banner with high contrast, glowing edge, and sharp legibility.
- Include {출시·획득 정보} as a tiny footer line or store-style tag to make the card feel like an actual mobile game asset.
- Background must follow {배경}, with depth separation, atmospheric particles, environmental props, banners, ruins, foliage, sparks, or magic traces that naturally fit the fantasy setting.
- Overall framing should feel like a premium collectible character card, with layered UI zones, ornate trim, badges, micro icons, and readable hierarchy across a vertical mobile screen.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero zone (left 55%): Render the character as the main visual anchor, with crisp edges, dramatic pose energy, armor/fabric/material detail, expressive face, and readable weapon or magic silhouette.
2. Name and identity zone (upper area): Show {캐릭터명} in bold Korean title type, add {클래스·속성}, and include a small role icon such as 탱커, 딜러, 서포터, 암살자, 마법사, or 궁수 if it matches the concept.
3. Stat panel (right 30%): Build a vertical game UI box for {스탯 정보}, using clean separators, compact typography, numeric emphasis, small icons, and a metallic or glass-like panel treatment.
4. Rarity and badge cluster: Render {레벨·등급} with star icons, an elemental crest, upgrade frame, and {장식·배지} such as 한정, 신규, 전설, 각성, 시즌 보너스, or 이벤트 획득.
5. Skill banner (lower center-right): Display {스킬 카피} in a bold ability-callout strip, with stronger contrast than the stat panel, luminous trim, and a slightly larger type scale.
6. Metadata/footer zone: Add {카드 메타} and {출시·획득 정보} as realistic mobile-game UI microcopy, including collection number, patch date, acquisition route, probability note, or event period.
7. Background layer: Apply {배경} as a fantasy game environment backdrop with atmospheric depth, naturally placed world details, magic particles, banners, ruins, weapon racks, moonlight, embers, or mist.
8. Accent framing: Add dark fantasy edges, gold trim, gem insets, diagonal corner plates, small UI ticks, and signature highlight accents that reinforce a premium RPG card feel.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for UI text, with bold 700–800 weight for headers and medium 500–600 weight for stats; skill text can use a condensed bold style at a slightly larger size.
- Korean title hierarchy: {캐릭터명} should be the largest readable Korean text; {스킬 카피} should be the second most visually important text; stat labels and metadata should remain crisp at mobile-card scale.
- Color palette: deep charcoal #121212, black-brown #1A1410, gold #C9A24A, warm amber #D8B15A, and one signature accent color from {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: use a subtle gold frame with soft drop shadow, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; panel edges should be clean, slightly beveled, and game-UI crisp.
- UI detailing: add small icons for HP, ATK, DEF, SPD, elemental affinity, rarity stars, lock/unlock status, upgrade arrow, and collection number; these should support the card fantasy rather than cover the face.
- Material rendering: armor, leather, fabric, metal, gems, weapon edges, spell effects, and background props should have high-quality fantasy illustration detail suitable for a polished RPG launch screen.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end fantasy key art look, equivalent to a 85mm portrait lens at f/2.0 for character clarity, with UI layers composited like a polished game promotional card.
- Lighting: dramatic studio-key lighting from upper-left at 45°, faint rim light from the right, and controlled shadow falloff to separate the figure from the background.
- Color grade: dark fantasy game grading with gold highlights, desaturated midtones, and a signature accent hue consistent with {컬러 톤}.
- Finish: premium mobile RPG splash-art finish, semi-realistic fantasy rendering, crisp UI overlays, luminous particles, embossed card frame, and collectible gacha-card presentation.

[6. MOOD]
Premium mobile RPG character card — polished fantasy game key art with the presentation feel of League of Legends, Seven Knights, and Genshin Impact promotional UI.
The mood should feel collectible, powerful, event-ready, and believable as a real in-game hero profile card released during a seasonal update.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "아리아", "빛의 발키리", "LV.80 / 등급 ★★★★★", "HP 1200 / ATK 350 / DEF 280 / SPD 95", "천공의 검 — 5초 무적·범위 공격".
- Additional readable UI text to include: "시즌 06", "컬렉터 NO. A-247", "2026년 5월 1일 업데이트", "픽업 소환 확률 0.8%", "한정 각성".
- Card layout must keep the character as the dominant hero focal point, the stats box on the right, the rarity badge at the top-right, and the skill line clearly readable as a game UI element.
- All Korean and English text must be clean, correctly rendered, and free of broken characters or spacing errors.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity face composites or real-person identity imitation

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean veterinary clinic informational card news for vaccination guidance and preventive care, designed as a vertical social-media carousel cover and clinic announcement poster with a polished medical editorial feel.
Useful for pet owners browsing clinic announcements, vaccination schedules, preventive-care reminders, and save/share-friendly pet health guidance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Build a tall 4:6 vertical card news layout for 1024x1536 mobile viewing, with a magazine-like clinic header, a practical vaccination information panel, a friendly hero illustration, and a clear booking/contact footer.
- Use {안내 종류} as the primary headline content, supported by {대상·시기}, {핵심 팁}, and small realistic clinic labels such as {작성일}, {슬라이드 번호}/{전체 슬라이드}, and {페이지 표시}.
- Place {병원명}, {연락처}, {진료시간}, and {위치} as a real clinic identity block near the lower section, with {예약 안내} and {CTA 문구} as save/share-oriented guidance.
- The background should be bright white or pale mint with subtle paper grain, soft rounded panels, faint paw-print motifs, tiny medical cross graphics, syringe/checklist icons, and friendly decorative tags that suit a veterinary clinic card news post.
- Maintain clear mobile readability while allowing realistic informational density: short checklist rows, small caption labels, a slide-number badge, page dots, hashtag text, and a footer CTA strip should all feel intentionally designed.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone (top 15%): Set a small clinic label line with {병원명}, {작성일}, and a pill badge reading CARD NEWS. Add {슬라이드 번호}/{전체 슬라이드} on the upper-right and a tiny paw/cross accent near the title.
2) Main title zone (upper 18%): Place the title '동물병원 안내·예방접종 카드뉴스' in bold Korean sans-serif, then use {안내 종류} as a prominent subtitle. Add a thin colored divider with a small syringe or shield icon.
3) Information panel (upper-middle 20%): Present {대상·시기} as a schedule notice inside a rounded medical chart card. Include two or three compact checklist rows such as '접종 전 컨디션 확인', '접종 기록 지참', '이상 반응 24시간 관찰', plus {핵심 팁} as a highlighted amber note.
4) Hero illustration zone (middle 30%): Feature {대표 비주얼} as the central visual cluster. Place a friendly veterinarian character, dog and cat illustrations, a stethoscope, vaccine vial, heart, shield, calendar, and paw-print labels as cohesive flat editorial graphics.
5) Clinic info and booking block (lower 12%): Display {병원명}, {연락처}, {진료시간}, and {위치} in stacked rows with small phone, clock, map-pin, and chat icons. Add {예약 안내} in a small speech-bubble tag.
6) Footer strip (bottom 5%): Apply {컬러 톤} as the accent system for a rounded footer band containing {CTA 문구}, {해시태그}, save/share micro icons, and {페이지 표시} as carousel page dots.
7) Size treatment: Optimize every text block for 1024x1536 vertical social viewing, using large hierarchy for the title, medium-weight labels for schedule details, and compact but legible microcopy for the footer.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text; headline in Bold 800, subtitle in Bold 700, schedule rows in Medium 500, contact line in SemiBold 600, footer microcopy in Medium 500.
- Color palette: Use the clinic palette from {컬러 톤}, grounded by white #FFFFFF, soft mint #EAF7F2, muted blue #DCEAF7, leaf green #35B883, and warm amber #F4C56A for highlights.
- Border/shadow: Rounded panels with soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), thin keyline borders in a slightly darker tint of the main accent color, and small tab labels attached to chart cards.
- Graphic treatment: Icons should be simple flat vector shapes with consistent stroke width, soft fills, rounded corners, friendly pet-clinic character illustration, and subtle tactile paper texture.
- Editorial details: Include realistic card news elements such as carousel dots, slide numbering, save/share icons, compact captions, hashtag-style text, and a clear appointment CTA without making unrealistic medical claims.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Clean editorial layout rendered like a high-resolution poster mockup, resembling a 50mm standard product composition with flat graphic spacing rather than a photographic scene.
- Lighting: Bright studio-white ambience with even illumination, soft panel depth, gentle icon shading, and a premium printed-card finish.
- Color grade: Fresh clinical white + soft green/blue + warm amber accent, with low contrast and slightly softened saturation to create a trustworthy medical tone.

[6. MOOD]
Premium pet clinic editorial — a friendly hospital information card with the organized clarity of a modern wellness brochure, the practical detail of a clinic notice board, and the warm personality of a boutique veterinary brand.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문구 — '동물병원 안내·예방접종 카드뉴스', '{안내 종류}', '{대상·시기}', '{핵심 팁}', '{병원명}', '{연락처}', '{진료시간}', '{위치}', '{예약 안내}', '{CTA 문구}', '{해시태그}'.
- Required card-news details: 상단에 '{슬라이드 번호}/{전체 슬라이드}', 하단에 '{페이지 표시}', 저장/공유 마이크로 아이콘, 작성일 '{작성일}'을 포함한다.
- Layout invariants: vertical stacked clinic card news, bold title first, schedule panel second, animal/veterinarian illustration as the dominant visual, and contact/booking block clearly separated near the bottom.
- All Korean text must render with correct spacing, punctuation, and no broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites
- Misleading guaranteed cure or exaggerated medical claims

[1. PURPOSE]
Premium pet food and snack package advertisement for dog/cat dry food, treats, wet cans, and pet nutrition branding.
Square e-commerce/social ad composition that feels like a premium natural pet food label, with product-first packaging presentation, realistic retail details, and appetizing ingredient cues.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {제품} package placed slightly left of center, occupying about 48% of the frame height, with the brand mark clearly readable on the front panel.
- Background treatment: warm cream studio-to-lifestyle backdrop with subtle paper texture, soft tabletop surface, faint pantry-shelf depth, and natural shadow gradients that make the product feel photographed in a real premium pet-food campaign.
- Supporting still life: {배경 정물} arranged in a low semicircle around the base of the package, including a small ceramic pet bowl, scattered kibble, fresh ingredient pieces, and tiny printed label cards that support the nutrition story.
- Text placement: {강조 카피} set as a strong ad headline near the upper-right or upper-center, accompanied by short Korean micro-copy such as “신선한 한 끼”, “하루 영양 밸런스”, and “우리 아이 맞춤 레시피”.
- Framing direction: product-shot framing with premium editorial spacing; props concentrated around the lower and side areas while the package remains the clear hero.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area: {제품} rendered as a premium package with sharp folded edges, realistic paper or pouch material, subtle matte finish, visible zipper seam or can rim when appropriate, front face fully visible with believable pack thickness and gentle perspective.
- Brand zone: {브랜드} printed on the top third of the package in a strong, refined logo treatment, aligned horizontally and kept high-contrast against the packaging color.
- Packaging design details: {패키지 디자인} with kraft-brown or white refined structure, charming dog/cat illustration, flavor name in Korean, nutrition-focused graphic accents such as small leaves, grain icons, protein markers, feeding-guide strip, net weight label “1.8kg”, barcode/QR area, batch date stamp, and a small price tag “₩27,900”.
- Base still life: {배경 정물} placed near the bottom edge, including scattered kibble pieces, a wooden scoop, ceramic bowl, ingredient illustrations mixed with realistic chicken/salmon cubes, pumpkin, carrot, peas, or sweet potato depending on the product theme; scale and shadows must feel natural.
- Copy block: {강조 카피} placed as a concise headline or badge-style callout, supported by 2–3 small Korean benefit blurbs: “저온 건조 원료”, “기호성 테스트 완료 표현 금지 대신 맛있게 즐기는 레시피”, “소화가 편한 식단”. Use non-official decorative badges only, not certification seals.
- Retail detail layer: add a small shelf-card or product info strip near the lower-right reading “NEW RECIPE”, “정기배송 10%”, “오늘의 추천 간식”, plus tiny icons for protein, fiber, and hydration to make the ad feel like a real e-commerce product tile.
- Color direction: {컬러 톤} applied across packaging, props, typography, small labels, bowl, and background accents so the whole composition feels cohesive and premium.
- Format cue: {비율} maintained as a centered square ad with strong symmetry and clear marketplace/social-feed readability.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for headline and supporting copy, bold 700 for {강조 카피}, medium 500 for labels, 26–44px equivalent sizing for headline, 10–18px equivalent for package micro-labels and shelf-card details.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with specific use of cream #F5F0E6, natural green #6F8B5A, charcoal #2E2E2E, warm kraft brown #8A623F, off-white #FAFAF7, and subtle ingredient colors like carrot orange, salmon pink, and pea green.
- Border/shadow: soft product shadow 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 16% opacity; realistic contact shadows under the bowl, kibble, scoop, and package; matte packaging highlights without glossy plastic shine.
- Layout finish: polished commercial packaging-ad aesthetic with real package printing details, appetizing ingredient styling, crisp edges, readable Korean text, and print-ready contrast.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm product lens look, f/5.6 equivalent, straight-on commercial packshot framing with minimal distortion.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, very subtle fill from right, controlled shadow falloff beneath the package and props, gentle rim highlight on package edges.
- Color grade: warm cream + sage green + charcoal with natural wood-toned neutrals, lightly desaturated for a premium organic-food look, with realistic texture in paper, kibble, bowl ceramic, and tabletop surface.

[6. MOOD]

[1. PURPOSE]

Create a real-looking classroom flashcard worksheet for {단어 셋 주제}, with friendly illustrations, big English words, smaller Korean meanings, and practical print details such as a title header, cut guides, page label, and teacher/parent note area.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 10-card learning set arranged as a 2x5 grid on a vertical page, each card evenly spaced with visible dotted cut lines, rounded card corners, and practical trimming guides.
- Use {단어 셋 주제} as the thematic category for the entire sheet, and use {10단어} as the exact 10 vocabulary items shown across the cards.
- Each card should follow {포맷}, with the illustration occupying the main area, the English word placed prominently below or beside it, and the Korean translation kept smaller but clearly readable.
- Overall page uses {레이아웃} logic, with consistent card sizes, rounded borders, small card numbers 01–10, and a cohesive worksheet structure.
- Add a top header band with Korean title text such as “오늘의 영어 단어 카드”, a small category label “주제: {단어 셋 주제}”, and a date/classroom memo line such as “DATE: 2026.05 / CLASS: SUNNY ROOM”.
- Add a subtle footer with “CUT & LEARN MINI CARDS”, page indicator “1/1”, tiny scissors icons near cut lines, and a short Korean note: “오려서 단어 놀이에 활용해요.”
- Background should be a soft cream paper base with gentle paper grain, pastel accent blocks, small sticker-like stars/dots, and rounded borders matching {컬러 팔레트}, creating a warm educational stationery look.
- Typography must support {타이포} in a playful but highly readable hierarchy, with strong contrast between the English word and the smaller Korean text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Full-page canvas: build a vertical 1024x1536 printable sheet with 2 columns and 5 rows, uniform gutter spacing, trim-safe outer edges, and a finished worksheet appearance.
2. Header layer: place a compact title strip at the top with “오늘의 영어 단어 카드”, “{단어 셋 주제}”, “10 WORDS”, and a small blank name field “NAME: ______”.
3. Card frame layer: each mini card gets a rounded rectangle frame, pastel border, soft inner background patch, dotted cutting line, and tiny card number badge in the corner.
4. Illustration zone: place one large kid-friendly illustration inside each card, centered and color-blocked with clean edges; for daily objects, include recognizable details like a cup handle, pencil eraser, book pages, toy blocks, toothbrush bristles, or bag zipper where relevant.
5. English word zone: set each target English word from {10단어} in a large rounded font beneath the illustration, centered, bold, and highly legible at a distance.
6. Korean meaning zone: place the Korean label in a smaller size directly under the English word, aligned with the card center, crisp and readable.
7. Learning detail layer: add tiny decorative tags on some cards such as “say it!”, “listen”, “trace”, or small sound-wave icons, without covering the vocabulary text.
8. Themed consistency: repeat the same visual system across all 10 cards so the set feels like one cohesive learning deck rather than separate posters.
9. Print-friendly finish: keep letter contrast strong, card edges clear, and illustrations simple enough to print well on paper while still feeling like a finished educational product.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use rounded kid-friendly fonts such as Cafe24 Ssurround or Pretendard Round; English words in bold 34–44px equivalent, Korean text in medium 18–24px equivalent; header text slightly larger with playful weight contrast.
- Color palette: cream base with pastel pink, mint, yellow, sky blue accents; rounded outlines in soft gray or muted navy; keep saturation gentle and classroom-friendly, following {컬러 팔레트}.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 2–4px y-offset, 8–12px blur, 10–15% opacity; thin rounded border strokes and dotted trim guides for a realistic cut-card sheet.
- Add small realistic print-production details: pale registration ticks, tiny scissors marks, subtle paper fiber texture, and a footer code like “VOCAB MINI SET VOL.010”.
- Use {비율} consistently so each card and illustration feels balanced within the 1024x1536 vertical page.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing flat poster layout, digitally designed as a print sheet, as if photographed with a 50mm lens on a perfectly perpendicular copy stand for zero perspective distortion.
- Lighting: even studio softbox-like illumination with no harsh shadows, high-key flat brightness, consistent across the whole sheet.
- Color grade: pastel cream + pink + mint + yellow + sky blue with gentle low-contrast kindergarten workbook tone.
- Material impression: matte printable paper with soft grain, lightly inked pastel shapes, clean vector-like illustrations, and a believable worksheet finish rather than a sterile mockup.

[6. MOOD]
Cute, educational, and print-ready — like a modern Montessori flashcard sheet blended with Korean kindergarten workbook design, Japanese stationery charm, and cheerful at-home learning material.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all Korean text, including “오늘의 영어 단어 카드”, “주제: {단어 셋 주제}”, “오려서 단어 놀이에 활용해요”, and every Korean meaning from {10단어}, must be rendered cleanly and correctly with no broken characters.
- Maintain exact 2x5 card logic on a single vertical page, with all 10 cards evenly aligned and fully visible.
- English words and Korean meanings must remain legible, with the English word larger than the Korean translation on every card.
- Use the vocabulary list implied by {10단어}; show exactly 10 distinct mini-cards, one vocabulary item per card.
- Keep the visual theme tied to {단어 셋 주제}, with child-friendly everyday-object illustrations that match the word labels.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters / 한글 깨짐
- Fake official seals / certifications

studio:prompts3:ours-537.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
유아·키즈 캐릭터 굿즈 목업 콜라주, 4종 상품을 한 화면에 배치한 평면 편집형 제품 시안.
밝고 안전한 키즈 캐릭터 브랜드의 신상품 카탈로그 한 페이지처럼, 캐릭터 중심 브랜드 소개용과 상품 제안서에 바로 사용할 수 있는 구성.
실제 키즈 브랜드 카탈로그 촬영처럼 제품 라벨, 가격 태그, 작은 패키지 카드, 시즌 문구, 주문 정보, 바코드, SKU, 매장 연락처가 함께 보이는 현실적인 굿즈 세트 프레젠테이션.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 화면 전체는 가로형 4종 굿즈 콜라주 구성이며, 중앙에 {캐릭터} hero가 가장 먼저 보이도록 배치하고 주변에 {굿즈 4종}이 자연스럽게 둘러싼다.
- {레이아웃} 느낌을 유지하되 각 상품의 형태와 인쇄 면이 잘 읽히도록 배치하고, 제품 사이에는 작은 가격 태그, 컬러칩, 캐릭터 스티커 조각, 패키지 라벨 카드, 접힌 행택, 샘플 주문서 조각이 함께 놓인 실제 촬영 세트처럼 구성한다.
- 배경은 밝은 크림 베이지 바탕에 아주 옅은 종이결 텍스처와 부드러운 파스텔 도형 패턴을 더해, 장난감 패키지 촬영처럼 탑뷰+정면 혼합 목업 감각을 유지한다.
- 모든 상품 표면은 과한 반사 없이 매트하고 부드럽게 표현하되, 텀블러의 반광, 키링의 에나멜 광택, 스티커북의 종이 질감, 티셔츠의 면 원단 결이 서로 구분되도록 사실적인 재질감을 살린다.
- {캐릭터 결}이 잘 드러나도록 큰 머리와 작은 몸 비율을 강조하되, 각 굿즈의 인쇄물과 오브젝트 형태는 선명하고 실제 판매 상품처럼 완성도 있게 보이게 한다.
- 상단에는 작은 카탈로그 헤더처럼 “{브랜드명}”, “키즈 굿즈 세트”, “{시즌 문구}”, “VOL.03”을 넣고, 하단에는 상품 정보 바와 간단한 주문 안내 느낌의 미니 텍스트를 배치한다.
- 우측 하단에는 제품 제안서처럼 “샘플 이미지”, “납품 상담 가능”, “권장 연령 3세+” 같은 작은 보조 문구를 넣어 실제 B2B 굿즈 카탈로그의 현실감을 더한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (center 30~35%): {캐릭터}를 가장 큰 시각 요소로 배치하고, 둥글둥글한 머리 실루엣과 파스텔 색감을 중심으로 한 컷의 핵심 아이콘처럼 보이게 한다. 캐릭터 옆에는 작은 말풍선 또는 스티커 태그로 “안녕!” 또는 “같이 놀자” 같은 짧은 한글 문구를 넣는다.
2. Product row 1: {굿즈 4종} 중 티셔츠는 좌측 상단 또는 좌측 중앙에 평평하게 놓인 목업 형태로 배치해 프린트 디자인이 또렷하게 보이게 한다. 티셔츠 목 라벨에는 “KIDS 110”, 작은 행택에는 “반팔티 ₩19,900”, 세탁 라벨에는 “찬물 세탁”을 넣어 실제 상품처럼 보이게 한다.
3. Product row 2: 텀블러는 우측 상단 또는 우측 중앙에 세워서 배치하고, 키링은 소품처럼 작게 보이되 형태가 읽히도록 옆에 분리 배치한다. 텀블러 옆에는 “가벼운 데일리 컵”, “350ml”, “BPA FREE” 같은 짧은 라벨을 붙이고, 키링에는 작은 고리 그림자와 패키지 백킹 카드, “키링 ₩8,500” 가격 스티커가 보이게 한다.
4. Product row 3: 스티커북은 하단 영역에 넓게 배치하여 표지와 일부 내부 페이지가 보이게 하고, 4종 중 가장 평면적인 인쇄물이라는 점이 드러나게 한다. 표지에는 “스티커북”, “24장 구성”, “놀이 스티커” 같은 읽기 쉬운 한글을 넣고 일부 페이지에는 작은 캐릭터 얼굴, 별, 하트, 구름, 숫자 스티커를 배치한다.
5. Unity details: 각 상품의 {캐릭터} 적용 위치는 통일된 스타일로 맞추고, 얼굴 비율·선 굵기·색상 농도를 동일하게 유지해 한 브랜드 세트처럼 보이게 한다. 전체에 같은 {컬러 팔레트}의 라벨, 스티커, 작은 그래픽 모티프를 반복하여 패밀리룩처럼 연결한다.
6. Catalog information layer: 하단 우측에는 작은 제품 정보 카드처럼 “구성: 티셔츠 · 텀블러 · 키링 · 스티커북”, “권장 연령 3세+”, “세트가 {세트 가격}”, “문의 {문의 계정}”을 넣고, 좌측 하단에는 작은 바코드 영역과 SKU 느낌의 “NO. {카탈로그 번호}”를 배치한다.
7. Store and order details: 하단 중앙의 좁은 주문 바에는 “주문 제작 7일”, “선물 포장 가능”, “{매장 정보}”를 작은 글씨로 넣고, 제품별 가격은 작은 원형 스티커나 행택으로 표시한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 둥글고 친근한 키즈 산세리프 계열, Pretendard ExtraBold 또는 Noto Sans KR Bold 느낌의 라운디드 폰트 사용. 굿즈 라벨은 22~34px 수준의 또렷한 크기, 헤더 문구는 더 굵고 크게, 상품 정보와 SKU는 작지만 판독 가능하게 표현한다.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}를 중심으로, #F8E8E2 파스텔 핑크, #DFF2E1 민트, #FFF1B8 옐로, #F5EBDD 크림 베이지를 주조색으로 사용. 포인트 컬러로 말풍선, 가격 태그, 별·하트 그래픽에 부드러운 코랄과 스카이블루를 소량 더한다.
- Border/shadow: 각 굿즈 아래에 8~12px 퍼짐의 부드러운 드롭섀도우, 불투명도 12~16%, 그림자 방향은 아래-right로 통일. 패키지 카드와 행택에는 얇은 라운드 코너 테두리와 종이 두께가 느껴지는 가장자리 그림자를 더한다.
- Material finish: 인쇄물은 매트 코팅, 텀블러는 반광 플라스틱/스틸 느낌, 키링은 작은 하드 에나멜 질감, 스티커북은 종이 표지 질감, 티셔츠는 부드러운 면 원단의 미세한 직조감으로 구분한다.
- Decorative system: 배경 곳곳에 작은 별, 동그라미, 구름, 크레용 선, 컬러칩, 접힌 종이 라벨, 샘플 스티커 조각, 포장 리본 끝부분을 배치해 키즈 브랜드 촬영 세트의 따뜻한 생활감을 만든다.
- Print consistency: 티셔츠, 텀블러, 키링, 스티커북에 들어간 캐릭터 인쇄는 같은 원본 아트워크를 사용한 것처럼 눈 위치, 볼터치, 외곽선 두께, 파스텔 색 농도를 일관되게 유지한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame overhead product shot 느낌, 50mm f/2.8 보조 시점 혼합, 평면 목업과 실물 제품이 함께 있는 카탈로그 촬영 스타일.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at 45°, very light fill from lower-right, 그림자는 짧고 가장자리가 부드럽게 번지도록 정리.
- Color grade: warm pastel grade with cream, blush pink, mint, soft lemon, low contrast, clean white balance.
- Realism: 실제 촬영된 제품 세트처럼 종이 라벨의 살짝 들뜬 모서리, 키링 고리의 작은 하이라이트, 텀블러 바닥의 접지 그림자, 티셔츠 천의 자연스러운 주름, 스티커북 페이지의 얇은 종이 두께, 행택 끈의 작은 굴곡을 표현한다.
- Depth and scale: 탑뷰 기반이지만 일부 제품은 살짝 세워진 각도로 보여 입체감을 주고, 티셔츠·텀블러·키링·스티커북의 실제 크기 차이가 자연스럽게 느껴지도록 배치한다.

[6. MOOD]
Little Tiger x Pinkfong style kids product catalog spread — playful but organized, like a premium preschool brand mockup page.
밝고 안전하며 선물 패키지처럼 설레는 분위기, 부모가 상품 제안서나 온라인 상세페이지에서 바로 확인할 수 있는 친근한 키즈 굿즈 세트 이미지.
새 학기 선물, 어린이집 답례품, 팝업스토어 샘플 진열대처럼 현실적인 판매 맥락이 느껴지는 따뜻한 키즈 브랜드 무드.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 {캐릭터}의 이름 표기가 깨지지 않고 선명해야 하며, {굿즈 4종}에 들어가는 한글 라벨이 있다면 정확히 읽혀야 한다.
- Render added Korean text clearly when used: “{브랜드명}”, “키즈 굿즈 세트”, “{시즌 문구}”, “VOL.03”, “반팔티 ₩19,900”, “키링 ₩8,500”, “스티커북”, “24장 구성”, “세트가 {세트 가격}”, “문의 {문의 계정}”, “NO. {카탈로그 번호}”, “{매장 정보}”.
- 모든 캐릭터 얼굴은 둥글고 친근한 비율로 유지하고, 손·발이 보이는 경우 해부학적으로 자연스럽게 표현한다.
- 4종 굿즈는 모두 한 화면에서 동일한 브랜드 스타일로 보여야 하며, 각 상품의 캐릭터 결, 색감, 선 굵기가 서로 다르게 흔들리면 안 된다.
- {비율}이 느껴지도록 각 상품의 상대적 크기를 유지하고, 중앙 {캐릭터} hero와 실제 굿즈 인쇄 캐릭터가 같은 디자인으로 보이게 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized child likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-536.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical car naming card for a premium automotive launch, combining a flagship-style English name, Korean meaning line, and signature visual hero.
Designed as a shareable brand presentation card with a Hyundai·Genesis-inspired reveal mood, enriched with realistic launch-card details such as a naming dossier label, date stamp, design-code chips, small credit text, and premium automotive presentation graphics.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center composition: a tall 1024x1536 poster with the {시그니처 비주얼} occupying the mid 52% of the frame, aligned on a refined central axis and surrounded by premium launch-card information panels.
- Typography stack: large {네이밍} at the top 18%, Korean meaning line in the lower 16%, plus realistic supporting text such as “NAMING DOSSIER VOL.247”, “2026년 5월 공개”, “디자인 코드: 정제된 속도감”, and a model-name credit line.
- Background treatment: deep navy matte field with subtle gradient falloff, refined luxury-card paper texture, fine metallic grain, faint blueprint contour lines, and gold foil-like divider rules that frame the hero without overpowering it.
- Framing direction: symmetrical, showroom-like editorial layout using {레이아웃} and {비율}, with crisp hierarchy, precise automotive brochure alignment, side index markers, and bottom launch metadata.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top title zone (upper 18%): set {네이밍} in large, premium sans-serif uppercase styling, centered, with generous tracking and strong contrast against the dark background. Add a small dossier label above it: “NAMING DOSSIER VOL.247” and a compact date label: “2026년 5월호 · 프리미엄 런칭 카드”.
2. Main hero zone (middle 52%): place {시그니처 비주얼} as the focal object, visually dominant, with a refined luminous edge, controlled shadow, subtle floor reflection, and fine contour-line graphic accents so it feels like a luxury unveiling panel photographed for a real launch presentation.
3. Meaning zone (lower-middle 14%): place {한글·의미} beneath the hero in smaller Korean text, centered and clearly legible. Add one short supporting Korean caption below it: “이름에 담긴 방향성과 첫인상을 기록합니다.”
4. Accent zone (small supporting area): add a small monogram-style signature mark, a thin gold divider, a model credit line “Name credit · {네이밍}”, and compact automotive spec chips such as “ELECTRIC VISION”, “SIGNATURE LIGHT”, “URBAN GRAND TOURER”.
5. Footer information zone: include realistic card metadata near the bottom: “서울 · 남양 디자인 프리뷰”, “문의 02-0000-2026”, “REF. AUTO-NAME-536”, a tiny barcode/QR-style block, and a subtle page indicator “01 / 03”.
6. Layout logic: maintain a premium concept-car brochure structure with consistent spacing, precise alignment, layered information bands, decorative guide marks, and editorial rhythm while keeping the name-first hierarchy intact.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Helvetica Neue-style uppercase for {네이밍}, 52–68px feel; use Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR Medium for {한글·의미}, 24–30px feel; use small support text in thin Pretendard, condensed uppercase, and crisp Korean microcopy.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} using deep navy #0B1630, gold accent #C8A24A, soft white #F7F7F2, and subtle cool gray highlights.
- Border/shadow: add a soft drop shadow under the hero, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; use fine gold foil rules, thin inner frame lines, subtle debossed card texture, and polished metallic highlight details without heavy outlines or glossy sticker edges.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: premium studio product-photography look, 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens feel with crisp separation and controlled depth; for emblem detail variants, a 100mm macro close-up aesthetic.
- Lighting: studio softbox key from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right, faint rim light along the silhouette to define the form without harsh reflections.
- Color grade: deep navy + gold + white with clean luxury editorial contrast, slightly cool blacks, polished metallic highlights, realistic printed-card texture, and controlled saturation drift.

[6. MOOD]
Hyundai·Genesis launch invitation card — refined automotive reveal editorial with a luxury showroom brochure feeling, like a real naming dossier card prepared for an executive design preview.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문자열:
  - {네이밍}
  - {한글·의미}
  - “2026년 5월호”
  - “서울 · 남양 디자인 프리뷰”
  - “이름에 담긴 방향성과 첫인상을 기록합니다.”
- The composition must read as a premium car naming card: English name first, hero visual centered, Korean meaning secondary, launch-card metadata and luxury brand presentation hierarchy intact.
- Keep typography crisp and evenly spaced; all text must be sharp, legible, and free of broken Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Luxury car interior and driver-seat catalog image, built for premium product showcase, dealership landing page, SNS carousel cover, and showroom consultation material.
Single hero or 4-cut editorial layout that emphasizes cabin materials, cockpit design, digital convenience, and practical luxury details with realistic automotive photography.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {차종} cabin interior as the visual hero, with the driver-seat cockpit, steering wheel, dashboard, center console, seat bolsters, and door trim clearly visible.
- Layout option: {컷_구성}; if 4-cut, combine driver-seat hero, infotainment close-up, rear-seat comfort view, and trunk or storage detail as one premium catalog board.
- Background treatment: dark cabin surfaces, refined matte textures, realistic leather grain, brushed trim, ambient-light glow, dashboard screen reflections, seat stitching, cupholders, charging port, gear selector, vents, and small practical controls visible where natural.
- Styling focus: {시그니처_디테일} should be framed as premium functional design elements with tactile material separation and believable everyday usability.
- Information overlay: add a refined Korean showroom-card layer with {매장명}, {위치_라벨}, {날짜_라벨}, {가격_정보}, {스펙_배지}, {프로모션_문구}, and {상담_정보} integrated like a luxury automotive catalog page.
- Overall tone: {조명_질감} and {컬러_톤} should create a high-end dealership brochure feel with strong material definition, cinematic shadows, and warm cabin depth.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area / primary panel: frame the cockpit from the driver-side perspective, with the steering wheel, dashboard, infotainment display, digital cluster, and center console forming a strong diagonal composition.
2. Detail emphasis: highlight {시그니처_디테일} with crisp surface separation, realistic stitching visibility, fingerprints-free glossy screens, and subtle specular highlights on polished parts.
3. Secondary areas: when using {컷_구성} as a 4-cut layout, show infotainment screen with {화면_표시}, rear-seat legroom and air vents, trunk or cargo space, and a tactile close-up of seat leather or wood trim.
4. Material realism: render leather grain, perforated seat texture, brushed metal, wood veneer, soft-touch plastics, piano-black accents, rubber floor mats, screen glass, and ambient-light strips with photographic precision.
5. Catalog information layer: include a small top label, model name block, 2–3 specification badges, price or consultation CTA, QR-style placeholder block, and discreet page number such as 01 / INTERIOR without overwhelming the cabin image.
6. Practical luxury cues: add natural automotive details such as seat controls, cupholder cover, wireless charging pad, stitched armrest, climate-control icons, rear USB-C ports, headrest shape, seatbelt buckle, and tasteful dashboard reflections.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use clean Korean sans-serif styling such as Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to semi-bold weight, 20–30px for small labels, 34–48px for section titles, and 54–72px for the main model headline.
- Color palette: {컬러_톤} interpreted as black #111111, charcoal #2B2B2B, deep graphite #3A3A3A, warm accent amber #C89B5C, muted cream #E8DED0, and metallic silver #B8BCC2.
- Editorial graphics: use thin divider lines, translucent graphite panels, small rounded spec badges, amber accent bars, subtle glassmorphism label chips, and a compact bottom information band.
- Text hierarchy: main model name largest, showroom/date/location secondary, feature badges and consultation details smaller; all Korean text must look printed or screen-rendered, not hand-drawn.
- Surface treatment: matte black interior surfaces, low-gloss reflections, natural screen bloom, readable instrument lighting, and realistic cabin depth.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame interior automotive photography, 24mm wide-angle for cabin hero shots, 35mm for detail panels, f/4 to f/5.6 for balanced depth and clarity.
- Lighting: controlled studio-soft ambient lighting with warm overhead fill, gentle side rim from upper-right, faint dashboard glow, and low interior accent lighting following door and dashboard contours.
- Color grade: dark luxury grade with neutral blacks, warm amber highlights, slightly cool midtones, clean contrast, and premium automotive brochure photography finish.
- Rendering: high-resolution photorealistic automotive interior, sharp stitching, believable reflections on screens and trim, visible depth from foreground steering wheel to rear cabin.

[6. MOOD]
Premium automotive catalog editorial — a refined Hyundai·Genesis·BMW showroom brochure aesthetic with cinematic restraint, practical luxury cues, and high material fidelity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render all Korean text cleanly, especially {매장명}, {위치_라벨}, {날짜_라벨}, {가격_정보}, {프로모션_문구}, and {상담_정보}.
- Required visible text examples: 프리미엄 인테리어 포커스, 시승 상담, 월 납입 예시, 실내 공간 체크, {스펙_배지}.
- Layout invariants: if {컷_구성} uses a 4-cut layout, all panels must share the same luxury catalog lighting, color grade, and photographic realism.
- Composition requirement: the image must clearly read as an automobile interior / driver-seat photo, with {차종}, {시그니처_디테일}, steering wheel, dashboard, seats, and infotainment area visible as intended.
- Screen content: infotainment and cluster displays may show {화면_표시}, navigation map lines, climate icons, battery/fuel status, and seat-heating indicators with legible Korean UI styling.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or real person portrait composites
- Misleading government, safety, or warranty authority marks

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean travel magazine-style drive route recommendation card news, vertical A4 poster layout for social sharing.
Route planning infographic with scenic viewpoints, restaurant stops, practical timing, budget cues, and a realistic road-trip editorial feel.
Design it as slide 01 of a saved travel guide series, rich with believable micro-information, map details, captions, and social card-news elements.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main headline area occupies the top 16% of the frame, with a bold title block, compact subtitle, VOL/date label, and small series tag such as TRAVEL ROUTE CARD NEWS.
- Central composition uses a map + car + landscape collage as the hero, framed to fill about 52% of the canvas width with route labels, photo captions, weather chip, fuel/toll hint, and small road-sign graphics around it.
- Route flow should read top-to-bottom with connected arrows and stop markers, guiding the eye from departure to destination like a real itinerary saved from a travel magazine.
- Place {코스 주제} as the thematic route title, {동선} as the core path, {명소·맛집} as the recommended stop list, {시간·예산} as the practical info block, {대표 비주얼} as the central visual treatment, and {컬러 톤} as the palette direction.
- Include {비율} as a small format note or layout label near the footer, integrated naturally into the card-news guide design.
- Use a structured editorial grid with visible alignment, layered paper cards, route stickers, caption strips, numbered chips, and compact guidebook details that make the page feel printed and useful.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band: set the main title 드라이브 코스 추천 in a large editorial masthead style, centered or slightly left-aligned, with the route title {코스 주제} beneath it. Add a small issue/date label such as VOL.247 · 2026년 5월호 and a short Korean subtitle like 전망 좋은 길, 맛있는 정류장까지.
- Slide indicator: place 01/05 near the top-right with a tiny progress bar and the label 저장용 여행 카드, making it clearly feel like a card-news carousel cover.
- Hero collage zone (middle 52%): build a layered composition of {대표 비주얼} with a tactile map base, compact car silhouette or small realistic car cutout, highway route line, pin markers, overlapping scenic photo tiles, a cafe/restaurant snapshot tile, and small handwritten-style caption labels.
- Map details: add thin route lines, local road names, kilometer marks, tiny compass, scale bar, parking pin, viewpoint icon, fork-and-spoon icon, coffee icon, and a small dotted detour line to make the route feel believable.
- Route panel: show {동선} as a clear directional sequence using numbered stop chips 1–4, directional arrows, estimated drive segments, and compact labels such as 출발, 전망 포인트, 점심, 도착.
- Recommendation block: place {명소·맛집} in a 2-column mini-card format with small icon markers for scenery, dining, coffee, and rest points. Add short caption lines like 포토존, 대표 메뉴, 주차 가능, 일몰 추천 where appropriate.
- Info strip: present {시간·예산} in a compact summary bar with bold numerals, thin separators, toll/fuel/meal icons, and quick notes such as 총 소요, 예상 경비, 추천 시간대.
- Footer accent: repeat the {컬러 톤} palette in thin rules, small tag labels, saved-guide CTA, and subtle background blocks. Include a tiny CTA line such as 저장해두고 주말에 떠나요 and a page footer with @drive.route.kr · SHARE / SAVE micro icons.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the headline, Pretendard Medium for body text, and Noto Sans KR SemiBold for labels; title size should feel like 54–72px equivalent, body around 22–28px equivalent, micro labels around 14–18px equivalent.
- Color palette: base on the specified {컬러 톤}, with beige paper tones like #F3EBDD, cool blue accents like #5C86B8, deep charcoal like #2F343A, warm road-sign yellow accents, and soft off-white separators.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1px charcoal rules, soft drop shadows with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, subtle paper grain, printed ink edges, and realistic layered cardstock depth.
- Layout rhythm should feel like a premium travel guide: precise hierarchy, readable Korean labels, tactile maps, small editorial annotations, and enough real travel information to reward close viewing.
- Decorative elements should support the route story: route pins, stamps, ticket-like labels, small arrows, weather badge, camera icon, kilometer note, and caption stickers.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: use a wide 24mm flat lay perspective for the map and layout base, plus a 50mm equivalent crop feel for the scenic collage tiles to keep them readable and grounded.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left, with a gentle fill from the right and mild paper-card shadows, like a premium travel brochure photographed near a window.
- Color grade: beige + cool blue + charcoal with slightly muted saturation, crisp whites, warm yellow highlights, natural paper texture, and a calm guidebook finish.
- Material realism: printed matte paper, slightly raised sticker chips, folded map texture, realistic photo grain in scenic panels, fine ink registration, and subtle touchable edges.

[6. MOOD]
Premium travel magazine editorial — similar to a refined Korean road trip guide spread with practical itinerary energy, scenic anticipation, saved-card usefulness, and the feeling of planning a weekend escape.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구 — 드라이브 코스 추천, {코스 주제}, {동선}, {명소·맛집}, {대표 비주얼}, {시간·예산}, {컬러 톤}, {비율}.
- Additional Korean text should be crisp and believable: VOL.247, 2026년 5월호, 저장용 여행 카드, 전망 좋은 길, 맛있는 정류장까지, 출발, 전망 포인트, 점심, 도착, 총 소요, 예상 경비, 추천 시간대, 저장해두고 주말에 떠나요.
- Map route arrows, stop numbers, kilometer marks, icons, label boxes, slide indicator 01/05, and footer CTA must be cleanly aligned and readable.
- Keep all Korean place names crisp, fully legible, and free of broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
