studio:prompts3:ours-507.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean fitness YouTube thumbnail for muscle close-up content, designed to stop the scroll with aggressive contrast, believable gym intensity, and bold typography.
High-impact gym channel cover image focused on body-building detail, comic-style emphasis, readable Korean clickbait copy, and realistic YouTube thumbnail metadata elements.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left 2/3: {인물 결} with muscle close-up dominating the frame, emphasizing shoulders, arms, chest, abs, and upper torso texture with sharp definition, sweat beads, veins, chalk dust, and post-workout pump realism.
- Right 1/3: large Korean headline stack placed vertically centered with strong spacing and a darker graphic panel behind the text for readability.
- {레이아웃 명세} should be treated as the layout core: close crop, oversized subject, comic burst lines around the body, bold accent arrows, and strong separation between subject and copy.
- Background treatment: dark charcoal real-gym atmosphere with blurred squat rack, cable machine silhouettes, rubber floor texture, faint mirror reflections, and {운동소품} visible as contextual details.
- YouTube thumbnail details: include a small channel handle label {채널핸들}, a bright view-bait sticker {조회유도뱃지}, the accent emoji {강조이모지}, and a small supporting copy tag {보조카피} near the headline.
- Framing: subject cropped tightly at chest/waist line, image feels like a punchy thumbnail with the body filling the left side edge-to-edge and the face partially visible only if it strengthens intensity.
- Use {컨셉} and {카피} exactly as provided, with the headline occupying the clearest visual zone.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero body area (left 2/3): render {인물 결} as a hyper-detailed muscular close-up with crisp skin texture, visible pump, natural sweat, believable vascularity, and dramatic highlight on shoulder and biceps.
2. Real gym context layer: add out-of-focus dumbbells, weight plates, bench edge, mirror glints, and rubber mat texture behind the subject while keeping the body and headline as the dominant readable elements.
3. Graphic emphasis layer: add comic-style 집중선, 속도선, small lightning-bolt shapes, a curved arrow pointing toward the activated muscle, and {강조이모지} near the top headline corner, keeping them bold but not obscuring anatomy.
4. Text block (right 1/3): place {카피} in oversized stacked Korean lettering, with the main phrase larger than the secondary phrase "BEST 5", strong line breaks, thick outline, and a compact {보조카피} tag below it.
5. Channel and click layer: place {채널핸들} as a small pill label in the upper-right or lower-right corner, and {조회유도뱃지} as a high-contrast sticker shape near the muscle/headline boundary.
6. Concept reinforcement: integrate {컨셉} through pose, tension, lighting, sweat, gym props, and comic reaction graphics, preserving a direct fitness-YouTube thumbnail feel.
7. Color separation: use {컬러 톤} so the subject pops from the background, with bright accent edges around the silhouette and deep shadow in the muscle grooves.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold Korean sans-serif such as Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main copy; tight tracking, heavy weight, 72–120 px feel for thumbnail scale.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with deep dark charcoal #1B1B1D, lime green #B8FF2C accents, white #FFFFFF text, and occasional warm skin highlights; use thick black stroke and lime outer glow for legibility.
- Border/shadow: strong drop shadow under the headline, 6px y-offset, 14px blur, 35% opacity; subject edges get a subtle rim light and crisp cutout separation.
- Graphic accents: comic line art should use lime green, white, and small yellow sparks, with high-opacity strokes and slight motion blur only on the outer tips.
- Sticker design: {조회유도뱃지} should appear in a rounded rectangle or starburst sticker with high contrast, slightly tilted like a real YouTube thumbnail callout.
- Micro labels: {채널핸들} should be small but legible, placed like a creator watermark, not an official logo.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.4 portrait lens look, tight crop, shallow depth of field, studio thumbnail photography aesthetic.
- Lighting: hard key light from upper-left at about 45° with a controlled fill from front-right, plus a faint rim from behind to carve the shoulder and arm silhouette.
- Color grade: deep charcoal shadows, lime-green accent glow, neutral skin tones with high micro-contrast, crisp YouTube thumbnail grading.
- Texture realism: visible sweat droplets, skin pores, compression fabric texture if clothing appears, chalk smudges on fingers, and gym metal reflections in the background.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean fitness channel thumbnail — loud YouTube click-through aesthetic with bodybuilding magazine intensity, realistic gym grit, and comic-book impact.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "이 운동 진짜 미쳤음", "BEST 5", "{보조카피}", "{조회유도뱃지}", "{채널핸들}"
- Composition invariants: left 2/3 must stay dominated by the muscle close-up; right 1/3 must remain dominated by large Korean copy; comic energy lines, arrows, emoji, and stickers must support the click-through design without covering key anatomy.
- Thumbnail realism: include believable gym details such as dumbbells, plates, bench edge, sweat, chalk, and hard lighting, while keeping all text large enough to read at small size.
- Anatomy/layout invariants: muscles should look powerful and anatomically plausible; no extra limbs, no deformed hands, no face or body warping.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled typography
- Celebrity face composites or implying a real public figure identity

- Add a small channel badge at the upper-left corner containing {채널 핸들}, and a compact travel-series label near it using {시리즈 라벨}.
- Add a YouTube-style view-bait sticker near the upper-right or beside the person using {보조 배지}, plus {강조 이모지} and an accent arrow/circle pointing toward the landmark or the person’s reaction.
- Compose with strong separation between subject, landscape, caption box, channel label, sticker, and graphic accents so every element remains readable at thumbnail size.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background layer: build a dramatic wide scenic view of {여행지·풍경}, with the horizon, landmark structure, sky texture, local terrain details, tourists or distant scale cues where natural, and sunlight/shadow depth occupying the top 2/3.
2) Hero subject layer: place {원본 인물} in the lower-middle or lower-right foreground as a full-body cutout, matching {인물 자세}, with clean edge masking, realistic contact shadow, and a subtle white/yellow rim stroke for instant readability.
3) Caption block: create a solid black rectangle across the bottom 1/3, with huge white Korean headline text from {자막 카피} set inside it, centered or slightly left-weighted, using thick stroke and drop shadow for strong CTR impact.
4) Secondary text: include {시리즈 라벨} as a smaller colored tag such as a red/yellow pill label above or inside the caption block, subordinate to the main quote but clearly visible.
5) Channel branding: render a small rounded badge in the top-left with {채널 핸들}, using a simple avatar circle or travel-pin icon, keeping it clearly fictional or generic if no real channel asset is provided.
6) View-bait accent: render {보조 배지} as a high-contrast sticker, speech bubble, or tilted label with {강조 이모지}; add a thick arrow, circle highlight, map-pin marker, dotted route line, or burst graphic to direct attention to the destination reveal.
7) Thumbnail polish: add subtle vignette, sunlight flare, dust/atmosphere, destination color accents, and a crisp cutout hierarchy so the image feels like a finished high-performing Korean travel vlog thumbnail.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold Korean sans-serif such as Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the headline, 62–90 px equivalent, tight line spacing, thick white fill, optional yellow keyword highlight, black stroke/drop shadow for thumbnail readability.
- Use {컬러 톤} as the main grade, paired with deep black for the caption box, pure white and yellow/red accent text, and warm amber or cool blue environmental accents depending on the destination.
- Sticker and accent graphics: use bold YouTube thumbnail language — red arrow, yellow burst, white speech bubble, travel map-pin, dotted route, and emoji treatment from {강조 이모지} — but keep them integrated with the travel scene.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the subject, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, plus a thin 1–2px light edge separation if needed to prevent background blending.
- The final layout should feel energetic, clickable, and editorial, with realistic travel atmosphere and enough environmental detail to sell the destination.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: ultra-wide travel photo look, 24mm full-frame equivalent, f/5.6, high-detail landscape clarity with subject separation suitable for a YouTube thumbnail.
- Lighting: natural daylight with strong location realism, either warm amber sunlight or cool blue ambient light depending on {컬러 톤}, with the subject clearly lit and the background evenly exposed.
- Color grade: crisp cinematic travel grade with saturated landmark detail, punchy contrast on the caption box, controlled highlights, visible sky/terrain texture, and energetic vlog-style saturation.
- Graphic finish: sharp text edges, clean thumbnail compositing, realistic subject cutout, glossy sticker highlights, and slight lens flare or atmospheric haze appropriate to the travel location.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean travel vlog thumbnail — dramatic, curious, and click-worthy, like a top-performing adventure channel episode revealing an unbelievable destination moment.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the main headline exactly as {자막 카피}; also render {시리즈 라벨}, {채널 핸들}, and {보조 배지} clearly with intact Korean characters and punctuation.
- Preserve the identity and face of {원본 인물}; do not replace with another person.
- Keep the exact three-part hierarchy: epic landscape hero at top, full-body person in the foreground, large black subtitle box at bottom.
- Include the accent thumbnail elements: {강조 이모지}, a bold arrow/circle or burst graphic, the top-left channel handle badge, and a small travel-series label.
- The subject must remain full-body and readable; do not crop into an unrelated portrait layout.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Fake official seals or certification badges
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public-figure face swaps
- Replacing the original person with a different face

studio:prompts3:ours-504.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean comedy sketch YouTube thumbnail, 4-panel comic grid, high-click entertainment cover.
Fast-readable thumbnail with exaggerated everyday gag timing, bold Korean speech bubbles, and recognizable YouTube thumbnail elements such as a short hook title, channel handle, and playful attention markers.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main layout: a strict 2x2 grid with four equal panels, each separated by thick black borders around 3px, with compact thumbnail-safe margins suitable for 1536x1024.
- Subject distribution: 2~3 한국인 일상 인물 centered within each panel as close-up or half-body crops, keeping faces large enough for instant readability on mobile.
- Thumbnail title zone: add a large bold Korean hook title across the upper center or lower center, integrated over the grid without hiding key faces; use short copy such as '오늘도 터졌다ㅋㅋ' or a theme-matched title derived from {콩트 주제}.
- YouTube metadata details: include a small channel handle such as '@콩트연구소', a tiny '구독' tag, and a small episode label like 'EP.04' or '4컷 콩트' in a corner badge.
- Background treatment: everyday indoor settings matched to {콩트 주제}, with believable props, wall notes, table items, phone screens, snack wrappers, office mugs, or household details where naturally appropriate to the gag.
- Framing direction: each panel should feel like a sequential reaction shot, with strong facial expression changes, visible hand gestures, comic motion marks, and clear visual punchlines.
- View-bait accents: add a bright arrow, burst shape, question mark, exclamation mark, or emoji-style sticker such as '?!' or 'ㅋㅋ' to guide the eye toward the funniest reaction.
- Use {콩트 주제}, {4컷 시퀀스}, {캐릭터 결}, {레이아웃 명세}, {컷별 말풍선·자막}, {컬러 톤}, {비율} as the organizing variables for the comic narrative.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Panel 1 (top-left): establish an ordinary, calm starting situation from {콩트 주제}, with relaxed faces, everyday objects, and a believable setting such as a living room, office, café counter, classroom corner, or convenience-store table.
2. Panel 2 (top-right): introduce the absurd incident from {4컷 시퀀스}, with a sharper pose shift, widened eyes, visible prop interaction, and stronger motion emphasis.
3. Panel 3 (bottom-left): push the reaction into an extreme scream or shock expression, keeping the character crops tight, hands and shoulders expressive, and the comedic timing obvious.
4. Panel 4 (bottom-right): end with a punchline finish, laughter, embarrassed silence, or awkward resolution, using a clear final visual clue so the image instantly reads as a comedy thumbnail.
5. Speech bubbles: place one Korean speech bubble per panel, matching {컷별 말풍선·자막}, with bubble size large enough to remain legible at thumbnail scale; include short, punchy text only.
6. Main title: place one large Korean thumbnail title outside or partly overlapping the panel grid, using thick outline lettering and high contrast; keep it short and funny, not paragraph-like.
7. Micro labels: add small realistic thumbnail details such as 'EP.04', '@콩트연구소', '실화냐?!', or '오늘의 4컷' in corner chips, sticker labels, or small caption bars.
8. Linework and comic energy: use thick black outlines, energetic facial exaggeration, crisp separation between panels, action lines, sweat drops, starbursts, and impact marks so the grid remains clear even when compressed.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold Korean comic lettering style, similar to hand-drawn webtoon captioning and variety-show subtitles, with heavy weight, white/yellow fills, black stroke, and red accent shadows for the main title.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} with vivid yellow, sky blue, coral, and lime accents; maintain strong black outlines, bright panel contrast, and saturated entertainment-thumbnail colors.
- Panel details: include small but readable environmental clues that support {콩트 주제}, such as a receipt, phone notification, kitchen utensil, desk calendar, convenience-store shelf, or sticky note.
- Border/shadow: thick black panel borders, subtle inner white margins, sticker-style drop shadows on title text, and layered caption bars that add depth without covering expressions.
- Graphic accents: add comic burst stickers, arrows, motion trails, tiny sparkle marks, sweat drops, and sound-effect marks like '쿵', '헉', or '띠용' where they enhance the joke.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm documentary-style framing with slight perspective compression, similar to a comic storyboard capture, keeping faces prominent and expressions readable.
- Rendering style: hybrid real-life YouTube thumbnail and webtoon-comic overlay; Korean actors should feel like real people photographed in a sketch set, then enhanced with clean illustrated outlines and comic captions.
- Lighting: bright even studio lighting with gentle fill from the front-left, catchlights in eyes, clean skin detail, and consistent exposure across all four panels.
- Color grade: saturated variety-show comic grade with clean primary-like tones, punchy contrast, sharp black line definition, and realistic set texture in clothing, hair, props, and backgrounds.
- Texture detail: preserve believable fabric folds, hair strands, plastic packaging, paper notes, table surfaces, and room lighting so the thumbnail feels content-rich and produced for an actual comedy channel.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean variety-show comedy thumbnail — fast, punchy, meme-friendly, slightly chaotic, and instantly clickable like a popular studio sketch channel cover.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: '엥?', '진짜?', '으악', 'ㅋㅋㅋ' must appear exactly and clearly in the speech bubbles.
- Also include readable Korean thumbnail/meta text such as '오늘도 터졌다ㅋㅋ', 'EP.04', '@콩트연구소', and '실화냐?!' unless {레이아웃 명세} requires different wording.
- Four-panel structure invariant: all 4 panels must remain in a strict 2x2 grid with equal sizing and thick black borders.
- Character integrity: keep the same characters visually consistent across panels, with only facial expression, gesture, and pose changes.
- Do not let title text, stickers, arrows, or speech bubbles obscure the main faces or hide the punchline prop.
- Keep all Korean characters clean, correctly formed, and placed intentionally as thumbnail graphics.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications

Maintain the subject identity from {원본 인물} while creating a dark luxury, monochrome, high-fashion cover with strong graphic typography and realistic printed-magazine details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the {원본 인물} as the dominant cover hero, occupying about 62% of the frame height, with the head near the upper third and carefully arranged cover lines around the silhouette.
- Keep the pose from {자세와 표정} visually strong and editorial: upright torso, direct gaze, one leg slightly forward when visible, hands relaxed and anatomically correct.
- Background should be {배경과 세트}: deep charcoal to black studio environment or monochrome gray sweep, with visible luxury studio depth such as soft fabric texture, graphite gradient, or subtle reflective floor sheen.
- Place title, issue metadata, feature headlines, barcode, and spine credit around the subject rather than covering the face; maintain a believable fashion-magazine hierarchy.
- Use {메인 표지 카피} as the main text system, supported by issue number, date, price, three Korean feature headlines, and a small barcode area like a real monthly fashion magazine.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Masthead zone (top 12-16%): Place the magazine title in a bold luxury editorial masthead style with wide letter spacing, crisp edges, and high contrast against the dark background. Add {이슈 정보}, {발행일}, and {가격} near the masthead in small refined type.
2) Hero portrait zone (middle 60%): Render {원본 인물} in the outfit defined by {의상}, with clean but natural skin texture, sharp facial focus, realistic hair detail, jewelry highlights, and subtle edge separation from the background.
3) Cover line zone (left and right margins): Add {메인 표지 카피} plus three Korean feature headlines: {특집 헤드라인 1}, {특집 헤드라인 2}, {특집 헤드라인 3}. Stack them in varied sizes with editorial rhythm, using both English and Korean typography where appropriate.
4) Print-detail zone (bottom 10-14%): Add a small realistic barcode block with {바코드 번호}, price label, page teaser, and compact publisher-style microcopy. Include {스파인 크레딧} vertically along the left spine edge.
5) Lighting emphasis: Use {조명과 컬러톤} to create a spotlighted face, sculpted cheekbones, glossy fabric highlights, and deep shadow falloff at the edges, like a studio fashion portrait.
6) Final polish: Keep the cover glossy, tactile, and print-ready, with realistic ink density, faint paper grain, refined typography, and premium editorial styling.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use a Harper's Bazaar-like editorial mix of Didot or Bodoni Moda for the masthead and cover headline, paired with Noto Sans KR or Pretendard for smaller Korean copy; masthead around 72-110 px equivalent, subheads 24-38 px, body lines 18-22 px, microcopy 10-14 px.
- Color palette: Deep black #0B0B0D, charcoal #1C1C1F, silver gray #B7B7BC, bone white #F2F0EB, and muted metallic highlights; keep saturation low and contrast high.
- Cover furniture: Use refined rule lines, thin typographic dividers, a small barcode rectangle, tiny issue metadata, and vertical spine text to make the image feel like a real printed fashion cover.
- Border/shadow: Add a soft realistic drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity under the subject for separation, with subtle vignette at the corners and gentle paper-surface texture.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Full-frame fashion portrait look, shot on a Hasselblad X2D 100C with 85mm lens at f/2.8, medium shallow depth of field, clean studio sharpness.
- Lighting: Hard key spotlight from upper-left at about 45°, subtle fill from front-right, gentle rim light from behind-right to define silhouette, deep shadow control like a Vogue/Harper's Bazaar studio cover.
- Color grade: Monochrome luxury grade with cool black, graphite, and pearl highlights; slight silver sheen on skin and wardrobe, restrained contrast roll-off for print elegance.

[6. MOOD]
High-fashion magazine cover — Harper's Bazaar / Vogue Korea editorial cover feel with dark luxury, confident gaze, precise studio polish, and realistic monthly issue details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Render visible cover text cleanly and accurately, including: "BAZAAR", "{이슈 정보}", "{발행일}", "{가격}", "{메인 표지 카피}", "{특집 헤드라인 1}", "{특집 헤드라인 2}", "{특집 헤드라인 3}", "{바코드 번호}", "{스파인 크레딧}".
- Korean text accuracy must be crisp for feature lines such as "새로운 파워 아이콘", "블랙으로 완성한 태도", "도시의 밤과 스타일" when used.

- Keep all visible body anatomy realistic and anatomically correct, with natural hands, natural proportions, and believable garment fit.
- Make the magazine elements feel printed and intentional: masthead, date, issue number, barcode, price, spine credit, and feature headlines should align like a premium editorial cover.

- Broken Korean characters

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 좌측 50%는 {채널 컨셉}의 인물 히어로 영역, 우측 50%는 {큰 썸네일 제목}을 크게 배치하는 2분할 구조.
- 인물은 어깨 위 또는 상반신 클로즈업으로 크게 잡고, {리액션 포즈}가 즉시 보이도록 얼굴·눈·입·손 제스처를 전면에 배치.
- 배경은 빨강/노랑 그라데이션, 방사형 속도선, 팝아트 점무늬, 음식 스티커 그래픽이 섞인 유튜브 리액션 배경으로 만들고, {음식 비주얼}은 하단 또는 인물 옆에 컷아웃 콜라주로 겹쳐 배치.
- 우측 제목 주변에 {강조 이모지와 도형}을 넣어 시선을 끌고, 하단에는 {채널 핸들}과 짧은 {보조 카피}를 작은 라벨처럼 배치.
- 전체 프레이밍은 1536x1024 가로형 썸네일 마스터이며, 중앙 주요 정보가 유튜브 피드 크롭에서도 살아남도록 얼굴·제목·음식 컷을 중앙부에 강하게 모은다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero subject area (left mid 50%): {채널 컨셉}을 대표하는 인물을 크게 배치하고, {리액션 포즈}가 한눈에 읽히도록 얼굴을 화면 전면에 둔다. 놀란 눈, 벌어진 입, 양손 제스처, 음식 한 입 직후의 표정 등 리액션 순간을 과장된 컷아웃 스타일로 강조한다.
2) Main headline area (right mid 50%): {큰 썸네일 제목}을 2~4줄의 굵은 한글 타이포로 배치한다. 첫 줄은 가장 크게, 핵심 단어는 노랑 또는 흰색으로 분리하고, 두꺼운 검정 외곽선과 붉은 그림자 레이어를 넣어 모바일에서도 즉시 읽히게 한다.
3) View-bait accent layer: 제목 근처에 {강조 이모지와 도형}을 크게 넣고, 화살표, 말풍선, 폭발형 배지, “진짜 반응?” 같은 짧은 후킹 스티커 느낌을 더한다. 스티커는 공식 인증처럼 보이지 않게, 예능 자막 그래픽처럼 가볍고 선명하게 처리한다.
4) Supporting food collage (bottom): {음식 비주얼}을 컷아웃 카드처럼 넣어 K-푸드/배달앱/리액션 상황을 즉시 전달한다. 음식의 윤기, 김, 소스, 젓가락, 포장 용기, 작은 별점 말풍선 등 실제 먹방 썸네일에서 보이는 디테일을 더한다.
5) Channel identity strip: 하단 좌측 또는 우측에 {채널 핸들}, {업로드 라벨}, 작은 재생 아이콘, 댓글 말풍선 아이콘을 배치해 실제 유튜브 썸네일 편집물처럼 보이게 한다.
6) Color emphasis and balance: {컬러 톤}을 메인으로 삼고, 빨강/노랑 포인트가 인물의 표정과 카피 주변에 집중되도록 한다. 음식은 따뜻한 채도와 선명한 하이라이트로 맛있게 보이게 하며, 얼굴은 자연스러운 피부 톤을 유지한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for main headline, size 130~180px equivalent, tight tracking, thick outline and subtle inner shadow for high readability.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} 기반으로 #E53935 red, #FFFFFF white, #FDD835 yellow, plus deep charcoal #1F1F1F for outlines and shadow anchors.
- Border/shadow: face and text both use crisp cutout shadow, 6px y-offset, 14px blur, 20% opacity; if needed add thin white stroke around subject for separation.
- Graphic details: comic burst shapes, thick arrows, sticker labels, emoji accents, small food-rating tags, and channel handle strip should feel like a real high-CTR YouTube thumbnail edit.
- Text hierarchy: main title first, reaction face second, food collage third, handle and micro labels fourth; all Korean text should be bold, clean, and legible at mobile size.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm f/1.8 portrait look, shallow depth of field, thumbnail-style close crop with sharp facial emphasis and slightly exaggerated expression clarity.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° with soft fill from front-right, clean catchlights in eyes, minimal background shadow so the subject pops from the backdrop.
- Color grade: saturated red-white-yellow social thumbnail grade with warm skin tones, clean contrast, and slightly boosted vibrance for food and reaction emphasis.
- Editing finish: crisp cutout edges, layered drop shadows, glossy food highlights, punchy contrast, enlarged facial expression, and high-resolution compositing suitable for 1536x1024 output.

[6. MOOD]
Fast-paced YouTube reaction thumbnail energy — MrBeast-style high-clarity clickbait layout mixed with K-food variety-show excitement, friendly surprise, and “이건 눌러봐야 한다”는 즉각적인 호기심.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{큰 썸네일 제목}" must appear exactly as the main Korean headline in the rendered image.
- Supporting rendered text must include "{보조 카피}", "{채널 핸들}", and "{업로드 라벨}" as smaller readable thumbnail labels.
- The composition must remain a 1536x1024 horizontal YouTube thumbnail master with left subject / right headline dominance and strong food-reaction readability.
- Face, hands, and reaction pose must stay anatomically correct with natural finger count if hands are visible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, fake verification marks, or misleading government/certificate-style badges
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Korean typography
- Celebrity composites or lookalike identity blending unless explicitly requested
- Overly sexualized pose or exposure

studio:prompts3:ours-492.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
YouTube thumbnail for a comedy / variety-show meme moment, designed for high click-through on mobile with loud reaction energy, instantly readable Korean headline, and realistic creator-channel packaging.
Use a punchy Korean variety-channel aesthetic with exaggerated facial expression, meme-style graphic accents, bold headline typography, channel handle, view-bait CTA, emoji reaction cue, and an episode/date label that makes the image feel like a real uploaded thumbnail.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {인물 반응} occupies the left 50% as the hero, cropped from chest-up or tighter, with the face enlarged enough to dominate the frame and the expression readable at phone-screen size.
- Text placement: {메인 제목} occupies the right 50% in oversized stacked Korean lines, with strong contrast, thick black outline, and a slightly tilted variety-show rhythm.
- Secondary copy: {서브 카피} sits as a small ribbon or sticker near the headline, acting like a punchline teaser without reducing headline readability.
- Channel packaging: {채널 핸들} appears in a small top-left or bottom-left creator tag, paired with {에피소드 라벨} and {날짜 라벨} as realistic upload metadata graphics.
- View-bait elements: {조회유도 문구}, {강조 이모지}, and {보조 그래픽} appear as accent stickers, arrow marks, burst shapes, or comic bubbles around the headline and face.
- Background treatment: high-saturation studio backdrop or graphic gradient based on {색상 톤}, with layered halftone dots, comic speed lines, and sticker shadows to create a lively meme-board feel.
- Overall framing: {레이아웃} with tight crop, aggressive scale, clear subject-copy separation, and a safe central reading zone for the 1536x1024 thumbnail canvas.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero zone: {인물 반응} shown with vivid meme reaction, eyes and mouth clearly readable, framed as a large cutout with crisp edge stroke, white rim light, and subtle drop shadow.
- Headline zone: {메인 제목} set in giant bold Korean lettering, stacked in 2–3 lines, using bright fill, thick black outline, small white highlight stroke, and a red/yellow emphasis word if appropriate.
- Punchline strip: {서브 카피} placed in a slanted banner, comic caption box, or speech bubble, supporting the joke like a variety-show subtitle.
- Channel identity zone: {채널 핸들} and {채널 컨셉} appear as a compact creator badge with a tiny play icon, episode label, or short channel slogan.
- CTA zone: {조회유도 문구} placed near the bottom-right or under the headline as a small but legible callout, using arrows, exclamation marks, or a sticker tab.
- Accent zone: {보조 그래픽} arranged as comic-style inserts: burst badge, laughing face icon, red arrow, shocked emoji, and small sound-effect lettering such as 빵! or 헉!.
- Color system: apply {색상 톤} consistently across background, text fill, outline, stickers, and CTA accents so the thumbnail reads as a single energetic channel signature.
- Canvas logic: use {비율} with a YouTube-like safe area, keeping the largest face and title inside the central readable region.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a bold Korean sans such as Pretendard ExtraBold, Noto Sans KR Black, or a hand-drawn meme-style display font; headline size should feel oversized, compressed, and optimized for mobile thumbnail impact.
- Text effects: add 6–10px black outline around headline text, white inline stroke, soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset and 10–14px blur, plus small red/yellow highlight blocks behind key words.
- Graphic accents: include a large arrow, circular highlight ring, shocked emoji sticker, comic burst, halftone dots, speed lines, and small caption labels that feel typical of Korean comedy editing.
- Creator details: render {채널 핸들}, {에피소드 라벨}, {날짜 라벨}, and {조회유도 문구} as small thumbnail UI-style elements, not as official seals.
- Color palette: build from {색상 톤}, with bright yellow, vivid red, deep black outlines, white highlight strokes, and a few blue or orange micro accents for modern YouTube energy.
- Composition rhythm: preserve a loud variety-show split-screen look, with the face and the main title competing for attention in a deliberate, click-driven way.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm or 85mm portrait look, f/2.0 to f/2.8, tight crop for exaggerated reaction emphasis, rendered like a polished YouTube thumbnail still.
- Lighting: frontal studio key light with slight upper-left emphasis, light fill from the opposite side, crisp catchlights in the eyes, and controlled shadows so the face stays readable.
- Rendering: sharp cutout portrait, clean edge masking, glossy sticker graphics, high-resolution typography, and compression-aware contrast for mobile readability.
- Color grade: punchy yellow-red-black meme palette with high contrast, hard edges, boosted clarity, vivid saturation, and playful variety-show graphic layering.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean variety-show reaction thumbnail — loud meme-board aesthetic with a Daesung / Running Man / Knowing Bros style punchline feel, realistic creator-channel metadata, and a scroll-stopping what-happened-next vibe.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean headline must be rendered exactly as: {메인 제목}
- Secondary Korean copy must be rendered exactly as: {서브 카피}
- Channel handle must be rendered exactly as: {채널 핸들}
- View-bait CTA must be rendered exactly as: {조회유도 문구}
- Episode/date labels must be readable as: {에피소드 라벨}, {날짜 라벨}
- Small sound effects in {보조 그래픽} must keep Korean characters correct, especially 빵!, 헉!, 대박.
- Face expression: the reaction must read clearly as exaggerated surprise or explosive laughter, not neutral or subtle.
- Composition invariant: hero reaction + giant Korean title must remain immediately readable as a YouTube thumbnail.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or face-swapped identity changes
- Sexualized emphasis or revealing styling

studio:prompts3:ours-491.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean entertainment news summary thumbnail, horizontal 3:2 layout, designed for YouTube or social-media clickability.
A bold headline on the left and a vivid card-collage news summary on the right, set inside a fictional entertainment-news studio with red-carpet press energy, clickable visual tension, and realistic broadcast-thumbnail details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left text block occupies about 38% of the frame; right collage, studio backdrop, and foreground broadcast accents occupy about 62%.
- Place {상단 문구} near the upper-left as a punchy capsule banner, {메인 문구} as the largest hero headline in the mid-left, and {서브 문구} anchored below with tight editorial line spacing.
- Add a small channel handle and timestamp-style metadata under the left stack, such as “@issue_today · 2026.05.01 · 8분 요약”, in tiny but legible Korean/Latin text.
- Right side: arrange {뉴스 카드} as layered rectangular cards in a staggered collage, each card slightly rotated by 2–6 degrees for a lively editorial feel.
- Add YouTube-thumbnail style bait elements: a bright play-button triangle, circular “HOT” badge, arrow pointer, emoji-style sparkle mark, and short Korean micro-labels like “오늘의 톱3”, “조회수 급상승”, “단독 체크”, “핵심만 정리”.
- Background: fictional red-carpet press backdrop with microphone stands, blurred studio lights, camera flashes, monitor glow, reflective floor streaks, and abstract media-stage geometry.
- Use {컬러 톤} throughout the palette, with strong high-contrast zones behind typography so the main text remains readable at mobile thumbnail size.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer — Build a fake entertainment-news stage using deep black and charcoal surfaces, with pink-red light flares, gold highlights, soft bokeh spots, press-camera flash bursts, and a few out-of-focus microphone silhouettes suggesting an active media event.
2. Left headline stack — Set {상단 문구} as a compact banner line above {메인 문구}, then place {서브 문구} as a smaller supporting caption below; all three should align flush-left with consistent editorial padding.
3. Main title emphasis — Make {메인 문구} the dominant element, using oversized bold Korean type with thick strokes, subtle outline, glow rim, and a slight shadow to separate it from the dynamic studio background.
4. Thumbnail metadata — Add tiny realistic YouTube/news graphic details near the left block: “연예 이슈 한눈에”, “@issue_today”, “2026.05.01”, “NEW EP.”, and a small red play icon; keep these secondary to the required placeholder text.
5. Right news collage — Render {뉴스 카드} as 4 separate content cards, each with a distinct mini-frame, rounded corners, thin divider lines, thumbnail-like image placeholders, caption strips, tiny category tags, and accent icons that feel like entertainment-news bullets.
6. Card details — Each card may include short Korean labels such as “TOP 1”, “현장 포착”, “컴백 소식”, “인터뷰”, “시상식 룩”, plus tiny caption bars and small time labels like “1분 전”, “속보 요약”, “오늘 밤 공개”.
7. Foreground accents — Add sparkle lights, lens-flare dots, neon arrows, confetti-like gold flecks, a faint microphone silhouette near the lower-right, and a glossy lower-third strip to reinforce the press/interview theme without overpowering the cards.
8. Final readability pass — Ensure all Korean text remains crisp, with the left headline and right card collage visually balanced so the thumbnail reads instantly on mobile.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {메인 문구}, Pretendard Bold for {상단 문구}, Pretendard Medium for {서브 문구}; title size very large, supporting text medium-small, micro-labels compact and broadcast-like.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} plus near-black #111111, hot pink #FF3D8D, metallic gold #D8B15A, white #FFFFFF, deep red #8A1026.
- Border/shadow: use a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity on title and cards; card borders thin, 2px, in warm gold or white; add glossy highlight edges on key cards.
- Use clean flat fills for the main lettering, with subtle outer glow, sharp contrast backing shapes, and clear spacing between headline lines.
- Make the right collage feel like a real clickable entertainment recap thumbnail: layered cards, bold labels, tiny captions, reaction symbols, and high-energy editorial motion.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame editorial wide shot, f/2.8 look, slightly shallow depth of field for the background stage.
- Lighting: studio softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, pink-red rim light from right, scattered practical bokeh lights in the background, and small simulated camera-flash highlights on card edges.
- Color grade: high-contrast entertainment promo grade with black, magenta, gold, and white accents; glossy broadcast-style finish.
- Rendering: realistic layered digital editorial thumbnail with polished 3D light reflections, crisp Korean typography, and believable media-studio depth.

[6. MOOD]
Fast-paced entertainment bulletin — like a polished Korean variety-show teaser card mixed with a TVN-style headline graphic, dramatic enough to feel clickable but still cleanly readable as a news-summary thumbnail.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as written:
  - {상단 문구}
  - {메인 문구}
  - {서브 문구}
  - {뉴스 카드}
- Additional small Korean text may appear as realistic thumbnail details, for example “오늘의 톱3”, “조회수 급상승”, “핵심만 정리”, “@issue_today”, “2026.05.01”, but it must not compete with the required placeholder text.
- This must remain a fictional entertainment-news thumbnail with no real celebrity faces and no defamatory or rumor-based wording.
- Layout invariant: left text stack + right card collage must be preserved; the collage must clearly read as separate cards.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real celebrity faces or identifiable real-person composites
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals or certification marks

args.name: 뉴스 카드
args.default: 컴백 앨범 발매 / 시상식 수상 / 공항 패션 화제 / 팬들 반응 폭발

studio:prompts3:ours-490.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
YouTube thumbnail for fortune-telling, tarot, and saju content, designed for high click-through with bold Korean headline readability.
Mystic divination channel thumbnail with a dramatic presenter-led layout, symbolic occult props, channel identity cues, and realistic YouTube thumbnail engagement details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {모델·인물 결} occupies the left 50% hero zone in a tight medium shot, with the face and upper torso clearly visible, gaze angled toward the headline area, and one expressive hand gesture directed at the viewer or tarot card.
- Text block placement: {썸네일 카피} fills the right 40–45% as a large stacked headline with thick contrast, wide spacing, and a high-impact outline suitable for mobile viewing.
- Background treatment: deep dark gradient backdrop with smoky texture, faint star-map pattern, glowing constellation lines, scattered gold dust particles, and a soft mystical aura behind the subject.
- Prop framing: {보조 비주얼·소품} appears as layered tarot cards, zodiac symbols, saju chart fragments, moon-phase marks, candle glow, and small gold ornament graphics around the lower-right and near the subject’s shoulder line.
- Thumbnail metadata layer: add {채널 핸들}, {업로드 날짜 라벨}, {조회 유도 배지}, {보조 카피}, and {미니 CTA} as small but readable YouTube-style accents that support the main headline.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Left hero zone: Render the presenter as a sharp, high-contrast thumbnail subject, with one hand lifting or pointing for emphasis and the other hand holding a single tarot card with a visible mystical illustration.
2. Central separation: Use a violet rim light, soft gold edge glow, and faint particle trail to separate the subject from the darker background, creating a bold thumbnail silhouette.
3. Right headline zone: Place {썸네일 카피} in oversized, bold Korean typography with a stacked layout, thick outline, shadow, and gold highlight strokes for instant readability.
4. Hook badge layer: Add {조회 유도 배지} inside a rounded red or gold sticker shape near the top-right corner, paired with {이모지 포인트} as a small attention-grabbing visual cue.
5. Channel identity layer: Place {채널 핸들} near the lower-left or upper-left in a small channel-tag bar, and add {업로드 날짜 라벨} as a compact date pill to make the thumbnail feel like a real uploaded video.
6. Supporting text layer: Add {보조 카피} as a smaller caption strip under the main headline and {미니 CTA} as a small bottom-right callout, both clearly secondary to the main title.
7. Symbol layer: Add {보조 비주얼·소품} as supporting elements, including tarot motifs, zodiac icons, saju grid hints, fortune imagery, glowing card edges, and decorative sparkle bursts.
8. Layout variation support: If needed, shift to the alternate composition described by {레이아웃}, while preserving the same presenter-versus-headline hierarchy and thumbnail-first readability.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main copy, with 72–110px visual scale, thick stroke, and a slight condensed feel for dense headline impact.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with deep purple #3B235E, gold #D8B45A, near-black #101018, violet haze #6B4FA3, urgent red #E63946 for the hook badge, and soft cream #FFF4D2 for small captions.
- Border/shadow: add a soft drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 14px blur, 25% opacity, plus a thin gold outline around the headline and sticker-like outlines around badges.
- Text treatment: use high-contrast white or pale gold Korean lettering on dark fields, with strong outline, inner glow, and subtle bevel highlights to avoid broken characters and maintain mobile clarity.
- Accent graphics: include one bold arrow, burst shape, or circular sticker behind {조회 유도 배지}, plus {이모지 포인트} near the headline without covering the presenter’s face.
- Realistic thumbnail finish: apply crisp cutout edges, mild skin retouching, bright eye catchlights, vivid thumbnail saturation, and layered social-video graphics.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.8 portrait look with a tight crop, shallow depth of field, and crisp facial emphasis for a YouTube thumbnail portrait.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45°, soft fill from front-right, plus a subtle rim light behind the subject to separate from the dark background.
- Color grade: rich purple-and-gold cinematic grade with deep blacks, warm metallic highlights, and a slight neon-violet mystic tint.
- Rendering detail: realistic human skin texture, glossy tarot card surface, metallic gold typography accents, softly glowing candle bokeh, and high-resolution thumbnail sharpening.

[6. MOOD]
Premium mystic YouTube thumbnail — a cross between modern tarot channel branding, polished K-beauty entertainment thumbnail design, and dramatic fortune-telling livestream energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 렌더링될 큰 문구는 {썸네일 카피}.
- 보조 문구는 {보조 카피}, 채널 표기는 {채널 핸들}, 날짜 라벨은 {업로드 날짜 라벨}, 클릭 유도 배지는 {조회 유도 배지}, 하단 콜투액션은 {미니 CTA}로 정확히 표시한다.
- {이모지 포인트}는 제목 옆이나 배지 옆에 작게 배치하되 얼굴과 손을 가리지 않는다.

[1. PURPOSE]
K-pop analysis/reaction YouTube thumbnail with strong click-through intent, combining a host portrait, bold Korean headline, compact idol-collage support graphics, channel handle, and view-bait sticker elements.
Designed for music commentary channels that need an instantly readable, high-energy thumbnail with a signature K-pop editorial look suitable for a YouTube upload and reusable series branding.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left-right split layout: {레이아웃} as the baseline, with the main person occupying about 48–52% of the frame and the headline block taking the remaining space.
- Main subject: {진행자 포즈} placed as the visual anchor, cropped large from chest-up or waist-up, with a clear face silhouette, expressive eyes, and a hand gesture pointing toward the Korean title.
- Background treatment: dark gradient stage base with neon pink, purple, electric cyan streaks, concert-light haze, LED screen dots, soft bokeh, and glossy K-pop broadcast texture.
- Secondary visual zone: {아이돌 콜라주 묘사} arranged as layered mini photo-card tiles, comeback-stage fragments, waveform bars, and a microphone icon near the lower-right or lower band.
- YouTube metadata styling: add {채널 핸들}, {에피소드 라벨}, a small view-bait sticker {리액션 배지}, and an accent shape with {액센트 이모지} so the thumbnail feels like an actual uploaded video cover.
- Branding feel: {채널 컨셉} should read as a repeatable channel signature, using consistent neon frame accents, punchy Korean typography, and a high-contrast hierarchy for mobile browsing.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main portrait area: {진행자 포즈} cut out sharply and placed on the left half or centered hero position depending on {레이아웃}, with a punchy facial expression, crisp edge separation, neon rim light, and a few animated reaction marks around the face.
2. Headline area: place {메인 카피} in a large, stacked Korean display treatment on the right half or upper/lower split, using thick characters, aggressive scale, bright outline, and strong contrast for instant mobile readability.
3. Subtitle and hook: place {서브 카피} as a smaller secondary line under or beside the main headline, plus {리액션 배지} inside a sticker, speech bubble, or jagged burst shape.
4. Support graphics: integrate {아이돌 콜라주 묘사} as small layered elements behind or below the headline, including idol mini-collage tiles, stage spotlight strips, album-card silhouettes, music waveform graphics, and a microphone icon.
5. Channel identity: include {채널 핸들} near the top-left or bottom-left, {에피소드 라벨} near the corner, and a tiny play-button motif or comment-bubble icon to reinforce the YouTube thumbnail context.
6. Color system: apply {컬러 톤} through the background glow, rim light, accent shapes, sticker border, and headline outline so the thumbnail feels like a K-pop reaction/editorial cover rather than a generic talk thumbnail.
7. Composition finish: emphasize the face, title, sticker, and idol-collage cluster with dynamic diagonal motion streaks, glow rings, chromatic edge highlights, and glossy editorial polish optimized for YouTube thumbnail scale.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main Korean copy, with compressed line spacing, large size, tight tracking, and a comic-like thumbnail punch.
- Main headline styling: use thick white or yellow Korean lettering with hot-pink/purple shadow, black outer stroke, and a second neon outline for maximum separation against the dark background.
- Color palette: use deep black #0B0B10, hot pink #FF3EA5, purple #7A2CFF, electric magenta #FF4FD8, neon cyan #2DE2E6, and bright thumbnail yellow #FFE45C from {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: add a thick white or pale outline around the headline, plus a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and 20% opacity on the subject cutout.
- Graphic treatment: use sharp diagonal shapes, glow rings, jagged burst marks, waveform strips, tiny sparkle highlights, emoji-style accent graphics, and sticker labels that support the title and reaction theme.
- Realistic upload details: make the design look like a finished YouTube thumbnail with a recognizable channel handle, episode label, bold hook, and layered editorial elements rather than a blank promotional graphic.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 portrait look, shallow depth of field for the person, combined with clean compositing typical of polished YouTube thumbnail production.
- Lighting: strong key light from upper-left at about 45°, slight neon rim from the right, magenta/cyan stage spill on hair and shoulders, with enough fill to keep facial features readable and dramatic.
- Color grade: dark noir base with pink-purple neon highlights, high contrast, saturated K-pop club/editorial grade, crisp skin-tone separation, glossy highlight roll-off, and digital thumbnail sharpness.
- Post-production: subject cutout with precise hair detail, chromatic glow around shoulders, high-pass sharpening on the face and text, soft lens bokeh in the background, and subtle motion blur on diagonal streaks only.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy K-pop commentary thumbnail — a YouTube reaction cover with music-video premiere energy, comeback-stage excitement, fan-analysis urgency, and a glossy Korean pop editorial feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear exactly and be rendered cleanly: "이 무대 진짜 미쳤음", "신곡 가사 분석", "소름 포인트 3개", "@케이팝분석실", "EP.27".
- If the chosen layout uses large headline text, keep the Korean characters fully intact, bold, legible, and not warped or partially hidden.
- The subject must remain a single person-like figure with natural proportions, correct facial structure, believable expression, and natural hands.
- Include the accent emoji "🔥" as a graphic sticker or burst accent near the headline without replacing any Korean text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity face composites or identity-mixed idol faces
- Fabricated official chart rankings presented as real certification

- Main visual area (right 65%): illustrate {장면} as a generic queue-outside-restaurant scene, including a numbered waiting ticket, a partial food preview, crowd depth, a storefront awning, a chalkboard-style waiting note, and reflections on the shop window.
- Review overlay layer: place {리뷰 요소} as icon badges near the lower-right, using short Korean micro labels like "맛", "가격", "회전율", "재방문"; keep them readable and connected to the review theme.
- Add realistic thumbnail proof details: waiting ticket text "대기번호 47", small receipt strip "2인 / 18:42", queue board text "현재 대기 83팀", photo caption tag "현장 도착 컷", and a small timestamp label "오후 6:30".
- Food preview: include a glossy close-up dish crop in the foreground, steam, sauce shine, chopsticks or spoon edge, and a tiny label "대표 메뉴" without naming a real restaurant.
- Depth treatment: use a foreground food cutout, midground waiting line, and background storefront suggestion to create a layered “real review” feeling.
- Edge framing: keep the right side denser and more detailed than the left to balance the large headline, with photo-card corners, tape stickers, and soft drop shadows.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {메인 문구} at poster-scale, Pretendard SemiBold for {서브 문구}, and Noto Sans KR Medium for small labels, waiting-ticket text, handle, and review badges.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with concrete anchors of #D62828 red, #F7F1E3 cream, and #111111 black; use warm beige, muted gray, and small yellow highlight accents for realistic thumbnail contrast.
- Border/shadow: subtle 4px vertical offset soft shadow, 14px blur, 18% opacity under cards and text blocks; thin black outline on key icons, arrow, emoji, and badges for readability.
- Graphic accents: use a red arrow, circular highlight, sticker labels, diagonal tape pieces, tiny comment bubble, and small "NEW" or "HOT" tag to enhance click-worthy food-review energy.
- Texture and realism: include paper grain, printed ticket fibers, laminated menu reflections, sidewalk marks, jacket folds, phone screens, and natural crowd variation to make the scene feel photographed rather than sterile.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm documentary-style wide shot, f/2.8, slightly compressed thumbnail perspective, inspired by food-review content photography.
- Lighting: bright overcast daylight from upper-left, with a mild fill bounce from the right to keep the waiting line and food preview evenly visible.
- Color grade: vivid red + warm cream + neutral black, with slight contrast boost and crisp highlights for a social-thumbnail finish.
- Rendering approach: realistic editorial-photo collage with crisp typography, shallow but readable depth, natural human poses in the queue, appetizing food highlights, and polished social media thumbnail finishing.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean food-review editorial — like a YouTube thumbnail translated through a clean magazine cover layout, with believable waiting-line proof, punchy captions, and appetizing street-food-review atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: "{메인 문구}", "{서브 문구}".
- Additional Korean micro text may include: "@mat_review", "EP.18", "2026.05.01 업로드", "대기번호 47", "현재 대기 83팀", "진짜 줄 설만해?", "현장 도착 컷", "맛", "가격", "회전율", "재방문".
- Content must feel like a generic restaurant review, not a specific named restaurant.
- Review elements must be presented as visual indicators and personal-review graphics, not as deceptive official verification.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean coding-error resolution tutorial thumbnail for YouTube or blog cover, split-layout with bold text on the left and a laptop code mockup on the right.
Designed to communicate “beginner-friendly debugging” at a glance in a clickable tech-thumbnail format with creator-channel details, dramatic error-to-solution cues, and strong view-bait energy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left 42% of the frame: large headline block with {메인 문구} and {서브 문구}, aligned left, stacked with strong hierarchy and energetic line spacing.
- Add a bright rounded badge near the headline reading {강조 배지}, plus a small emoji/accent sticker {썸네일 이모지} beside the main phrase for instant YouTube-style recognition.
- Below the subtitle, place a compact creator row: {채널 핸들} · {업로드 날짜} · {조회 유도 문구}, styled like a small tech-channel metadata strip.
- Right 58% of the frame: {장면} as the visual focal point, filling most of the height with a slight perspective angle.
- Background: {분위기} with matte navy desk surface, subtle grid texture, sticky notes with tiny debugging scribbles, coffee cup reflection, cable curve, and faint neon glow accents near the monitor edges.
- Use a diagonal red arrow or circular highlight pointing from the text area toward the error icon, with a green glow trail leading to the solved check mark.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Text block (left): place {메인 문구} in the upper-middle area with maximum emphasis, then {서브 문구} directly below as a smaller supporting line.
- Add {강조 배지} as a high-contrast pill label above or beside the main headline, and render {조회 유도 문구} as a small but legible callout under the channel handle.
- Scene block (right): show {장면} as a laptop screen mockup with code editor panes, a prominent red error icon, and a green success check nearby for clear before/after contrast.
- Visual hierarchy: the red error indicator should feel urgent with a warning triangle, red underline, or popup panel; the green check should look like the final solved state with a subtle celebration sparkle.
- Background props: keyboard edge, desk lamp reflection, debug checklist sticky note, mouse, terminal mini-window, and a faint line graph can appear as authentic developer-desk details while staying secondary to the main laptop screen.
- Keep all code content generic and fictional; use short placeholder lines, highlighted syntax colors, simplified UI chrome, tiny file tabs, and a visible but unreadable terminal error summary.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {메인 문구} at roughly 72–92px, Pretendard SemiBold for {서브 문구} at 34–44px, both in crisp white with slight tracking.
- Metadata typography: Pretendard Bold or Medium for {채널 핸들}, {업로드 날짜}, and {조회 유도 문구} at roughly 20–28px, using off-white and neon green accents.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} plus accent red #FF4D4D for errors, accent green #2ED47A for success, off-white #F5F7FA for text, deep navy #0B1020 for the base.
- Text treatment: add a subtle outer glow or thin shadow to the headline for readability on the dark background; apply a red-to-green accent underline beneath the key word in {메인 문구}.
- Badge and accent shapes: use rounded rectangles, thick arrows, soft neon rings, small sparkle marks, and a YouTube-thumbnail-style duration pill in the bottom-right corner reading “08:21”.
- Border/shadow: use a soft drop shadow under the laptop mockup, 8px y-offset, 20px blur, 18% opacity, and a faint neon rim light around the screen.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm lens at f/2.8, slightly angled three-quarter product shot to give the laptop depth while keeping the text area flat and readable.
- Lighting: low-key studio setup with soft key light from upper-left, subtle cyan rim light from the right, and a dim practical glow from the desk surface.
- Color grade: dark navy base with neon green and red UI accents, slightly cool contrast, crisp digital editorial finish.
- Rendering detail: realistic laptop reflections, shallow depth on foreground keyboard edges, glossy UI highlights, soft haze around neon elements, and sharp vector-like typography composited over the scene.

[6. MOOD]
A high-contrast creator-education thumbnail with a modern tech editorial feel, tuned for YouTube tutorial clarity, urgent debugging drama, and satisfying “problem solved” momentum.
The mood should feel helpful, fast, and practical: a beginner sees the error, the fix path, the channel cue, and the promise of an easy walkthrough immediately.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “코딩 에러 해결”, “초보도 따라함”, “3분 디버깅”, “@dev-note”, “2026.05 업로드”, “지금 바로 해결!” must appear exactly and clearly when using the default values.
- Include a YouTube-style clickable composition: bold headline, badge, emoji accent, channel handle, upload/date label, call-to-action microcopy, and a small duration pill “08:21”.
- The laptop screen must show only fictional/generic code; no readable real API keys, no secret tokens, and no long legible production code blocks.
- Keep the layout clearly split: text-heavy left side, mockup-heavy right side, with the red error cue and green solved cue both instantly recognizable.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Misleading government or institutional endorsement marks

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a horizontal 3:2 car interior review thumbnail for a tech-review style YouTube video or blog cover. The layout should feel crisp, high-contrast, realistic, and highly clickable, with a premium automotive cockpit on the left and a bold Korean thumbnail information system on the right.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left side 58%: {장면} as the main visual hero, framed tightly so the dashboard, steering wheel, infotainment screen, digital cluster, air vents, stitching, console controls, cup holder area, and ambient light strips feel immersive and believable.
- Right side 42%: stacked text and info module area with {메인 문구}, {서브 문구}, and {정보 요소} arranged as bold YouTube thumbnail blocks with a small channel handle, date label, and attention-grabbing accent shapes.
- Keep a strong left-right balance with a subtle vertical separation zone; the frame should feel energetic and content-rich while every Korean text element remains readable at thumbnail size.
- Use a modern car interior with realistic materials, reflections, screen glow, leather grain, metallic trim, soft dust-free surfaces, and natural dashboard depth. Brand or model details may appear only as incidental visual realism, not as the focus.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero image area (left 58%): show {장면} as a sharp, realistic interior close view with the dashboard sweeping diagonally from lower-left to upper-center, steering wheel partially visible, digital instrument cluster glowing, center display lit with simple UI shapes, and center console lines leading toward the right.
2. Detail callouts over hero area: add 2-3 small blue outline circles or arrow pointers highlighting interior features such as “와이드 디스플레이”, “수납공간”, “앰비언트 라이트”; keep them integrated like a real review thumbnail overlay.
3. Text block (upper-right): place {메인 문구} in the largest type, aligned left, with strong contrast and a compact two-line layout if needed. Add a small red or electric-blue pill label above it reading “NEW 실내 분석” or “FIRST LOOK”.
4. Subtitle block (mid-right): place {서브 문구} directly under the main title, smaller and lighter weight, but still bold enough for thumbnail readability. Add one short punchy Korean hook nearby such as “직접 앉아봤습니다” or “생각보다 넓다?”.
5. Info cards (lower-right): arrange {정보 요소} as 2-3 compact cards or badges with check icons, score-style chips, and blue highlights, keeping the cards evenly spaced and visually consistent. Include realistic micro labels such as “공간감”, “디스플레이”, “버튼 배치”.
6. YouTube thumbnail extras: include a small channel handle “@AutoLab_KR”, a date tag “2026.05”, a tiny view-bait accent “🔥”, and a slim lower ticker strip reading “실내 장점·단점 빠르게 정리”.
7. Separation and emphasis: use a crisp diagonal overlay, glassmorphism panel, or thin luminous divider to keep the image and text zones distinct while preserving depth and visual energy.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {메인 문구}, Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Medium for {서브 문구}, and Pretendard Medium for {정보 요소}; title size should dominate the right side with thumbnail-first readability.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} with charcoal #1E1F24, electric blue #2D6BFF, and white #FFFFFF; add small red #FF3B30 or yellow #FFD84D accents only for labels, arrows, emoji, or urgent thumbnail emphasis.
- Border/shadow: apply a soft but defined shadow under text boxes and cards, around 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 18% opacity, with slightly rounded corners for the info elements.
- Graphic language: use bold rounded rectangles, angled blue highlight bars, subtle glass panels, UI-style chips, feature arrows, and small review metadata elements so the thumbnail feels like a polished Korean automotive YouTube upload.
- Text hierarchy: {메인 문구} must be the dominant visual anchor; {서브 문구}, {정보 요소}, handle, date, and micro labels should support the story without competing with the title.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 24mm wide-angle automotive interior shot, slightly above dashboard height, f/4 look with crisp perspective and controlled distortion.
- Lighting: cool studio-like daylight from upper-left, subtle fill from the right, realistic windshield reflections, dashboard highlights, soft screen glow, and metallic surfaces rendered clearly.
- Color grade: charcoal base with electric-blue UI accents and neutral white highlights; keep the car interior realistic, clean, and slightly premium-tech in tone.
- Realism details: visible leather or soft-touch grain, stitching lines, piano-black reflections, brushed metal trim, tactile buttons, small fingerprints on glossy screen edges, and believable depth through the windshield or side window.

[6. MOOD]
High-performance automotive tech review thumbnail — clean YouTube thumbnail energy with a Carwow-style comparison graphic feel, but richer and more realistic, like a premium Korean car review channel revealing the cockpit details for the first time.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 합니다: “신차 실내 리뷰”, “장점 단점 3가지”.
- Also include readable Korean thumbnail microcopy such as “NEW 실내 분석”, “직접 앉아봤습니다”, “공간감”, “디스플레이”, “버튼 배치”, and “실내 장점·단점 빠르게 정리”.
- Include a small channel handle “@AutoLab_KR” and date label “2026.05” as realistic YouTube thumbnail metadata.
- 자동차는 일반 차량 실내처럼 보여야 하며, 계기판이나 인포테인먼트 화면의 숫자·아이콘은 실제처럼 보이되 허위 성능 비교나 검증된 제원처럼 보이는 차트는 만들지 마세요.
- All text must be legible, correctly kerned, and free of broken Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a horizontal 3:2 YouTube thumbnail for a book-summary channel, designed to communicate “one book in 10 minutes” at a glance.
Make it feel like a real, clickable BookTube thumbnail: a believable reading-desk scene on the left and a bold, high-impact Korean title stack on the right, optimized for fast mobile recognition.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas is 3:2 landscape with a strong split composition: left 52% for the scene, icons, and small supporting thumbnail details; right 48% for the main title stack.
- Right text block is vertically centered and occupies about 70% of the height, with oversized headline emphasis, a supporting line underneath, and small channel/series details near the bottom.
- Left side features {장면} as the visual anchor, surrounded by {아이콘}, a stopwatch/timer cue, sticky notes, bookmark tabs, pencil marks, and subtle reading-desk details that support the “10-minute summary” idea.
- Use {메인 문구} and {서브 문구} as the exact text hierarchy on the right. Add short supporting thumbnail labels in Korean such as “📚 10분컷”, “오늘의 핵심 3가지”, “저장 필수”, and a small handle “@10min_book” without overpowering the main phrase.
- Background should feel like a warm reading desk surface: beige paper texture, soft shadows, faint notebook grid, highlighter strokes, realistic edges of paper, and editorial lighting.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Left hero area (about 52% width): build {장면} as a realistic tabletop editorial still-life, with a slightly angled view so the books, notebook, bookmarks, and timer read clearly at thumbnail size.
2) Around the left hero: place {아이콘} as modern line icons or compact filled icons, mixed with small accent shapes such as a circular “10 MIN” badge, arrow stickers, and a yellow highlight underline.
3) Right title area: set {메인 문구} as the largest text, bold and highly legible, then place {서브 문구} directly below it in smaller type with tighter spacing. Use a bold contrast panel or soft paper-card backing behind the text if needed for readability.
4) Add YouTube-thumbnail cues: a small channel handle “@10min_book”, a tiny “VOL.247” label, a red play-button accent shape, and a small bottom tag reading “오늘의 핵심 3가지”.
5) Overall balance: keep the left scene tactile and realistic with visible paper fibers, shadows, tabs, and desk objects, while the right title remains crisp, punchy, and immediately readable.
6) Surface and framing: use a desk-like composition with natural object overlap, layered papers, readable sticker labels, and enough safe area so all main Korean text is fully visible.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {메인 문구}, Pretendard SemiBold or Medium for {서브 문구}; headline size should be very large, roughly 92–120 px equivalent, with subtext at 42–56 px equivalent.
- Supporting labels: use compact Korean text in small rounded rectangles or sticker-like tags, such as “📚 10분컷”, “VOL.247”, “저장 필수”, and “@10min_book”; keep these secondary to {메인 문구}.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} as the main scheme, with warm beige #E8DDC8, deep dark green #1F3A2E, black #111111, cream paper tones, muted yellow highlight, and a small red YouTube-style accent.
- Border/shadow: apply a soft drop shadow under books, notebook, timer, sticky notes, and the title card area, about 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; use subtle physical depth and realistic contact shadows.
- Graphic accents: add underline strokes, small arrows, page-corner folds, bookmark ribbons, and simple motion lines around the timer to make the thumbnail feel energetic without reducing legibility.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic tabletop product-photo look, 50mm lens equivalent at f/4, slightly elevated angle for a clean, thumbnail-friendly layout.
- Lighting: warm desk lamp from upper-left at about 35°, with a gentle fill from the right to preserve readable text contrast and soft object shadows.
- Color grade: warm beige + deep green + charcoal, with slightly desaturated highlights and a calm editorial contrast similar to a modern productivity/booktube thumbnail.
- Rendering detail: realistic paper texture, subtle coffee-ring mark, graphite pencil tip, translucent sticky tabs, satin book-cover surfaces, shallow shadows, and crisp vector-like overlay text.

[6. MOOD]
Calm but clickable reading-summary channel aesthetic — a realistic editorial BookTube thumbnail with a warm desk still-life, quick-learning energy, and a modern productivity brand feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: "책 1권 10분 요약", "핵심만 읽기".
- Additional Korean thumbnail text may include: "📚 10분컷", "오늘의 핵심 3가지", "저장 필수", "VOL.247", "@10min_book".
- Use only a fictional book image and generic book shapes; do not depict an identifiable published book cover or real author name.
- Keep all Korean text crisp, correctly spelled, and large enough to remain readable at thumbnail size.

- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
게임 공략 유튜브 썸네일, 3:2 가로형, 보스전 공략 주제의 강렬한 클릭 유도 이미지.
가상의 RPG/액션 게임 장면처럼 보이되, 특정 게임 IP를 연상시키지 않는 독립적인 구성.
모바일 피드에서 즉시 읽히는 대형 한국어 타이틀, 실제 게임 캡처처럼 보이는 풍부한 HUD, 공격 이펙트, 채널 브랜딩, 회차 정보, 감정적인 클릭 유도 배지와 공략 포인트 콜아웃을 포함한 완성형 유튜브 썸네일.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left third: {메인 문구}를 가장 크게 배치하고, 시선이 즉시 잡히도록 세로 정렬된 헤드라인 블록으로 구성. 글자 뒤에는 찢어진 검은 금속판 형태의 반투명 배경, 붉은 에너지 균열, 금속 리벳, 칼자국 스크래치를 넣어 게임 공략 썸네일다운 밀도를 강화.
- Bottom-left strip: {서브 문구}를 보조 카피로 넣고, 노란 경고 라벨 또는 캡슐형 공략 태그처럼 보여주며, 옆에 불꽃 이모지 스타일 아이콘, “긴급 공략”, “초보 가능” 마이크로 라벨을 추가.
- Right two-thirds: {장면}을 중심으로 구성하고, 그 위에 {UI 요소}를 게임 HUD처럼 겹쳐 배치. 보스 HP 바, 약점 표시 원형 타깃, 스킬 쿨타임 아이콘, 피해 숫자, 미니맵 조각, 전투 로그처럼 보이는 짧은 한글 UI를 자연스럽게 배치.
- Top area: 채널 핸들 “{채널 핸들}”, 영상 분류 라벨 “{영상 분류}”, 빨간 LIVE-style 포인트 배지 “보스전”, 작은 업로드 날짜 “{업로드 날짜}”를 넣어 실제 유튜브 썸네일처럼 정보 밀도를 높임.
- Upper-right hook: 큰 빨간 화살표와 원형 확대 콜아웃을 사용해 보스의 약점 부위를 가리키고, {클릭 배지} 스티커를 대각선으로 붙여 위기감과 클릭 욕구를 강조.
- Right foreground: 보스의 거대한 무기, 부서진 방패, 튀는 금속 파편, 바닥의 용암 균열, 플레이어 캐릭터의 작은 실루엣을 넣어 스케일 차이를 분명하게 표현. 플레이어 주변에는 회피 타이밍을 암시하는 잔상과 흰색 궤적선을 추가.
- Lower band: “{회차 라벨}”, “약점 공개”, “3분 컷”, “패턴 캔슬” 같은 작은 스티커형 정보 조각을 배치하고, 우측 하단에는 조회수 유도형 마이크로 카피 “지금 안 보면 전멸”을 작게 넣음.
- Background treatment: 어두운 전장 배경에 연기, 금속 파편, 붉은 에너지 안개, 무너진 성벽, 전투 흔적, 바닥 먼지와 불씨가 퍼지는 질감 있는 공간. 보스 뒤의 폭발 섬광과 전장 UI 패널이 실제 게임 장면처럼 겹쳐 보이게 함.
- Spacing and framing: 왼쪽 텍스트 영역과 오른쪽 액션 영역의 대비를 강하게 두고, 중앙 경계에 시선이 걸리도록 약간의 대각선 구도를 사용. 텍스트와 보스가 겹치는 지점에는 붉은 슬래시 그래픽과 금색 번개 모양 분리선을 넣어 시선 흐름을 연결.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Left title block: {메인 문구}를 굵고 압축감 있는 타이포로 크게 배치, 3:2 썸네일에서도 한눈에 읽히게 전체 높이의 약 35%를 차지하도록 설정. 글자 일부에는 금색 하이라이트, 붉은 외곽선, 거친 전투 스크래치 텍스처, 미세한 불꽃 입자를 적용.
2. Subtitle block: 하단에 {서브 문구}를 넣고, 작은 배지나 캡슐형 태그처럼 정리해 메인 문구와 시각적 계층을 분리. 주변에 “3분 컷”, “약점 공개”, “패턴 5개”, “노데스 루트” 같은 짧은 보조 라벨을 스티커처럼 배치.
3. Boss scene: {장면}을 오른쪽 중앙에 배치해 가장 큰 시각적 피사체로 만들고, 붉은 오라와 역광 실루엣으로 위협감을 강조. 보스 뒤에는 폭발 섬광, 날카로운 무기 궤적, 거대한 체력바를 겹쳐 전투 중인 순간처럼 보이게 함.
4. UI overlay: {UI 요소}를 화면 상단과 우측 일부에 배치해 실제 게임 전투 화면처럼 보이게 한다. 상단에는 “BOSS HP x12” 스타일의 긴 체력바, 우측에는 스킬 아이콘 3개, 중앙 보스 약점에는 원형 타깃 마커와 “약점!” 라벨을 선명하게 노출.
5. View-bait accents: 붉은 슬래시 자국, 큰 화살표, 원형 줌 인셋, 작은 불꽃 파편, 충격파 링, 피해 숫자 “9999”, 경고 삼각형, 노란 체크 마크, 흔들림 블러를 피사체 주변에 넣어 역동성을 강화.
6. YouTube thumbnail details: 상단 좌측 또는 우측에 작은 채널 핸들 “{채널 핸들}”, 하단 한쪽에 짧은 회차 라벨 “{회차 라벨}”, 클릭 유도 스티커 “{클릭 배지}”를 포함. 모든 보조 문구는 메인 문구보다 작고 보조적이어야 함.
7. Realistic creator layout: 실제 게임 공략 채널 썸네일처럼 얇은 검정 상단 바, 작은 빨간 녹화 점, 흰색 시간 코드 “00:47”, 노란 공략 체크 아이콘, 반투명 채팅 로그 “회피 후 딜!”, “2페이즈 조심”을 넣어 방송 캡처와 편집 썸네일이 결합된 느낌을 만든다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for {메인 문구}, Pretendard Bold for {서브 문구}; 메인 문구는 84–120px급 느낌, 서브 문구는 34–48px급 느낌. 보조 라벨은 22–32px급 느낌으로 작지만 또렷하게.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}를 기본으로 하되, #0B0B0F, #D61F2A, #F1B84B, #FFFFFF 같은 고대비 조합으로 마감. 위험 표시는 붉은색, 공략 정보와 약점 표시는 금색과 흰색으로 구분.
- Border/shadow: 텍스트에는 8px 정도의 강한 검은 외곽 그림자와 18% 투명도의 미세한 글로우를 적용, UI 요소에는 얇은 금속성 테두리와 2px 하이라이트. 메인 타이틀은 이중 외곽선과 약한 입체감을 주어 게임 썸네일다운 밀도를 만든다.
- Graphic elements: 굵은 화살표, 원형 타깃, 경고 삼각형, 빨간 X 마크, 노란 체크 마크, 이모지 느낌의 불꽃 아이콘, 확대경 인셋, 대각선 속도선, 충격파 링을 사용해 시청자가 공략 포인트를 즉시 이해하게 함.
- HUD realism: UI는 가상의 게임 인터페이스처럼 반투명 패널, 체력 게이지, 작은 수치, 아이콘 슬롯, 얇은 스캔라인과 유리 질감을 포함하되, 핵심 텍스트의 가독성을 해치지 않게 정돈.
- Creator branding: {채널 핸들}, {영상 분류}, {업로드 날짜}, {회차 라벨}은 실제 유튜브 게임 채널의 편집 그래픽처럼 작게 배치하고, 과도하게 공식 게임 로고처럼 보이지 않게 독립적인 채널 브랜딩으로 처리.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: cinematic game-poster framing, 35mm wide-angle feel at f/2.8, slight low-angle perspective to make the boss feel larger than life.
- Lighting: strong backlight from upper-right, faint red underglow from bottom-left, hard-edged rim light on the boss silhouette, subtle fill on the UI. 보스 무기와 갑옷 모서리에는 뜨거운 금색 림라이트를 추가.
- Color grade: black and crimson base with molten gold highlights, high contrast, slightly desaturated shadows, arcade action-poster finish.
- Texture and finish: smoky battlefield particles, sparks, cracked stone floor, heat haze, metallic debris, glowing UI glass, compressed YouTube thumbnail sharpness with punchy contrast.
- Depth: foreground sparks and damage numbers, midground boss and player silhouette, background ruins and smoke layers로 깊이감을 구성. 왼쪽 타이틀은 전경 그래픽처럼 선명하고, 오른쪽 보스 장면은 약간의 모션 블러와 피사계 심도를 섞어 영상 캡처 같은 현실감을 준다.

[6. MOOD]
High-stakes game strategy thumbnail — polished YouTube gaming guide poster with a cinematic boss-fight trailer energy.
긴박한 레이드 실패 직전의 순간, “이 공략을 보면 깰 수 있다”는 느낌이 들도록 과장된 액션, 명확한 약점 표시, 강한 타이포그래피, 실제 게임 방송 썸네일 같은 정보 밀도를 전달.
시청자가 모바일 피드에서 멈춰 보게 만드는 위기감, 성공 루트가 숨겨져 있다는 기대감, 보스의 압도적인 크기와 공략 채널의 신뢰감을 동시에 표현.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문자열은 “{메인 문구}”, “{서브 문구}”, “{클릭 배지}”, “{회차 라벨}”.
- Additional Korean micro text may include: “긴급 공략”, “패턴 분석”, “약점 공개”, “패턴 5개”, “노데스 루트”, “초보 가능”, “약점!”, “회피 후 딜!”, “2페이즈 조심”, “지금 안 보면 전멸”.
- Small channel handle should read “{채널 핸들}” and remain secondary to the main title; video category should read “{영상 분류}”.
- The scene must be a fictional game battle image, not tied to any real game franchise.
- Main title must be large and instantly legible on mobile, with strong outline and shadow.
- Keep the boss, HUD, action effects, Korean callouts, creator handle, date label, and view-bait stickers visually rich while ensuring “{메인 문구}” and “{서브 문구}” are the clearest text elements.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certification marks
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness
