studio:prompts3:ours-476.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
3:2 YouTube unboxing first-impression thumbnail for a lively Korean product review. Designed to look clickable, real, and energetic, with bold Korean title text, a surprised fictional adult reviewer, an opened parcel box reveal, and authentic creator-thumbnail details such as channel handle, reaction stickers, arrows, and small product-check labels.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left side text block occupies about 42% of frame, stacked headline and subheadline aligned left, with bold outlines, color blocks, and thumbnail-friendly contrast.
- Right side product scene occupies about 58% of frame: open shipping box, {제품}, tissue paper, tape, delivery label, manual card, protective filler, and a surprised fictional adult reviewer leaning into frame.
- Speech bubble floats near the reviewer’s face with high contrast, rounded comic styling, and an expressive pointer tail aimed toward the reaction.
- Background is a bright creator studio tabletop scene using {컬러 톤} as the dominant palette, with realistic desk texture, subtle wall gradient, small filming accessories, and colorful graphic accents that support the unboxing story.
- Include YouTube thumbnail cues: a red play-button style icon, a bold arrow or circle pointing at the product, a small channel handle label, and compact Korean sticker text such as “찐 첫인상”, “구성품 체크”, or “3분 언박싱”.
- Keep the composition thumbnail-friendly, with large readable text, oversized facial expression, clear product reveal hierarchy, and rich but controlled details that make the scene feel like a real creator upload.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Left text area: place {메인 문구} as the largest headline, bold and condensed, with {서브 문구} directly below in smaller supporting type. Use tight vertical stacking, black or white stroke, and a punchy color slab or glow behind key words for mobile readability.
2. Add small creator metadata near the lower-left or top-left: “@unbox_lab”, “FIRST LOOK”, “EP.27”, and a tiny date tag “2026.05.01” in Korean thumbnail UI style, without competing with the main headline.
3. Right hero area: show an open cardboard parcel box angled slightly toward camera, with {제품} partially lifted out so the unboxing moment is obvious at a glance. Include realistic box flaps, crumpled kraft paper, bubble wrap, torn packing tape, a printed delivery sticker, and a small instruction leaflet.
4. Reviewer character: place a fictional adult reviewer on the far right or slightly behind the box, with a shocked, delighted expression, raised eyebrows, mouth slightly open, and one hand gesturing toward the product reveal. Add realistic clothing texture, catchlights in eyes, and natural skin detail.
5. Speech bubble: position {말풍선} near the reviewer’s head, sized large enough to read on mobile, with thick outline, playful comic shape, and a small accent emoji or starburst nearby.
6. Visual emphasis: add a bold arrow, circular highlight ring, motion burst, sparkle shapes, and compact pop labels around the product reveal. Keep these graphic overlays integrated with the real tabletop scene.
7. Add small thumbnail engagement details: a tiny “새 제품?” sticker, a check-mark tag reading “실사용 전”, and a subtle faux video duration badge “08:12” in one corner.
8. Background and surface: use a realistic bright studio desk with soft reflections, scattered unboxing materials, a small camera/mic silhouette, and color-coordinated props that reinforce the creator review environment while keeping all major text clear.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for {메인 문구}, Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for {서브 문구}, and a handwritten/comic-style Korean font for {말풍선}. Headline size should dominate like a YouTube thumbnail masthead.
- Color palette: build around {컬러 톤} with white #FFFFFF, hot pink #FF2D7A, black #111111, vivid yellow #FFE14D, and optional light gray #EAEAEA for support surfaces.
- Border/shadow: add a soft drop shadow under the box and product, around 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; use crisp text outlines, thick strokes, glow accents, and sticker shadows for readability.
- Text treatment: {메인 문구} should be bold and clean with strong contrast; {서브 문구} should be smaller but still punchy; extra Korean micro-text must be short, realistic, and placed like thumbnail labels rather than long paragraphs.
- Graphic overlays: use saturated arrows, circles, spark bursts, emoji accents, and sticker tabs in a modern Korean creator style. Make them feel intentionally designed, not random.
- Realism details: cardboard grain, torn tape fibers, printed shipping label texture, plastic wrap highlights, product reflections, and natural hand/face lighting should be visible.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame lens look at f/4, slightly elevated front-right angle, thumbnail-style product framing with moderate perspective.
- Lighting: bright studio softbox from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, faint rim light to separate the reviewer from the background; keep shadows soft but defined.
- Color grade: high-key white base with hot pink accents and deep black anchors, clean commercial-review finish, slightly boosted saturation for mobile thumbnail impact.
- Rendering: realistic photographic creator-studio look combined with crisp graphic text overlays, sharp facial expression, sharp product edges, and mild background falloff.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean YouTube unboxing thumbnail — modern creator review style with clean commercial polish, excited first-impression reaction, realistic parcel-opening details, and clickable visual drama similar in spirit to fast-paced lifestyle tech and gadget review thumbnails.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as written in the image: "{메인 문구}", "{서브 문구}", "{말풍선}".
- Add short Korean thumbnail labels such as “찐 첫인상”, “구성품 체크”, “새 제품?”, “실사용 전”, plus the channel handle “@unbox_lab” and date tag “2026.05.01”.
- The reviewer must be a fictional adult, not a celebrity or real person.
- The product reveal, opened parcel, box contents, reaction face, arrow/circle emphasis, and bold Korean title must clearly read as an unboxing first-impression thumbnail at small size.
- Ensure all Korean characters are clean, correctly formed, and legible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-475.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean cooking recipe YouTube thumbnail for high click-through, combining a personality-forward food hero shot with oversized Korean title copy, appetizing real food texture, and instantly understandable recipe-step cues.
Designed for a 1536x1024 thumbnail canvas with a strong YouTube cooking-cover feel, using {비율} as the framing guide while keeping the key subject, title, and food readable on mobile and desktop.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The main subject should occupy roughly 45–55% of the frame, with {모델·인물 결} as the focal hero on the left or center depending on {레이아웃}.
- The title block must take the most visually dominant text space, using {썸네일 카피 (큰 한글)} in a large, high-contrast arrangement that balances against the hero subject.
- Background should feel like a real Korean home-cooking or creator-studio kitchen: cream countertop, warm wooden cutting board, small bowls, sauce splashes, steam, cookware highlights, amber practical light, and green herb touches guided by {컬러 톤}.
- Add secondary thumbnail information that feels natural for a recipe video: short Korean callout stickers such as “10분 완성”, “재료 5개”, “실패 없는 양념”, a small channel handle like “@오늘의집밥”, a tiny runtime badge “08:24”, and an accent emoji or graphic shape such as 🔥, ✅, or a bright arrow pointing toward the finished dish.
- Keep secondary food elements, ingredient cuts, sauce bowls, garnish, chopsticks, spoon, and numbered step indicators visually organized so the thumbnail remains readable at small size while still feeling like a real photographed cooking scene.
- Use {채널 컨셉}, {보조 비주얼·소품}, {레이아웃}, and {비율} as the composition guide, making the frame energetic, content-rich, and creator-led.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area: Place {모델·인물 결} as the dominant character element, posed in a lively cooking-presenter stance while holding or presenting the featured dish. Keep the face clearly visible and expressive, with natural skin texture, realistic hands, and the food hero visually linked to the person through gaze, pointing gesture, chopsticks, spoon, or plate presentation.
2. Title area: Render {썸네일 카피 (큰 한글)} in oversized Korean typography with thick stroke weight, strong contrast, and compact line breaks so it remains legible at 1536x1024 and smaller preview sizes. Add a small supporting line near it, such as “오늘 저녁 메뉴 끝!” or “초보도 성공”, in Korean.
3. Food hero cluster: Add {보조 비주얼·소품} as an appetizing cluster near the lower side or opposite side of the subject, including glossy sauce texture, steam, garnish, ingredient snippets, cut vegetables, seasoning bowls, and numbered step cues “1 손질”, “2 볶기”, “3 완성” that support the recipe story.
4. Layout balance: Follow {레이아웃} so one side holds the human hero and the other side holds the text block, while supporting food elements, arrows, sticker labels, and step badges create a clear reading path from subject to title to finished dish.
5. Channel signature: Reinforce {채널 컨셉} through a familiar Korean cooking-thumbnail structure that feels energetic, practical, and creator-led. Include small recurring channel details like “@오늘의집밥”, “구독자 요청 레시피”, or a tiny corner label “집밥 레시피” integrated into the design.
6. YouTube UI realism: Add a subtle black duration pill in the lower-right reading “08:24”, a tiny play-triangle motif or red rounded accent shape, and one bold view-bait callout like “진짜 쉬움!” or “맛 보장!” without overpowering {썸네일 카피 (큰 한글)}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main Korean title, with size priority on legibility, tight leading, bold outline, sticker-like shadow, and clear separation from the kitchen background. Use smaller Noto Sans KR SemiBold for step labels like “1 손질”, “2 볶기”, “3 완성”, channel handle, and runtime details.
- Color palette: Use the palette implied by {컬러 톤} — cream #F4EFE6, warm amber #D89A3B, olive green #6F8B5B, toasted brown #8B5E3C, with dark text accents in near-black #1E1E1E. Add small punch colors such as tomato red, chili orange, or scallion green only where they support food appetite and click-through.
- Border/shadow: Apply a soft drop shadow to the subject and title, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 18% opacity, plus subtle edge separation around food cutouts, stickers, arrows, and step badges to prevent background blending.
- Texture realism: Food should show real steam, oil sheen, toasted edges, sauce gloss, sesame seeds, chopped scallions, condensation on bowls, and slight countertop crumbs or seasoning flecks for a freshly cooked look.
- Graphic accents: Use rounded sticker labels, hand-drawn arrows, check marks, small burst shapes, and one accent emoji in a YouTube-thumbnail style, aligned with the title and food rather than floating randomly.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Use a 35mm or 50mm full-frame editorial food shot look, similar to a contemporary YouTube cooking thumbnail photographed with a Canon RF 35mm f/1.8 or Sony FE 50mm f/1.4 at f/2.8.
- Lighting: Use bright studio key light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from the right and soft bounce on the food so skin tones and dishes look clear and punchy without harsh glare. Add believable kitchen practical highlights on metal pans, ceramic bowls, and glossy sauce.
- Color grade: Warm cream + amber + green grade, slightly boosted saturation and contrast, with clean whites and appetizing browns that evoke modern Korean food-media thumbnails.
- Depth and realism: Use shallow but controlled depth of field so the presenter, main dish, and title remain sharp while background tiles, shelves, utensils, and ingredient bowls fall slightly softer.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean home-cooking thumbnail — a practical creator style with the pacing and clarity of a popular Korean food video cover, but polished like a modern food magazine frame. The image should feel fresh, flavorful, useful, and click-worthy, as if the viewer can immediately understand the recipe payoff.

[7. CRITICAL]

- Use {컬러 톤} as the overall palette, with fresh paper whites, soft sky-blue panels, coral highlight shapes, and practical travel-prep cues that feel organized, useful, and realistic.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Text block: Set {메인 문구} in a bold, large Korean sans-serif headline with strong line breaks; place {서브 문구} below as a smaller support line, then add {배지 문구} as a coral pill badge and {강조 이모지} as a small visual hook.

5. Travel readiness cues: Add a luggage tag, boarding-pass-like mock ticket, travel zip pouch, mini bottle set, and destination sticker {여행지 라벨}; use {날짜 라벨} as a small printed date tag on the checklist or label.
6. Background and depth: Use a bright tabletop with subtle paper grain or matte texture, soft shadow separation under suitcase and objects, and a balanced editorial product-photo composition with enough visual information to feel lived-in and useful.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {메인 문구} at very large thumbnail size, Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR for {서브 문구}; use clean, modern Korean lettering with strong weight contrast and crisp anti-aliased edges.

- Color palette: {컬러 톤} plus paper white #F8FAFC, soft gray #D9E2EC, navy text #1E293B, and coral #FF6B6B for badges, check marks, arrows, and underlines.

Bright, organized, practical travel-prep editorial — feels like a useful YouTube packing guide thumbnail with cheerful checklist energy, realistic travel objects, and a clear “출발 전 바로 확인” mood.

- 체크리스트 종이에는 “짐싸기 체크리스트” 제목과 “{체크리스트 항목}” 항목들이 체크박스와 함께 읽히도록 배치한다.

- Keep the main title large enough for thumbnail viewing and ensure all Korean characters are clean, complete, and unbroken.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Place {채널 핸들} near a lower corner or under the headline as a channel signature, with a tiny play icon or reviewer tag.
- Integrate {보조 비주얼 소품} as a secondary cinematic cue, such as a fictional film still, poster fragment, film strip, ticket stub, or timeline card.
- Use {액센트 그래픽} to add urgency around the reaction and title: arrows, burst shapes, red circles, emoji, warning tape, or shocked marks.
- Follow {레이아웃} so the face, headline, channel tag, and support imagery feel like a real Korean entertainment thumbnail.
- Keep {컬러 톤} as the dominant palette across background, type, accents, facial lighting, and cinematic support imagery.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero face area: Place {모델·인물 결} as a large shocked reaction cutout or tightly cropped portrait, with open mouth, surprised eyes, visible hand gesture, natural skin texture, and a strong rim-shadow separating the subject from the background.
2. Text block: Render {썸네일 카피 큰 한글} in oversized, high-contrast Korean lettering, using stacked words, thick outline, inner highlight, and dramatic shadow so it reads instantly at thumbnail size.
3. View-bait tag: Add {조회수 유도 문구} as a compact red/yellow label, sticker, speech bubble, or slanted ribbon near the main headline, visually reading like an urgent review cue.
4. Channel identity: Add {채널 핸들} and {채널 라벨} as small but legible on-screen branding, placed like a YouTube creator signature with a tiny play icon, review badge, or subscriber-style label.
5. Cinema support layer: Add {보조 비주얼 소품} as a fictional movie poster thumbnail, dramatic film still collage, blurred cinema screen, timeline marker, popcorn bucket, ticket stub, or red-circled clue image near the bottom or beside the headline.
6. Accent system: Use {액센트 그래픽} around the title and face, including red arrows pointing at the clue, shocked emoji, jagged burst shape, highlight circle, glow edge, or diagonal slash marks.
7. Background treatment: Build a dark cinema-style backdrop with theater curtain shadows, projector haze, grain, film perforation texture, subtle lens flare, and deep red lighting that reinforces the movie-review context.
8. Composition lock: Preserve the thumbnail-first structure defined by {레이아웃}, ensuring the hero face and headline remain the two largest visual anchors while the support graphics make the frame feel like an actual uploaded YouTube thumbnail.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use bold Korean display typography in the style of Pretendard ExtraBold, Noto Sans KR Black, or a condensed headline font; headline size should feel oversized, with tight line control, thick stroke weight, strong outline, and readable spacing.
- Korean text hierarchy: Main headline first, then {조회수 유도 문구}, then {채널 핸들}; all rendered Korean or handle text must be sharp, not warped, and placed on clear contrast panels or outlined directly.
- Color palette: Follow {컬러 톤} with deep charcoal / near-black background, saturated red accents, bright white and yellow headline contrast, plus warm skin tones and cinematic amber highlights.
- Border/shadow: Use a noticeable drop shadow on the face cutout and text, around 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15–20% opacity, plus thin red/yellow glow on key accent elements.
- Graphic realism: Include believable thumbnail editing details such as cutout edge glow, red circle markup, arrow sticker, timeline label, small creator logo plate, and compressed YouTube-style contrast.
- Text placement: Allow layered stickers, labels, small icons, film stills, and creator tags as long as the primary title remains the most dominant readable element.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm portrait look, f/1.8, tightly framed reaction-shot aesthetic with shallow depth of field and crisp facial focus.
- Lighting: hard-edged key from upper-left mixed with soft fill from front-right, creating dramatic facial contrast and a trailer-poster feel.
- Color grade: dark theater black, blood red accents, and bright white text highlights with subtle warm skin tones for contrast.
- Edit finish: high-contrast YouTube thumbnail treatment, sharp cutout edge, cinematic grain, red glow accents, slightly exaggerated saturation, and crisp graphic overlays.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean movie-review thumbnail — close to a YouTube reaction + cinematic trailer-poster hybrid, with the tension of a shocking ending reveal, urgent spoiler warning, and fast entertainment-channel click appeal.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 메인 제목으로 {썸네일 카피 큰 한글} 문구가 정확한 한글 그대로 렌더되어야 함. 기본 문구 예시: "이 결말 진짜 충격임" 또는 "마지막 5분 미쳤음".
- 반드시 보조 라벨로 {조회수 유도 문구}가 읽히게 들어가야 함. 예시: "스포주의", "엔딩 해석", "소름 반전".
- 반드시 채널 표기로 {채널 핸들} 또는 {채널 라벨}이 작게 들어가야 함. 예시: "@시네마충격리뷰", "오늘의 영화리뷰".
- The shocked facial expression must be clearly readable: open mouth, surprised eyes, and hand covering the mouth in a convincing reaction pose.
- Include at least one accent shape or emoji from {액센트 그래픽}, such as "😱", red arrow, warning triangle, or jagged burst sticker.
- Preserve the channel signature cinema feeling described by {채널 컨셉}, {컬러 톤}, and {레이아웃}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Celebrity face composites or identity swaps
- Unreadable main headline text

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean home workout YouTube thumbnail, wide 3:2 format, designed for high click-through and clear mobile readability.
Bright, energetic fitness-channel thumbnail with bold Korean title text, realistic home workout action, and creator-style visual hooks such as a channel handle, timer badge, play icon, and short attention-grabbing stickers.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left text block occupies about 42% of the frame, with {메인 문구} as the dominant headline and {서브 문구} as a smaller supporting line beneath it.
- Right visual block occupies about 58% of the frame, featuring {장면} and {인물} with clear separation from the text area.
- Background should feel like a real, sunlit Korean apartment living room: warm wood floor, bright window curtains, indoor plant, rolled towel, water bottle, yoga mat, small dumbbells, resistance band, and a phone timer visible in the workout area.
- Use {컬러 톤} as the main visual palette across typography, sticker badges, mat accents, activewear details, and small graphic shapes.
- Add YouTube-thumbnail enrichment: a small channel handle "@homefit_daily" near the lower-left, a bold lime circular badge reading "10 MIN", a small red play-button icon, and a compact sticker label reading "NO 장비" or "초보 가능" near the person without covering the face or body pose.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Left headline zone: Place {메인 문구} in very large bold Korean type, aligned left, taking roughly the top 45% of the left side, with strong contrast against the background.
2. Subheadline zone: Place {서브 문구} directly below the headline in a smaller weight, with tight line spacing and a compact block so it reads instantly on mobile.
3. Channel metadata strip: Add a small creator label near the bottom-left: "@homefit_daily · 오늘의 루틴" with a tiny play icon and a thin lime underline, styled like real YouTube thumbnail branding.
4. Right action zone: Show {인물} inside {장면}, posed safely and clearly, with the body angled slightly toward the text to create visual tension across the split layout.
5. Prop emphasis: Make the yoga mat, small dumbbells, resistance band, water bottle, towel, and visible phone timer support the workout story; place them naturally on the living-room floor as if a real home routine is being filmed.
6. View-bait graphic elements: Add one or two bold graphic shapes such as a lime arrow pointing toward the pose, a white rounded badge reading "칼로리 UP", and a timer bubble reading "00:10:00"; keep them crisp and readable.
7. Separation and balance: Use contrast, color blocks, shallow shadows, and the natural living-room lighting to separate the text-heavy left side from the action-heavy right side without a hard border.
8. Thumbnail readability: Ensure the headline remains readable at small size, with the figure’s silhouette distinct from the background and no overlapping elements that block the core Korean text.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for {메인 문구}, and Pretendard SemiBold for {서브 문구}; headline around 92–110px equivalent, subtext around 34–42px equivalent.
- Text treatment: Use thick black or white lettering with lime highlight strokes, selective yellow-lime emphasis on key words, and a punchy thumbnail-style drop shadow.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} should resolve into white #FFFFFF, lime green #B7F14A, black #111111, plus a light cool gray background #F4F6F8 and natural wood floor warmth.
- Border/shadow: Add a soft shadow behind text, 0px x-offset, 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 20% opacity; use a faint edge glow in lime green for high contrast around the main headline and action figure.
- Graphic accents: Include rounded stickers, arrow shapes, timer badge, and small emoji-style energy mark such as "🔥" or "⚡" rendered cleanly, matching the Korean fitness-channel look.
- Realistic details: Activewear fabric texture, mat surface texture, window light gradients, floor reflections, and small household items should feel photographed rather than flat vector-only design.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame look, 28mm wide-angle feel for a crisp YouTube-thumbnail composition, f/4, slightly elevated eye-level framing.
- Lighting: Bright diffused daylight from upper-left like a large window, with gentle fill from front-right to keep the person, face, mat, props, and Korean text evenly visible.
- Color grade: Clean white-balanced grade with fresh green accents, slightly boosted contrast, crisp blacks, warm skin tones, and a modern fitness-channel finish.
- Rendering: Realistic lifestyle photo base with polished YouTube overlay graphics; sharp subject edges, clear typography, lively contrast, and high perceived energy.

[6. MOOD]
Upbeat Korean lifestyle fitness thumbnail — modern YouTube creator aesthetic with the clarity, punch, and real-home authenticity of a buzz-worthy workout channel cover.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "집에서 10분 홈트 루틴", "복잡한 준비물 없이" must appear exactly and be fully legible.
- Render {메인 문구} as the largest headline and {서브 문구} as the supporting text; if these match the required Korean phrases, preserve them exactly.
- Additional Korean thumbnail text may include "10 MIN", "NO 장비", "초보 가능", "칼로리 UP", "@homefit_daily", and "오늘의 루틴"; keep all Korean characters clean and readable.
- The exercise pose must look safe, balanced, athletic, and anatomically correct.
- The composition must clearly read as a split thumbnail: text-heavy left side, action-heavy right side, with creator-style badges and realistic home workout props.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
YouTube thumbnail for a Korean mukbang channel, designed as a high-click food reaction image with exaggerated close-up appeal.
Wide 3:2 thumbnail composition optimized for mobile browsing, with bold Korean headline text, appetite-driven food texture, channel branding, and a quick-read emotional hook.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left/right split or center-punch composition: {레이아웃} based on the source face in {원본 인물}, with the subject occupying about 45–55% of the frame and the text/graphic area taking the remaining space.
- Keep the subject face large and near the camera, with the mouth area, food, and reaction expression clearly visible in a tight crop.
- Background should feel like a vivid mukbang set or blurred late-night food-channel backdrop: warm kitchen bokeh, red/yellow color panels, steam haze, sauce shine, table highlights, and energetic depth behind the subject.
- Place the headline text in a dominant, instantly readable block, using {큰 제목} exactly as written.
- Add a short secondary hook using {서브 카피}, smaller than the main title but still bold, placed as a sticker label, speech-burst, or top-corner badge.
- Integrate {음식 비주얼} as a strong secondary visual cue near the mouth or lower side of the frame, with visible steam, sauce gloss, crispy texture, noodles, cheese stretch, broth reflection, or garnish details as appropriate.
- Add YouTube-style accent graphics: {강조 이모지}, red arrow, impact burst, small sparkle marks, and a rounded view-bait badge containing {조회 유도 문구}.
- Include channel branding with {채널 핸들} in a small but readable corner label, plus {업로드 배지} as a date/time or episode-style tag.
- Preserve the same person identity from {원본 인물}; facial structure and likeness must remain recognizable.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Main reaction hero: {원본 인물} placed as the primary close-up subject, with the face filling most of the left side or center, and the mouth area emphasized as the key action point.
2) Eating moment detail: {본인 표정·자세} rendered with a highly readable expression, eyes slightly closed, cheeks engaged, and the bite moment frozen at peak reaction.
3) Food anchor: {음식 비주얼} positioned right beside the lips or just below chin level, with steam, gloss, sauce shine, crispy crumbs, broth droplets, or melted-cheese stretch clearly visible depending on the food type.
4) Main typography block: {큰 제목} set as the most dominant text element, large enough to read instantly on mobile, with thick black outline, heavy yellow fill, and a slightly tilted thumbnail-style layout.
5) Secondary hook elements: {서브 카피}, {조회 유도 문구}, and {강조 이모지} placed as attention-grabbing badges or burst stickers without covering the eyes, mouth, or food texture.
6) Channel identity layer: {채널 핸들} and {업로드 배지} appear as small realistic thumbnail metadata graphics, such as a top-left label, bottom ribbon, or tiny creator tag.
7) Layout balance: {레이아웃} should create a thumbnail-first hierarchy, keeping face, food, text, badges, and accent shapes energetic but readable at small size.
8) Color emphasis: {컬러 톤} applied across the title treatment, accents, arrows, emoji highlights, and edge outlines so the image reads as a classic Korean mukbang reaction thumbnail.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold Korean sans-serif such as Pretendard ExtraBold, Noto Sans KR Black, or Spoqa Han Sans Neo Bold; headline size very large, compact line spacing, thick stroke outline.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with strong yellow (#FFD400), red (#FF3B30), black (#111111), creamy white highlights, and glossy food-friendly warm tones.
- Text effects: hard-edged black outline, white outer stroke, subtle 2–4px drop shadow at 15–25% opacity, slight rotation or stacked layout for urgent click-through energy.
- Accent graphics: use comic burst shapes, red arrows pointing to the bite, small flame/spark icons, emoji stickers, and rounded badges that look like common Korean YouTube entertainment thumbnails.
- Food rendering: emphasize natural texture — steam curling upward, oil sheen, sauce streaks, crumbs, sesame, scallions, cheese pull, broth reflections, or crisp fried edges depending on the dish.
- Face separation: optional sticker-like white stroke around the subject, rim light along hair/shoulder, and high-contrast edge treatment for strong thumbnail visibility.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with RF 50mm f/1.2L or RF 85mm f/1.2L portrait lens look, f/2.0–f/2.8, tight social-media close-up framing that exaggerates facial reaction and food proximity.
- Lighting: bright studio key light from front-left at about 45°, soft fill from right, small catchlight in the eyes, glossy highlights on sauce and broth, and a warm rim light separating the subject from the background.
- Color grade: saturated warm reds and yellows with clean skin tones, deep black outlines, crisp white highlights, and high contrast optimized for YouTube thumbnail scanning.
- Depth: shallow depth of field on background while keeping the eyes, mouth area, and food bite sharply readable; steam and sauce highlights should add realism and appetite.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy Korean mukbang thumbnail — the punchy, oversized reaction style seen in fast-cut YouTube food channels, late-night spicy-food challenges, and bold entertainment thumbnails.
The overall feeling should be addictive, hot, glossy, funny, and instantly clickable, as if the viewer can almost smell the food.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Render Korean text accurately and prominently: main title must read {큰 제목}; secondary hook must read {서브 카피}; badge text must read {조회 유도 문구}; channel handle must read {채널 핸들}; upload tag must read {업로드 배지}.
- Example visible Korean text layout: 큰 제목 “{큰 제목}”, 보조 카피 “{서브 카피}”, 배지 “{조회 유도 문구}”, 채널 “{채널 핸들}”, 업로드 태그 “{업로드 배지}”.
- Preserve the same person identity from {원본 인물}; do not change facial identity, age, or gender presentation.
- Keep the eating moment anatomically natural and visually convincing; mouth, cheeks, hand position, chopsticks/fork if present, and food contact must look physically plausible.
- The composition must remain thumbnail-readable at small size, with face, food, headline, emoji/accent shapes, and channel handle clearly distinguishable.
- The food must look freshly prepared and appetizing, not plastic-like: visible moisture, heat, seasoning, texture, and bite tension are important.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or replacing the person with a public figure
- Distorted face identity or replacing the person with someone else

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Dynamic vertical action poster in comic/manga style, featuring two AI-personified brand characters in a dramatic clash. Designed for social sharing, thumbnail impact, and high-energy visual storytelling, while also reading like a finished event battle poster with title typography, date, venue, ticket information, and sponsor-style footer details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas is 9:16 vertical; the left character {좌측_캐릭터} occupies the left 42% with a slightly forward, defensive battle pose, while the right character {우측_캐릭터} occupies the right 42% in an attacking stance.
- Keep the central collision zone narrow and explosive, with {액션_종류} crossing the midline horizontally so the viewer immediately reads the confrontation.
- Background is a neon cyber arena with cracked floor plates, drifting smoke, LED score panels, distant audience silhouettes, flying debris, speed-line ribbons, and {배경_빔_컬러} cutting across the stage.
- Place {좌측_거대_효과음} in the upper-left quadrant and {우측_거대_효과음} in the lower-right quadrant, oversized and partially overlapping the characters for maximum comic impact.
- Add a finished poster information layer: {포스터_타이틀} at the top, {서브_카피} near the collision area, {이벤트_정보} and {티켓_정보} in the lower information block, plus {스폰서_표기} as a compact sponsor strip near the bottom edge.
- Include a small vertical spine-like credit on the left edge reading {스파인_크레딧}, and a compact stats/score panel reading {대결_점수표} without blocking the main faces or weapon silhouettes.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Left combatant zone: {좌측_캐릭터} rendered as a stylized anthropomorphic AI mascot, cut sharply against the neon arena with thick contour lines, strong shadow masses, readable silhouette, logo patch details, clothing folds, glove creases, hair strands, and impact dust around the feet.
2) Right combatant zone: {우측_캐릭터} posed as a mirrored opponent, with equally strong outline treatment, visible weapon or attack-ready arm gesture consistent with {액션_종류}, fabric motion, glowing weapon edge, sparks, and directional motion blur.
3) Collision beam zone: {배경_빔_컬러} forms the main horizontal energy strike from left to right, with sharp light streaks, black spark fragments, glass-like shards, ink splashes, and impact burst particles at the center contact point.
4) SFX typography layer: {좌측_거대_효과음} and {우측_거대_효과음} should be set in giant hand-drawn Korean comic lettering, slightly tilted, with black heavy outline, colored inner highlight, halftone grain, and high-contrast fill so they read like a classic action manga sound effect.
5) Poster information layer: top title, small issue/date label, lower event details, ticket price, QR-like decorative block, sponsor strip, and channel handle {채널_핸들}; these should feel printed into the poster design rather than floating randomly.
6) Finish layer: add hard-edged shading, motion streaks, ink texture, halftone dots, scuffed paper grain, rim-light bloom, and tiny debris trails so the entire image feels like a fast, punchy action panel printed as a premium vertical battle poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold hand-drawn Korean comic lettering for sound effects; use heavy stroke weight, exaggerated ink contour, and size large enough to cover roughly 1/4 of the frame each. Supporting poster text should use Pretendard Bold or a similar clean Korean gothic style for legibility.
- Color palette: deep navy, charcoal black, electric blue, cyan highlights, muted gray, sharp white specular accents, warning red details, and warm beige highlights from the right character, anchored by {배경_빔_컬러}.
- Border/shadow: thick black outlines around both characters, hard cel-shaded shadows, 10–20% opacity smoke-like edge vignette, crisp impact shadows under limbs and props, and graphic speed-line shadows radiating from the center.
- Poster realism: include print-like artifacts such as slight ink misregistration, small paper scratches, halftone screen texture, sponsor/footer microtype, and event-poster layout hierarchy while keeping the action readable.
- Decorative graphics: add diagonal hazard tape accents, tiny starburst icons, numbered match labels, arena light flares, and a small QR-code-like square as graphic dressing, but do not let them cover the mandatory Korean SFX.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm wide cinematic framing with slight low-angle perspective, like an action comic key art panel shot on a Canon RF 35mm f/1.8 look.
- Lighting: strong backlit beam from left-to-right across the center, with a cool rim light on both characters, high-contrast shadow falloff, and sharp highlight edges along faces, hands, clothing seams, logos, and weapons.
- Color grade: cool noir palette with electric blue energy, deep black shadows, subtle steel-gray midtones, and selective saturated accents in the beam, logo marks, poster title, and sound-effect typography.

[6. MOOD]
High-intensity comic showdown — a Shonen Jump battle spread meets a neon-lit cyber action poster, with the punchy energy of Spider-Verse-style graphic composition and the tactile feel of a printed underground tournament flyer.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: "쩌", "엉". The two sound effects may visually combine into "쩌엉" or remain as separate giant SFX, but every Korean character must be clean and correctly rendered.

[1. PURPOSE]
Company quarterly OKR board infographic for internal strategy presentation, designed as a realistic one-page vertical executive dashboard.
Consulting-firm + tech-company board aesthetic, with key objectives, KR progress, owners, cadence notes, and decision-ready status signals visible at a glance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical poster layout with a strong top header occupying about 14% of the frame, the three objective columns/cards occupying the middle 66%, and a concise footer governance area occupying the bottom 10%.
- Center the company-quarter title at the top, followed by a compact subtitle line, document metadata, and a small date label such as “2026.05.01 기준 · 내부 공유용 · DOC-OKR-Q2-247”.
- Present three equal-width objective blocks with visible card headers, owner chips, KR rows, progress bars, status tags, and small trend markers so the page reads like a polished board pack page rather than a sterile template.
- Background: matte white paper-like surface with subtle warm-gray texture; add faint spreadsheet grid hints, tiny section markers, thin charcoal divider lines, and restrained accent blocks for hierarchy.
- Use {회사·분기}, {Objective 3개}, {KR 예시}, {진행 시각화}, {컬러 톤}, {타이포}, and {비율} placeholders.
- Keep all text aligned to a precise corporate grid, with consistent padding, page-like edge trim marks, small folio text, and executive dashboard annotations.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 14%): set {회사·분기} centered in a large bold corporate title, with a thin rule beneath and a smaller supporting line reading “분기 OKR 실행 보드 · 목표/핵심결과/진행률 요약”. Add compact metadata on the right: “보고일 2026.05.01”, “Owner 전략기획팀”, “CONFIDENTIAL INTERNAL”, and a tiny page marker “01 / OKR DASHBOARD”.
2. Objective block 1 (left third): place the first objective from {Objective 3개} as a numbered heading with a colored objective tag “O1”, an owner chip “PM 김서연”, and a priority label “High”. Under it, show the matching KR line from {KR 예시} split into realistic KR rows, each with a slim progress bar from {진행 시각화}, numeric targets, and a small note such as “전월 대비 +8%p”.
3. Objective block 2 (center third): repeat the same hierarchy with the second objective, keeping identical card sizing, label size, and bar alignment. Include small realistic dashboard details: “리스크: 응답속도”, “이번 주 액션 2건”, and a checkmark status chip “ON TRACK”.
4. Objective block 3 (right third): repeat the same hierarchy with the third objective, using an upward or sideways arrow marker from {진행 시각화} to indicate direction of change. Add a small “Revenue Mix” micro-chart strip with three segmented blocks and compact labels to support the revenue objective.
5. Progress treatment: for each KR line, show compact numeric emphasis on the right side of the row, with tiny percentage chips such as “35%”, “60%”, “90%”, arrow indicators “↑ / → / ↓”, and small target labels like “목표 5K”, “현재 2K”, “Gap 15%p”. Keep the bars flat, crisp, and boardroom-like with clear scale ticks at 0 / 50 / 100.
6. Footer area (bottom 10%): add a brief operational note row with small text: “다음 점검: 2026.05.15 · 데이터 출처: GA4 / CRM / CSAT / 정산 리포트 · 의사결정 필요: 예산 재배분, 실험 우선순위 확정”. Include a small legend for colors and status chips, a page number “p.03”, and a subtle approval routing line “작성 전략기획팀 · 검토 Product / Sales / CS”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: follow {타이포}; Pretendard ExtraBold for the main header, Pretendard SemiBold for objective labels, and Noto Serif KR or a refined serif-like Korean body font for supporting lines; use large numerals with tight leading so metrics feel authoritative.
- Color palette: white #F7F7F4, charcoal #1F2328, navy #243B63, mustard #C89B2C, coral #D86A5A, with muted gray UI lines #D7D9DD; apply {컬러 톤} as the guiding palette direction.
- Borders/shadows: use thin 1px charcoal rules, soft card separation with very light shadow 0px 8px 24px 8% opacity, and flat progress bars with crisp edges; include realistic dashboard chips, divider ticks, small legend boxes, and muted table rules.
- Ratio and hierarchy: apply {비율} to the visual balance between header, three objective cards, metric rows, and footer notes while preserving a premium internal strategy-report feel.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: straight-on flat graphic poster composition, equivalent to a front-facing 50mm document capture with zero perspective distortion.
- Lighting: even studio-soft lighting, diffuse overhead illumination, gentle paper surface presence, no dramatic shadow falloff, no reflections, no specular shine.
- Color grade: cool-white consulting slide base with restrained navy/mustard/coral accents, slightly warm neutral paper tone, clean digital presentation finish.
- Render quality: crisp vector-like Korean typography, realistic print-dashboard density, precise progress bars, visible micro labels, and refined corporate information design.

[6. MOOD]
McKinsey-style strategy slide meets modern SaaS dashboard — polished consulting deck clarity with a realistic internal board-report finish, showing enough operational detail to feel like an actual quarterly OKR review page.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시해야 하는 문자열:
  - {회사·분기}
  - 01 카탈로그 사용자 1만 / 02 AI 생성기 신뢰도 / 03 수익 다각화
  - 가입 5K·MAU 2K·리텐션 35% / 만족도 4.5·재사용 60%·응답 3초 / 광고 100만·유료 30·광고주 10
  - 각 KR 옆 진행도 막대 (35%·60%·90% 등) + 화살표 ↑↓
  - 분기 OKR 실행 보드 · 보고일 2026.05.01 · 내부 공유용 · 전략기획팀
- Additional small Korean labels may appear, such as “ON TRACK”, “주의”, “다음 액션”, “데이터 출처”, “목표”, “현재”, “Gap”, but all must be crisp and correctly formed.
- Keep all Korean characters crisp and correctly formed; all metric numerals, punctuation, percent signs, arrows, and decimal points must remain sharp and legible.
- Maintain a strict three-column objective structure with identical card sizing and alignment.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean street-food tteokbokki close-up hero image for a square social post. Photoreal food editorial with a lively portable-stall mood, focused on thick glossy sauce, rising steam, disposable stall details, warm signage, and the tactile realism of a Seoul night-market snack counter.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject sits in the center 58% of the frame, filling most of the square crop with a tight tabletop close-up.
- {음식} is presented in {용기}, with the rim of the vessel visible enough to anchor the scene; include sauce clinging to the inner rim, small red pepper flakes, sesame specks, and natural drip marks.
- {사이드} are placed as small supporting accents near the lower-right and lower-left edges, such as a paper cup, folded napkin, wooden skewer, pickled radish dish, or fish-cake broth cup, all partially cropped like a real stall table.
- Background uses a softly blurred night street-pushcart setting with {배경}: orange tent vinyl, stainless-steel counter reflections, condensation on plastic sheets, and warm handwritten Korean menu signage recognizable through depth of field.
- Maintain a shallow-depth, food-photography framing with foreground sauce detail and a slightly cropped edge to feel like an editorial magazine food feature captured at an actual 포장마차.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero food zone (center 58%): {음식} arranged in {용기}, glossy red sauce pooled naturally, visible rice-cake curves, fish-cake pieces if appropriate, scallion flecks, sesame, light steam, uneven hand-served shapes, and no artificial symmetry.
- Supporting accents (lower 20%): {사이드} placed as believable stall-side accompaniments, with a paper cup or small dish partially visible for street-food realism; add subtle sauce smears, chopstick marks, napkin texture, and a stainless spoon or wooden skewer edge catching warm light.
- Environmental layer (rear 22%): {배경} rendered as soft bokeh with faint tent fabric texture, metal tray highlights, menu-board edges, and warm signage glow; readable background text may include short Korean stall words and prices while remaining secondary.
- Stall text details: include a small blurred menu strip or sign card in Korean such as “분식”, “떡볶이”, “어묵 3개 ₩2,000”, “순대 ₩5,000”, or “포장 가능”, handwritten in compact stall lettering and integrated into the background.
- Light behavior: {조명·셔터} should produce bright sauce highlights, soft shadow falloff, tiny specular reflections on oil, and a slight backlit steam edge for freshness.
- Color anchor: {컬러 톤} should dominate the dish, with restrained charcoal, warm gold, stainless silver, off-white steam, and amber tent reflections in the background and container.
- Framing note: {비율} with the subject cropped close enough to emphasize sticky sauce texture, rice-cake density, and the immediacy of eating at a street counter.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: menu text in the background should use compact handwritten Korean stall-style lettering, similar to casual brush marker on laminated paper or vinyl, medium weight, slightly imperfect and softly blurred by depth of field.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} plus off-white steam highlights, deep charcoal shadows, muted amber reflections, stainless-steel neutrals, pale yellow paper-cup tones, and natural red-orange sauce variation; avoid neon colors or oversaturated reds.
- Surface detail: include real stall textures such as stainless counter scratches, translucent plastic curtain glare, paper napkin fibers, chili flakes, sesame seeds, and tiny sauce splashes around the vessel.
- Border/shadow: use natural contact shadows under the bowl and props, soft 8px vertical blur, 18% opacity; the image should feel photographed in-camera rather than designed as a flat mockup.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame food photography, 100mm macro lens at f/2.8, close working distance, crisp focus on sauce texture and rice cakes.
- Lighting: warm tungsten practical-like key light from upper-left, gentle fill from front-right, slight backlight to catch steam and gloss; exposure tuned for a cozy night-stall feel with realistic highlight rolloff on sauce and stainless steel.
- Color grade: red-gold food highlights with charcoal mids and a restrained warm amber cast, similar to a high-end magazine food feature shot inside a busy Korean street-food stall.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean street-food editorial — cozy, spicy, tactile, and appetizing, like a Seoul night-market 포장마차 moment photographed with magazine-level food styling while keeping the imperfections of real stall service.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: readable signage may include only short, correct Korean stall strings such as “분식”, “떡볶이”, “어묵 3개 ₩2,000”, “순대 ₩5,000”, and “포장 가능”.
- The dish must read clearly as Korean street tteokbokki; sauce should look thick, glossy, spicy, and clingy, not soup-like.
- Include authentic street-stall context: warm tent glow, stainless counter reflections, disposable cup or napkin details, steam, and casual side-dish placement.
- Keep the composition tightly cropped and food-forward, with supporting props and signage enhancing realism without competing with the main dish.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

- Main info area (about 58%): large donut chart and key allocation numbers anchored in the center-left, with supporting labels arranged in infographic modules, small legend pills, mini bar indicators, coin/wallet/calendar icons, and tiny annotation arrows.
- Action strip (about 18%): three-step practical checklist stacked vertically with numbered badges, checkboxes, thin divider lines, small memo-tag labels, and a short CTA line such as "월급날 저장하고 다시 보기".
- Product recommendation block (about 12%): highlighted capsule/card area with {추천 상품} as a compact list, plus a small note label "입문자 추천", monthly auto-transfer hint, and tiny risk/term tags.
- Publisher footer (about 5%): {발행처} aligned bottom-center in small type with Instagram-style micro UI: handle line, hashtags, page indicator "1/5", save/share/bookmark icons, and a subtle source/date stamp.
- Use {주제}, {분배 비율}, {실전 액션 3}, {추천 상품}, {비주얼 결}, {컬러 톤}, {발행처}, {비율} as the editable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header: place the main title in a strong Korean editorial style, centered near the top, with a large numeral emphasis and tight line spacing for mobile viewing. Add small cover-style metadata around it: "VOL.08", "2026년 5월", "MZ MONEY NOTE", and a tiny credit line using {발행처}.
2. Hero data cluster: build the central infographic around a large donut chart for {분배 비율}, with adjacent percentage callouts, legend chips, mini comparison bars, and simple coin/wallet/card icons that feel social-media friendly and practical.
3. Finance context details: include small realistic side notes such as "고정비 먼저 분리", "비상금 3개월", "연금은 자동이체", "월 1회 리밸런싱" as tiny sticky-note tags or annotation captions, while keeping the central data immediately readable.
4. Practical steps: render {실전 액션 3} as three stacked action rows with clear numbering, small icon bullets, checkbox squares, short memo captions, and a highlighted "이번 달 실행" marker.
5. Product strip: show {추천 상품} inside a rounded rectangle or slim editorial card, visually separated from the action rows with a rule, soft shadow, label chips, and small details like "초보자용", "장기", "분산".
6. Visual texture: apply {비주얼 결} as a playful finance-illustration layer combining coins, wallets, chart markers, receipt snippets, calculator keys, piggy-bank silhouettes, calendar dots, and oversized digits, with the layout remaining infographic-first and easy to scan.
7. Footer credibility line: place {발행처} in a neat signature line so the design feels like a real MZ finance post; add Instagram card-news details including "@money_kim_kr", "#월급관리 #저축습관 #연금시작", small save/share/comment icons, and page indicator "1/5".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for the title, Pretendard SemiBold for labels, Pretendard Regular for explanatory text; title around 88–104px, labels 28–36px, footnote 18–22px, micro metadata 14–18px.
- Color palette: cream #F6F1E8, charcoal #2B2B2B, lime green #A6E22E, coral #FF6B6B, with small muted gray accents for secondary text. Apply {컬러 톤} consistently across labels, charts, icons, and CTA chips.
- Border/shadow: thin charcoal rules, rounded 18px cards, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; add subtle paper grain, printed ink texture, sticker-like labels, dotted guide marks, and app-card UI elements for a realistic editorial surface.
- Data styling: donut chart segments should match {분배 비율}; show clear percentage labels, leader lines, legend chips, and one tiny explanatory footnote such as "예시는 월급 300만원 기준".
- Instagram realism: include a top handle strip, small carousel/page indicator, save/share icons, and short Korean hashtags without introducing new editable arguments.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: designed as a graphic poster, but with a polished flat-lay editorial feel inspired by a 24mm top-down composition and clean vector infographic treatment.
- Lighting: even studio-style illumination with no harsh shadows, slightly brighter upper-left emphasis, crisp readable contrast, and a tactile printed-card feel.
- Color grade: cream base with charcoal typography, lime green financial highlights, coral accent pops, and restrained modern app-like clarity.
- Rendering: high-resolution editorial graphic, sharp Korean typography, precise alignment, believable printed texture, visible chart details, tiny UI icons, and layered finance-themed illustration elements.

[6. MOOD]
MZ finance editorial — feels like a Toss/BankSalad-style Instagram card-news infographic mixed with a practical magazine finance tip sheet: friendly, useful, data-driven, playful, and credible enough to save for payday planning.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 포함되어야 하는 문자열 — "월급 300만원 황금 분배 — 또는 30대 연금 시작·자산 5천 모으기·청년도약계좌", "생활비 50% / 저축 30% / 투자 15% / 자기계발 5% — 도넛 차트", "01 통장 쪼개기 (생활/저축/투자) / 02 자동이체 / 03 매달 1일 점검", "\"청년도약계좌 / S&P500 적립식 / IRP\"", "\"@money_kim_kr · 재테크 블로거\"".

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header area (top 18%): place {종목·티커} as the dominant title, bold and left-aligned with a stock-code feel. Add a small top utility row: "주식 종목 카드", "LIVE", "2026.05.01 09:42 업데이트", a watchlist star icon, and a tiny market-status chip "장중". Follow the title with a smaller subtitle line using {현재가·변동}.
2) Price focus block (upper-mid 20%): show {현재가·변동} in the largest numeric type, with the percent change emphasized in red or green depending on direction. Add compact realistic secondary rows such as "거래량 18.2M", "시가 73,800", "고가 75,100", "저가 73,400", and a market-cap line if present in the provided text.
3) Opinion capsule (mid 14%): render {투자 의견} inside a rounded pill or framed analyst quote box with strong contrast. Add a small label "AI 요약 의견" and a confidence-style chip such as "리스크 중간" or "관망 구간" without overpowering the main quote.
4) Three-point insight section (mid-lower 22%): list {3가지 포인트} as three evenly spaced numbered rows, each with a small index badge, tiny category tag, and short line length, like a pro investment app summary. Add a slim "오늘 체크" divider and subtle icon accents for earnings, supply chain, and momentum.
5) Mini chart module (lower 16%): place {차트 미니} as a small inset chart with visible candles, volume bars, crosshair guide, last-price marker, and two moving-average lines. Include axis ticks, a tiny "1D · 1W · 1M · 1Y" selector, and labels "MA5" and "MA20".
6) Footer strip (bottom 10%): show {컬러 톤} and {비율} as small design-reference labels only if needed in the composition. Also include a realistic footer note: "투자 판단 참고용 · 데이터 지연 가능", a page/card number "CARD 01/03", and a small creator handle such as "@market.note".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text, weight 700 for title and 500-600 for body, numeric data slightly condensed; price figures should feel like a premium finance app, 34-44px equivalent on 1024 canvas.
- Color palette: dark charcoal #16181D, slate gray #232833, neon lime #B7FF3C, signal red #FF4D4F, cool white #F5F7FA, accent blue-gray #7D8CA3; keep the palette faithful to {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px separators in semi-opaque white, cards with soft drop shadow 0px 8px 24px at 18% opacity, restrained blur, tasteful data glow on active price and chart markers.
- UI realism: include small but legible app affordances such as rounded tabs, toggle chips, stock alert icon, bookmark icon, tiny news headline strip, and muted disclaimer text, all aligned to the same grid.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing digital UI mockup look, equivalent to a clean 50mm product-shot perspective with no perspective distortion, flat graphic composition rather than photographed scene.
- Lighting: controlled screen-like illumination with slight top-left highlight and subtle edge contrast, giving the card dimensionality like a captured premium finance dashboard.
- Color grade: dark financial-app palette with neon lime and red data accents, cool charcoal base, crisp contrast, modern fintech UI tone.
- Rendering detail: crisp vector-like UI edges, realistic anti-aliased Korean typography, believable candlestick chart density, micro dividers, small status chips, and tactile layered panels.

[6. MOOD]
Premium securities app editorial — Toss Securities / KakaoPay investment dashboard aesthetic with the clarity of a Bloomberg-style market card, enriched with realistic market-data widgets and social-finance share-card polish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "주식 종목 카드", "삼성전자 005930 — 또는 NVIDIA·테슬라·SK하이닉스·카카오", "74,500원 / +1.8% (전일 대비) / 시총 4,450조", "\"단기 변동성 ↑ / 중장기 메모리 사이클 회복 — Buy & Hold\"", "01 HBM 글로벌 1위 / 02 파운드리 회복 / 03 분기 어닝 5/2 발표", "작은 캔들 차트 + 5일·20일 이평선", "다크 차콜 + 라임 그린 + 빨강 — MZ 증권 앱 결 (토스·카카오페이 톤)", "1024x1024 정사각".
- Additional Korean UI text may include: "LIVE", "장중", "관심", "AI 요약 의견", "오늘 체크", "거래량", "52주 범위", "CARD 01/03", "투자 판단 참고용 · 데이터 지연 가능", "@market.note".
- All Korean characters and numerals must be crisp and unbroken; keep ticker code formatting exact and preserve punctuation, arrows, percent signs, Korean won symbols, and quotation marks.
- Chart and data widgets must read as a coherent finance card with aligned rows, realistic market microcopy, and believable securities-app hierarchy.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
연말정산 환급을 한눈에 정리하는 세로형 카드뉴스 첫 장. 직장인과 프리랜서가 바로 저장해두고 읽을 수 있는 재테크 인포그래픽 커버이며, 실제 금융 앱 매거진·인스타그램 카드뉴스의 첫 슬라이드처럼 발행일·권호·페이지·출처·저장 유도·다음 장 CTA까지 포함한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 구도: {비율} 세로형 인스타 스토리 레이아웃, 상단 타이틀 16%, 중앙 정보 블록 62%, 하단 출처·주의 문구·페이지 표시 12% 비중.
- 배경은 화이트 기반의 옅은 종이 질감, 연한 영수증 워터마크, 흐릿한 세금 달력 그리드, 작은 체크 표시 패턴, 얇은 점선 구분선을 깔아 실제 카드뉴스 제작물처럼 정보 밀도를 만든다.
- 색감은 {컬러 톤}을 바탕으로 차콜 텍스트와 라임 그린/코랄 포인트가 선명하게 대비되도록 구성한다.
- 중심에는 {대표환급숫자}가 크게 보이는 환급 숫자/아이콘 영역을 두고, 주변에 달력·계산기·영수증·차트 일러스트와 작은 라벨 태그를 배치해 세금 환급 문맥이 즉시 읽히게 한다.
- {대상}과 {핵심 공제 5}가 메인 정보로 읽히도록 중앙 정보 블록을 카드·칩·체크리스트 형태로 구성하고, 카드뉴스 5장 시리즈의 첫 장처럼 강한 헤더와 페이지 인디케이터를 함께 넣는다.
- {발행처} 신뢰형 톤을 유지하며, 실제 저장용 가이드처럼 발행일, 권호, 채널 핸들, 출처, 안내 문구, 저장/공유 마이크로 아이콘, 다음 장 CTA를 하단에 포함한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 16%): 상단 좌측에 작은 시리즈 라벨 "{시리즈명}"와 "{권호}"를 넣고, 우측에는 페이지 배지 "{페이지표시}"를 배치한다. 메인 제목 "연말정산 환급 가이드"를 굵은 제목으로 크게 배치하고, 보조 문구는 {대상}을 짧게 요약해 "직장인·프리랜서 저장 필수"처럼 한 줄로 붙인다. 제목 근처에는 작은 라임 그린 밑줄, 코랄 원형 스티커 "SAVE"를 더해 첫 장 커버의 클릭감을 만든다.
2. Hero numeric block (center 24%): 중앙에 {대표환급숫자}와 원화 기호를 큰 숫자 그래픽으로 배치하고, 위쪽 작은 캡션 "돌려받을 항목 먼저 확인"을 넣는다. 주변에 계산기, 영수증, 달력, 상승 차트 아이콘을 4방향으로 분산하고 각 아이콘 옆에 "카드 사용", "의료비", "기부금", "월세" 같은 짧은 라벨을 붙인다. 숫자 뒤에는 반투명 원형 그래프와 체크 완료 표시를 겹쳐 환급 체크가 끝난 느낌을 준다.
3. Deduction strip (mid 20%): {핵심 공제 5}를 5개 칩/번호형 리스트로 정리한다. 각 칩은 "01 신용카드", "02 의료비", "03 교육비", "04 기부금", "05 월세"가 선명하게 보이도록 하며, 번호는 라임 그린 또는 코랄 하이라이트 원형 배지로 강조한다. 오른쪽 가장자리에는 작은 메모 라벨 "공제 먼저 확인"을 붙인다.
4. Tip box (lower-mid 14%): {환급 팁}은 인용구 스타일의 강조 박스로 넣고, "연봉 25% 초과 카드 사용분 — 체크카드 30% 공제 우선" 문장을 굵기 차이와 밑줄형 포인트로 처리한다. 박스 모서리에 작은 "TIP" 라벨, 체크 아이콘, 형광펜 스트로크를 넣어 저장 가치가 높은 정보처럼 보이게 한다.
5. Missed item box (lower 12%): {자주 놓침}은 별도 서브박스로 분리해 의료비·기부금 키워드가 눈에 띄도록 작은 영수증 아이콘, 병원 십자 아이콘, 하트 기부 아이콘과 함께 정렬한다. "안경·콘택트렌즈·산후조리원 의료비 / 종교단체·사회적기업 기부금" 문장을 정확하게 넣고, 좌측에 코랄 경고 배지 "놓치기 쉬움"을 붙인다.
6. Footer/source area (bottom 8%): {발행처}를 신뢰형 출처 라인으로 배치하고 "출처: 국세청 안내 기준", "발행: {발행처}", "{발행일} 업데이트"를 작은 주석으로 넣는다. 하단에는 점 5개 페이지 인디케이터에서 첫 번째 점만 라임 그린으로 활성화하고, 우측에 "{다음장CTA}" CTA를 넣는다. 좌측에는 "{채널핸들}"과 "{해시태그}"를 작게 넣고, 저장·공유·북마크 마이크로 아이콘 옆에 "{저장CTA}"를 배치한다. 맨 아래 작은 회색 주의 문구로 "{주의문구}"를 넣는다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR 혼합 사용. 제목은 ExtraBold 44~58px, 본문은 SemiBold 24~30px, 주석은 Regular 18~22px. 숫자는 굵고 네모난 산세리프 느낌으로 명확하게.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, charcoal #222222, lime green #B7E35A, coral #FF6B5A, soft gray #E9ECEF, muted mint #DFF3D1. {컬러 톤}의 느낌을 유지한다.
- Graphic details: 카드형 박스는 6~10px 라운드, 4px y-offset / 10px blur / 12% opacity drop shadow. 작은 스티커형 라벨, 체크 배지, 점선 구분선, 미세한 종이 그레인, 반투명 영수증 조각, 달력 탭, 저장/공유 아이콘을 배경과 박스 주변에 레이어링한다.
- Information hierarchy: 제목 → 환급 숫자 → 핵심 공제 5 → 환급 팁 → 자주 놓침 → 출처·페이지 순서로 시선이 흐르게 한다. 모든 텍스트 박스는 실제 카드뉴스처럼 정렬선과 여백이 맞아야 한다.
- Card news realism: 첫 장이지만 시리즈물임을 알 수 있도록 권호, 발행일, 페이지 표시, 하단 점 인디케이터, 다음 장 CTA, 채널 핸들, 해시태그형 문구, 저장 유도 아이콘을 실제 게시물 디자인처럼 자연스럽게 포함한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean flat graphic composition, digital infographic layout, 50mm equivalent orthographic feel, no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: evenly lit studio-style diffuse illumination, crisp legibility prioritized, with subtle paper texture and soft editorial shadows that make the card feel like a finished finance content asset.
- Color grade: bright neutral white with charcoal text, lime green and coral accent system, same tone as a finance app editorial card.
- Visual motif: {비주얼}을 반영해 달력·계산기·영수증·차트·체크리스트 요소를 세금 환급 가이드 맥락에 맞게 일관된 벡터 스타일로 제작한다.

[6. MOOD]
Toss Moneytalk / Banksalad-style finance editorial infographic — concise, data-forward, trustworthy, save-worthy, realistic as a published social card news cover, with practical office-worker tax guide energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: "연말정산 환급 가이드", "직장인", "프리랜서", "01 신용카드", "02 의료비", "03 교육비", "04 기부금", "05 월세", "연봉 25% 초과 카드 사용분 — 체크카드 30% 공제 우선", "안경·콘택트렌즈·산후조리원 의료비 / 종교단체·사회적기업 기부금", "국세청".
- Additional Korean text to render clearly: "직장인·프리랜서 저장 필수", "돌려받을 항목 먼저 확인", "놓치기 쉬움", "공제 먼저 확인", "출처: 국세청 안내 기준", "발행: {발행처}", "{발행일} 업데이트", "{다음장CTA}", "{저장CTA}", "{페이지표시}", "{채널핸들}", "{해시태그}".
- 5장 시리즈의 첫 장처럼 보이되, 한 장 안에서 핵심 요약이 완결되어야 한다.
- 한글과 숫자 표기는 정확하고 선명해야 하며, 글자 깨짐이나 잘못된 줄바꿈이 없어야 한다.
- 모든 아이콘은 달력·계산기·영수증·차트·환급 숫자 중심으로 금융 인포그래픽 맥락에 맞게 배치.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or impersonation

studio:prompts3:ours-457.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- format: vertical card-news poster, {비율}

[1. PURPOSE]
Public health card-news for vaccination and screening guidance, designed as a vertical informational poster for community health centers and hospitals.
Clear, trustworthy Korean public-service layout with strong hierarchy, easy scanning, and shareable social-media format, including slide navigation, practical contact details, and an end-card call-to-action.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main title block at the top 18%: bold headline slightly left-aligned, followed by short explanatory lines with {안내 종류} and {대상}; add a small pill label reading “{기관명} 안내” and a date-style notice tag.
- Mid hero zone about 40–42%: a polished medical illustration scene featuring {대표 비주얼}, with a doctor, nurse, patient checklist, vaccine vial or screening clipboard, calendar icon, and gentle mint medical symbols.
- Information bands below the hero: structured cards for {기간}, {장소}, and {신청 방법}, separated by thin dividers, icon bullets, and compact caption text.
- Background surface: white base with pale mint gradients, paper-like medical bulletin texture, faint cross icons, subtle grid dots, and soft rounded panels for realistic hospital notice-board depth.
- Bottom utility area: add {문의 전화}, {유의사항}, {해시태그}, slide indicator “{슬라이드 번호}/{전체 슬라이드}”, save/share micro icons, and a CTA strip with {CTA 문구}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area top 18%: set a concise public-health title in Korean with strong emphasis, then place {안내 종류} as the key explanatory line directly beneath it.
2. Audience line: display {대상} as a short, high-contrast subline with eligibility icon accents such as age badge, calendar, health insurance card, or hospital pin.
3. Hero illustration area mid 42%: place {대표 비주얼} in a neat editorial composition, with doctors/nurses, a checklist board, vaccine syringe, screening form, and small health icons arranged around the central message.
4. Schedule and location block: render {기간} and {장소} in a rounded bordered information box with clear date-like formatting, thin rules, icon labels, and a small caption for reservation or visit guidance.
5. Application block: place {신청 방법} as a distinct callout section with a highlighted “신청” label, QR-style placeholder square, phone icon, and step labels 01–02–03.
6. Footer reassurance strip bottom 12%: add “정확한 대상 여부는 방문 전 확인하세요”, {문의 전화}, {해시태그}, the page indicator “{슬라이드 번호}/{전체 슬라이드}”, and the CTA text {CTA 문구}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for headlines, Pretendard SemiBold for subheads, and Noto Sans KR Regular for body copy; headline size should feel like 54–72px on 1024x1536, body text around 24–30px, micro labels around 18–22px.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤}; white #FFFFFF, signature green #1F8A5B, soft mint #EAF6EF, charcoal #2B2F33, light gray #E5E8EB, plus warm cream #FFF8EA for notice tags.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1px separators in pale green-gray, rounded 24px information panels, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 16px at 12% opacity for the hero card and info boxes.
- Graphic details: include realistic card-news UI details such as slide number, page dots, small save/share icons, hashtag label, QR-style contact block, and clinic bulletin captions while keeping the official-public tone.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean editorial poster design with a 35mm equivalent composition feel, top-down graphic balance, and no photographic distortion.
- Lighting: bright diffused studio-style illumination, even coverage from upper-left with a very soft fill from right, no harsh highlights.
- Color grade: crisp white medical palette with mint-green accents, charcoal text, soft cream notice tags, and a calm hospital-information finish.

[6. MOOD]
Korean public health bulletin — 질병관리청 and 국민건강보험 안내문 tone, like a clean civic information poster with dependable editorial clarity, practical hospital counter signage, and friendly card-news readability.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함:
  - 보건소 백신·검진 안내
  - {기관명} 안내
  - {안내 종류}
  - 대상 {대상}
  - 기간 {기간}
  - 장소 {장소}
  - 신청 {신청 방법}
  - 문의 {문의 전화}
  - 유의 {유의사항}
  - {슬라이드 번호}/{전체 슬라이드}
  - {해시태그}
  - {CTA 문구}
  - 비주얼 {대표 비주얼}
  - 컬러 {컬러 톤}
- Keep all Korean characters crisp and correctly formed; no broken glyphs.
- Maintain a clear public-service hierarchy: title > eligibility > schedule/location > application details > contact/CTA.
- Use realistic Korean informational microcopy such as “방문 전 확인”, “신분증 지참”, “대상자 확인”, “예약 권장” where it supports the layout.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or real-person impersonation

- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Hotel room and stay photography editorial, 4-cut grid layout for accommodation listings and travel marketing.
Premium property showcase that communicates room, bathroom, lounge, and view in one polished horizontal composition, like a realistic Korean hotel booking feature or travel magazine room tour.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall framing: a 4-panel horizontal grid with equal visual weight, each panel occupying about 25% of the width, with thin warm-gray dividers between panels and a refined editorial listing-card feel.
- Subject placement: the main bed scene should feel like the hero panel, with the other three panels balanced in sequence for a premium accommodation preview; each panel should include natural hotel details that make the space believable and lived-in for a guest arrival.
- Background treatment: realistic hotel interior surfaces and tactile material detail; use soft wall texture, wood grain, brushed metal, stone, linen, glass, amenity packaging, folded towels, lamps, curtains, and small guest-ready objects appropriate to {객실 컨셉}.
- Spacing and framing direction: keep each panel clearly readable as bed, bathroom, lounge, and exterior view, with authentic depth, straight architectural lines, and enough contextual objects to feel like a real property shoot.
- Add a subtle editorial header or lower caption strip across the grid with Korean room-tour information, such as “호텔 객실·숙박 사진”, “ROOM TOUR VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “체크인 15:00 · 체크아웃 11:00”, “디럭스 더블 / 기준 2인”, and small panel labels.
- Use {숙박 종류}, {객실 컨셉}, {4컷 구성}, {조명}, {컬러 톤}, {가격대 시그니처}, {비율} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Panel 01 — Bed hero: a neatly made bed with premium linens, layered pillows, a textured throw blanket, upholstered or wood headboard, bedside lamp, phone, water glasses, room key card, folded welcome card, curtains, and warm wall sconces; frame it as the most inviting room feature, with the bed angled slightly to show depth and the headboard wall in full context. Add a small Korean caption: “01 침대 hero”.
2) Panel 02 — Bathroom: a polished bathroom scene with vanity, mirror, shower glass or bathtub visible, stacked towels, amenity tray, ceramic soap dish, robe hook, hair dryer pouch, and realistic reflections on marble, tile, chrome, or matte-black fixtures; the scene should feel freshly prepared by housekeeping, not empty. Add a small Korean caption: “02 욕실”.
3) Panel 03 — Lounge / sofa: a seating corner with sofa or armchair, side table, lamp, cushion, local magazine, notebook, ceramic cup, small vase or plant, power outlet detail, luggage stand or neatly placed small suitcase partially visible; composition should feel relaxed, upscale, and ready for a guest. Add a small Korean caption: “03 라운지·소파”.
4) Panel 04 — Window view: a framed city, ocean, mountain, or garden view depending on {숙박 종류}; show a real-world vista through a large window with curtain texture, slight glass reflection, balcony rail or window frame detail, atmospheric depth, and golden-hour light. Add a small Korean caption: “04 창밖 view”.
5) Price cue integration: subtly imply {가격대 시그니처} through material quality, fixture finish, amenity selection, view quality, room scale, and curated guest items; include a small price-style line such as “1박 25만원” as part of the editorial caption, not as a loud advertisement.
6) If the chosen property style is luxury-oriented, emphasize thicker textiles, darker accents, marble, brass or black metal details, generous room scale, layered lighting, and refined service touches; if it is value-oriented, keep the room efficient but still refined, with believable compact storage, clean bedding, practical amenities, and warm hospitality cues.
7) Include small listing metadata in Korean near the top or bottom edge: “시티 호텔 디럭스”, “모던 미니멀”, “자연광 + 따뜻한 다운라이트 / 황금시간”, “크림 + 우드 + 신선한 그린”, and “1536x1024 가로”, styled like an editorial information bar.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if text overlay appears, use Pretendard SemiBold for titles and Noto Sans KR Regular for secondary lines, with title size around 34–42 px and secondary text around 18–22 px; panel captions may be smaller, around 14–16 px, in a refined hotel listing style.
- Color palette: derive from {컬러 톤}; use warm cream, natural wood brown, soft sage green, off-white, charcoal gray, brass, stone beige, deep navy, or dark luxury accents as appropriate, with restrained saturation and believable interior color balance.
- Border/shadow: thin clean white or warm gray dividers between panels, plus very subtle soft shadow around the full grid, approximately 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12–15% opacity.
- Graphic details: allow small editorial UI elements such as room number text, check-in/check-out line, tiny amenity icons, location/date label, and tasteful caption tags; keep them integrated with the photography so the final image feels like a premium hotel room-tour spread.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 full-frame interior photography look, RF 24mm to 35mm wide lens range, f/5.6 to f/8, straight verticals, high-detail room capture, realistic architectural perspective, tripod-stable framing.
- Lighting: natural window light mixed with warm ceiling downlights, bedside lamps, vanity lighting, and golden-hour softness when possible; keep highlights controlled, shadows gentle, and surfaces dimensional.
- Color grade: Marriott / Aman-inspired toned-down luxury, similar to a polished Korean premium hotel editorial; warm neutrals, balanced whites, slightly muted greens, natural wood warmth, and clean but realistic contrast.
- Rendering detail: emphasize real fabric weave, towel texture, stone veining, brushed metal, glass reflections, curtain folds, wood grain, and subtle signs of guest readiness such as a room card, folded note, or tea set.

[6. MOOD]
Premium hotel magazine spread — Marriott and Aman toned-down luxury mixed with the clean polish of Korean Signiel and Shilla Stay, with realistic arrival-day warmth, refined hospitality, and a trustworthy accommodation-listing atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: ensure these exact Korean strings appear correctly if shown in the design — “호텔 객실·숙박 사진”, “시티 호텔 디럭스”, “모던 미니멀”, “01 침대 hero”, “02 욕실”, “03 라운지·소파”, “04 창밖 view”, “자연광 + 따뜻한 다운라이트 / 황금시간”, “크림 + 우드 + 신선한 그린”, “1박 25만원”, “1536x1024 가로”.
- Additional Korean editorial text may appear and must be legible, for example: “ROOM TOUR VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “체크인 15:00 · 체크아웃 11:00”, “디럭스 더블 / 기준 2인”, “예약 문의 02-0000-0000”, “서울 중구 프리미엄 스테이”.
- All 4 panels must show the same overall editorial grid logic and consistent luxury hotel realism.
- Keep room architecture physically plausible, with correct perspective, straight lines, believable materials, realistic fixture scale, and natural reflections.
- The final image should feel like a real photographed hotel room feature with polished editorial captions, not a flat mockup.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Wedding stationery and favor label set mockup, 4-item collage for a Korean wedding ceremony program sheet, macaroon favor label, seating card, and welcome board, designed as a premium shareable editorial layout.
Showcase a cohesive printed wedding suite that feels ready for an actual boutique wedding: readable ceremony information, guest-facing labels, table assignment details, and a coordinated welcome sign.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main composition: a 4-panel collage arranged as a polished editorial flat-lay, each panel showing one stationery item from {굿즈구성}; panels may overlap slightly like real paper goods while keeping every item identifiable.
- Hero emphasis: the A5 ceremony program sits in the upper-left or center-left panel at roughly 35% of the frame, with clear title hierarchy and visible ceremony order.
- Background treatment: warm ivory paper surface with tactile linen grain, letterpress-like impressions, soft natural shadows, and small real wedding styling details such as a silk ribbon curl, dried flower sprig, wax-colored envelope flap, or gold paper clip.
- Typography placement: {신랑신부날짜} should appear as the primary header treatment on the ceremony sheet and as smaller coordinated text on the label and welcome board.
- Visual identity: {시그니처모티프} repeats across all pieces as a monogram, floral corner mark, small divider, label icon, or footer ornament, with realistic print ink weight.
- Framing direction: top-down or slightly angled flat-lay presentation with crisp paper edges, readable Korean text, visible paper thickness, and a boutique stationery photography feel.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top-left panel: a full A5 ceremony program sheet with {신랑신부날짜} at the top, title “WEDDING CEREMONY” and “예식 순서”, then the sequence {식순세부}; include small lines for 사회, 주례/덕담, 축가, and 감사 인사.
2) Top-right panel: a macaroon favor label from {굿즈구성}, designed as a small premium tag tied with sage ribbon; include {답례품문구}, flavor line, made-for-wedding date, and tiny monogram mark.
3) Bottom-left panel: a seating card from {굿즈구성}, using {좌석정보} with guest name, table number, meal note, and a polite welcome phrase; card may be shown with a vellum overlay or small envelope corner.
4) Bottom-right panel: a welcome board from {굿즈구성}, styled as the largest secondary piece with headline “WELCOME TO OUR WEDDING”, {웰컴문구}, venue/date line, and a small QR-style information block that looks decorative rather than scannable.
5) Across all panels: keep the same visual system for margins, line weights, monogram placement, color accents, and paper finish so the set feels like one branded wedding suite.
6) Use {컨셉} as the overall design direction, preserving a refined editorial wedding stationery look with realistic printed details, tactile materials, and premium tabletop styling.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean main text in Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo, bold for names and headings; English accents in Garamond + Allura, delicate script weight, with sizes ranging from 18–42pt depending on panel hierarchy; use {타이포방향} as the typographic personality.
- Color palette: {컬러팔레트} rendered as ivory #F7F2E8, soft sage #A9B8A1, muted gold #C9B37E, blush beige #E8D8C8, and charcoal #2F2A26 for readable text.
- Border/shadow: thin warm-gray rules, 1–2px hairline borders, soft natural drop shadow with 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity, plus subtle embossed label edges.
- Surface finish: premium matte paper, faint letterpress indentation on monogram and names, satin ribbon texture, natural paper fibers, and warm champagne foil highlights used sparingly.
- Print realism: include slight paper curl, stacked sheet thickness, gentle ink absorption, tiny registration variations, and believable scale differences between A5 sheet, tag, card, and board.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with RF 35mm f/1.8 macro-style close flat-lay framing, f/5.6 for crisp stationery edges and readable typography.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, natural shadow falloff, controlled reflections on foil accents.
- Color grade: warm ivory and sage with subtle champagne gold highlights, low saturation, clean editorial contrast.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean wedding stationery editorial — refined Martha Stewart Weddings x Kinfolk tabletop spread with luxury boutique print-shop polish, romantic but practical enough for a real ceremony day.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: “박지호 ♥ 이서윤 · 2026.06.07 · 신라호텔 영빈관”, “01 식순지 (A5) / 02 답례품 마카롱 라벨 / 03 좌석 카드 / 04 웰컴 보드”.
- 추가 인쇄 문구가 선명하게 보여야 함: “예식 순서”, “개식 선언 · 화촉점화 · 신랑 입장 · 신부 입장 · 혼인서약 · 성혼선언 · 축가 · 양가 인사 · 폐식”, “감사의 마음을 담아”, “TABLE 07 / 김민서 님”, “WELCOME TO OUR WEDDING”.
- All 4 panels must remain clearly separated and fully legible, with consistent layout logic across the entire collage.
- The stationery should look like real printed wedding goods photographed on a tabletop, not digital UI cards.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
