studio:prompts3:ours-454.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024
- format: {비율}

[1. PURPOSE]
Pet sitter and pet hotel advertisement poster, square social ad for local pet-care services.
Designed to communicate trust, daily routine care, transparent pricing, and premium-but-friendly neighborhood service in a magazine-style layout.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Square poster with a balanced editorial layout: main pet-and-sitter lifestyle scene occupies about 58% of the frame, while service information, pricing, contact, and booking details form stacked cards along the side and lower band.
- Background treatment: warm cream-beige base with tactile paper texture, soft sage blocks, amber label stickers, small paw-print accents, rounded info cards, and realistic pet-care props such as leash, water bowl, blanket, toy basket, check-in clipboard, and room key tag.
- Use {비주얼} as the central visual concept, arranged like a premium local service poster: a calm dog or cat with a sitter, cozy hotel bedding, natural home-like interior, and small details that suggest daily feeding, walking, nap time, and safe overnight care.
- Create a clear reading path from headline to service list, price, review, reservation information, address, and contact; the layout should feel like a real printed flyer adapted for Instagram feed advertising.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (center 55-60%): present the {비주얼} scene with a real-life documentary feel — a calm dog with a sitter, a cat resting in a cozy hotel room, or a sitter holding a leash near a warm entrance — with natural fur detail, soft realistic shadowing, and believable interior depth.
2. Top header zone (12-15%): place "펫시터·반려동물 호텔 광고" as a small category kicker, then set {업체명} as the main headline in a bold, trustworthy editorial style. Add {슬로건} directly below as a friendly one-line promise.
3. Service band (mid-lower 15-18%): show {서비스 종류} as a short, scannable service line with dot separators, mini icons, or pill labels; include a small "오늘 예약 가능" style label using {예약문구}.
4. Price block (lower-left or lower-center 12-15%): set {가격} in a compact pricing layout with clear hierarchy; make numbers more prominent than the surrounding text, with thin dividers and tiny captions such as "소형견 기준", "상담 후 확정" if visually appropriate.
5. Trust and review strip: display "후기" and {후기 인용} in quotation marks as a real customer testimonial, placed inside a soft tint card with a tiny paw icon, date stamp, or customer initial badge.
6. Local information block: include {주소}, {연락처}, {운영시간}, and {채널핸들} in a footer-style contact card with map pin, phone, clock, and chat icons; add a small QR-style square labeled {예약QR라벨}.
7. Promotion and care points: add 2-3 small sticker badges reading {안심포인트} and {프로모션}, styled like realistic service highlights rather than exaggerated guarantees.
8. Color accent system: use {컬러 톤} for labels, dividers, paw marks, icon fills, and background cards; keep the palette warm, polished, and pet-friendly.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body and service text, Bold 700-800 for {업체명}, Medium 500-600 for details, strong price numerals, and compact caption text; all information must remain readable at 1024x1024.
- Color palette: cream beige #F4EFE6, sage green #A9B79A, warm amber #D9A15E, soft brown #7A5C45, charcoal #2F2A26; allow {컬러 톤} to drive the accent balance.
- Border/shadow: thin rounded cards with soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px rgba(47,42,38,0.12), subtle inner padding, fine dotted dividers, gentle sticker edges, and warm editorial poster finishing.
- Graphic details: include small but believable pet-service graphics such as calendar label, walking route doodle, paw icons, checklist bullets, room number tag, pet name tag, or reservation label; these should support the advertisement rather than overwhelm the main service message.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm f/2.8 documentary product-lifestyle look, natural depth but still crisp enough for ad text overlays; if the scene includes an interior, keep perspective mildly wide and realistic.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from right, lightly diffused highlights to suggest safety and cleanliness; realistic reflections on bowls, clips, glass door, or polished floor are acceptable.
- Color grade: warm cream + sage + amber with slightly muted contrast, clean whites, and soft brown shadows; keep the overall image polished but not glossy.
- Material realism: fur texture, cotton bedding, woven leash, matte paper cards, printed sticker labels, wooden floor, and soft sofa fabric should feel tactile and natural.

[6. MOOD]
Premium pet-care editorial — a calm local-service ad with the approachable trust of a modern neighborhood brand, the warmth of a pet lifestyle magazine spread, and the practical clarity of a real booking flyer.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구 — "펫시터·반려동물 호텔 광고", "{업체명}", "{슬로건}", "{서비스 종류}", "{가격}", "후기", "{후기 인용}", "{예약문구}", "{주소}", "{연락처}", "{운영시간}", "{채널핸들}", "{예약QR라벨}"
- 추가로 자연스럽게 보이면 좋은 문구 — "산책", "1박 케어", "호텔링", "트레이닝", "오늘 예약", "상담 가능", "소형견·고양이 케어".
- Keep all Korean characters crisp and correctly formed; no broken syllables, no spacing errors in the displayed text.
- The composition must clearly communicate pet sitter / pet hotel service advertising with visible booking, price, and contact information, not a generic pet illustration.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Overly glossy AI-smooth fur or plastic-looking interiors

args.default: 강아지와 펫시터의 산책 준비 장면 + 따뜻한 반려동물 호텔 인테리어

args.name: 슬로건

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
긴급 반려동물 실종 포스터, 세로형 A4 비율의 신고용 안내 이미지. 전봇대 부착물과 SNS 공유용으로 즉시 읽히는 구조로, 강아지·고양이 모두 적용 가능한 실종 공지 레이아웃.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 프레임은 {비율} 기준으로 구성하고, 상단 18%는 긴급 헤더와 게시 정보, 중앙 42%는 {대표 사진}, 하단 40%는 실종 정보·식별 특징·사례금·연락처·제보 탭 영역으로 나눈다.
- 배경은 화이트 종이 위에 실제 출력물 같은 미세한 섬유 질감, 차콜 잉크 번짐, 접힌 자국, 투명 테이프 2곳, 작은 스테이플 자국을 더해 동네 게시판과 전봇대에 붙은 포스터 느낌을 만든다.
- 상단 좌측에는 {포스터 번호}, 우측에는 {게시일}을 작은 행정 문서형 라벨처럼 배치하고, 헤더 아래에는 {지역 태그}를 빨강 캡슐 태그로 넣는다.
- {동물·이름·종}, {실종 일시·장소}, {외모 특징}, {사례금}, {연락처}는 각각 카드형 정보 블록으로 분리하고, 아이콘·굵기·색상 대비를 활용해 길거리에서 2초 안에 핵심 정보가 잡히게 한다.
- 하단에는 손으로 뜯어갈 수 있는 세로 절취 탭 6개를 넣고, 각 탭에 연락처 일부와 “실종 제보” 문구가 반복 인쇄된 실제 전단지 구조로 만든다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone (top 18%): 굵은 긴급 타이틀 스타일로 “반려동물 실종”을 가장 먼저 읽히게 하고, 바로 아래에 {동물·이름·종}을 큰 서브헤드로 배치한다. 빨강 액센트 바, 얇은 차콜 규칙선, 작은 경고 삼각형 아이콘을 써서 동네 공고문 같은 긴급성을 만든다.
2) Posting metadata strip: 헤더 하단의 얇은 줄에 “포스터 번호: {포스터 번호}”, “게시일: {게시일}”, “공유 가능” 라벨을 넣고, 우측에는 작은 QR 박스와 {QR 안내}를 배치한다.
3) Main photo zone (mid 42%): {대표 사진}을 중앙에 크게 배치하되, 첫 컷은 정면 인식이 쉬운 얼굴 중심, 보조 컷은 옆모습 또는 반측면으로 넣어 털색과 체형이 한눈에 보이게 한다. 사진 주변에는 얇은 화이트 프레임, 약한 그림자, 손글씨 느낌의 작은 캡션 “최근 사진 / 측면 확인”을 붙여 실제 제보 포스터처럼 보이게 한다.
4) Incident info block: {실종 일시·장소}를 날짜/시간과 장소가 분리되어 보이도록 두 줄 구성으로 정리하고, 지도 핀 아이콘·짧은 골목 지도 미니라인·“마지막 목격” 라벨을 함께 넣어 위치 정보임을 즉시 인식시킨다.
5) Identification block: {외모 특징}은 짧은 항목형 정보 칩으로 풀어내고, 목줄·귀 끝 점·마이크로칩 같은 식별 요소가 가장 먼저 눈에 띄도록 굵게 강조한다. 옆에는 작은 확대 원형 콜아웃 2개를 넣어 귀·목줄 같은 특징을 사진 위에서 연결한다.
6) Reward and action block: {사례금}은 빨강 강조 박스 안에 넣고, 바로 아래에 {행동 요청}과 {제보 안내}를 작은 안내문으로 배치해 발견자가 어떻게 행동해야 하는지 자연스럽게 알 수 있게 한다.
7) Contact and cooperation block (bottom): {연락처}를 가장 읽기 쉬운 크기로 배치하고 “24시간 연락 가능”을 보조 라인으로 표시한다. 하단 좌측에는 {협력 문구}, 우측에는 QR 코드 박스와 SNS 공유용 짧은 문구를 넣으며, 맨 아래 절취 탭에는 전화번호와 “코코 제보” 같은 반복 텍스트를 인쇄한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR combination. Header uses Pretendard ExtraBold 54–72px, body uses Noto Sans KR SemiBold 28–34px, contact line uses Pretendard Bold 36–44px. 숫자와 시간은 가독성을 위해 탭형 숫자처럼 정렬한다.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, charcoal #1F1F1F, emergency red #D92D20, soft gray #E9E9E9, muted black #111111, tape beige #E8D9B8. {컬러 톤}의 긴급 인쇄물 느낌을 유지하면서 실제 레이저 프린트와 SNS 전단 이미지 사이의 질감을 살린다.
- Border/shadow: thin charcoal border 2px, photo drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity. Header red bar should be flat with crisp edges. 절취 탭은 점선 커팅 라인과 약한 찢김 질감을 포함한다.
- Graphic details: 지도 핀, 전화기, QR 코드, 작은 발자국 아이콘, 빨강 경고 라벨, 동네 게시판용 테이프 조각을 사용한다. 장식은 정보 전달을 보조하는 실제 포스터 요소처럼 보이게 한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary pet portrait look, 85mm f/1.8 for the main pet photo, secondary side cut at 50mm f/2.2, shallow but readable depth of field.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from front-right; natural home-or-street snapshot realism, clear fur texture and readable markings.
- Color grade: neutral white paper base, charcoal text, emergency red accents, slightly desaturated real-world poster tone, similar to municipal notice boards and rescue-group SNS flyers.
- Print realism: subtle paper grain, slight ink density variation, taped corners, small staple marks, faint fold line, and low-gloss printed photo finish.

[6. MOOD]
Urgent neighborhood rescue notice — practical flyer design with the clarity of a community bulletin and the immediacy of a lost-and-found pet poster, warm enough to feel made by a real worried guardian.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함:
  - “반려동물 실종”
  - “포스터 번호: {포스터 번호}”
  - “게시일: {게시일}”
  - {동물·이름·종}
  - {실종 일시·장소}
  - {외모 특징}
  - {사례금}
  - {연락처}
  - “24시간 연락 가능”
  - {행동 요청}
  - {제보 안내}
  - {QR 안내}
  - {지역 태그}
  - {협력 문구}
- All 2 photo cuts must show the same animal identity clearly, with anatomically correct pet proportions and no visual confusion between breed/color/markings.
- Maintain emergency poster readability: large headline, clear photo, concise info blocks, strong contrast, realistic tear-off contact tabs.
- The poster must feel printable and usable in the real world: A4 vertical notice, street-posted paper texture, readable Korean typography, and SNS-shareable visual hierarchy.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications / government or police emblems
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unrelated human portraits

studio:prompts3:ours-452.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Pet adoption / rehoming advertisement poster in an Instagram-style rescue shelter aesthetic, designed as a trustworthy square social post that looks like a real foster/rescue community listing with practical adoption details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {동물·이름} as the hero, presented like a real shelter profile card for 분양·입양 상담.
- Composition: one large primary animal image plus 2 supporting views for side profile and everyday behavior, arranged in a readable 3-cut grid with a header, profile facts, contact band, and small social-post details.
- Background treatment: soft warm cream-beige base with subtle recycled-paper texture, faint paw-print pattern, tape-label accents, gentle rounded cards, and small handwritten-style note stickers that support the shelter profile mood.
- Framing: centered, stable, and information-forward; the animal should occupy about 55–65% of the frame overall, while Korean info panels, small captions, and contact details remain clearly readable.
- Add realistic post details such as shelter handle, date label, adoption ID, tiny save/share/comment icons, hashtag line, and a small QR-code-like contact block next to {연락처}.
- Use {유형}, {성격·건강}, {입양 조건}, {비주얼}, {컬러 톤}, {연락처}, and {비율} as editable content placeholders integrated into the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 15–18%): set a concise adoption title in Korean, with a shelter-poster feel and clear hierarchy. Include the fixed title text “반려동물 분양·입양 광고”, a small label “입양 프로필”, a date stamp such as “2026.05.01 업데이트”, and an account handle like “@happy_paws_rescue”.
2. Hero panel (left or center, about 45–50%): place the front-facing animal portrait as the main focal point, with soft daylight, tactile fur detail, natural eyes, and a calm real-life expression. Add a small name tag label reading “오늘의 가족 후보: {동물·이름}”.
3. Supporting panels (right/bottom, each about 15–20%): include a side-angle view and an everyday candid shot, such as sitting near a foster-home blanket, looking out a window, or playing gently with a small toy, so viewers can read body shape, temperament, and real-life presence. Add short captions like “옆모습 체크” and “일상 컷”.
4. Info blocks (lower or side text column): show {유형}, {성격·건강}, {입양 조건}, and {비주얼} in short, readable Korean lines with quote-style emphasis for key facts. Use section labels “성격”, “조건”, “비주얼”, and “컬러” with small icon dots or paw bullets.
5. Contact strip (bottom area): display {연락처} clearly in a warm amber contact band, separate from the main body text for quick action. Include “상담 가능 시간 10:00–19:00”, “입양 문의 DM/문자”, and a small QR-style square marked “문의 QR”.
6. Social footer details: add tiny Instagram-like micro icons for 좋아요, 댓글, 공유, 저장; include a hashtag line such as “#사지말고입양하세요 #평생가족찾기 #임보일기” and a small page/profile note like “ADOPT CARD 01 / {비율}”.
7. Palette application: use {컬러 톤} consistently across background, accent rules, sticker labels, info badges, and text emphasis to keep the mood warm and credible.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for body copy, with bold 700–800 weight for headings and 400–500 weight for details; size hierarchy should feel like a polished Instagram rescue post from a real foster community.
- Color palette: cream beige, warm amber, charcoal, off-white, muted brown accents, and the tones from {컬러 톤}; use charcoal for main text and amber for highlights.
- Border/shadow: thin rounded frame lines with a soft drop shadow of 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; combine printed-card panels, subtle label stickers, dotted dividers, and soft paper grain for a warm shelter-post finish.
- Layout details: include small but believable design elements such as adoption ID “PAW-0526”, tiny profile badges “중성화 확인”, “건강 체크”, “임보 기록”, and a muted sponsor/support strip reading “지역 임보 네트워크 · 자원봉사 상담”. Do not present these as official certifications.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic pet-photo look using a 50mm f/1.8 for the hero portrait and a 35mm f/2.0 for the supporting lifestyle cuts, with natural perspective and minimal distortion.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, slight fill from the right, evenly exposing fur texture and facial expression without overexposure.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + amber highlights with charcoal text contrast, lightly desaturated for a shelter-trust aesthetic.
- Image realism: show believable fur texture, catchlights in the eyes, natural whiskers or muzzle detail, and slight depth separation between the animal, paper-card panels, and background textures.

[6. MOOD]
Instagram rescue shelter profile card — a warm, trustworthy adoption-post feel inspired by real foster/rescue community graphics, with enough real listing details to feel ready for posting and sharing.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 할 문자열: “반려동물 분양·입양 광고”, “성격”, “조건”, “비주얼”, “컬러”, “연락”.
- Also render short Korean listing text clearly, such as “입양 프로필”, “오늘의 가족 후보”, “상담 가능”, “입양 문의 DM/문자”, “#사지말고입양하세요”, and “평생가족을 기다려요”.
- The animal must remain the visual hero; do not replace it with decorative graphics or unrelated objects.
- Keep the 3-cut structure consistent and readable, with no broken Korean characters, and make {연락처} easy to find in the bottom contact band.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

args.default: 강아지 푸들 / 봄이 / 4개월 / 암컷 — 또는 고양이·토끼·햄스터

args.name: 컬러 톤
args.default: 크림 베이지 + 따뜻한 amber + 차콜 — 따뜻한 입양 결

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- canvas_ratio_note: {비율}

[1. PURPOSE]
어린이 생일 파티 초대장 poster, vertical 5:8 layout, for a kid-friendly birthday invite with customizable age, date, venue, theme, visual mascot, palette, RSVP, ticket note, program schedule, and host credit.
Designed to feel like a cheerful boutique party invitation card suitable for printing, messenger sharing, and mobile story posting.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Build a lively vertical invitation card with a rounded printed-card silhouette, soft paper texture, layered stickers, bunting flags, streamers, balloons, cake candles, gift boxes, and tiny party-icon doodles.
- Top 16%: place a small English/Korean party label, then the main title block with {파티 제목} and {아이·연령} as the dominant birthday identity.
- Upper-middle 16%: show {일자·장소} and {상세 주소} in a friendly event-info panel with calendar, clock, and map-pin micro icons.
- Middle 38%: feature {대표 비주얼} as the hero illustration, surrounded by confetti, ribbon curls, cupcakes, candles, wrapped presents, party hats, and theme-matching sticker labels.
- Lower-middle 16%: add two compact info cards: one for {컨셉·드레스코드}, one for {파티 프로그램}; use rounded tabs, dotted dividers, and small illustrated icons so the information feels like a real event flyer.
- Bottom 14%: create a detachable ticket-stub style RSVP footer with perforation dots, a small PARTY PASS label, {티켓 안내}, {RSVP}, and a tiny host credit line {호스트}.
- Keep the layout centered and readable, but make the surrounding edges rich with festive stationery details rather than empty space.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header zone: render the fixed label 초대합니다 near the top, add a small BIRTHDAY PARTY ribbon, then typeset {파티 제목} in a rounded playful Korean display style; place {아이·연령} directly below as the largest line.
- Date / venue zone: place {일자·장소} in two balanced lines, with small star separators; place {상세 주소} below inside a cream-white pill box with a tiny map-pin icon.
- Theme ribbon zone: display {컨셉·드레스코드} inside a curved sticker banner using a contrasting accent color from {컬러 팔레트}; add tiny clothing, crown, mask, leaf, shell, or sparkle icons depending on the theme.
- Hero illustration zone: show {대표 비주얼} as a cute polished centerpiece with balloons, birthday cake, candle glow, wrapped gifts, paper garlands, confetti dots, and playful shadowing that resembles printed cut-paper stickers.
- Program mini-card zone: display {파티 프로그램} as a compact timeline with small circular time badges and dotted dividers.
- Ticket / RSVP zone: design a bottom ticket strip with scalloped edges, perforation holes, small barcode-like party stripes, PARTY PASS text, {티켓 안내}, {RSVP}, and {호스트}; make it look like a real invitation pass, not a plain footer.
- Age variation handling: for 5살 use softer shapes and larger mascot proportions; for 7살 use balanced cute-party details; for 10살 use slightly cooler sticker graphics, sharper typography accents, and more refined icon details while preserving the birthday invitation hierarchy.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Gmarket Sans Bold for {아이·연령}, Pretendard SemiBold for date and venue, and a rounded handwritten accent font for small labels such as 초대합니다, PARTY PASS, and tiny sticker tags; approximate sizes: 78–104 pt for the age line, 40–54 pt for {파티 제목}, 28–38 pt for event details, 22–30 pt for info cards and RSVP.
- Color palette: base cream beige #F6F0E6, warm white #FFF9F2, pastel pink #F7B6C8, lilac #C9B6F8, soft gold #E7C56A, candy blue #9ED8F5, and accents derived from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Materials: matte stationery paper, subtle grain, rounded card corners, layered sticker shadows, soft cut-paper edges, tiny foil-like gold highlights on stars and candle flames.
- Border and dividers: use a gentle 6px outer card margin, rounded corners, dotted dividers, scalloped ticket perforations, and soft drop shadows with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity.
- Decorative graphics: include theme-aware confetti, ribbons, balloons, cake crumbs, garlands, gift tags, tiny hearts, stars, and sticker labels so the invite feels ready for an actual children’s party.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean editorial flat poster look, simulated as a 50mm lens product-photo composition with no perspective distortion, centered orthographic feel.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at 45° with a faint fill from lower-right, creating even color separation and crisp readable edges.
- Color grade: pastel candy tones with warm cream highlights, restrained saturation, and a lightly matte finish inspired by modern kids-event stationery.

[6. MOOD]
Playful premium kids-party stationery — a polished Korean birthday invitation with real event-poster details, cute handmade-card warmth, and the celebratory energy of a boutique children’s party.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following visible strings must appear exactly as rendered text, with no broken characters:
  - 초대합니다
  - {파티 제목}
  - {아이·연령}
  - {일자·장소}
  - {상세 주소}
  - {컨셉·드레스코드}
  - {파티 프로그램}
  - {티켓 안내}
  - {RSVP}
  - {호스트}
- Use {대표 비주얼} and {컬러 팔레트} as the main visual direction for illustration, props, stickers, confetti, border accents, and color harmony.
- The invitation must read naturally for a 5살, 7살, or 10살 birthday party, with friendly Korean wording and a clear date, venue, RSVP, and party-pass footer.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable real-person face swaps

studio:prompts3:ours-450.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
돌잔치·생일 파티용 프리미엄 굿즈 4종 세트 콜라주. 케이크 토퍼, 답례품 라벨, 좌석 카드, 포토존 백드롭을 실제 제작 샘플처럼 촬영한 평면 mockup 이미지로 보여준다. 인쇄물의 종이 결, 컷팅 단면, 리본·스티커·소형 패키지 소품까지 포함해 파티 준비물이 한 세트로 완성된 느낌을 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 4분할 콜라주가 한 화면을 가득 채우며, 좌상단은 메인 케이크 토퍼, 우상단은 답례품 잼 라벨, 좌하단은 좌석 카드, 우하단은 포토존 백드롭 샘플로 배치한다.
- 전체 바닥은 크림 베이지 매트 종이와 린넨 패브릭이 겹쳐진 product styling surface로 구성하고, 리본 조각, 금박 컨페티, 작은 말린 꽃, 투명 스티커 시트, 둥근 목재 블록을 자연스럽게 곁들인다.
- 각 패널에는 {컨셉}의 대표 색, 아이콘, 패턴을 반복해 하나의 패키지 디자인처럼 연결하고, 패널 모서리에는 얇은 그림자와 실제 종이 두께가 보이도록 한다.
- 케이크 토퍼에는 {아이이름}, {생일문구}, {행사날짜}가 가장 잘 보이게 들어가며, 토퍼 하단에는 꽂이 스틱 2개와 레이저 컷 가장자리의 미세한 그을림 질감을 표현한다.
- 답례품 라벨에는 {답례품정보}, {감사문구}, 작은 제조일/행사일 표기와 원형 스티커를 넣고, 실제 유리병 목 부분에 리본으로 묶인 모습과 라벨 단품이 함께 보이게 한다.
- 좌석 카드에는 {좌석정보}, 게스트 이름 예시, 테이블 번호, 작은 하트 또는 별 아이콘을 인쇄하고, 접힌 카드의 앞면과 뒷면이 살짝 겹쳐 보이게 한다.
- 포토존 백드롭에는 {포토존문구}, {파티장소}, 대형 패턴 그래픽, 풍선 아치 일부, 패브릭 배너 가장자리와 고정 클립 디테일을 넣는다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Main hero panel: {굿즈구성} 중 케이크 토퍼를 가장 눈에 띄게 배치한다. 3/4 각도로 살짝 세워 종이 두께, 골드 포일 포인트, 레이저 컷 라인, 꽂이 스틱 그림자가 보이게 한다.
2) Favor label panel: 답례품 잼 라벨은 둥근 모서리 스티커, 병 라벨, 뚜껑 원형 스티커, 작은 태그까지 3가지 적용 예시로 보여준다. 라벨에는 “THANK YOU”, “딸기잼 120g”, “첫돌 답례품” 같은 실제 사용 문구가 선명하게 들어간다.
3) Place card panel: 좌석 카드는 접이식 카드와 낱장 카드가 함께 보이게 하며, “Table 03”, “할머니 자리”, “Guest Card” 등 파티 현장에서 쓰이는 정보가 자연스럽게 배치된다.
4) Backdrop panel: 포토존 백드롭은 축소된 디자인 보드처럼 보이게 하되, 실물 배너 느낌을 위해 천의 미세한 주름, 상단 봉집, 고정 클립, 풍선 장식의 일부를 포함한다.
5) Typography layer: {타이포} 스타일을 적용해 메인 이름은 우아한 한글 명조, 보조 문구는 둥근 산세리프, 영문 축하 문구는 손글씨체로 구성한다. 작은 정보 텍스트는 실제 인쇄 가능한 크기와 간격으로 정리한다.
6) Palette application: {컬러팔레트}를 메인 70%, 보조 20%, 포인트 10% 비율로 분배하고, 금박 포인트와 파스텔 음영을 패널마다 반복해 세트감을 만든다.
7) Mockup realism: 종이 결, 잉크 농도 차이, 스티커의 반광 코팅, 병 유리의 반사, 리본 섬유감, 미세한 먼지와 손으로 놓은 듯한 각도 차이를 넣어 실제 촬영된 정물 사진처럼 만든다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 본문과 정보 텍스트는 Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR Regular 24–34px, 메인 타이틀은 한글 명조 계열 SemiBold 44–64px, 영문 보조 문구는 손글씨체 28–36px.
- Color palette: {컬러팔레트}를 기준으로 크림 #F6EEDF, 파스텔 핑크 #F5C7D0, 샴페인 골드 #C8A96A, 웜 그레이 #B9B0A6, 소프트 코랄 #EFA9A8을 함께 사용한다.
- Print finish: 메인 이름과 작은 별 장식에는 subtle gold foil effect, 라벨 표면에는 satin sticker coating, 좌석 카드에는 300gsm textured paper 느낌을 적용한다.
- Border/shadow: 각 패널은 2–4px의 얇은 인쇄 경계선, 8px y-offset, 18px blur, 12% opacity의 소프트 섀도우로 실제 종이 목업처럼 분리한다.
- Decorative system: 리본, 컨페티, 말린 꽃, 스티커 샘플, 작은 케이크 크림 자국 같은 파티 준비 소품을 색상 규칙에 맞춰 배치해 생활감 있는 촬영 컷으로 만든다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm flat lay product photography, f/5.6, top-down with slight angle on hero props, high-resolution editorial mockup.
- Lighting: 북서쪽 창가에서 들어오는 부드러운 자연광, 약한 반사광을 오른쪽에 추가해 종이 질감과 인쇄면, 유리병 반사를 선명하게 드러낸다.
- Color grade: warm cream + pastel pink + muted gold, with gentle contrast and low saturation to match a premium celebration stationery editorial.
- Surface detail: matte paper grain, linen textile weave, satin sticker reflection, delicate foil highlights, soft contact shadows.

[6. MOOD]
돌잔치 디자인 매거진 무드 — 따뜻한 가족 행사 준비 장면과 프리미엄 스테이셔너리 브랜드 룩북이 섞인 정갈한 스튜디오 스프레드 느낌. 사랑스럽고 포근하지만 실제 인쇄 샘플처럼 디테일이 풍부해야 한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: "{아이이름}", "{생일문구}", "{행사날짜}".
- 메인 토퍼와 포토존 백드롭에는 “이서아”, “첫 번째 생일”, “2026.04.29”가 깨짐 없이 선명하게 보여야 한다.
- 답례품 라벨에는 “첫돌 답례품”, “딸기잼 120g”, “고마운 마음을 담았어요”가 자연스럽게 인쇄되어야 한다.
- 좌석 카드에는 “Table 03”, “할머니 자리”, “오늘 함께해 주셔서 감사합니다”가 읽히도록 배치한다.
- 4종 굿즈는 케이크 토퍼 / 답례품 라벨 / 좌석 카드 / 포토존 백드롭으로 명확히 구분되어야 하며, 각 아이템이 실제 제작 가능한 인쇄물처럼 보여야 한다.
- 모든 한글 문자는 깨짐 없이 정상 표기되어야 하며, 날짜 표기는 지정된 형식을 유지해야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters, mojibake, misspelled required Korean text
- Celebrity composites or real-person likeness swaps

studio:prompts3:ours-449.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean preschool and lower-elementary workbook page for 한글, numbers, English alphabet, or early math/time practice, formatted as a realistic A4 portrait learning sheet. Designed for home study, classroom handouts, after-school worksheets, and early-learning workbook publishing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main worksheet page fills the full A4 portrait frame with a recognizable workbook hierarchy: series masthead, lesson title, child information line, warm-up example, main practice tasks, reward area, and footer note.
- Use {학습지 제목} as the large top title, with {워크북 호수} and {난이도 라벨} placed like a real workbook issue/lesson code.
- Use {과목·연령} as the lesson focus in the header and subject badge, making it immediately clear whether the page is 한글, 숫자, 영어, or 기초 사고력.
- Place {활동 종류} across the main practice zone as child-friendly instructions with numbered steps, small pictogram icons, and clear activity labels.
- Set {예시 문제} as the sample prompt near the exercise area, with a large dotted character or shape, guide arrows, and practice boxes.
- Include realistic workbook micro-content: {날짜칸}, {이름칸}, {페이지 표시}, {점수 스티커}, {부모님 메모}, and {큐알 안내문} in appropriate small areas.
- Add {장식 캐릭터} as a friendly illustrated companion with a speech bubble using {응원 멘트}, positioned as a helpful guide beside the learning content.
- Use {컬러 톤} for the paper tint, header band, activity dividers, tracing guidelines, icon accents, stickers, and character details.
- Keep handwriting zones large and usable, with solid/dotted guide lines, answer boxes, circle targets, maze paths, and small example illustrations arranged like a real printed workbook page.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top masthead band (top 10–12%): Display {학습지 제목} in large rounded Korean type, with {워크북 호수}, {난이도 라벨}, {날짜칸}, and {이름칸} arranged like an actual children’s workbook header. Add small subject icons such as pencil, star, apple, clock, alphabet block, or number cube.
- Subject label and lesson strip (upper-left to upper-center): Present {과목·연령} as the lesson topic line, paired with a small colored badge reading “오늘의 학습”.
- Activity instruction block (upper-middle): Show {활동 종류} as 2–3 short steps, such as “1. 소리 내어 읽기”, “2. 점선을 따라 쓰기”, “3. 알맞은 것을 동그라미 하기”, using clear rounded bullets.
- Example prompt area (middle-top): Place {예시 문제} inside a lightly tinted rounded callout box. Include one oversized dotted character/number/letter, directional arrow marks, and four blank practice boxes.
- Main practice area (middle 45–50%): Build realistic worksheet exercises: dotted tracing rows, ruled handwriting boxes, circle-choice questions, simple maze route, connect-the-dots line, or coloring target depending on {활동 종류}. Use child-scaled spacing and visible gray guide strokes.
- Mini review area (lower-middle): Add a small “스스로 확인해요” section with three checkboxes, tiny smiley icons, and a simple self-assessment line.
- Reward and teacher/parent note area (lower-right/lower-left): Add {점수 스티커}, {부모님 메모}, and a small stamp-like reward graphic that feels playful but not official.
- Decorative character corner (one side, 8–14%): Add {장식 캐릭터} with {응원 멘트} in a rounded speech bubble, secondary to the exercises but visually integrated with the workbook theme.
- Footer area (bottom 8–10%): Include {페이지 표시}, a small publisher-style learning note, {큐알 안내문}, tiny cutout-style icons, and a simple dotted completion line.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard Round or Cafe24 Ssurround for Korean headers, with bold 700–800 weight at roughly 28–40 px for titles and 18–24 px for body prompts; pair with a neat handwritten-style English font for alphabet cues or small labels.
- Color palette: Follow {컬러 톤} with cream background #F7F1E6, pastel mint #BFE3D0, peach #F7C9B6, soft yellow #F8E7A1, sky blue #BFDDF2, and charcoal #3C3C3C for readable lines and text.
- Workbook graphics: Use rounded rectangular boxes, dotted tracing strokes, light ruled lines, sticker-like stars, tiny pencil/eraser icons, child-safe pastel dividers, and soft classroom illustration details.
- Print texture: Render subtle paper grain, slight ink absorption, fine guideline strokes, and crisp black/charcoal text like a real printed worksheet scanned or photographed flat.
- Border/shadow: Use thin rounded borders with very light 10–15% opacity charcoal lines and a soft paper-edge shadow where helpful, while keeping the workbook content practical and readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Flat lay top-down document view, equivalent to a 35mm lens perspective with perfectly parallel page framing, no tilt, no dramatic depth.
- Lighting: Soft diffused studio light from above-left with even fill from the right, gentle paper shadow, crisp printed line visibility, and no glare.
- Color grade: Warm cream + pastel mint + peach + charcoal grade, with low contrast and clear educational print clarity.
- Rendering details: High-resolution A4 portrait page, sharp Korean typography, visible dotted tracing guides, realistic pastel ink, subtle paper fiber, and workbook-publishing polish.

[6. MOOD]
Korean children’s workbook editorial — warm, encouraging, classroom-friendly, and realistic like a thoughtfully designed early learning textbook page for preschool and lower elementary students.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: The following Korean strings must appear clearly and legibly on the worksheet: “새싹 한글 놀이 워크북”, “새싹한글 12호”, “쉬움 ★☆☆”, “5세 한글 자음 — 또는 6세 숫자 1~10·초1 영어 알파벳·초2 시계 보기”, “따라쓰기 + 동그라미 + 미로 — 또는 색칠하기·연결하기·문제 풀기”, “ㄱㄱㄱ — 따라 써보세요”, “날짜: 2026년 5월 1일”, “이름: __________”, “12쪽 / 32쪽”, “참 잘했어요 별 스티커 3개”, “부모님 확인: 오늘 배운 글자를 큰 소리로 읽어 보세요”, “QR로 듣기 활동 열기”, “할 수 있어요! 천천히 또박또박 써 봐요”.
- Page layout must stay worksheet-like and print-ready, with tracing lines, blank writing boxes, answer spaces, and activity labels aligned for real child use.
- The decorative animal character, stickers, icons, and footer notes should enrich the page while preserving readability of all exercises.
- All Korean text must render without broken characters, random spacing errors, or nonsensical syllable combinations.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable worksheet text
- Fake official seals, certifications, school stamps, or government approval marks
- Celebrity composites or recognizable real-person likenesses
- Heavy clutter that blocks tracing lines, writing boxes, or answer areas

args.name: 과목·연령
args.default: 5세 한글 자음 — 또는 6세 숫자 1~10·초1 영어 알파벳·초2 시계 보기

args.name: 활동 종류
args.default: 따라쓰기 + 동그라미 + 미로 — 또는 색칠하기·연결하기·문제 풀기

args.default: 부모님 확인: 오늘 배운 글자를 큰 소리로 읽어 보세요

args.name: 장식 캐릭터
args.default: 아기 동물 토끼와 곰, 작은 다람쥐 친구

args.name: 응원 멘트
args.default: 할 수 있어요! 천천히 또박또박 써 봐요

args.name: 컬러 톤
args.default: 크림 + 파스텔 민트·복숭아 + 차콜 — 따뜻한 학습지 결

studio:prompts3:ours-448.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
헬스장·요가·필라테스 회원권 광고 포스터, 인스타그램 공유용 세로형 홍보 이미지.
실제 시설 인테리어, 운동 중인 회원/트레이너, 가격·기간·혜택·예약 정보를 함께 담은 실전형 광고 레이아웃으로, 오픈 이벤트와 강사 신뢰 정보를 한눈에 읽히게 구성한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 프레임은 1024x1536 세로 포스터이며 {비율}에 맞춰 상단 18%는 강한 브랜드 헤더, 중앙 50–52%는 시설+운동 인물 메인 비주얼, 하단 30–32%는 이벤트·가격·운영 정보·예약 CTA 영역으로 나눈다.
- 메인 피사체는 프레임 중앙에 크고 선명하게 배치하고, {시설명·동네}는 상단 타이틀로, {시설 종류}는 바로 아래 보조 타이틀로, {이벤트 카피}는 시선이 가장 먼저 머무는 중단 배너로 넣는다.
- 배경은 실제 체육관/스튜디오 인테리어의 벽면, 고무 바닥, 요가 매트, 덤벨 랙, 리포머, 샌드백, 거울 반사, 창가 빛, 회원용 라커와 수건 바구니 같은 자연스러운 요소가 보이는 현실적 공간으로 처리한다.
- 정보 텍스트는 광고 포스터처럼 명확한 계층으로 배치한다: 이벤트 배너, 가격 카드, 기간/장소 라벨, 강사 소개 박스, 예약 방법, 하단 운영 정보 띠가 모두 실제 홍보물처럼 읽혀야 한다.
- 하단에는 작은 QR 예약 박스처럼 보이는 그래픽, 전화/카카오 예약 라벨, 주소 한 줄, SNS 핸들, 협찬/파트너 영역을 추가해 실제 동네 피트니스 광고의 밀도를 만든다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header: {시설명·동네}를 가장 크게 배치해 브랜드명이 즉시 읽히게 하고, 그 아래에 {시설 종류}를 한 줄 보조 타이틀로 붙인다. 헤더 한쪽에는 작은 라벨로 “OPEN WEEK”, “2026.05 MEMBERSHIP”, “선착순 50명”을 넣어 시즌 프로모션 느낌을 만든다.
2. Main visual center (mid 52%): {비주얼 결}에 맞춰 시설 인테리어와 운동 인물 컷을 결합한다. 인물은 자연스러운 운동 자세, 땀의 미세한 질감, 근육의 실제 윤곽, 손목 보호대나 운동화의 사용감이 보이도록 하며, 배경은 실제 공간 깊이가 느껴지는 실내로 유지한다.
3. Offer banner: {이벤트 카피}를 중앙 또는 우측 중단에 굵은 배너 형태로 넣고, 이벤트 숫자 “10회”, “5회”, “50%”는 가장 높은 대비와 큰 크기로 강조한다. 배너 주변에는 사선 라임 스트라이프, 원형 할인 스티커, 작은 화살표 장식, “무료 상담 예약” 칩을 더한다.
4. Price and membership cards: 하단 정보 영역에 “1개월 ₩89,000부터”, “PT 10회 ₩550,000”, “그룹 클래스 주 3회”, “체험권 1회 무료”처럼 현실적인 가격·혜택 카드 3–4개를 넣어 회원권 광고임이 즉시 보이게 한다.
5. Instructor block: 하단 중상단 또는 측면 박스에 {강사 소개}를 넣어 신뢰 정보를 전달하고, 사진이 함께 있다면 어깨 위 3/4 구도의 트레이너 프로필 컷을 자연스럽게 붙인다. 이름 크레딧처럼 “TRAINER 김도윤”, “YOGA LEAD 한서연” 같은 작은 라벨을 포함한다.
6. Event details: 이벤트 기간·시간·장소를 포스터형으로 추가한다. 예: “기간 2026.05.01–05.31”, “상담 10:00–22:00”, “장소 강남역 3번 출구 5분”, “현장 등록 시 사은품 증정”.
7. Sponsor / partner area: 최하단 또는 우하단에 “LOCAL PARTNER”, “단백질 쉐이크 바 협찬”, “체형 분석 무료 측정” 같은 작은 협찬/제휴 텍스트와 간단한 로고타입 박스를 넣되, 공식 인증처럼 보이지 않게 한다.
8. Info strip: {작은 정보}를 하단의 얇은 정보 띠에 정리하고, 영업시간·주차·샤워실·트라이얼 혜택·상담 예약·주소·SNS 핸들을 텍스트 우선으로 간결하게 배열한다.
9. Color application: {컬러 톤}을 전체 디자인의 기준으로 사용하되, 문자 가독성을 위해 헤더와 핵심 숫자는 가장 강한 대비로 처리한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for main title 70–90px, Pretendard Bold for subhead 28–38px, Pretendard Medium for info 18–24px; 숫자는 두껍고 직선적인 산세리프로 처리한다.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}을 기준으로 다크 차콜 #1F1F1F, 라임 그린 #B7E23A, 화이트 #F7F7F2 조합을 우선 사용하고, 요가·필라테스 톤일 경우 따뜻한 베이지 #E8DCCB를 보조색으로 추가한다.
- Layout texture: 사진 위에는 반투명 차콜 그라데이션, 라임 컬러 라인, 작은 체크 패턴, 운동 기록표처럼 보이는 얇은 표식, 가격 카드의 미세한 종이 질감 또는 코팅 포스터 반사감을 추가해 실제 인쇄/디지털 광고처럼 만든다.
- Border/shadow: 카드형 텍스트 박스는 1px 미세 라인과 soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity로 분리하고, 사진에는 과한 필터 없이 얇은 자연 그림자만 더한다.
- Text hierarchy: {이벤트 카피}와 숫자 혜택이 1순위, {시설명·동네}와 {시설 종류}가 2순위, 가격·기간·장소·예약 정보가 3순위로 읽히게 한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 35mm f/1.8 for interior-wide portrait framing, or 50mm f/1.4 for a tighter trainer/athlete crop; realistic commercial fitness editorial framing.
- Lighting: soft daylight from large windows at upper-left, with gentle fill from the right and subtle specular highlights on skin and equipment; practical ceiling lights and mirror reflections may appear naturally in the studio.
- Color grade: dark charcoal + lime green + clean white with slight warm-neutral skin tone, natural contrast, and realistic gym material texture.
- Detail realism: show tactile surfaces such as rubber flooring, brushed metal dumbbells, stitched yoga mats, reformer leather, chalk marks, water bottle condensation, towel texture, mirror smudges, and realistic skin highlights.

[6. MOOD]
Commercial fitness editorial — Soho House gym branding meets Yoga Alliance brochure aesthetic, with authentic Korean studio realism and a polished local membership-sale poster energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: “헬스장 PT”, “요가·필라테스·크로스핏·복싱·골프 스튜디오”, “강남 바디밸런스 짐”, “망원 요가스튜디오”, “홍대 필라테스 K”, “오픈 기념 PT 10회 → 5회 무료 + 첫달 50%”, “前 국가대표 보디빌더 / 자격증 ACE-CPT”, “영업시간 06~24 / 주차 / 샤워실 / 트라이얼 1회 무료”.
- Additional Korean promo text to render cleanly where appropriate: “OPEN WEEK”, “2026.05.01–05.31”, “선착순 50명”, “1개월 ₩89,000부터”, “무료 상담 예약”, “체험권 1회 무료”, “장소 강남역 3번 출구 5분”, “예약 @bodybalance.fit”.
- Composition invariant: all text must remain crisp and legible, the event numbers must be visually dominant, and the photo-based gym/studio realism must not be replaced by flat illustration.
- Visual authenticity: sweat, muscle definition, mats, mirrors, dumbbells, reformers, boxing bags, golf practice props, towels, bottles, shoe marks, and studio lighting should look physically plausible and non-plastic.
- Poster completeness: include visible event details, sponsor/partner area, date/time/venue, ticket or trial information, price cards, and a small reservation/QR-style block so the result feels like a finished real advertisement.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
8-panel eyeglass simulation catalog image for face-shape comparison, arranged as a 2x4 grid for easy side-by-side review.
Designed as an optical-store try-on visualization with clean editorial clarity and practical social-share readability.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the same face from {원본} across all 8 panels, with each panel keeping identical head angle, crop, expression, clothing, and background so only the eyewear changes.
- Use a strict 2x4 grid layout from {레이아웃}, with even gutters and consistent panel margins; each tile should feel like a uniform product test sheet.
- Place the Korean type label for each model directly under or over each panel in a compact, legible style; labels must correspond to {8 종류}.
- Keep the background consistent across all panels as a clean optical-shop neutral tone, with no scene change, no prop change, and no body movement.
- Apply {컬러} per frame so each frame can preview a different frame color while the rest of the portrait remains locked.
- Maintain the same face, hair, clothes, and backdrop as specified in {보존}; only the glasses frames should differ.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Overall sheet: build a 1536x1024 landscape comparison board with 8 equal portrait panels, aligned precisely in a 2x4 matrix, each tile separated by narrow clean white or very light gray gutters.
2. Per-panel portrait base: use {원본} as the source for all panels, preserving the face crop and posture exactly so the viewer can compare frame shape rather than pose.
3. Eyewear variation set: render the eight frame types from {8 종류} as distinct silhouettes across the grid, with shape differences clearly visible in lens outline, bridge, and temple thickness.
4. Color application: distribute the frame colors from {컬러} so the set feels like a real optical try-on selection, balancing dark, metallic, transparent, and tortoiseshell options across the row and column.
5. Labeling: add small Korean labels naming each frame type in a neat, structured placement tied to {레이아웃}, keeping the typography unobtrusive but readable.
6. Preservation rule: obey {보존} strictly—no background substitution, no hairstyle change, no clothing alteration, no facial retouching beyond what is needed to integrate glasses realistically.
7. Lighting consistency: match {조명} across all eight frames so reflections on lenses and frames look uniform, believable, and store-like rather than cinematic.
8. Visual finish: keep the try-on result crisp and realistic, with natural frame edges, subtle lens reflections, and no extra marketing decoration beyond the comparison layout.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to semibold weight, around 22–28px for labels; keep letter spacing tight and alignment centered.
- Color palette: optical-neutral whites, soft grays, matte black, warm tortoiseshell brown, brushed gold, and clear acetate; reference {컬러} as the actual frame palette.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px dividers or soft gutter separation, with minimal shadow only if needed, such as a 3px y-offset, 8px blur, 12% opacity.
- Layout discipline: every panel must feel mechanically aligned and evenly spaced, like a professional eyewear fitting chart.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean studio portrait look, 50mm or 85mm equivalent at f/4 to f/5.6 for a natural face shape and sharp eyewear edges.
- Lighting: soft optical-store natural light with a diffused key from upper-left at about 45°, subtle fill from front-right, and controlled reflections on the lenses.
- Color grade: neutral white balance with slight cool-gray store tone, realistic skin tones, and restrained contrast to preserve product accuracy.

[6. MOOD]
Professional optical fitting sheet — like a clean Gentle Monster / Look Optical try-on catalog page with practical showroom clarity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as the eight style labels and comparison cues indicate, with no broken Hangul.
- Verbatim Korean strings that must be preserved or rendered correctly: "라운드", "스퀘어", "오벌", "캣아이", "보스턴", "웰링턴", "얇은 메탈", "두꺼운 호른".
- Keep the same person, same framing, same clothes, same background, and same head position in all 8 panels.
- Each panel must show exactly one eyeglass style; do not duplicate or blend frame types within a single panel.
- Eyeglass integration must look physically plausible: bridge alignment, temple attachment, lens fit, and ear placement must be anatomically and optically correct.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Face shape changes, hair changes, clothing changes, or background changes
- Overdone artificial bokeh, plastic-smooth AI skin, or mismatched reflections

studio:prompts3:ours-446.content:
[추천·추정·시즌·품종·MBTI 등 결과] 결 매번 다르게 자체 생성합니다.
- 사용자 결 결과 텍스트 결 박지 마세요. AI 결 사진 결 보고 자동 작성합니다.
- 아래 옵션 (디자인 톤·색·언어·길이 등) 만 사용자가 customize 합니다.

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
7-look OOTD outfit recommendation grid, editorial lookbook layout for social sharing.
Show one consistent person across a weekly styling set with clearly differentiated outfits, realistic garment textures, accessories, and a polished Korean fashion-magazine / Instagram lookbook presentation.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: the same person occupies each panel with a full-body or polished three-quarter fashion pose, keeping face, body proportions, hairstyle, and overall setting consistent while only the clothing, shoes, bags, and styling accessories change.
- Grid structure: {레이아웃} with clear day labels; each panel has equal visual weight and reads like a weekly outfit board from a fashion platform.
- Background treatment: consistent modern studio or lifestyle showroom backdrop across all panels, such as warm off-white wall, pale wood or concrete floor, subtle floor shadows, a faint wall seam, and realistic light falloff that supports the outfits.
- Spacing and framing: frame each look clearly from head to shoes when possible, with natural fashion-catalog breathing room, visible outfit details, and consistent alignment for easy comparison.
- Editorial overlay: add a top title bar and small metadata like season, week range, handle, and style-note chips so the image feels like a real published OOTD recommendation card.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Overall grid: build a 7-look fashion recommendation board in {레이아웃}, with each outfit framed consistently and easy to scan left-to-right or top-to-bottom.
2) Subject continuity: preserve {보존} so all panels feel like the same model photographed in one session, with only styling changes per day.
3) Outfit variation: apply {7 룩} so each day reads as a distinct styling direction while staying cohesive in color harmony, silhouette balance, footwear, bags, and small accessories.
4) Seasonal adaptation: translate {시즌} into suitable fabrics, layering, and accessories, keeping the wardrobe realistic and wearable; show details like knit texture, denim grain, wool blend, cotton shirt creases, leather bag finish, socks, belt, scarf, cap, or jewelry where appropriate.
5) Labeling: place weekday tags near each panel in a clean, readable layout, using Korean weekday markers "월", "화", "수", "목", "금", "토", "일" as primary labels; add short Korean style subtitles under selected days.
6) Image source handling: use {원본} as the visual anchor for pose, identity, and proportions, then swap only the clothing elements while keeping the original pose logic intact.
7) Social card details: include a realistic header such as "WEEKLY OOTD 7 LOOKS", "VOL.247", "2026년 5월 1주", and "@daily_style.kr"; add tiny save/share/like micro icons, a page indicator such as "01 / 07", and small style tags like "출근룩", "카페룩", "데이트룩", "주말룩".
8) Item notes: near the lower part of each panel, add compact Korean notes such as "린넨 셔츠", "와이드 데님", "크롭 재킷", "니트 베스트", "슬링백", "토트백", with optional price-like text such as "₩39,000" or "₩79,000" in small type.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to semibold weight, 24–34px for weekday labels, 14–18px for secondary notes, 10–12px for metadata; clean sans-serif with tight tracking and magazine-style hierarchy.
- Color palette: neutral fashion-editorial tones derived from a lookbook aesthetic, such as off-white #F5F1EA, charcoal #222222, soft gray #D9D9D9, muted beige #CBBBA0, warm sand #D8C8AE, and accent black for labels.
- Border/shadow: subtle 1px divider lines, thin cream gutters, small rounded label chips, and soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity only if separation is needed.
- Graphic details: add tasteful editorial elements such as small numbering badges "LOOK 01" to "LOOK 07", thin rule lines, small corner captions, tiny hanger/shoe/bag pictograms, and realistic Instagram-card UI accents without overpowering the outfits.
- Clothing realism: fabric folds, seams, buttons, stitching, hems, zippers, shoe soles, bag handles, and accessory scale must look physically plausible and photographed, not flat illustration.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm or 85mm fashion portrait lens, full-frame look, f/4–f/5.6 for crisp garment detail and natural body proportions.
- Lighting: {조명}; even natural daylight, soft diffused window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from front-right to preserve fabric texture and skin tone.
- Color grade: clean lookbook grade with balanced neutrals, slightly cool whites, restrained saturation, and accurate textile color rendering; keep skin tones natural and avoid heavy cinematic tint.
- Layout ratio: compose for {비율} within 1536x1024, optimized as a wide social-sharing fashion board with all seven looks readable at thumbnail size.
- Realism cues: consistent floor contact shadows, subtle fabric wrinkles, natural hand placement, believable shoe stance, and cohesive studio perspective across all panels.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean fashion lookbook editorial — a Musinsa / 29CM style seasonal outfit board with a polished catalog feel, enriched with practical daily styling notes, realistic accessories, and a publish-ready social media card design.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following weekday and label text must appear cleanly with no broken characters: "월", "화", "수", "목", "금", "토", "일".
- Include readable Korean title or caption text such as "요일별 OOTD 코디 추천 7룩", "이번 주 뭐 입지?", "출근부터 주말까지", and compact tags like "출근룩", "꾸안꾸", "데이트룩", "주말 산책".
- Add realistic metadata text such as "VOL.247", "2026년 5월 1주", "@daily_style.kr", "SAVE THIS LOOK", and "01 / 07" without covering the model's face or key garment details.
- If weekday labels are shown in English, they must be exactly readable and aligned consistently across panels.
- Same person continuity is mandatory: face, body shape, hair, and background stay consistent; only clothes, footwear, bags, and styling accessories change.
- Each panel must show a complete, anatomically correct body presentation with natural proportions, natural hands, correct shoe placement, and no duplicated limbs.
- Maintain exactly seven outfit panels corresponding to Monday through Sunday, while allowing small editorial labels, item notes, and social-card interface details around them.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-445.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {원본}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
네일 디자인 12종을 한 화면에서 비교하는 정사각 살롱 카탈로그 시뮬레이션.
네일샵 메뉴판, 인스타그램 썸네일, 시술 상담용 비교 이미지로 바로 사용할 수 있는 12컷 그리드 구성이며, 실제 살롱 카운터에 놓인 젤 네일 샘플북 한 페이지처럼 디자인명, 가격, 태그, 예약 정보가 함께 보이는 현실적인 비주얼로 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 중앙의 12개 패널에는 {원본} 손이 각 칸의 주 피사체가 되도록 배치하고, 한 컷마다 손가락 5개가 모두 안정적으로 보이게 유지한다.
- 전체 화면은 {레이아웃} 기준의 3x4 그리드 12컷으로 구성하며, 각 칸 하단에는 한글 디자인명, No.01~No.12, 간단한 가격 표기를 함께 넣는다.
- {보존} 조건을 엄격히 유지해 손의 형태, 피부 톤, 각도, 손의 크기, 손가락 간격, 손목 노출 범위는 동일하게 두고 네일 디자인만 교체한다.
- 배경은 네일샵 카탈로그 느낌의 밝은 뉴트럴 톤으로 통일하되, 실제 촬영된 살롱 메뉴판처럼 은은한 종이 질감, 유광 아크릴 트레이 반사, 작은 컬러칩 표식, 가격 마이크로 텍스트, 구분선이 자연스럽게 포함되게 한다.
- 상단에는 살롱 카탈로그 헤더를 넣어 “{살롱명}”, “젤 네일 디자인 12”, “{컬렉션명}”, “{인스타핸들}”이 보이도록 하고, 우측에는 “VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호” 같은 매거진식 작은 표기를 더한다.
- 하단 정보 바에는 {주소}, {연락처}, “예약 상담 DM”, “기본 케어 포함”, “컬러 변경 가능”, “평일 11:00–20:00” 같은 실제 매장 안내를 얇은 캡션과 아이콘으로 배치한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) 전체 프레임: 1024x1024 정사각 화면에 12개의 동일 크기 패널을 정돈된 3x4 구조로 배치한다. 상단 8~10% 영역에는 카탈로그 타이틀 바, 하단 6~8% 영역에는 매장 정보와 예약 안내가 들어간 메뉴판식 정보 바를 둔다.
2) 각 패널의 주제: 동일한 손 포즈를 유지한 채 {디자인목록}에 해당하는 네일 스타일만 바꿔 보여준다. 각 컷은 같은 촬영 거리와 같은 손 위치를 사용해 비교가 즉시 가능해야 한다.
3) 라벨 영역: 각 컷 하단에 한글 디자인명을 명확히 읽히게 넣고, 라벨 옆에는 작은 디자인 번호 “No.01”~“No.12”, 가격 표기 “₩55,000~”, “₩65,000~”, “₩75,000~”를 살롱 메뉴판처럼 배치한다. 일부 칸에는 “BEST”, “NEW”, “POPULAR”, “SEASON” 스티커 태그를 작게 붙인다.
4) 디자인별 디테일: 누드는 맑은 시럽 젤과 큐티클 라인이 보이는 자연 광택, 미러는 크롬 파우더의 금속 반사, 그라데이션은 컬러가 부드럽게 사라지는 밀도 변화, 프렌치는 균일한 스마일 라인, 체크는 얇은 라인 교차와 젤 두께, 진주는 작은 파츠의 입체 그림자, 꽃 한 송이는 손톱 중앙의 섬세한 플라워 아트, 마블은 흐르는 결, 자석은 깊은 캣아이 입자감, 별빛은 미세 글리터 반짝임, 데일리 누드핑크는 웨어러블한 반투명 핑크, 시즌은 벚꽃 또는 크리스마스 모티프가 실제 시술 가능한 스케일로 보이게 한다.
5) 현실적인 메뉴판 장치: 패널 모서리에는 작은 원형 컬러 스와치, 얇은 구분선, 라운드 스티커 태그, save/share micro icons, 하트 아이콘, “저장하고 상담하기” 같은 인스타그램 카드 요소를 아주 작게 넣는다.
6) 하단 매장 정보: 정보 바에는 “{살롱명}”, “{주소}”, “{연락처}”, “{인스타핸들}”, “기본 케어 포함”, “컬러 변경 가능”, “예약 상담 DM”을 넣고, 항목 사이에 얇은 세로 디바이더를 사용해 실제 가격표처럼 보이게 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR, regular~medium weight. 패널 라벨은 18~24px 수준, 번호와 가격은 11~15px 수준, 상단 타이틀은 34~42px bold, 보조 문구는 12~16px로 계층을 만든다.
- Color palette: soft nude beige, milky pink, warm ivory, muted gray, pearl white, subtle chrome silver, pastel accent tones from {디자인목록}.
- Panel design: 각 패널 사이에는 1~2px의 얇은 구분선 또는 8~12px 간격을 두고, 손 아래에는 10~15% opacity의 부드러운 그림자를 넣는다. 패널 배경에는 약한 살롱 테이블 질감, 아크릴 트레이의 반사, 젤 샘플북 종이 질감이 보이게 한다.
- Graphic details: 작은 컬러칩, 메뉴판식 가격 디바이더, 라운드 스티커 태그, 인스타그램 카드 느낌의 save/share micro icons, 하단 예약 CTA를 포함한다. 정보 요소는 실제 살롱 메뉴 이미지처럼 밀도 있게 배치하되 네일 디테일의 가독성을 유지한다.
- Text hierarchy: 디자인명은 가장 먼저 읽히고, 가격과 번호는 보조 정보로 보이게 한다. 상단 헤더는 브랜드 카탈로그처럼 선명하게, 하단 정보 바는 작은 영수증·예약카드 느낌으로 정돈한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame studio product shot 느낌, Canon EOS R5 with 85mm lens look, f/5.6 전후의 또렷한 디테일 중심 구도.
- Lighting: {조명}을 반영한 네일샵 톤 다운라이트 느낌의 부드러운 확산광, 상단 45°에서 내려오는 조명과 약한 보조광으로 광택을 자연스럽게 살린다. 네일 표면에는 긴 직사각형 소프트박스 하이라이트가 작게 비치고, 손가락 그림자는 같은 방향과 강도로 유지된다.
- Color grade: neutral beige + soft pink + pearl white 중심의 저채도 그레이드, 과한 채도 없이 살짝 따뜻한 상업 사진 톤.
- Realism: {비율}을 유지한 실제 손 사진 기반 합성처럼 보이게 하며, 각 패널의 피부 결, 손톱 큐티클 라인, 손등의 미세한 주름, 젤 네일 코팅 두께, 파츠의 작은 그림자가 자연스럽게 살아 있어야 한다.

[6. MOOD]
네일 살롱 카탈로그와 젤 네일 포트폴리오, 인스타그램 메뉴 카드를 합친 상업용 비교 시트 느낌. 실제 네일샵 카운터에 놓인 상담 메뉴판, 시즌 컬렉션 샘플 페이지, SNS 예약 안내 이미지가 결합된 분위기로 따뜻하고 세련되며 신뢰감 있게 보이게 한다. 작은 가격표와 매장 정보가 있어 실제로 예약 상담에 사용할 수 있는 완성도 높은 살롱 비주얼을 목표로 한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보이게 할 라벨 문자열: “누드”, “미러”, “그라데이션”, “프렌치”, “체크”, “진주”, “꽃 한 송이”, “마블”, “자석”, “별빛”, “데일리 누드핑크”, “시즌 (벚꽃·크리스마스)”.
- Additional Korean text accuracy: 상단 또는 하단에 “젤 네일 디자인 12”, “2026 봄 컬렉션”, “예약 상담 DM”, “기본 케어 포함”, “컬러 변경 가능”, “저장하고 상담하기”, “{살롱명}”, “{인스타핸들}”를 자연스럽게 넣는다.
- Menu text accuracy: 가격 예시는 “₩55,000~”, “₩65,000~”, “₩75,000~”처럼 읽히게 하고, 매장 정보로 “{주소}”, “{연락처}”를 작은 글씨로 넣는다.
- 손은 해부학적으로 자연스럽고 각 손마다 손가락 5개가 정확히 보여야 하며, 12컷 모두 동일한 손 포즈와 동일한 카메라 각도를 유지해야 한다.
- 각 패널의 네일 디자인만 바뀌고 손 형, 피부 톤, 조명 방향, 배경 톤은 변하지 않아야 한다.
- 12개 디자인은 실제 시술 가능한 네일처럼 보이게 하며, 파츠와 패턴은 손톱 크기에 맞는 스케일로 표현한다. 라벨, 번호, 가격, 태그는 실제 메뉴판처럼 읽히되 손톱 디테일을 가리지 않아야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-444.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {원본}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
K-beauty makeup before/after tutorial sheet, 4-step comparison grid for social media and beauty education.
Create a realistic, magazine-like beauty lesson card that shows the same person progressing through four makeup stages, with useful editorial details such as captions, product-zone notes, date label, handle, and save/share UI accents.
Clear, step-by-step transformation card showing only makeup changes while keeping the same face identity.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the same face across all panels with identical crop, angle, hairstyle, clothing, and background; the face should occupy about 70% of each panel for easy comparison.
- Use {레이아웃} as either a horizontal 1x4 strip or a 2x2 grid with equal panel sizes, thin separators, and clear STEP 01~04 labels.
- Keep {원본} as the base face reference and preserve facial shape, features, pose, hair, outfit, and background exactly; only makeup changes from panel to panel.
- Respect {보존}: maintain the same identity, expression, skin details, hairline, earrings or accessories if present, outfit neckline, and studio backdrop across all four panels.
- Use {비율} to balance portrait scale, label area, and editorial information blocks so the final 1536x1024 card feels like a real K-beauty classroom handout and Instagram carousel cover.
- Background should remain neutral and consistent, using a soft studio backdrop with gentle fabric or paper-backdrop texture, realistic shadow gradients, and beauty-studio depth.
- Add a top editorial header bar with the Korean title “메이크업 비포애프터 4단계”, a small date label “2026.05 BEAUTY CLASS”, and a small handle “@kbeauty.note”.
- Add a bottom information strip with compact Korean notes, tiny save/share/comment micro icons, and a page indicator “1/4” to make the layout feel like a real social beauty tutorial card.
- Include small cosmetic swatch accents, soft peach divider tabs, and tiny product-zone callouts near each caption, without covering the face.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Panel 1: Start with bare skin and gentle enhancement; show the original face from {원본} with clean, natural complexion, visible skin texture, softly groomed brows, and no strong color cosmetics.
- Panel 2: Apply {4단계} part 1 and 2 — even out tone, add concealer, then define eyes with shadow, liner, and mascara; keep the same pose and lighting.
- Panel 3: Apply {4단계} part 3 — blush and highlight should add dimension to cheekbones, nose bridge, inner corners, and high points with visible but realistic sheen.
- Panel 4: Apply {4단계} part 4 — finish with lip tint or lipstick, making the final look the most polished and complete while still natural.
- Ensure all four panels follow the same head position, same camera distance, and same crop so the only noticeable change is the makeup progression.
- Show the full {메이크업 결} across the sequence so the finish reads clearly as K-beauty natural, glam, chic, or urban depending on the chosen style.
- Under each panel, include a short Korean caption line and a micro tip line, for example “피부결 정돈”, “눈매 또렷하게”, “생기와 윤광”, “컬러 밸런스 완성”.
- Add tiny before/after comparison ticks or progress dots between panels to reinforce the tutorial flow, with the final panel marked as “FINISH LOOK”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, bold for STEP labels, medium weight for step captions, 18–26px on the final layout, crisp and readable.
- Header typography should feel like a contemporary Korean beauty magazine or Instagram education card: bold title, smaller metadata, and compact caption hierarchy.
- Color palette: soft beige #F4EFE7, warm ivory #FFF8F1, muted peach #E7B6A8, rose beige #C98F8A, cocoa brown #5B433A, with dark charcoal text for contrast.
- Border/shadow: thin white or warm-gray dividers, subtle soft drop shadow 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity; avoid heavy vignette or harsh outline.
- Panel labels should be compact, clean, and aligned consistently; avoid decorative script that reduces readability.
- Use warm peach label chips, small cocoa-brown numbering, subtle cosmetic-swatch marks, and fine editorial rules to enrich the design while keeping the face comparison readable.
- Korean UI details may include tiny text such as “저장”, “공유”, “피부 표현 체크”, “오늘의 룩”, and “BEAUTY NOTE”.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame beauty portrait look, 85mm f/1.4 at f/4 for the face comparison; if the layout is flatter, a 50mm lens at f/5.6 with controlled perspective is acceptable.
- Lighting: {조명}; natural daylight look from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill on the opposite side, soft shadow falloff, skin texture preserved without plastic smoothing.
- Color grade: K-beauty editorial grade with warm ivory highlights, soft peach blush tones, neutral beige mids, and slightly deeper brown contrast in hair and eyes.
- Rendering should feel like a photographed beauty editorial laid out as a real social tutorial card: realistic pores, fine baby hairs, cosmetic powder texture, believable lip sheen, and accurate makeup layering.
- The design surface should have subtle paper-card realism, gentle printed-text sharpness, and slight separation between portrait panels and caption strips.

[6. MOOD]
Beauty tutorial editorial with the polished clarity of a magazine before/after spread — refined K-뷰티 demo page feel, like an in-house makeup class visual shared as a realistic Instagram carousel cover.
Warm, helpful, and trustworthy, with enough beauty-magazine detail to feel produced by a real makeup studio.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문자열:
  - STEP 01
  - STEP 02
  - STEP 03
  - STEP 04
  - 01 베이스 (톤업·컨실러)
  - 02 아이 (섀도우·라이너·마스카라)
  - 03 블러셔·하이라이트
  - 04 립 (틴트·립스틱)
  - 메이크업 비포애프터 4단계
  - 2026.05 BEAUTY CLASS
  - @kbeauty.note
  - 1/4
  - FINISH LOOK
- Keep the same face identity, same hairstyle, same outfit, same background, same crop, and same camera angle in all four panels.
- The makeup progression must be clearly sequential and readable; each step should look like a real cosmetic change, not an entirely different person.
- Skin texture should remain natural, with realistic pores and fine details; do not over-smooth the face.
- Apply {보존} consistently: facial proportions, eye spacing, nose shape, lip shape, jawline, hair volume, and outfit details must match from panel to panel.
- The final look must reflect {메이크업 결} and the selected {4단계} progression without changing the person’s age, ethnicity, or expression.
- All Korean text must be legible, correctly spelled, and placed like real printed UI/editorial typography.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-443.content:
[추천·추정·시즌·품종·MBTI 등 결과] 결 매번 다르게 자체 생성합니다.
- 사용자 결 결과 텍스트 결 박지 마세요. AI 결 사진 결 보고 자동 작성합니다.
- 아래 옵션 (디자인 톤·색·언어·길이 등) 만 사용자가 customize 합니다.

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {원본}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean fitness transformation before/after composite for social media, presented as a realistic Instagram-style wellness post with editorial detail.  
Designed to simulate a believable body-shape change while preserving identity, clothing, posture, lighting, and scene continuity.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left panel shows the BEFORE state and right panel shows the AFTER state in a clear 50/50 split, with both figures aligned to the same vertical baseline.
- Keep the subject centered within each panel, full body or half body depending on {원본}, with matching posture, camera angle, crop height, floor line, and horizon level.
- Background remains the same recognizable indoor or natural-light setting across both sides, including natural details already present in {원본} such as wall texture, mirror edge, floor grain, curtains, gym mat, doorway, or window light direction.
- Preserve {보존 요소} so the face, hair, clothing, accessories, and background read as the same person and same scene, while only the body silhouette changes according to {목표 변화}.
- Add a realistic social-media overlay frame: top-left handle "@fit.note_2026", small date/location label "2026.05.01  ·  서울", and a tiny carousel marker "1/3" near the top-right.
- Place a motivation copy card near the lower center or lower-right margin so it does not cover the torso, waistline, hips, or leg comparison. The card must include {동기부여 카피} and the exact Korean line required in [7. CRITICAL].
- Include small Instagram-style micro elements near the bottom edge: tiny save/share icons, a subtle like count line "좋아요 2,486개", and short hashtag text "#바디프로필준비 #건강한변화".
- Use {레이아웃} as the exact structural rule for panel division and alignment.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Base frame: build a realistic side-by-side comparison canvas with a thin vertical divider line between panels, equal visual weight on both sides, and a soft off-white social post border area that feels like a captured fitness influencer post.
2. Header details: add a compact top header with circular profile thumbnail placeholder, handle "@fit.note_2026", date label "2026년 5월 1일", and small location text "서울 · 자연광 기록" in Korean.
3. BEFORE panel: place {원본} on the left with original body proportions, maintaining realistic fabric tension, clothing folds, skin texture, natural limb placement, and unchanged facial expression. Add a small label near the upper-left of the panel reading "BEFORE" and a secondary Korean label "시작점".
4. AFTER panel: create the transformed body on the right using {목표 변화}, keeping the same clothing, same pose, same face, same hair, same camera perspective, and same background perspective for direct comparison. Add a small label near the upper-right of the panel reading "AFTER" and a secondary Korean label "3개월 후".
5. Measurement-style accents: include 2–3 subtle editorial detail chips around the lower third, such as "체형 변화 시뮬레이션", "꾸준함 기록", and "DAY 90", positioned away from the body outline so they do not hide the transformation.
6. Preservation pass: enforce {보존 요소} so there is no face swap feel, no hair drift, no clothing redesign, no accessory mismatch, and no background perspective shift.
7. Tone matching: apply {조명·톤} consistently across both panels, with a subtle vitality lift on the AFTER side through body shape, posture confidence, fabric fit, and micro-contrast only, not through a redesigned scene.
8. Copy treatment: add {동기부여 카피} as a compact caption card with clear typographic hierarchy, plus the exact rendered phrase "3개월 후의 나 — 시작은 오늘". Make the caption look like a real fitness progress note, not an advertisement.
9. Social footer: add a realistic bottom footer strip containing tiny Korean caption text such as "오늘의 기록을 저장해두기", hashtags, save/share micro icons, and a small page indicator "● ○ ○".
10. Aspect control: lock the composition to {비율}, ensuring the left/right split feels balanced and suitable for feed-sharing at 1536x1024.
11. Final realism check: keep the result as a believable transformation simulation with clean body edges, natural skin texture, realistic clothing deformation, preserved identity, and no glossy AI smoothing.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to semibold weight for panel labels and caption cards, with Korean text rendered sharply and naturally like a real social media graphic.
- Main labels: "BEFORE" and "AFTER" may use bold uppercase English, while supporting labels must be Korean, including "시작점", "3개월 후", "체형 변화 시뮬레이션", and "꾸준함 기록".
- Color palette: use neutral fitness-editorial tones such as off-white #F5F2EC, cool gray #D9DCE1, charcoal #2B2B2B, warm beige #E8DED0, and a soft muted blue-gray accent #7E8A97.
- Divider and cards: use a thin soft-gray divider, semi-opaque caption cards, realistic UI spacing, small rounded corners, and light shadowing that matches the natural lighting direction.
- Text scale: keep social UI text small but legible; keep the motivation copy larger than metadata but smaller than the BEFORE/AFTER labels.
- The visual should feel like a polished real wellness-progress post with believable editorial annotations, natural room details, and useful comparison context.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic smartphone-to-editorial fitness look, equivalent to a 50mm lens at f/4, straight-on framing with minimal perspective distortion.
- Lighting: matched natural window light from the front-left at about 45°, soft fill on the shadow side, no dramatic rim light, no studio hotspot.
- Color grade: natural skin tones with a slight cool-neutral fitness editorial grade, mild contrast lift, restrained saturation, and realistic texture in clothing, skin, floor, and background surfaces.
- Rendering detail: preserve the original environment’s ordinary real-life cues such as wall seams, floor texture, mirror reflections, fabric wrinkles, hair strands, shadows under feet, and phone-camera sharpness.
- Composite quality: both panels must appear captured from the same moment and same camera setup, with seamless alignment and no visible cutout artifacts.

[6. MOOD]
Instagram fitness influencer transformation post — credible wellness editorial vibe with a motivating but personal progress-record feeling, like a real before/after diary saved for followers.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as rendered text: "3개월 후의 나 — 시작은 오늘"
- Also render short Korean social details naturally: "시작점", "3개월 후", "2026년 5월 1일", "서울 · 자연광 기록", "좋아요 2,486개", "#바디프로필준비 #건강한변화".
- Keep the composition as a truthful transformation simulation: same person, same pose, same clothes, same background, only body shape changes between panels according to {목표 변화}.
- Ensure body anatomy remains realistic and proportions stay natural on both sides; no warped limbs, no asymmetrical torso distortion, no fake sticker look.
- The comparison must clearly read as BEFORE on the left and AFTER on the right without changing scene identity.
- Maintain {조명·톤}, {레이아웃}, {보존 요소}, and {비율} exactly as the governing constraints for lighting, structure, identity preservation, and aspect composition.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

자격증·시험 합격 후기 카드뉴스, 1장 요약형 SNS 인증 카드.
합격 결과, 공부 기간, 교재, 실전 팁을 한눈에 보여주는 인스타그램 공유용 정사각형 후기 디자인.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas: 1024x1024 square, editorial card-news layout with a realistic study-desk collage and social media UI details.

- Background treatment: matte white paper texture base with subtle desk grain, charcoal grid note paper, sticky memo corners, highlighter marks, small paper clips, bookmark tabs, pencil marks, and realistic study traces.
- Framing direction: slightly top-down desk layout mixed with screenshot-card collage feel, readable Korean typography, Instagram carousel cover look, and a small page indicator near the top-right or bottom-right.
- Use {시험}, {점수·기간}, {추천 교재}, {3가지 팁}, {비주얼}, {컬러 톤}, {계정명}, {발표일}, {슬라이드표기}, {CTA문구}, {해시태그} placeholders naturally throughout the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 16%): set {시험} as the main headline in a strong social-card masthead, with compact subtitle styling for “합격 후기” and a small {슬라이드표기} badge like an Instagram carousel cover.
2. Social metadata strip (under header 8%): add {계정명}, {발표일}, a tiny save/share icon row, and the hashtag line {해시태그}, styled as subtle card-news UI microcopy.
3. Result callout zone (upper-middle 17%): present {점수·기간} as a bold stat strip with boxed emphasis, checkmark icon, highlighted score chip, and a realistic “결과 확인” mockup label.
4. Central hero zone (mid 34%): build {비주얼} as a layered collage — a 합격 화면 캡처 mockup, stacked study books, handwritten notebook page, sticky memo, highlighter, pen, and small receipt-like exam date slip, arranged with crisp edges and slight overlap.
5. Study material zone (lower-middle 12%): show {추천 교재} as a neat quote-card or saved-study-note label, with a tiny bookmark tag reading “교재 기록”.
6. Tips zone (bottom 18%): lay out {3가지 팁} as three numbered bullets with clear hierarchy, each with a small icon or marker dot for quick skim reading.
7. End-card CTA detail: place {CTA문구} in the bottom footer bar with a small page indicator and “저장/공유” micro icons, making the card feel like slide 1 of a real exam-review carousel.
8. Color system: apply {컬러 톤} across headers, labels, marker strokes, tabs, badges, and divider rules, keeping the academic success tone consistent.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for main title, Pretendard SemiBold for stats, Noto Sans KR Medium for body tips; title around 54–64px, body around 24–30px on a 1024px canvas.
- Color palette: use white #FFFFFF, charcoal #2B2B2B, mustard #D9A441, muted green #5C7A5B, soft gray #E9E6DF, and a pale cream paper tint for notes and labels.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px charcoal rules, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity on hero cards, realistic paper layering, tape strips, small clipped corners, and printed-note dividers.
- Graphic details: include carousel slide badge, save/share micro icons, handwritten underline marks, checkmark sticker, dotted separators, and small date-label tags that support the study-review theme.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat lay editorial look, 35mm lens at f/5.6, top-down desk composition with crisp focus across the scene.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at 45°, very mild fill from lower-right, paper surfaces, book edges, stationery, and mockup screens evenly exposed.
- Color grade: clean white + charcoal base with mustard and muted green accents, slightly warm neutral grade, natural paper texture, realistic printed ink, no oversaturation.

[6. MOOD]
Insta-friendly academic success editorial — study-blog collage with a Kinfolk-meets-Notion aesthetic, proud but practical, like a real saved carousel cover for exam preparation.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함:
  - 합격 후기
  - {시험}
  - 결과 {점수·기간}
  - 교재 “{추천 교재}”
  - 팁 {3가지 팁}
  - {계정명}
  - {발표일}
  - {슬라이드표기}

- Required realistic card-news details: “저장”, “공유”, “교재 기록”, “결과 확인” micro labels should appear as small readable UI or sticker text.
- Layout invariants: the card must feel like a real 합격 인증 후기 carousel cover, with readable hierarchy, authentic study objects, and clear exam-result storytelling.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean career counseling card-news poster, 9:16 editorial infographic for job introduction and study-path guidance.
Made for social sharing, with a magazine-like career guide tone inspired by Careerly / Jobplanet, enriched with realistic carousel metadata, editorial labels, and useful consulting details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Single-page vertical card-news layout with a strong title block at the top, a central career identity area, and three structured info modules stacked below.
- Main subject area should occupy about 40% of the frame, with {주제} presented as the hero focus.
- Background: warm cream paper texture with visible subtle grain, charcoal line accents, small signature-color highlights from {컬러 톤}, faint desk-document shadows, sticky-note tabs, and realistic printed-card depth.
- Add social card-news details: small handle “@career_note”, slide indicator “01 / 08”, date label “2026.05 CAREER GUIDE”, and a tiny save/share icon row near the footer.
- Include compact editorial microcopy such as “진학·직무·현직자 코멘트”, “오늘의 직업 탐색”, and a bottom CTA label “다음 장에서 체크리스트 보기”.
- Use {주제}, {3가지 핵심}, {현직자 한 줄}, {진입 경로}, {비주얼 결}, {컬러 톤}, {비율} as the editable content placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band (about 15%): bold title “진로·커리어 상담 카드뉴스” in a compact editorial masthead style, with subtitle “직업 소개 · 진학 가이드” beneath it, plus “VOL.042”, “2026년 5월호”, “01 / 08”, and @career_note aligned like a real social magazine card.
- Hero career block (about 22%): place {주제} as the biggest focal text with a representative profession visual, pairing a signature tool object, a believable work-environment photo feel, a desk snapshot or workplace crop, a small info-chart accent, and two small label tags “핵심역량” and “업무환경”.
- Middle info row (about 20%): present {3가지 핵심} as three numbered chips or mini-cards labeled “01 무슨 일을 하나”, “02 어떻게 진입”, “03 연봉·전망”, each separated by thin rules and supported by tiny pictogram icons, short note lines, and a realistic annotation mark.
- Quote band (about 12%): display {현직자 한 줄} as a highlighted quotation strip with quotation marks, a small speaker-label treatment “현직자 한 줄”, a tiny profile-dot avatar, and a date stamp “인터뷰 2026.05”.
- Pathway block (about 16%): show {진입 경로} as a step-by-step pathway line or arrow flow, using short labels, simple icons, checkpoint dots, and a small side note “전공·자격·포트폴리오 확인”.
- Visual summary footer (about 15%): feature {비주얼 결} and a compact infographic-style support panel, with the palette from {컬러 톤} applied as accents, labels, chart fills, small bar meters, and a tiny legend “적성 / 준비기간 / 성장성”.
- Bottom tiny footer (about 4%): include {비율} as a discreet format note styled like a magazine metadata tag, with micro CTA “저장하고 상담 때 활용하기”, save/share/bookmark icons, and page marker “CAREER CARD NEWS”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for headers, Pretendard Medium for body labels, Noto Sans KR Regular for explanatory text, with size contrast similar to a modern career magazine spread.
- Color palette: cream, charcoal, and the profession accent colors from {컬러 톤}; use off-white #F4F0E6, deep charcoal #2B2B2B, and a restrained accent set matching the chosen career theme.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px charcoal rules, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, with card corners slightly rounded for a polished editorial infographic feel.
- Add tactile realism through paper fibers, printed ink density variation, faint registration marks, tab stickers, light under-card shadow, and small handwritten-style annotation arrows while maintaining professional readability.
- Information hierarchy must feel like a real published card-news guide: masthead, hero job title, three key points, quote, entry pathway, summary data, footer CTA.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm documentary-style editorial framing, shallow depth of field only for the subject-photo component, with overall flat infographic composition rather than a cinematic scene.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, even exposure across panels, no harsh spotlighting.
- Color grade: warm cream base with controlled charcoal contrast and selective mint/coral/navy accent treatment depending on {컬러 톤}.
- The profession visual should feel like a realistic editorial cutout or embedded photo: natural workplace textures, believable tools, documents, laptop/tablet edges, notebooks, and subtle human-scale cues appropriate to {주제}.

[6. MOOD]
Modern career-guide magazine spread — Careerly / Jobplanet editorial infographic with practical, trustworthy consulting tone, realistic printed-card texture, and social-media carousel polish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “진로·커리어 상담 카드뉴스”, “직업 소개 · 진학 가이드”, “VOL.042”, “2026년 5월호”, “01 / 08”, “@career_note”, “진학·직무·현직자 코멘트”, “오늘의 직업 탐색”, “01 무슨 일을 하나”, “02 어떻게 진입”, “03 연봉·전망”, “현직자 한 줄”, “인터뷰 2026.05”, “전공·자격·포트폴리오 확인”, “적성 / 준비기간 / 성장성”, “저장하고 상담 때 활용하기”, “다음 장에서 체크리스트 보기”, and all verbatim Korean strings inside {주제}, {3가지 핵심}, {현직자 한 줄}, {진입 경로}, {비주얼 결}, {컬러 톤}, {비율} must appear correctly.
- All text must be clean Hangul with no broken characters, no garbled spacing, and no random English substitutions.
- Keep the three-core-info structure clearly separated and easy to read at a glance.
- Preserve the vertical 1024x1536 card-news format and keep {주제} as the dominant career identity.

- Broken Korean characters
