[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
온라인 클래스 썸네일 for an education platform landing page or marketplace thumbnail. Must feel like a high-conversion course cover in the style of Inflearn, Class101, and Coloso, with realistic course-card details that would appear in a paid online class catalog.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas is a horizontal 1536x1024 marketplace thumbnail with a 16:9 safe-area reading path: large title zone on the left, instructor and learning-visual zone on the right, and a clear top/bottom information band.
- Main subject area should feature {비주얼} with a crisp, ad-like arrangement; include realistic e-learning details such as a platform badge, course category tag, lesson count, level label, price benefit chip, and short review proof.
- Place {강의명} as the primary headline, {키메시지} as the shortest possible conversion hook, and {강사명} / {강사소개} as supporting identity text.
- Add marketplace-style microcopy: {플랫폼명}, {플랫폼핸들}, {카테고리태그}, {레벨}, {수강정보}, {가격혜택}, {후기문구}, and {보조혜택} so the thumbnail feels like a real course listing rather than a sterile banner.
- Apply {컬러톤} across background, accent blocks, badges, CTA chips, chart graphics, and text highlights while keeping the hierarchy instantly readable at small marketplace sizes.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer: build a modern education-tech backdrop using the dominant tones from {컬러톤}; combine a soft gradient, faint code snippets, translucent chart grid, rounded app-card panels, and subtle paper/noise texture for realistic depth.
2. Top utility row: place a small platform pill reading {플랫폼명}, a handle label {플랫폼핸들}, and a category tag {카테고리태그}; use compact rounded chips with clear contrast.
3. Title block: set {강의명} in the largest area of the composition, bold and immediately readable, with line breaks optimized for a storefront course thumbnail.
4. Hook block: place {키메시지} near the title as a short attention-grabber, paired with a vivid accent shape and {이모지}; make it feel like view-bait for learners who want a practical result quickly.
5. Instructor identifier: show {강사명} and {강사소개} as a smaller support line, with a simple verified-style dot or profile label that looks like a platform UI element, not an official seal.
6. Visual hero area: render {비주얼} as the main visual anchor, cropped and positioned to complement the title; if the subject includes a person, keep the face natural, friendly, sharply focused, and lit like a professional course portrait.
7. Course proof strip: add compact chips for {레벨}, {수강정보}, {가격혜택}, {후기문구}, and {보조혜택}; use dividers, small icons, and short Korean labels such as “입문”, “42강”, “평점 4.9”.
8. Accent treatment: use small blocks, cursor arrows, highlighted code brackets, bar charts, line-chart strokes, and data-card graphics that echo an educational data-analysis lesson theme while remaining secondary to the headline.
9. Layout balance: create a polished platform thumbnail rhythm with strong contrast, layered cards, realistic UI details, and a clear reading path from headline to hook to instructor proof to visual hero.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: {타이포}; use Pretendard ExtraBold or a similar bold Korean sans-serif for the main headline, with clean Korean sans-serif support text, compact UI labels, and tight but readable line spacing.
- Color palette: {컬러톤} should translate into concrete tones such as deep green #124734, white #FFFFFF, near-black #101815, mint #1EC98B, and coral accent #FF6B5B; if platform-specific tones are implied, keep them crisp and saturated.
- Graphic system: use rounded rectangles, pill badges, small UI chips, chart cards, code-window frames, and CTA stickers; vary scale so the headline stays dominant and the course-card metadata feels authentic.
- Border/shadow: use subtle soft drop shadows around the main visual, text blocks, chips, and code/chart panels, about 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, to separate layers without looking heavy.
- Rendered Korean text should look typeset, not handwritten; maintain consistent baseline alignment, proper spacing around punctuation, and realistic platform-thumbnail typography.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial portrait feel shot on an 85mm f/1.4 for the instructor visual, or a clean studio flat-lay look if {비주얼} is object-based; keep perspective natural and thumbnail-friendly.
- Lighting: bright studio key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, with a gentle fill from the front-right and controlled shadow; if charts or code screens appear, they should be evenly lit and readable.
- Color grade: modern e-learning marketplace grade with deep green, clean white, and coral highlights; contrast should be punchy but not neon, with slight premium polish like a SaaS landing page hero.
- Texture/detail: include subtle screen glow on code panels, realistic fabric/skin detail for the instructor, clean glassy reflections on UI cards, and restrained grain so the thumbnail feels produced for a real course marketplace.

[6. MOOD]
Premium online course thumbnail — a polished marketplace cover with the clarity and trust of a Coloso feature card, the conversion focus of an Inflearn/Class101 promo, and the energetic immediacy of a high-performing YouTube learning thumbnail.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "파이썬으로 데이터 분석 시작하기", "엑셀이 답답하다면, 파이썬", "박민지", "데이터 분석가 6년차".
- 추가로 선명하게 읽혀야 하는 한국어 UI 문구: "인프런", "@data.mj", "데이터 분석 입문", "입문자 추천", "총 42강 · 6시간 20분", "첫 수강 30%", "수강생 12,804명", "평점 4.9", "실습 파일 제공".
- Layout must preserve the strong thumbnail hierarchy: one primary headline, one short hook, one instructor identity line, one proof strip, and one main visual cluster.
- If any chart, code screen, or human figure appears, keep it clean, realistic, naturally proportioned, and free of distorted hands, faces, or nonsensical interface text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Hangul glyphs
- Fake official certificates, seals, government marks, or award badges
- Celebrity composites or implying a real celebrity instructor without request
- Warped human faces, extra fingers, or physically impossible hands

studio:prompts3:ours-439.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean mathematics formula infographic for exam prep, vertical study-note poster.
Designed as a one-page 핵심 공식 정리 sheet for 수능·내신 review with dense, realistic workbook-page detail: chapter label, page number, checklist markers, small memo notes, and exam-tip annotations around the formula blocks.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main title zone at the top 14%: bold headline anchored left-of-center, with a compact subtitle line beneath it for exam-prep context; add a small page code such as “MATH NOTE VOL.247”, “2026 수능 대비”, and “p.018” in the upper corners.
- Central body takes 68% of the frame and is divided into modular study cards: 5 formula blocks, each pairing {핵심 공식 5개} with {시각화} in a consistent grid, with small numbered tabs “01–05” and tiny difficulty chips like “기본”, “빈출”, “주의”.
- {단원} is used as the section label near the title and repeated as the thematic tag on the first card header; place it in a blue capsule tag with a small chapter marker “CHAPTER”.
- {예제 한 줄} appears in a highlighted example box near the lower third, separated from the formula cards by a ruled divider and accompanied by a small “1분 확인” label.
- Background is a realistic paper-like white study sheet with subtle grain, faint grid lines, lightly printed margin guides, small binder-hole marks along the left edge, and tiny pencil-like check marks that make it feel like an actual exam prep handout.
- Keep alignment precise and symmetrical, with each card separated by 18–24 px gutters; include readable side notes, tiny arrows, underlines, circled keywords, and micro labels without damaging formula legibility.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header band: place the main study title in a wide top band, with {단원} as a smaller secondary line; use a compact roadmap-like layout that feels organized and exam-oriented. Add header metadata in Korean: “수능·내신 핵심 공식”, “오답노트 연계”, “정리일 2026.05.01”, and a small student-note label “오늘 암기 완료 □”.
2. Formula grid: render the 5 key formulas from {핵심 공식 5개} into evenly sized blocks, each block containing one large formula line, one short supporting label, and a tiny exam-use hint such as “그래프 해석”, “부호 주의”, “대입 확인”, or “기출 빈도 높음”.
3. Visual aids: add {시각화} as small schematic diagrams beside or below each formula block, using educational line art such as unit circle, triangle ratio diagram, mini coordinate graph, arrow flow, shaded interval, and small dotted construction lines.
4. Example box: place {예제 한 줄} inside a bordered callout with a light fill, positioned to stand out while following the grid rhythm; include a short answer-space line “풀이: ________” and a coral sticker-like tag “실전 체크”.
5. Footer strip: reserve a slim bottom strip for a concise summary note and study-tip styling; include “한 장에 핵심, 수식 정확”, a small QR-style placeholder block labeled “복습 링크”, “3회독 체크 □ □ □”, and tiny publisher-like credit text “Model note layout by @math_review”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Inter Bold for formulas, Noto Sans KR Medium for labels, and Noto Serif KR SemiBold for explanatory Korean text; formula text around 42–56 px, labels 22–28 px, micro metadata 12–16 px.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, charcoal #1F2937, blue accent #2563EB, coral highlight #FF6B6B, soft gray #E5E7EB, pale blue tint #EFF6FF; keep {컬러 톤} reflected through tags, dividers, and highlighted callouts.
- Border/shadow: thin 1.5 px charcoal rules, card borders in #D1D5DB, soft shadow 0 6px 18px 10% opacity for the example box and sticker tags only; add faint notebook grid rules and printed registration marks for a realistic workbook feel.
- Layout texture: include crisp diagram strokes, small dot leaders, boxed definitions, circled numbers, and subtle highlighter swipes in pale blue and coral, matching {타이포} and {비율} without changing the A4 vertical poster format.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean orthographic graphic layout, like a scanned A4 study sheet rather than a photographed scene; if a photographic reference is implied, keep it flat-lay and top-down, 50mm equivalent look.
- Lighting: even diffused studio light with paper-flat illumination, crisp legibility, and gentle realistic paper texture visible in the white areas.
- Color grade: crisp white-paper base with cool blue academic accents and a single coral emphasis, similar to a modern Korean 수능 정리집 palette; add authentic workbook-print details such as tiny page labels, fine gray ruling, and slightly varied ink density.

[6. MOOD]
Structured exam-prep infographic — a disciplined Korean study note aesthetic with the clarity of a high-end educational workbook spread, enriched by realistic annotations, exam checklist details, and compact reference-card density.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "수학 공식 인포그래픽", "수능·내신 핵심 공식", "삼각함수 기본 공식 — 또는 미분·이차함수·지수로그·확률통계", "sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 / sin(2θ) = 2sinθcosθ / cos(2θ) = cos²θ - sin²θ ...", "단위원 + 삼각형 + 그래프 — 공식별 작은 시각 자료", "\"sin30° + cos60° = ?\" 작은 예제 박스", "화이트 + 차콜 + 블루 액센트 + 한 가지 강조 (코랄) — 학습 노트 결", "굵은 영문 산세리프 (수식) + 한글 명조 (설명)", "A4 세로 1024x1536", "학습 노트 결", "수능 정리집·로드맵 톤", "한 장에 핵심, 수식 정확".
- Add realistic Korean study-sheet microtext where appropriate: "MATH NOTE VOL.247", "2026 수능 대비", "정리일 2026.05.01", "p.018", "오늘 암기 완료 □", "3회독 체크 □ □ □", "실전 체크", "1분 확인", "복습 링크", "기출 빈도 높음".
- Math notation must be rendered accurately and consistently; keep symbol spacing, superscripts, subscripts, fraction bars, parentheses, theta symbols, and degree marks clean.
- Maintain the infographic layout as a single-page vertical study sheet with 5 formula sections and one example box.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters / 한글 깨짐

studio:prompts3:ours-438.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean workbook / problem book cover for elementary, middle, or high school subjects, designed as a realistic educational publishing front cover with strong hierarchy, print-friendly readability, and believable retail-book details.
Front-cover style that feels like EBS / Megastudy study material, with a bold chapter signal, clear subject branding, bookstore-ready metadata, and practical 학습지·문제집 packaging cues.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject title area: place {과목·학년} in the upper-left or upper-center as the primary educational identifier, using a compact but prominent layout that anchors the cover immediately.
- Chapter emphasis: set {단원·주제} as the secondary headline, larger than body text but smaller than the series name, so the chapter theme is readable at a glance.
- Series branding: position {시리즈명} as a strong publisher/series mark near the top or within a header band, paired with {개정판·권호} and {출판사} so it feels like a real workbook line.
- Signature visual: integrate {대표 비주얼} as a simplified academic icon system or chapter motif, combined with a large {단원번호} numeral, equation fragments, diagram labels, answer-grid marks, and subject-specific learning cues.
- Color blocking: apply {컬러 톤} as the dominant palette across header, accents, divider lines, number blocks, tab labels, and the lower information band, while preserving a white or warm paper base.
- Retail details: include {가격}, {ISBN}, {바코드번호}, a small barcode box, QR-study label {QR라벨}, author credit {저자명}, and practical study badges such as {학습배지1}, {학습배지2}, {학습배지3}.
- Layout balance: keep the cover vertically stacked and stable, with precise print-grid alignment, realistic trim-safe spacing, and a front-facing A4 publication look suitable for school, bookstore, or online product thumbnails.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band — Place {시리즈명} in a publisher-style strip with sharp alignment; add {개정판·권호}, {출판사}, and a small level tag {학습단계} so the top reads like a real Korean study guide cover.
2. Main subject zone — Feature {과목·학년} prominently in bold Korean sans-serif, using strong contrast and compact letter spacing to create immediate academic clarity.
3. Chapter headline zone — Set {단원·주제} as the central topic statement, larger and more expressive than supporting text, but still restrained and textbook-appropriate; support it with a small subtitle {부제}.
4. Hero visual zone — Render {대표 비주얼} as a crisp, simplified educational graphic, such as geometry shapes, equations, alphabet/world-map motifs, science symbols, note cards, graph paper, answer-sheet bubbles, or labeled diagrams, integrated with a large {단원번호} chapter number treatment.
5. Number / accent system — Use a large chapter numeral block or chapter badge that visually dominates one side of the cover, paired with thin rules, boxed labels, tab dividers, small checklist icons, and geometric separators to reinforce the workbook format.
6. Feature badge area — Add three believable Korean feature callouts: {학습배지1}, {학습배지2}, {학습배지3}; arrange them as rounded stickers or rectangular textbook labels near the middle or lower third.
7. Bottom publication band — Add {저자명}, {가격}, {ISBN}, {바코드번호}, {QR라벨}, website/contact microtext {문의정보}, and a compact barcode block at the lower right; include a tiny spine-style vertical credit on the left edge reading {스파인문구}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use bold Korean sans-serif such as Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for {과목·학년} and {단원·주제}; use a large English numeral treatment only where it supports the chapter hierarchy; keep weights heavy, academic, and not playful.
- Color palette: base it on {컬러 톤}, anchored by white paper #FFFFFF or warm off-white #F7F7F2, with disciplined subject accents and secondary grays (#D9DDE3, #6B7280) for rules, metadata, and labels.
- Print details: include fine registration-like dividers, small textbook labels, QR and barcode boxes, answer-grid or note-paper micro-patterns, and realistic cover copy hierarchy, while keeping all important text legible at thumbnail scale.
- Border/shadow: use restrained print-style shading, such as a 2–4px soft shadow at 10–15% opacity under the hero graphic or chapter number; avoid glossy advertising effects and heavy gradients.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean front-facing flat graphic composition, like a professionally designed textbook cover photographed with a 50mm normal lens look, straight-on, no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: even studio lighting, soft diffused front light with no dramatic shadows, paper surface rendered uniformly and clearly.
- Color grade: textbook print palette with crisp white, subject-specific saturated accents, and controlled contrast; keep the overall tone academic, practical, and publication-ready.

[6. MOOD]
Academic workbook cover — EBS / Megastudy study guide aesthetic, Korean educational publishing design with disciplined hierarchy, credible bookstore metadata, and a focused school-exam preparation atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: {과목·학년}, {단원·주제}, {시리즈명}, {개정판·권호}, {부제}, {학습배지1}, {학습배지2}, {학습배지3}
- Rendered cover details should include Korean text such as “{학습단계}”, “{가격}”, “{ISBN}”, “{QR라벨}”, “{문의정보}”, and barcode number “{바코드번호}” in small but believable print positions.
- Layout invariant: the cover must read instantly as a Korean school workbook or problem-book front cover, with a clear title hierarchy, large chapter emphasis, academic icon graphics, retail metadata, and structured print-ready composition.
- The composition, palette, lighting style, typography weight, and overall educational mood must stay tightly aligned with the workbook-cover format.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or celebrity endorsement imagery

studio:prompts3:ours-437.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
수능·시험 디데이 카운트다운 카드용 세로형 SNS 포스터. 수험생 인스타그램 피드와 스토리 공유에 어울리는 동기부여형 학습 타이포 카드로, 달력·문제집·펜·형광펜·포스트잇이 놓인 새벽 책상 또는 도서관 정물 사진 위에 D-Day, 다짐, 진척도, 오늘 할 일을 편집형 카드뉴스처럼 구성한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 캔버스는 1024x1536 세로 비율로, 상단 18%는 디데이 헤더와 계정 정보, 중앙 40%는 핵심 다짐 문구, 하단 30%는 공부 진척도·오늘 할 일·응원 문구, 마지막 12%는 해시태그·저장/공유 마이크로 아이콘·페이지 표시·CTA로 구성.
- 배경은 짙은 네이비 무광 종이 질감과 실제 책상 사진의 나뭇결, 문제집 모서리, 접힌 달력, 펜 자국, 작은 포스트잇이 자연스럽게 보이도록 만들고, 골드 포인트와 화이트 타이포가 또렷하게 대비되도록 구성.
- 주 피사체는 책상 위 정물과 타이포 블록이 균형 있게 공존하도록 배치하고, 모든 텍스트는 중앙축 기준의 안정적인 정렬과 카드뉴스식 레이어 구조를 따른다.
- {비주얼 결}은 좌측 하단 또는 우측 가장자리에 배치해 상황감(책상/도서관/새벽 공부)을 만들고, 텍스트 영역 주변에는 라벨 스티커, 체크 박스, 형광펜 밑줄, 작은 날짜 스탬프가 함께 놓이도록 한다.
- {시험·디데이}, {다짐 한 줄}, {공부 진척도}, {오늘 할 일}, {응원 메시지}는 각각 독립된 카드형 블록으로 나눠 읽기 쉽게 계층화하고, {계정명}, {날짜·장소}, {해시태그}, {슬라이드 번호}, {CTA 문구}를 실제 SNS 카드처럼 추가한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone (0–18%): 좌측 상단에 {계정명}과 작은 프로필 점 아이콘, 우측 상단에 {날짜·장소}를 배치한다. 중앙에는 {시험·디데이}를 가장 크게 배치하고, 얇은 골드 라인, 소형 달력 아이콘, “COUNTDOWN” 라벨을 더해 카운트다운 성격을 즉시 인지하게 구성.
2. Main quote zone (18–58%): {다짐 한 줄}을 중앙에 크게 두 줄 또는 세 줄 구성으로 배치하고, 핵심 단어만 약간 더 굵게 처리한다. 문구 주변에는 형광펜 밑줄, 작은 별표 메모, 접힌 종이 그림자, 손글씨 느낌의 “오늘도 완료” 태그를 더한다.
3. Progress zone (58–76%): {공부 진척도}는 과목별 진행 바, 체크리스트, 모의고사 평균 배지로 정리하고, {목표 점수}를 작은 골드 캡슐 배지로 함께 표시한다.
4. Today checklist zone (76–86%): {오늘 할 일}을 3개 내외 체크 박스 형태로 배치하고, 한 칸은 체크 표시가 들어간 상태로 표현해 실제 공부 인증 카드처럼 보이게 한다.
5. Support / social footer zone (86–100%): {응원 메시지}를 따옴표 포함 문구로 배치하고, 하단에는 {해시태그}, 저장/공유/댓글을 연상시키는 미세 아이콘, {슬라이드 번호}, {CTA 문구}를 넣어 인스타그램 카드뉴스의 실제 게시물 느낌을 강화한다.
6. Still life / mood support layer: {비주얼 결}에 따라 달력, 책, 펜, 샤프, 형광펜, 오답노트, 스티커 메모, 커피 머그의 일부가 프레임 가장자리나 하단 테이블 위에 자연스럽게 놓이도록 하고, 그림자와 종이 두께가 보이는 현실적인 레이어감을 만든다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {시험·디데이}, Pretendard SemiBold for {다짐 한 줄}, Pretendard Medium for {공부 진척도}, {오늘 할 일}, {응원 메시지}; 숫자와 D-Day는 64–96px급, 본문은 28–40px급, 계정명·날짜·해시태그·페이지 표시는 18–26px급으로 계층을 분명히 구분.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}에 맞춰 #0B1530 dark navy, #C8A44D muted gold, #F5F1E8 off-white, #D9DEE7 cool gray, #6F7FA3 muted blue gray를 사용. 강조선과 배지는 골드, 본문은 화이트 중심, 체크리스트와 진행 바는 쿨 그레이와 골드 혼합.
- Layout details: 카드형 텍스트 블록에 6px radius, 1px subtle gold stroke, 4px y-offset / 12px blur / 18% opacity soft shadow를 적용해 인쇄물 같은 밀도를 유지. 달력 날짜 칸, 페이지 인디케이터, 얇은 구분선, 작은 스티커 태그, 필기 메모를 배치해 실제 수험생 플래너를 촬영한 듯한 디테일을 만든다.
- Social UI details: 하단에는 “저장”, “공유”, “오늘 공부 인증”을 암시하는 작은 라인 아이콘과 {슬라이드 번호}를 넣되, 실제 앱 화면 캡처가 아니라 카드 디자인 요소처럼 자연스럽게 녹인다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial tabletop still life photographed on a Canon EOS R5 full-frame camera with 50mm f/2.8 for the desk scene, or 35mm f/2.0 when slightly wider study-room context is needed; clean front-facing composition with controlled perspective and realistic paper edges.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, with a faint cooler fill from the right and gentle edge light on the pen/book spines; desk lamp glow may create a warm pool of light on the notebook, with believable shadows under paper, pens, calendar pages, and sticky notes.
- Color grade: deep navy + muted gold + warm off-white with controlled contrast, subtle filmic roll-off, slightly desaturated academic editorial tone, realistic paper grain, matte ink texture, and soft graphite/pen marks.

[6. MOOD]
Korean exam-prep editorial — 메가스터디·수만휘 계열 수험생 카드 느낌, 차분하지만 즉시 행동을 유도하는 학습 포스터 무드. 새벽 5시 책상, 도서관 열람실, 오답노트와 플래너를 꾸준히 채워가는 현실적인 수험 생활의 밀도와 긴장감을 담는다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문구 — {시험·디데이}, {다짐 한 줄}, {공부 진척도}, {오늘 할 일}, {목표 점수}, {응원 메시지}, {계정명}, {날짜·장소}, {해시태그}, {슬라이드 번호}, {CTA 문구}.
- Rendered micro text examples may include: “COUNTDOWN”, “오늘 공부 인증”, “저장해두고 매일 보기”, “D-DAY CHECK”, “오답노트 완료”, but all main Korean phrases must remain crisp and properly spaced.
- Composition must preserve a strong vertical hierarchy: header at top, quote centered, progress and checklist lower, support line and social footer at bottom, while still showing realistic desk objects, paper layers, sticker labels, and study-plan details.
- All typographic Korean characters must remain crisp and properly spaced; no broken glyphs, no mistranslation, no random English replacement of the required Korean text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications / school emblems
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable D-Day numbers
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized face mashups

studio:prompts3:ours-436.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
자동차 리뷰 매거진 스타일의 세로형 스펙 인포그래픽, 1페이지 비교표 + 시각화 중심의 SNS/블로그용 데이터 카드.
기아 EV9, 현대 IONIQ 7, 테슬라 모델 X의 제원·연비·옵션 차이를 한눈에 읽히게 정리한 IT/리뷰 톤이며, 실제 자동차 매거진의 데이터 시트처럼 발행 정보, 페이지 번호, 짧은 해설 카피, 출처 캡션까지 포함한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 상단 14~16%는 매거진 헤더 존으로 구성한다. {대상} 대형 타이틀, {비교 항목} 서브라인, 작은 이슈 라벨 “AUTO DATA SHEET VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “전기 SUV 비교 리포트”를 함께 배치한다.
- 중앙 58~62%에는 3개 차량 비교 그래프, 실제 차량 사진을 참고한 정교한 사이드 실루엣, 항목별 아이콘, 얇은 기준선, 컬러 막대그래프를 배치해 실제 리뷰 기사 데이터 페이지처럼 보이게 한다.
- 하단 18~20%에는 {강조 수치} 요약 카드, “빠른 결론” 한 줄 코멘트, {발행처} 캡션, 에디터 크레딧, 페이지 번호 “P.03”, 작은 바코드/QR 스타일 박스, SNS 저장용 핸들 “@car_data.kr”을 정렬한다.
- 전체 배경은 짙은 매트 차콜 기반에 subtle paper grain, fine halftone dots, blueprint grid lines, soft noise를 얹어 인쇄된 자동차 리뷰 페이지 같은 촉감을 만든다.
- 각 차량 영역은 동일한 폭의 3열 컬럼으로 분할하되, 컬럼마다 작은 번호 배지 “01”, “02”, “03”, 차종명, 배터리/주행거리/0-100/가격/보조금 라벨을 반복해 비교 우선순위가 분명하게 보이도록 한다.
- {대상}, {비교 항목}, {강조 수치}, {비주얼 결}, {컬러 톤}, {발행처}, {비율}을 레이아웃 변수로 사용하되, 숫자와 라벨은 실제 비교판처럼 기준선에 맞춰 정밀하게 정렬한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 15%): {대상}을 대형 타이틀로 배치하고, 그 아래에 {비교 항목}을 작은 서브라인으로 넣는다. 좌상단에는 “AUTO DATA SHEET VOL.247”, 우상단에는 “2026년 5월호”와 “ISSUE 05”를 배치한다. 제목은 좌측 정렬, 서브라인은 자간을 넓힌 산세리프 스타일로 구성하며, 헤더 하단에 얇은 레드/블루/라임 컬러 라인을 넣는다.
2. Main comparison zone (middle 40%): 3대 차량의 사이드 실루엣을 동일한 기준선 위에 놓고, 각 차량 아래에 배터리/주행거리/0-100/가격/보조금의 막대와 숫자를 대응시킨다. 각 차에는 작은 캡션 “기아 EV9”, “현대 IONIQ 7”, “테슬라 모델 X”와 트림/구동방식처럼 보이는 짧은 보조 텍스트 “롱레인지 AWD”, “패밀리 전기 SUV”, “프리미엄 3열”을 넣는다. {비주얼 결}은 차량마다 색상 포인트만 다르게 하되 전체 스타일은 통일한다.
3. Data highlight cards (middle-lower 20%): {강조 수치}를 카드형 박스로 분리해 가장 굵은 숫자가 먼저 보이도록 만들고, 작은 단위 텍스트는 2차 정보로 낮춰 계층을 분명히 한다. 카드 모서리는 12px 라운드, 얇은 구분선, 은은한 그림자를 적용한다. 카드 내부에는 “최장 주행”, “배터리 TOP”, “가격 체크”, “옵션 포인트” 같은 짧은 한국어 라벨과 작은 전기 플러그·배터리·스피드미터 아이콘을 함께 넣는다.
4. Detail table band (lower-middle 10%): 3열 컬럼 아래에 얇은 표 형태의 데이터 밴드를 추가한다. 행 라벨은 “배터리 용량”, “주행거리”, “0-100 가속”, “가격”, “보조금”으로 정렬하고, 각 셀에는 숫자와 단위를 함께 표기한다. 표 하단에는 아주 작은 주석 “제원은 공개 자료 및 예상치를 바탕으로 재구성”을 넣는다.
5. Footer strip (bottom 15%): {발행처}를 작은 캡션으로 배치하고, {비율}에 맞는 편집물 마감처럼 정리한다. 하단 좌측에는 “모터그래프 / 또는 차크닉 인스타·블로그”, 중앙에는 “저장해두고 비교하세요”, 우측에는 바코드 스타일 블록, QR 스타일 사각 패턴, “P.03 / EV SUV SPEC”를 넣어 실제 배포용 카드뉴스 페이지처럼 마감한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR 기반의 하이브리드 산세리프. 타이틀은 Bold 52~64px, 수치는 ExtraBold 40~52px, 보조 라벨은 Medium 18~24px, 캡션은 Regular 12~14px. 작은 매거진 메타 텍스트는 Condensed Sans 느낌으로 10~12px.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}을 기반으로 차콜 #1B1E23, 화이트 #F5F7FA, 브랜드 포인트 레드 #E53935, 블루 #1976D2, 라임 #AEEA00 같은 3종 포인트를 제한적으로 사용한다. 각 차량 컬럼은 서로 다른 포인트 컬러를 갖되 배경 톤은 하나로 묶는다.
- Border/shadow: 카드와 차트 요소에는 1px 라이트 그레이 라인, shadow 0px 8px 24px 12% opacity의 소프트 드롭 섀도우를 적용해 과장된 3D가 아닌 편집 그래픽 느낌을 유지한다.
- Graphic details: thin divider lines, small arrow markers, data ticks, percentage pills, mileage badges, tiny editorial footnotes, page markers, issue labels, and subtle technical diagram marks. All decorative elements must support readability and make the infographic feel like a finished automotive magazine data page.
- Vehicle rendering: 차량 실루엣은 완전한 평면 아이콘이 아니라 실제 SUV 차체 비율, 휠베이스, 루프라인, 유리 면적, 휠 아치가 느껴지는 semi-realistic editorial cutout style로 표현한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 정면이 아닌 약간의 15° 사선 뷰를 가진 자동차 리뷰 비주얼로, 35mm equivalent product/editorial framing 느낌. 그래픽 요소는 벡터 기반이지만 차체 비율은 실제 차량 사진 참고처럼 정확하게 보이게 한다.
- Lighting: 스튜디오 소프트박스 45° + 약한 림 라이트, 전체는 균일한 확산광으로 처리해 반사광이 과도하지 않게 한다.
- Color grade: dark charcoal base + crisp white data surfaces + restrained primary accents, 자동차 매거진 비교 페이지 같은 선명하고 차분한 톤.
- Surface realism: matte printed infographic paper texture, fine ink edges, subtle screen-print grain, crisp Korean typography, clean but content-rich editorial layout.

[6. MOOD]
Motorgraph / AutoView 스타일의 자동차 리뷰 편집 페이지 — 기술 정보가 먼저 읽히면서도 실제 매거진 한 면처럼 이슈 번호, 데이터 표, 요약 코멘트, 발행처 크레딧이 살아 있는 전문적인 EV SUV 비교 인포그래픽.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “기아 EV9”, “현대 IONIQ 7”, “테슬라 모델 X”, “배터리 용량”, “주행거리”, “0-100 가속”, “가격”, “보조금”, “기아 EV9: 99kWh · 501km · 6.0초 · 7,800만원”, “모터그래프 / 또는 차크닉 인스타·블로그”.
- Additional readable Korean strings to include: “AUTO DATA SHEET VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “전기 SUV 비교 리포트”, “빠른 결론”, “최장 주행”, “배터리 TOP”, “가격 체크”, “옵션 포인트”, “저장해두고 비교하세요”, “제원은 공개 자료 및 예상치를 바탕으로 재구성”.
- 한 페이지 안에서 3개 차량의 비교 구조가 동일해야 하며, 각 항목의 정렬 기준과 숫자 위치가 서로 어긋나지 않아야 한다.
- 모든 수치 텍스트는 깨지지 않은 한글과 숫자로 선명하게 읽혀야 한다.
- {대상}, {비교 항목}, {강조 수치}, {비주얼 결}, {컬러 톤}, {발행처}, {비율} placeholders must remain intact and be used as visible layout variables.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-435.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean car wash and detailing advertisement, square 1:1 promo poster for self-service, tunnel wash, and professional detailing shop promotions.
Social-media-ready commercial graphic with clear pricing callout, service menu, event date, location/contact info, and glossy vehicle hero imagery that feels like a real neighborhood car-care campaign.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero placement: a clean, polished car occupies the center 55–60% of the frame, angled slightly 3/4 so the front grille, windshield, hood, and side surfaces catch bright wash-bay highlights; if a before-after concept is used, split the frame into two equal halves with a sharp vertical divider and matching vehicle angle.
- Background treatment: deep charcoal-to-cyan wash-bay environment with wet concrete texture, drainage grates, wall tiles, hose reels, foam lance, spray mist, ceiling LED strips, service signage, and reflective floor sheen, all supporting the vehicle without overpowering it.
- Real shop-ad details: include a visible price/menu board, QR reservation box, small map-pin/address line, phone icon, operating-hours icon, loyalty stamp graphic, and compact sponsor/partner strip near the bottom edge to make the poster feel printed and commercially usable.
- Spacing and framing: build a strong top header band for {세차장 종류}, a prominent promotional badge for {이벤트 카피}, a mid-frame hero zone for {비주얼}, and a lower utility zone for {작은 정보}; use layered panels, dividers, stickers, water-drop accents, and readable mobile-first hierarchy.
- Use {세차장 종류}, {이벤트 카피}, {비주얼}, {시그니처 컬러}, {작은 정보}, {타이포}, and {비율} as the customizable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone (top 18%): place {세차장 종류} as the main service title in a bold, condensed Korean sans-serif, with a small English subline such as CAR WASH & DETAILING beneath; add thin separator rules, tiny water-drop icons, and a premium shop-code label like WASH PROMO 2026 / VOL.05.
2) Offer badge (upper-right or upper-center): render {이벤트 카피} inside a bold rounded sticker, angled coupon tab, or glossy shield-shaped badge using {시그니처 컬러}; make the price/date visually dominant, and add small supporting Korean copy such as 이번 주 한정, 사전예약 가능, 멤버십 적립.
3) Hero image zone (middle 55%): show {비주얼} with crisp reflections, visible water beads, foam trails, clean tire shine, realistic glass reflections, and strong edge separation; if it is a before-after layout, make both sides match in angle and crop, label them BEFORE / AFTER and add short Korean labels 세차 전 / 세차 후.
4) Service menu layer: add a compact realistic menu strip beside or beneath the car with multiple items and prices, for example 기본 세차 ₩12,000, 프리미엄 폼 ₩25,000, 실내 클리닝 ₩35,000, 광택 코팅 상담, using small icon bullets for exterior, interior, wheel, coating.
5) Color system and accents: apply {시그니처 컬러} across badges, lines, QR frame, small icons, highlight bars, water-drop shapes, and menu dividers; keep the vehicle body tones realistic with cool metallic contrast, charcoal shadows, white highlights, and cyan reflections from the wash environment.
6) Information strip (bottom 17%): present {작은 정보} as compact, high-contrast utility text with icons for hours, service type, address, phone, reservation, and parking; include fixed microcopy such as 매일 08:00–22:00, 예약문의 010-0000-0000, 서울시 강남구 워시로 24, QR 예약하기, 오늘 방문 시 타월 증정.
7) Typography layer: use {타이포} for the main title and price callout, with tighter tracking for the headline and smaller regular-weight text for details; combine large headline numerals, Korean subheads, micro labels, and small credit text such as photo by CLEAN BAY Studio.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the headline, Pretendard SemiBold for details, 44–64px title scale, 18–26px info scale, 11–14px microcopy, and narrow tracking for the main offer text.
- Color palette: cyan #23B7D9, white #FFFFFF, dark charcoal #1E2329, cool gray #D9E1E6, with subtle steel-blue reflections from the wash environment and {시그니처 컬러} used as the campaign accent.
- Poster graphics: use glossy coupon badges, layered rounded panels, thin white divider lines, chrome-like highlight strokes, water splash silhouettes, tiny service icons, QR code block, barcode-like reservation marker, and sponsor-logo placeholders such as LOCAL PARTNER / DETAIL SUPPLY / TIRE CARE.
- Border/shadow: use a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity under badges, menu cards, QR panel, and the hero vehicle; add crisp rounded-corner panels and reflective floor shadows for depth.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame commercial automotive shot, Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.8 for the hero car or Canon EOS R5 with 35mm f/2.8 for a clean shop poster framing; if using before-after, keep a straight-on product-ad angle with controlled perspective and minimal distortion.
- Lighting: studio softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, subtle rim light to define the car contours, ceiling LED strip reflections across the hood and windshield, plus wet-surface specular highlights on the floor and body panels.
- Texture realism: show believable soap foam, water droplets, tire gloss, wet concrete pores, drainage lines, rubber hose texture, transparent mist, glass reflections, and slight smudges on shop panels for a real operating car wash atmosphere.
- Color grade: cool cyan + white + charcoal with clean metallic highlights, slightly boosted clarity on water droplets, controlled contrast, bright readable typography, and a crisp wash-bay commercial finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium auto-service magazine ad meets local Korean shop promotion — energetic, trustworthy, glossy, and practical, like a polished car-care brochure with real service information, coupon urgency, and clean commercial presentation.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as intended in the rendered image:
  - {세차장 종류}
  - {이벤트 카피}
  - {작은 정보}
- Additional Korean poster text may include: 기본 세차 ₩12,000, 프리미엄 폼 ₩25,000, 실내 클리닝 ₩35,000, 매일 08:00–22:00, QR 예약하기, 오늘 방문 시 타월 증정, 세차 전, 세차 후.
- If the design uses a before-after comparison, both halves must be visually balanced and aligned so the same vehicle and framing logic are clear across the split.
- All text must remain crisp, correctly spelled, and fully readable with no broken Hangul characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-434.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean auto repair shop Instagram post, documentary-style daily service update card. Square social post showing intake, maintenance, and completion with a trustworthy neighborhood garage feel, including realistic Instagram UI cues, shop identity, work status tags, and everyday workshop details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Square 1:1 composition with a three-step day-in-the-shop narrative: intake vehicle at left, active repair in center, completed result at right, layered like a real workshop photo diary rather than a sterile advertisement.
- Main subject emphasis should favor the repair bay, vehicle surface details, mechanic hand work, lift arms, wheel/brake area, and service-note overlays, with {정비소명} as the contextual shop identity and {입고차} as the featured car.
- Background treatment: real garage floor, hydraulic lift structure, tool cart, torque wrench, oil pan, shop rag, tire stack, small parts tray, oil-stained concrete, muted workshop walls, taped checklist sheet, and slightly busy but organized neighborhood-shop atmosphere.
- Instagram card treatment: include top account bar with {인스타핸들}, small profile circle icon, {날짜}, {위치}, and a bottom interaction row with tiny heart/comment/share/save icons, like a real shop feed post.
- Add service-log overlays and readable labels: {상태라벨}, {접수번호}, {작업 종류}, {정비사 멘트}, {해시태그}, and {문의문구}, integrated into the photo using sticker labels, tape strips, clipboard notes, and small caption boxes.
- Use {비주얼 결} and {컬러 톤} as the overall visual direction, with the post designed to feel like an authentic local shop update from a busy repair bay.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Instagram account bar (top 8%): Place a small circular garage-profile mark, {인스타핸들}, {날짜}, and {위치}; use compact UI-like spacing, a tiny more-options dot icon, and subtle charcoal background translucency.
2. Header area (upper 13%): Set {정비소명} as the main title in a bold, compact Korean sans style, slightly left-aligned over the workshop scene with mustard underline tape or sticker accent.
3. Service line and status row (upper-mid 12%): Place {작업 종류} as a clear operational subtitle; add small pill labels reading {상태라벨} and {접수번호}, styled like shop intake tags or printed service stickers.
4. Main visual strip (center 43%): Show {입고차} in the shop environment, with three connected moments: left intake angle with visible front plate blur and checklist, center wheel/brake or engine-bay hand-tool work, right completed car lowered near the bay exit. Include functional tools and believable mechanic posture.
5. Quote and caption block (mid-lower 12%): Present {정비사 멘트} in quotation marks as a short trust-building caption, placed on a cream memo sticker, clipboard sheet, or taped workshop note with light grease smudges.
6. Instagram footer row (lower 7%): Add tiny heart/comment/share/save micro icons, a short caption beginning with {인스타핸들}, and {해시태그}; keep icons simple and realistic, not oversized.
7. Contact / CTA strip (bottom 5%): Include {문의문구} and {연락처} as a practical local-shop note, styled like a small receipt strip or service desk label.
8. Visual texture pass: Emphasize metal reflections, rubber, dust, fingerprints, mild oil stains, work gloves, scuffed lift paint, handwritten pen marks, and shop-floor grit to preserve raw garage realism.
9. Color pass: Apply {컬러 톤} consistently across signage, text accents, shadows, UI stickers, small labels, and highlight balance so the whole card reads as a single neighborhood-shop Instagram identity.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, bold for title (700–800), medium for service line (500–600), compact UI caption weight for Instagram bar and footer (400–500), with tight but readable tracking.
- Color palette: charcoal, mustard accent, warm yellow shop light, concrete gray, oil black, muted cream label paper, faded red/blue tool marks, and text highlights from {컬러 톤}.
- Overlay system: use semi-transparent charcoal panels, cream memo stickers, mustard tape strips, small service-tag pills, printed receipt-like footer, and subtle drop shadows that feel physically attached to the garage photo.
- Text hierarchy: title first, service type second, vehicle/status third, mechanic quote and hashtags smaller but readable on a 1024x1024 Instagram feed.
- Realism details: include usable tool positions, believable lift contact points, readable service labels, ordinary shop clutter, and imperfect surfaces that match a working neighborhood garage.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary shop photography look, full-frame 35mm lens at f/2.8 for the bay scene, with slightly wider 24mm framing where the lift and tools need to be included.
- Lighting: mixed natural daylight from a workshop opening plus warm fluorescent overhead shop lighting, with hard-to-soft contrast and slight side rim on the car body.
- Color grade: warm filmic garage tones, charcoal shadows, mustard highlights, slightly desaturated reds and blues, Kodak Portra-like neutrality with gritty local-shop realism.
- Composition finish: square Instagram feed crop, realistic depth of field that keeps the service story readable, textured shadows under the lift and car, and photo-card graphics blended into the scene.

[6. MOOD]
Neighborhood auto shop documentary — honest service logbook aesthetic with a local garage trust feel, like a real Instagram update from a busy repair bay. Practical, warm, slightly gritty, friendly, and credible, with the feeling of a mechanic sharing today’s completed job rather than a polished commercial campaign.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 그대로 보여야 함: {정비소명}, {인스타핸들}, {날짜}, {위치}, {작업 종류}, {입고차}, {상태라벨}, {접수번호}, {정비사 멘트}, {해시태그}, {문의문구}, {연락처}
- 반드시 인스타그램 게시물처럼 보여야 함: 상단 계정 바, 하단 하트·댓글·공유·저장 마이크로 아이콘, 짧은 캡션, 해시태그가 포함되어야 함.
- 입고 → 정비 → 완료 흐름이 한눈에 읽혀야 하며, 차량·리프트·공구·정비사 손동작이 실제 정비 과정처럼 자연스러워야 함.
- 손과 공구는 해부학적으로 정확하고 기능적으로 보여야 하며, 차량 부품과 접촉하는 위치가 설득력 있어야 함.
- 작업장 분위기는 실제 동네 정비소의 바쁜 하루처럼 보여야 하며, 기름때·먼지·메모지·공구함·서비스 태그 같은 생활감 있는 디테일을 살려야 함.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or celebrity lookalikes
- Fake government inspection marks or authority stamps

studio:prompts3:ours-433.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean mobility advertising key visual for car rental and car-sharing, square format, designed for app promotion and short-term rental conversion.
Editorial advertising layout for a realistic Korean app campaign, combining a polished hero vehicle, practical trip context, pricing emphasis, and app-download CTA details that feel like a real rental-car or car-sharing social ad.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: place the car or lifestyle hero in the central 60% of the frame, with the headline block in the upper 18% and price/supporting info anchored in the lower third.
- Background treatment: use a realistic urban-road, parking-lot pickup zone, airport curbside, or weekend travel-destination setting with visible asphalt texture, lane markings, soft building silhouettes, street signage, luggage, and app-use context; if using a car-only hero approach, make it feel like a premium showroom or roadside campaign shoot rather than a blank mockup.
- Framing direction: keep the layout ad-ready and square, with strong visual hierarchy, believable spacing between typography and vehicle, and layered real-world elements such as a phone map UI, location pin graphics, small route line, and pickup/drop-off info tags.
- Use {서비스·차종} as the featured vehicle/product spec, {키 카피} as the primary headline, {비주얼 결} as the main visual texture and finish direction, {가격 정보} as the pricing callout, {컬러 톤} as the palette direction, {작은 정보} as the utility strip, and {비율} as the composition ratio guidance.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (middle 55-60%): feature {서비스·차종} as the main focal point, parked at a slight 3/4 angle with realistic reflections, tire detail, windshield highlights, license-plate area, and subtle road contact shadow; optionally include a couple, family, or friends placing luggage near the trunk, checking a phone app, or standing beside a travel setting.
2. Headline zone (top 15-18%): place {키 카피} in a bold, highly legible Korean ad type style, with a compact sub-label such as "오늘 예약 가능", "24시간 비대면 픽업", or "주말 드라이브 특가" placed near it as a small campaign tag.
3. Pricing zone (lower middle): set {가격 정보} as a clear secondary information block, using compact line breaks and strong numeric hierarchy so the hourly and daily prices are instantly readable; add a bright pill-shaped CTA button reading "지금 예약하기" or "앱에서 바로 확인".
4. Realistic app-promo details: include a smartphone mock screen with a simple Korean map route, pickup pin, return pin, small fuel/insurance icon row, and short labels like "픽업 09:00", "반납 21:00", "보험 포함", "주행거리 확인".
5. Brand color accents: apply {컬러 톤} as the dominant accent scheme through buttons, separators, price highlights, map pins, route lines, sticker labels, and vehicle-adjacent graphic elements, while keeping white and charcoal as stabilizing neutrals.
6. Utility strip (bottom 10-12%): place {작은 정보} alongside a QR placeholder, app-download cue, small App Store / Google Play style badges, customer support line, and a tiny address-style pickup note such as "서울 주요 지점 320곳 운영" so the footer reads like a real mobility ad.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the headline, Pretendard SemiBold for pricing, and Pretendard Regular for small utility text; headline around 44-56px, pricing 28-36px, small text 18-22px.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} as the core accent, paired with white #FFFFFF, charcoal #2B2B2B, soft gray #E9E9E9, asphalt gray, glass reflections, and a muted road-neutral beige if needed.
- Graphic system: use rounded app-card panels, small icon badges, route-line illustrations, location pins, insurance/fuel icons, fine dividers, and promotional sticker shapes while keeping copy hierarchy clear and readable.
- Border/shadow: use a subtle 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12-15% opacity shadow under the car or product card, with crisp graphic edges, realistic surface contact, and no excessive glow.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end automotive advertising look, shot on a Canon EOS R5 with 50mm f/1.8 for lifestyle framing or 85mm f/1.4 for a tighter car hero; use a clean commercial perspective with controlled depth.
- Lighting: soft daylight from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from the right and a faint rim highlight to define the car body and people while preserving realistic reflections on metal, glass, tires, and road surface.
- Color grade: clean commercial grade with coral-green brand accents, white highlights, charcoal shadows, and slightly desaturated environment tones to keep the vehicle and copy dominant.
- Rendering quality: realistic Korean outdoor-ad photography mixed with polished app-ad graphic overlays; include tactile details such as luggage fabric, painted lane lines, curb texture, windshield reflections, small dust on tires, and natural clothing folds if people appear.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean mobility campaign — polished app-ad editorial with a practical weekend-trip commercial feel, like a premium automotive OOH layout adapted for social media, energetic enough for app conversion and believable enough to look like a real rental-car promotion.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and clearly in the rendered image: "주말 1박 2일, 5만원", "시간당 6,500원 / 1일 38,000원 / 보험 포함", "앱 다운로드 QR / 신규가입 1만원 크레딧".
- Additional Korean microcopy may appear as realistic ad details: "지금 예약하기", "오늘 픽업 가능", "반납 위치 선택", "서울·제주·부산 주요 지점", "주행거리 확인", "고객센터 1588-0000".
- Keep all Korean characters crisp and correctly formed; no broken syllables, swapped spacing, or mistranscribed pricing numbers.
- If people are included, keep them natural and anatomically correct, with realistic proportions, casual Korean weekend styling, clean ad-style posing, and believable interaction with the car, luggage, or smartphone.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean used-car listing detail card, square social post, dealership inventory highlight with four-view vehicle presentation, price/spec summary, dealer contact, and purchase CTA.
Designed for auto dealer catalog use, emphasizing trust, scanability, realistic marketplace information density, and a premium K-car / Encar style inventory presentation.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered square layout for {비율}: a 4-panel vehicle photo grid occupies about 58–62% of the canvas, while pricing, specs, badges, dealer info, and CTA occupy the remaining 38–42%.
- Use {사진구성} as the main visual structure: each panel should feel like a separate real listing image, with distinct exterior/interior/detail views and consistent crop scale.
- Background should be a dark charcoal base with crisp near-white information cards, graphite dividers, and one signature accent color from {컬러톤}, arranged with dealership-catalog clarity.
- Include realistic marketplace UI elements: inventory number {매물번호}, update date {등록일}, location label {위치}, dealer/contact block {딜러정보}, quick call button {연락처}, and CTA {CTA}.
- Add small but readable spec chips for {차량상태}, {가격주행}, and {핵심옵션}; use divider lines, numbered photo labels, and a small QR-style inquiry box or map-pin label for authenticity.
- Place all copy in aligned blocks with strong hierarchy, price and mileage immediately visible, and practical inventory details presented like a real dealer listing card.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header area (about 13–15%): display "중고차 매물 상세 카드" as a small category label, then show the vehicle name from {차종연식} in a bold Korean sans-serif masthead style, slightly left-aligned with a small status badge such as "실매물 확인" and the inventory number {매물번호}.
2. Main image block (about 50–55%): build a four-cut layout using {사진구성}; each cut should show a distinct angle or interior view, with thin separators, rounded card corners, tiny labels like "01 외관", "02 정면", "03 실내", "04 적재공간", and realistic dealership photo lighting.
3. Price/spec strip (about 12–14%): show {가격주행} in large, highly legible numerals and short labels; separate price, mileage, accident history, fuel/transmission with thin vertical dividers and a highlighted price tag.
4. Option and condition badges (about 9–11%): arrange {핵심옵션} and {차량상태} as pill-shaped badges or compact chips with strong contrast; include icons such as speedometer, shield, seat, camera, sunroof, and steering wheel where appropriate.
5. Dealer info footer (about 10–12%): place {딜러정보}, {위치}, {등록일}, and {연락처} in a clear info bar styled like a legitimate inventory listing; add a small QR inquiry square, map-pin marker, and CTA button {CTA}.
6. Color system: apply {컬러톤} across accent bars, price highlight, status badge, CTA button, and selected chips; keep the palette premium, modern, and consistent with a used-car marketplace.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all UI text; use Bold 700–800 for titles and price, SemiBold 600 for labels, Medium 500 for chips, Regular 400 for supporting text; title size should feel about 42–54 px in a 1024x1024 canvas.
- Color palette: use dark charcoal #1F2328, near-white #F7F7F4, cool gray #C7CCD1, slate #2D333A, and a single accent from {컬러톤}; maintain high contrast for mobile readability.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px separators, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px at 14% opacity for cards, subtle rounded corners around 10–14 px, and precise dashboard-like alignment.
- Information density: include realistic small print such as "성능점검표 확인", "보험이력 조회", "할부 상담 가능", and "방문 전 재고 확인" without making the design feel like a loud sale banner.
- UI detailing: use compact icon labels, small tab markers, inventory metadata, a phone CTA, and footer dividers to make the card feel like a working marketplace asset.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: dealership catalog photo look, 35mm full-frame lens for exteriors and 50mm for interior detail crops, f/5.6 for balanced sharpness, straight-on perspective with low distortion.
- Lighting: clean overcast daylight or controlled showroom light, soft front fill with mild side depth, controlled reflections on body panels and dashboard surfaces.
- Color grade: neutral automotive editorial grade with deep charcoal shadows, clean whites, and controlled silver/graphite highlights; keep the paint finish realistic and showroom-true.
- Image realism: exterior panels should show natural reflections, tires with believable texture, dashboard screens and leather seats with real material detail, and license plate area treated like a normal listing photo.

[6. MOOD]
Premium used-car marketplace editorial — a trustworthy K-car / Encar style listing card with realistic dealer inventory details, clear pricing, verified-looking metadata, and polished mobile commerce presentation.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "중고차 매물 상세 카드", "차종·연식", "가격·주행", "옵션", "대표 사진", "컬러 톤", "딜러 정보".
- Render the listing text clearly in Korean: "실매물 확인", "무사고", "성능점검표 확인", "보험이력 조회", "할부 상담 가능", "방문 전 재고 확인", "상담 예약", "차량 위치", "등록일", "매물번호".
- Vehicle details must reflect the provided values: {차종연식}, {가격주행}, {핵심옵션}, {차량상태}, {매물번호}, {등록일}, {위치}, {딜러정보}, {연락처}.
- Layout invariant: four vehicle views must be clearly recognizable as a 4-cut set, and all listing sections must remain separated, aligned, and readable at square social-post size.
- The design must preserve a trustworthy dealership listing feel, with price, mileage, condition, and dealer contact more prominent than decorative graphics.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites
- Any layout that obscures the price, mileage, vehicle condition, or dealer info

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean moving checklist card news, 4-step guide layout, practical life-guide social post.
Editorial infographic for renters and movers, designed to be saved, shared, and read on mobile as a realistic social carousel cover/overview card.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical card-news poster with a strong top-to-bottom reading flow; title and metadata zone at the top 14%, main checklist blocks in the middle 72%, practical tip / CTA / page indicator zone at the bottom 14%.
- Use {이사 종류} as the main audience/context cue near the header, styled as a small category pill such as “전월세 이사 가이드” or “원룸 이사 준비”.
- Background should be a warm cream-beige paper surface with subtle real paper grain, faint planner-grid texture, small tape-tab details, and soft tactile shadows that make the card feel like a photographed lifestyle magazine checklist.
- Organize the layout as four color-coded step cards, each separated by thin rules, calendar tabs, checkbox rows, and small illustrated moving icons such as boxes, key, truck, utility bill, gas valve, Wi-Fi router, and cleaning spray.
- Add realistic card-news UI details: small slide label “01/05”, page indicator dots, tiny save/share icon marks, a creator handle “@moving.note”, and a footer CTA line encouraging saving the checklist.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 14%): large title “이사 체크리스트 카드뉴스” centered or slightly left-aligned, with a short subtitle line introducing {이사 종류}; use a magazine-cover style hierarchy with small metadata such as “MOVE GUIDE · VOL.04 · 2026.05”.
- Add a top corner badge or label: “CHECKLIST”, “SAVE”, and “01/05” as small but legible editorial elements.
- Step row 1: present {단계 4종} as four stacked cards, each card showing one moving phase with a bold step label and short supporting line.
- Step card content: place {각 단계 핵심} as concise checklist-style text inside each card, paired with box/calendar/home icons, small tick boxes, priority dots, and thin dividers.
- Each step section must visually include the phase labels “D-30”, “D-7”, “D-Day”, and “D+7” in order, with one or two short Korean checklist bullets under each.
- Tip callout: highlight {실용 팁} in a rounded note box or sticky-note style accent area, visually distinct from the step cards, including the exact practical reminder “통신 이전 신청은 최소 7일 전, 도시가스는 방문 일정 잡기”.
- Visual accents: incorporate {비주얼 결} with box outlines, checklist marks, calendar sheets, mover labels, paper clips, tape strips, and simple moving-related line icons, keeping them editorial, useful, and modern.
- Footer area: include “저장해두고 이사 전날 다시 확인”, small page dots “● ○ ○ ○ ○”, handle “@moving.note”, and tiny micro text like “생활 정리 가이드 / 카드뉴스”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all body text, bold 700 for headers, medium 500 for step labels, 24–32px title feel, 16–20px body feel; keep line spacing readable and Korean punctuation crisp.
- Color palette: off-white/cream #F4F0E6, charcoal #2B2B2B, and step colors from {컬러 톤} using muted green, yellow, coral, and blue accents; avoid neon saturation.
- Border/shadow: thin 1–2px charcoal rules, soft paper-like card shadows with 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity, gentle paper grain, subtle sticker/tape shadows, and realistic printed-card contrast.
- Use small editorial dividers, dotted guide lines, checkbox squares, tab labels, and caption-style microcopy to make the infographic feel like a real saved social post rather than a blank template.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic editorial illustration rendered like a clean top-down layout, equivalent to a 35mm documentary flat lay viewpoint with no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: diffused overcast daylight feel from upper-left, with soft natural shadowing, slight paper depth, and even brightness across the page.
- Color grade: warm cream + charcoal base with muted pastel step coding, similar to a lifestyle magazine infographic palette.
- Rendering approach: realistic printed editorial card-news design with tactile paper texture, precise Korean typography, small icon illustrations, subtle ink density variation, and social carousel interface details.

[6. MOOD]
Practical lifestyle editorial — similar to 오늘의집 매거진 and 집꾸미기 guide-card aesthetics, organized like a helpful moving-day checklist page from a modern home magazine, with warm planner stationery details and save-worthy social content cues.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함 — “이사 체크리스트 카드뉴스”, “D-30”, “D-7”, “D-Day”, “D+7”, “통신 이전 신청은 최소 7일 전, 도시가스는 방문 일정 잡기”.
- Additional Korean text to render cleanly: “MOVE GUIDE · VOL.04 · 2026.05”, “01/05”, “저장해두고 이사 전날 다시 확인”, “@moving.note”.
- Layout invariants: exactly 4 step sections must be present, with clear step order from D-30 to D+7 and consistent visual treatment across all steps.
- All Korean text must be clean, legible, and correctly spaced with no broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-430.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
신축 분양 SNS 정사각 게시물, 아파트 분양 정보 카드형 홍보 디자인.
고급 분양 카탈로그와 실제 인스타그램 광고 피드가 결합된 1장 구성으로, 분양가·평형·청약 일정·대표 옵션·상담 CTA를 한눈에 읽히게 하면서도 실제 분양 홍보물처럼 세부 정보, 계정 정보, 해시태그, 마이크로 아이콘, 작은 고지 문구까지 포함한 현실적인 프리미엄 부동산 광고 이미지를 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 구도는 상단 헤더 14%, 중앙 정보·비주얼 카드 62%, 하단 상담·해시태그·CTA 24% 비율로 배치하고, {단지명·위치}가 가장 먼저 시선을 끌도록 설계한다.
- 배경은 {컬러 톤}을 반영한 딥 네이비 그라데이션 바탕에 미세한 고급지 결, 매트 코팅 질감, 은은한 건축 도면 라인 패턴, 작은 좌표 그리드, 금박 느낌의 얇은 구획선을 더해 실제 분양 브로슈어를 SNS용으로 재편집한 듯하게 만든다.
- 좌측 상단에는 SNS 계정 라벨 “{SNS계정}”과 작은 프로필 원형 아이콘을 배치하고, 우측 상단에는 “NEW SUPPLY 2026”, “모델하우스 OPEN”, “VOL.024” 배지를 함께 넣어 실제 인스타그램 광고 게시물처럼 보이게 한다.
- 핵심 시각은 {비주얼}을 기반으로 하되, 조감도 렌더, 평면도 미니 카드, 분양가 강조 박스, 청약 일정표, 옵션 아이콘, 문의 정보, QR 코드 영역, 저장/공유/댓글 tiny micro icons가 자연스럽게 함께 들어간 럭셔리 카드 형태로 구성한다.
- {비율}에 맞춰 정사각 SNS 피드 안에서 모바일 화면에서도 주요 숫자, 단지명, 분양가, 일정이 선명하게 읽히도록 글자 크기와 정보 밀도를 조절한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 14%): {단지명·위치}를 가장 크게 배치하고, 아래에 짧은 서브 라인 “신축 분양 · 선착순 상담 안내”를 넣어 분양 성격이 바로 인지되게 한다. 작은 보조 텍스트로 “{공급월} 공급 정보”, “입주예정 {입주예정일}”, “PREMIUM RESIDENCE GUIDE”, “VOL.024”를 얇은 골드/화이트 텍스트로 배치한다.
- Main hero area (center 40%): {비주얼}을 중심에 두고, 실제 아파트 조감도 렌더가 전면에 보이며 뒤쪽에는 흐릿한 도시 스카이라인, 단지 주변 녹지, 낮은 상가 라인, 하단에는 단지 배치도 느낌의 라인 드로잉이 겹쳐 보이게 한다. 우측 또는 하단에는 평면도 미니 썸네일 2개를 카드처럼 배치하고 각 썸네일에 “84A”, “99㎡”, “남향 위주”, “확장형” 같은 작은 타입 라벨을 추가한다.
- Information block 1 (upper-middle): {분양 정보}를 숫자가 먼저 읽히는 방식으로 배치하여 총 세대수, 전용면적, 분양가가 순서대로 눈에 들어오게 한다. 각 항목은 “총 세대수”, “전용면적”, “분양가” 라벨과 함께 작은 구분선, 골드 숫자 강조, 단위 표기, “VAT 포함 여부 확인” 같은 작은 현실적 주석을 포함한다.
- Price focus module: 중앙 하단 또는 우측에 {분양가강조}를 큼지막한 금박 박스로 강조하고, 옆에는 {평형타입}을 작은 칩 형태로 나열한다. “계약금 10%”, “중도금 조건 문의”, “옵션 별도” 같은 실제 분양 카드에서 보이는 보조 문구를 작은 캡션으로 넣는다.
- Information block 2 (middle-lower): {청약 일정}을 3단 분할 카드로 나누어 특별공급, 1순위, 2순위가 날짜와 함께 일목요연하게 보이게 한다. 각 카드 상단에는 작은 캘린더 아이콘, 하단에는 “접수”, “당첨자 발표”, “계약” 같은 짧은 일정 태그를 넣고, 좌우에는 얇은 골드 라인과 작은 페이지 인디케이터 “1/3 INFO”를 넣는다.
- Option strip (lower section): {대표 옵션}을 아이콘형 짧은 목록처럼 정리하고, “시스템 에어컨”, “팬트리”, “드레스룸”, “빌트인 가전”, “발코니 확장” 등 실제 분양 홍보에서 보이는 옵션 항목처럼 보이게 한다. 아이콘은 얇은 라인 스타일로 통일하고, 옵션별로 작은 체크 배지와 설명 한 줄을 더해 정보형 광고의 밀도를 만든다.
- Footer emphasis (bottom 12%): 분양가 또는 평형 핵심 숫자를 크게 한 번 더 강조해 SNS 썸네일에서도 즉시 인식되도록 한다. 하단에는 “분양문의 {문의전화}”, “{CTA문구}”, “{모델하우스주소}” 같은 현실적인 상담 정보 라인과 {QR라벨}이 적힌 작은 QR 코드 영역, 저장/공유/댓글 형태의 tiny micro icons를 넣는다.
- Social detail layer: 하단 가장자리에는 “{해시태그}”를 넣고, 옆에 “좋아요 2,486”, “저장하고 일정 확인”, “DM 상담 가능” 같은 SNS 마이크로 카피를 작게 배치한다. 최하단에는 {법적고지}를 1줄로 넣어 실제 부동산 광고의 신뢰감과 현실감을 높인다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 한글 굵은 명조 계열 중심, 본문은 Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR Regular/Medium, 숫자는 SemiBold~Bold로 대비를 준다. 헤더는 28~36px급, 핵심 가격은 38~48px급, 본문은 16~20px급, 보조 문구와 SNS 라벨은 10~14px급으로 세밀하게 구성한다.
- Color palette: 딥 네이비 #0B1630, 골드 #C8A45D, 화이트 #F7F7F3, 쿨 그레이 #D7DCE3, 차콜 #1F2430, 작은 CTA 포인트 컬러로 샴페인 베이지 #E7D4A1. {컬러 톤}이 지정하는 분위기를 우선 반영하되, 프리미엄 부동산 광고의 네이비·골드 대비를 유지한다.
- Border/shadow: 카드 가장자리는 얇은 골드 라인 1.5px, 정보 패널에는 소프트 섀도우 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.14)를 사용한다. 평면도 썸네일, 일정 카드, 가격 박스에는 살짝 들어간 종이 카드 레이어와 미세한 금박 테두리 느낌을 주어 실제 브로슈어를 촬영한 듯한 깊이를 만든다.
- Graphic elements: 얇은 도면 그리드, 위치 핀 아이콘, 캘린더 아이콘, 전화 아이콘, 층수 라인, 작은 분양 배너, 저장/공유/댓글 micro icons, QR 박스, 금박 느낌의 섹션 라벨, 평형 타입 칩, 상담 버튼을 추가해 정보형 SNS 광고의 현실감을 높인다.
- Text hierarchy: 단지명, 분양가, 평형, 청약일정, 옵션, 문의처, 해시태그 순서로 시선이 흐르도록 하며, 각 정보 블록은 서로 다른 배경 톤과 라벨 컬러로 구분한다. 모든 숫자 정보는 단위가 함께 보이고, 주요 문구는 모바일 화면에서도 판독 가능해야 한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: architectural advertising render 느낌의 24mm wide-angle flat layout, 제품/브로슈어 합성처럼 정밀한 원근감.
- Lighting: studio-grade even lighting with subtle top-left key light and controlled front fill, 텍스트 가독성을 우선하면서 골드 라인, 카드 모서리, QR 박스, 금박 배지에 은은한 하이라이트가 보이게 한다.
- Color grade: deep navy + warm gold + clean white with a premium brochure finish, 채도는 낮추고 금속성 골드만 선명하게 유지한다.
- Material realism: 매트한 고급지 표면, 얇은 금박 인쇄, 살짝 눌린 카드 레이어, 미세한 인쇄 질감, 고급 분양 안내 책자를 정사각 SNS 피드로 재구성한 듯한 완성도.

[6. MOOD]
Luxury apartment sales brochure editorial — premium real-estate advertisement aesthetic, 실제 분양 상담 배너와 인스타그램 홍보 카드가 결합된 신뢰감 있는 분위기. 고급스럽지만 정보가 풍부하고, 방문 예약을 유도하는 실전형 부동산 SNS 광고 무드.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 한다.
  - {단지명·위치}
  - {분양 정보}
  - {청약 일정}
  - {대표 옵션}
  - 신축 분양
  - {문의전화}
- Additional Korean microcopy should be legible and realistic: “모델하우스 OPEN”, “분양문의 {문의전화}”, “{CTA문구}”, “{해시태그}”, “저장하고 일정 확인”.
- Layout invariants: 분양가, 옵션, 평형 정보는 각각 분리된 블록에서 읽혀야 하며, 숫자 정보가 서로 겹치지 않아야 한다.
- “조감도 렌더 + 평면도 미니 + 분양가 큼지막 텍스트”의 3요소가 모두 한 화면 안에서 인지 가능해야 한다.
- The final image must feel like a real premium real-estate SNS advertisement, with handle, hashtags, contact line, QR area, tiny save/share/comment icons, legal notice, and brochure-style information density.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or misleading endorsement faces

studio:prompts3:ours-429.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Neighborhood introduction card-news cover/post for local infrastructure, transit, and dining highlights.
Magazine-guidebook style neighborhood explainer graphic for blog or real-estate social media, designed to feel like a curated local living guide and the first slide of a shareable card-news series.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Square 1:1 layout matching {비율}, with a central map-based hero composition occupying about 55% of the frame and an editorial information grid around it.
- Main title zone at the top 15% in bold Korean headline type; {동네} is the primary subject and should read as the location focus.
- Use {비주얼} as the core visual system: place the map illustration or photo collage in the center, with pin markers, tiny landmark photo tiles, transit route lines, station icons, park labels, and small street-name chips arranged like a real local guide.
- Add card-news metadata: {슬라이드번호}, {페이지표시}, {발행일}, and {해시태그} should appear as small but readable editorial labels near the header/footer.
- Secondary text blocks for {포인트목록} and {맛집추천} should sit in clear callout boxes with numbered chips, mini icons, short captions, and a practical local-guide rhythm suitable for mobile viewing.
- Background should feel like a printed guidebook page: warm paper texture, subtle grain, lightly visible fold/print registration details, and real editorial card components rather than a blank poster.
- Footer area should include {발행처}, {연락처}, small save/share micro icons, and the end-card CTA {CTA문구}, aligned like a polished Instagram carousel cover.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band: set a compact Korean headline featuring {동네}, with strong hierarchy and clear spacing, like a magazine section opener. Include a small kicker such as “우리 동네 생활 가이드” and a guide issue label using {발행일}.
- Main hero area: build the map illustration or collage from {비주얼} in the center, with crisp pin icons, subway/bus symbols, thin route lines, small photo or landmark panels, and caption labels such as “도보권”, “공원”, “업무지구”, “맛집”.
- Nearby highlights area: place {포인트목록} as five clearly numbered micro-cards or bullets, each with short line breaks, icon markers, and practical labels like 거리·생활·교육·공원·교통, arranged to one side or below the hero depending on balance.
- Food recommendation area: present {맛집추천} in a warmer highlighted callout box with tiny menu-tag graphics, rating-style dots, opening-hour style snippets, and a “오늘의 동네 픽” label so the dining picks feel realistic.
- Card-news navigation: show {슬라이드번호} as a small badge near the top corner, {페이지표시} near the bottom edge, and micro UI marks for 저장/공유/넘기기 so it clearly reads as a carousel cover.
- Publisher/footer area: render {발행처} as a small byline-style footer paired with {연락처}, {해시태그}, and {CTA문구}; use a thin divider line and compact metadata styling.
- Overall frame: maintain a calm, organized grid with consistent padding, aligned edges, readable labels, and enough active detail—pins, captions, chips, icons, and local snippets—to feel like a real neighborhood guide card.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the main title, Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Medium for section labels, and Pretendard Regular for body copy; title around 54–68px feel, body around 24–30px feel, metadata around 18–22px feel.
- Color palette: cream beige, sage green, charcoal, and muted warm gray; prioritize the provided {컬러톤} with paper-like off-white backgrounds and dark readable text.
- Border/shadow: use thin charcoal rules, soft 4px y-offset drop shadows with 12px blur at 15% opacity for cards, and lightly rounded rectangles rather than heavy neumorphism.
- Graphic accents: use small map pins, route lines, subway dots, neighborhood label chips, page indicator marks, save/share icons, tiny photo captions, and guidebook-style stickers such as “도보 5분”, “주말 산책”, “점심 추천”.
- Information density should feel like a real Korean card-news cover: readable at mobile size, but with enough local metadata, labels, and editorial details to avoid looking empty.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: if using photos, treat them like a curated editorial collage shot with 35mm documentary framing and a 50mm detail crop for inserts; if fully illustrated, emulate a clean flat-lay layout with precise overhead composition.
- Lighting: soft overcast daylight look, diffused from upper-left, with gentle ambient fill and matte paper highlights suitable for a printed guidebook aesthetic.
- Color grade: warm cream + sage + charcoal with slightly muted saturation, similar to a contemporary Seoul lifestyle magazine and urban guidebook spread.

[6. MOOD]
A curated neighborhood guidebook spread with the practical clarity of Urbanplay / Nowplay editorial design and the calm confidence of a premium local-living brochure; friendly, useful, locally informed, and believable as the cover slide of a Korean Instagram carousel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as intended in the rendered image:
  - {동네}
  - {포인트목록}
  - {맛집추천}
  - {발행처}
  - {발행일}
  - {슬라이드번호}
  - {페이지표시}
  - {CTA문구}
  - {해시태그}
- Also render small Korean UI labels such as “저장”, “공유”, “다음”, “우리 동네 생활 가이드”, and “오늘의 동네 픽” clearly and naturally.
- Keep all labels clean, readable, and evenly spaced; no broken Korean characters.
- Maintain the card-news layout as a square, with map/points/food/publisher/page-navigation hierarchy preserved and visually balanced.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or misleading public-figure likenesses

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean real-estate market comparison infographic, single-page vertical editorial layout for apartment complex / district / unit-size price comparison.
Designed as a realistic data-report social graphic with clear hierarchy, readable tables, chart-driven credibility, issue metadata, source labeling, and finance-magazine details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Tall portrait poster with a top header occupying about 14% of the frame, main comparison table at center 46%, chart strip and insight block at lower 28%, and source footer at the bottom 6%.
- White report-paper background with subtle paper grain, charcoal text blocks, light gray table cells, small metadata labels, and three color-coded accents for each comparison target; use natural editorial density so the page feels like a real property-market brief.
- Keep the layout strict and grid-based, with thin dividers, aligned columns, compact callout labels, small footnotes, and finance-report micro text; use {비교 대상}, {시세 정보}, {6개월 추이}, {인사이트}, {발행처}, {컬러 톤} as editable content variables.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 14%): Set the main title as a bold Korean masthead: "부동산 시세 인포그래픽". Add a smaller subtitle describing the comparison scope for {비교 대상}. Include realistic report metadata such as "MARKET SNAPSHOT", "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", "자료 기준일 2026.05.01", and a small right-aligned report code "APT-PRICE INDEX" with thin rules beneath the header.
- Comparison table area (middle 46%): Present {시세 정보} in a clean 3-column or 3-row grid depending on the comparison type; each item should have a distinct colored tag, large numeric emphasis, and smaller unit labels for 매매·전세·월세. Add realistic table headers such as "비교 대상", "전용면적", "매매가", "전세가", "월세", "평당가", "거래량", "전월 대비" and include small inline badges like "상승", "보합", "하락" where relevant.
- Add a compact left-side or top-of-table legend explaining the color codes, for example "A 단지", "B 구", "C 평형"; include tiny apartment-building icons, district markers, or map-pin pictograms in a subtle finance-report style.
- Trend chart strip (lower-middle 14%): Render {6개월 추이} as a compact line chart with clear axis labels, matching color lines for each target, grid ticks, month labels "12월, 1월, 2월, 3월, 4월, 5월", and percentage annotations placed close to the line endpoints. Include a small chart caption: "6개월 추이 · 실거래가 기준".
- Insight block (lower 14%): Place {인사이트} in a highlighted note box with a light tinted background, a thin border, and a short editorial-style callout treatment. Add a label chip "인사이트" and concise Korean supporting bullets such as "거래량 회복 구간", "전세가율 확인 필요", "평형별 가격차 확대" while keeping the placeholder insight as the main text.
- Footer/source area (bottom 6%): Show {발행처} as a concise source line with a small separator, page number "PAGE 01", section marker "REAL ESTATE DATA", tiny barcode-style block, and disclaimer-style microcopy "단위: 원 / 기준: 전용면적" so the attribution looks like a trusted finance-magazine footer.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard for all Korean UI text and 숫자 labels, with bold 700–800 weight for headers and 400–500 weight for explanatory text; size hierarchy should be strong and compact, with headline around 56–68px equivalent and body around 24–30px equivalent.
- Color palette: Base on white #FFFFFF, charcoal #222222, cool gray #6B7280, and three comparison accents such as blue #3B82F6, green #10B981, and orange #F59E0B; incorporate {컬러 톤} as the overall accent direction while maintaining a finance-like editorial palette.
- Border/shadow: Use thin 1px dividers in #E5E7EB, soft card shadows at 0px 6px 18px with 10–12% opacity, squared or slightly rounded corners, and subtle report-card layering for table panels, chart panels, labels, and footnotes.
- Add realistic micro-details: small index labels, table row numbers, tiny info icons, source notes, a barcode area, section tabs, and light gray background grid fragments that support the data without reducing legibility.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Flat infographic layout, top-down editorial design feel inspired by a 50mm standard-documentation aesthetic rather than a photographic scene; no perspective distortion, all text and chart geometry must remain orthographic and crisp.
- Lighting: Even studio-like illumination with high legibility and uniform brightness across the entire canvas, as if scanned from a premium printed property-market report.
- Color grade: Neutral white + charcoal base with disciplined blue/green/orange coding, similar to a Bloomberg-style property data sheet or a Korean real-estate market report card, enriched with realistic magazine-report metadata and compact analytical annotations.

[6. MOOD]
Trusted, analytical real-estate market report — KB부동산 / 직방 style editorial data page with a magazine-grade finance infographic feel, detailed enough to look like a published monthly market snapshot rather than a plain template.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문자열: "부동산 시세 인포그래픽", "비교 대상", "시세 정보", "6개월 추이", "인사이트", "발행처".
- Also render realistic Korean report text clearly where used: "2026년 5월호", "자료 기준일 2026.05.01", "매매가", "전세가", "월세", "평당가", "거래량", "전월 대비", "실거래가 기준", "단위: 원".
- Keep all Korean characters crisp and unbroken; numbers, percentages, currency units, district names, month labels, and table headers must remain fully legible and aligned to the grid.
- The comparison table, line chart, insight note, barcode area, metadata labels, and source footer must all fit on one page with no overlaps and consistent column alignment.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean real-estate listing detail card, square social-media/portal-friendly layout, designed for apartment, villa, officetel, or retail property sales.
Professional property info card with realistic photo collage, concise selling points, listing metadata, agency contact details, and portal-style trust cues in a polished editorial format.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main layout: square property listing card with a strong top visual area, thumbnail strip, and structured information blocks below, balancing {대표 사진} with readable property text and practical buying/renting details.
- Subject placement: {대표 사진} occupies the upper 50–56% of the frame as the visual anchor; include one large hero photo plus 2–3 smaller photo thumbnails along the lower edge of the photo zone showing interior detail, building exterior, lobby, balcony view, floor-plan crop, or nearby street context.
- Background treatment: matte off-white paper-like base with subtle warm beige tint, very light gray section dividers, small label chips, map-pin icon area, and realistic portal-card UI details.
- Spacing and framing: premium real-estate portal alignment with clear hierarchy; text blocks remain left-aligned, but enrich the card with listing ID, registration date, room/floor/parking facts, nearby transit tag, small map preview, contact CTA, and agency footer.
- Use {매물 종류·동네}, {가격·면적}, {포인트}, {에이전트 정보}, {컬러 톤}, {비율} as configurable content placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero image zone (top half): {대표 사진} presented as a crisp real-estate collage or single hero image, with clean edges and subtle shadow separation from the background; add small overlay chips such as "추천매물", "실사진", "확인매물", and a compact photo count label like "사진 12".
2. Photo detail strip: under or overlaid on the hero zone, include 2–3 small rectangular thumbnails with tiny captions such as "거실", "주방", "외관", "위치" to make the card feel like a real portal listing preview.
3. Title line: show {매물 종류·동네} prominently near the upper text zone, using a bold modern Korean sans-serif treatment with strong visual weight; add a small map-pin label line such as "서울 주요 생활권 · 도보권 인프라".
4. Price and size block: place {가격·면적} directly beneath the title in a slightly smaller but still highly legible hierarchy, using compact separators and supporting labels such as "매매가", "공급/전용", "관리비 별도", "즉시 상담 가능".
5. Property facts grid: include realistic compact info cells with short Korean labels, for example "방 3", "욕실 2", "층수 12/18층", "주차 1대", "남향", "입주 협의", styled as portal-style rounded chips or bordered cells.
6. Selling points row: display {포인트} as short, concise bullet-like phrases or slash-separated tags, arranged in one or two tight lines for scanability; support it with extra feature chips such as "역세권", "신축급", "학군", "생활편의" when appropriate to the property mood.
7. Mini location / note block: add a small simplified map preview, subway-line dot, or neighborhood marker with readable micro-copy such as "도보 5분 생활권", "마트·공원 인접", "현장 확인 완료".
8. Agent / listing metadata block: place {에이전트 정보} at the bottom in smaller text, framed like a portal listing footer with restrained emphasis; include invented realistic metadata such as "매물번호 A-0526", "등록 2026.05.01", "중개사무소 확인", "상담 09:00–19:00", plus a small phone/QR/contact CTA area.
9. Color system application: apply {컬러 톤} across the background, dividers, label chips, highlight bars, map marker, and contact CTA, keeping the card calm, trustworthy, and premium.
10. Format lock: keep the entire composition strictly square according to {비율}, with the photo, listing facts, price block, map preview, and footer metadata locked in a polished listing-card structure.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for the main body, Bold 700–800 for headings, Medium 500 for supporting lines, 22–34px header feel, 14–18px detail feel, 10–12px for metadata only if still legible.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} as the base direction, interpreted as white, charcoal, warm beige, soft gray, muted sand, and one subtle accent color for chips or CTA; maintain low-saturation real-estate editorial colors.
- UI details: add realistic portal-card elements including small icons for area, floor, parking, direction, subway, phone, and map; use thin dividers, label chips, listing badges, and a compact contact button reading "상담 문의" or "전화 상담".
- Border/shadow: 1px cool gray separators, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px at 12% opacity, gentle rounded card corners, tactile paper-card depth, no hard glow.
- Text density: the card should feel like a real property listing with useful information, not a blank brochure; keep every Korean label readable and arranged in clear blocks.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-resolution real-estate photography look, 24mm wide-angle for interior shots, 35mm standard perspective for exterior detail, crisp rectilinear framing with no fisheye distortion.
- Lighting: bright natural daylight from large windows or open-air exterior light, softly diffused, neutral white balance, controlled highlights, realistic interior shadows, believable exterior reflections on windows if shown.
- Photo realism: include natural apartment/villa/officetel/storefront details such as wood flooring, window frames, curtains, kitchen counters, built-in storage, balcony rail, building facade, elevator hall, street trees, parked cars, or signage when relevant to {대표 사진}.
- Color grade: muted white + charcoal + warm beige with slightly desaturated contrast, portal-listing polish, restrained premium real-estate finish.

[6. MOOD]
Trustworthy premium property listing card — a modern Korean portal-real-estate editorial aesthetic with practical clarity, convincing listing metadata, realistic photography, and enough detail to feel like an actual property card ready for social media or a real-estate app.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문자열이 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함.
  - {매물 종류·동네}
  - {가격·면적}
  - {포인트}
  - {에이전트 정보}
  - {비율}
- Additional Korean text that may appear clearly on the card: "추천매물", "실사진", "확인매물", "매물번호 A-0526", "등록 2026.05.01", "상담 문의", "전화 상담", "도보 5분 생활권", "방 3", "욕실 2", "주차 1대", "입주 협의".
- Layout invariant: the image must read as a real-estate detail card, with the hero photo clearly separated from the information area and the typography aligned in a neat grid.
- The card must include realistic listing enrichments: thumbnail photos, price/area hierarchy, feature chips, property facts grid, agent footer, date/listing ID, and a small location or contact detail area.
- All Korean text must be rendered cleanly with no broken characters, spacing errors, or garbled syllables.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
