[1. PURPOSE]
Portfolio cover page for a Korean designer/developer/marketer/PM career deck, A4-portrait editorial cover with a strong typographic hierarchy, modular visual system, and realistic portfolio-publication details.
Designed to read instantly as a polished self-branding cover for presentation, PDF export, recruiter screening, or Behance case-study landing image, with enough secondary information to feel like a real professional deck cover rather than a blank mockup.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main title block occupies the upper 22% of the canvas, with {이름·연도} set as the primary focal point and {직군} as the secondary descriptor directly adjacent or just beneath it.
- Add a compact magazine-cover style metadata strip near the header: "PORTFOLIO", "VOL.2026", "2026년 업데이트", "CAREER DECK", and a small issue/date label such as "No. 03 / Seoul".
- Center visual system fills the middle 48%: {시그니처 비주얼} arranged as a structured collage or diagram-like composition with realistic portfolio artifacts such as UI frames, code snippets, product roadmap cards, campaign thumbnails, wireframe nodes, analytics tiles, sticky-note labels, or process diagrams depending on {직군}.
- Include 2–3 short Korean feature blurbs around the center grid, for example "대표 프로젝트 6선", "문제 정의부터 출시까지", "성과와 과정 기록", set as small editorial cover lines that reinforce the role and theme.
- Supporting info line sits in the lower 12%, aligned to the same left edge grid as the title, containing {추가 정보} in smaller type, plus a small QR-code-like square, barcode area, document version label, page mark "COVER / 01", and micro credit text such as "Designed by {이름·연도}".
- Overall framing should feel like a premium magazine cover grid with real print-production details: precise columns, numbered markers, crop-like ticks, thin divider lines, page code labels, and tactile paper texture while keeping the main reading order clear.
- Use {직군}, {이름·연도}, {시그니처 비주얼}, {컬러 톤}, {타이포}, {추가 정보}, {비율} as editable content placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 22%): place {이름·연도} in the largest type on the page, bold and condensed enough to dominate the top half of the composition, with {직군} nearby as a clear role label. Add small header metadata: "PORTFOLIO COVER", "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", and a tiny category tag like "디자인 · 개발 · 기획".
2. Visual anchor (mid 48%): construct {시그니처 비주얼} as a refined editorial centerpiece — a grid of wireframe shapes, code-card fragments, mobile UI screenshots, kanban cards, product strategy diagrams, campaign-image tiles, metric widgets, color chips, or component sheets depending on the chosen role, all locked to the same visual system and spacing.
3. Hierarchy reinforcement: introduce thin rules, rectangles, alignment marks, small index numbers, timeline ticks, sticker-like role tags, and caption labels around the title and visual anchor to make the page feel like a finished design portfolio cover with documented context.
4. Feature blurb layer: add three concise Korean cover-line captions in smaller but readable type, such as "핵심 역량", "프로젝트 인덱스", "협업 기록", each paired with a one-line subcaption or numeric marker like "01", "02", "03".
5. Support line (bottom 12%): place {추가 정보} as a compact contact/footer line with restrained size and wide tracking, keeping it readable but clearly secondary. Include realistic footer details: email/website style text, "PDF EXPORT", "A4 PORTRAIT", "LAST UPDATED 2026.05", a barcode block, and page number "01".
6. Format confirmation: maintain {비율} as a tall portrait layout with a professional flat front-facing cover composition, no perspective warp, and a consistent editorial grid.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Helvetica Neue for the main title in ExtraBold/Bold, with {직군} in slightly smaller Semibold and {추가 정보} in Regular or Medium at 22–32 px equivalent on a 1024x1536 canvas. Use condensed uppercase English for metadata and crisp Korean for all cover lines.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 톤} with concrete palette control such as charcoal #1C1C1E, cyan #00D1FF, white #F7F7F5, black #0B0B0C, neon yellow #DFFF3A, beige #E8DCCB, coral #FF7A6B as applicable.
- Surface and print detail: add subtle paper grain, faint ink density variation, slightly embossed keylines, realistic printed barcode marks, QR-code-like micro pattern, small registration marks, and layered translucent panels that make the cover feel physically printed and professionally produced.
- Border/shadow: use precise editorial styling — thin 1px rules, keyline frames, modular panels, small caption boxes, and a soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity if any shadow is needed.
- Graphic language: keep all added elements connected to portfolio storytelling: project index, skill tags, timeline fragments, product screenshots, system diagrams, code blocks, metrics, and case-study labels rather than unrelated ornament.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean studio-like graphic composition, equivalent to a top-down 50mm flat graphic layout with no exaggerated perspective; if photographic elements are present, keep them as crisp cutouts, printed case-study thumbnails, device-screen crops, or document fragments integrated into the cover grid.
- Lighting: even, diffuse studio illumination with no harsh hotspots, resembling a design-book cover photographed under large softboxes and flattened for print clarity, with believable paper texture and soft contact shadows on layered cards.
- Color grade: editorial neutral base with high contrast and controlled accent tones, tuned toward charcoal/cyan, monochrome/neon, or beige/coral variants depending on {컬러 톤}.
- Detail density: medium-high professional editorial density, with readable Korean labels, small metadata, project-card thumbnails, and structured information panels that reward close viewing while preserving the top-to-bottom title hierarchy.

[6. MOOD]
Premium design portfolio cover with a design-studio magazine spread feel, similar to a Kinfolk x Wired editorial hybrid where identity, system, process, and career evidence are immediately legible. The cover should feel confident, current, and ready for a real hiring presentation, with tactile print realism and smart professional details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following verbatim Korean strings must appear correctly in the rendered image when included by the chosen arguments: 포트폴리오 표지, 직군, 헤더, 비주얼, 컬러, 타이포, 정보.
- Additional Korean cover text should be short and readable, such as "대표 프로젝트", "핵심 역량", "작업 범위", "성과 요약", "협업 기록", "업데이트", "연락처", and must not appear as broken or nonsensical characters.
- Layout invariants: the page must remain a vertical A4-like cover, with the title hierarchy at top, the signature visual in the center, and the contact/footer line at the bottom; do not scatter the elements.
- Keep {직군}, {이름·연도}, {시그니처 비주얼}, {컬러 톤}, {타이포}, {추가 정보}, {비율} visible as the controlling content concept, and make all added details subordinate to that self-branding structure.
- The result must look like a real exported portfolio cover: sharp alignment, readable typography, credible printed metadata, consistent role-specific visuals, and no warped or unreadable text.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean resume PDF template, professional A4 portrait document for job applications, optimized for print-ready reading, recruiter scanning, and realistic editable PDF preview.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Build a crisp A4-portrait resume sheet with either a left 1/3 sidebar + right 2/3 main body, or an upper header + full-width single-column layout, depending on {레이아웃}.
- Present {지원자명} and {지원직무} as the main identity block, with the applicant name visually dominant, the role secondary, and a short summary line using {경력요약}.
- Include realistic resume details: contact block using {연락처}, address line using {주소}, portfolio/QR area using {포트폴리오}, 작성일 label using {작성일}, and a small submission label for {지원회사}.
- Arrange {섹션 구성} into recruiter-friendly modules with clear labels, consistent baseline rhythm, readable body text, and practical document spacing.
- Apply the overall visual direction of {형식} while preserving a polished Korean hiring-document feel.
- Use a white paper background with charcoal text, soft gray separators, and one accent color from {컬러 톤}; include subtle form-like lines, small section icons, skill chips, and timeline markers where appropriate.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area: Set the applicant identity block at the top or upper-left with “{지원자명}” in the largest type, “{지원직무}” below, and a compact Korean summary sentence from {경력요약}. Add a small right-aligned label such as “지원서류 | {지원회사} 제출용” and “작성일: {작성일}”.
- Photo/contact zone: If using the sidebar layout in {레이아웃}, place a realistic ID-style portrait placeholder at the top of the sidebar, followed by phone/email lines from {연락처}, address from {주소}, a portfolio URL, and a small QR-code style square labeled “포트폴리오”.
- Main content grid: Arrange {섹션 구성} into clean resume modules: 인적사항, 학력, 경력, 자격, 기술 스택, 자기소개, 포트폴리오 링크. Use short sample entries, dates, company/school names, role labels, bullet points, and aligned year ranges.
- Career/project area: Add a realistic experience timeline with 2–3 entries, one highlighted project block using {핵심 프로젝트}, achievement bullets with numbers, and a compact “주요 성과” row.
- Skills area: Render {기술스택} as small pill badges or a two-column proficiency table, with categories such as Backend, Database, Infra, Collaboration.
- Footer details: Add a subtle footer with “Resume PDF Template”, page number “1 / 1”, and a small update note; keep all text aligned to the A4 grid and suitable for PDF export.
- Typography layer: Render headings in bold sans-serif and body copy in a highly legible Korean font, keeping English, URLs, dates, and numbers aligned neatly throughout the page.
- Accent system: Use the single accent color from {컬러 톤} for section labels, dividers, skill chips, timeline dots, QR label, and name emphasis while maintaining a serious hiring-document look.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: {타이포}; Pretendard Bold for headings, Noto Sans KR Regular/Medium for body text, with clean 9–12pt body sizing and 18–28pt title sizing depending on hierarchy.
- Color palette: White #FFFFFF, charcoal #2B2B2B, soft gray #E7E7E7, plus one accent from {컬러 톤} such as navy #1F3A5F, mustard #C8A24A, or sage #7C9A8E.
- Document components: Use thin 1px separators, light gray information boxes, small circular timeline markers, neat skill chips, contact icons, a portfolio QR placeholder, and table-like rows for dates and credentials.
- Paper realism: Show a clean PDF page with subtle paper edge definition, precise print margins, and a believable A4 document proportion matching {비율}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Flat editorial document mockup, orthographic top-down presentation, 50mm standard-document reproduction look, no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: Even studio diffuse lighting from above, shadow-free paper presentation, slight edge falloff only to define the page boundaries.
- Color grade: Neutral white paper with clean charcoal text and a single muted accent, matching a Korean job-portal resume sample aesthetic.

[6. MOOD]
Professional Korean recruitment PDF — Wanted / Jobplanet-style editorial resume template with a confident, practical, print-first corporate tone and realistic applicant information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: “박서윤”, “백엔드 개발자”, “인적사항”, “학력”, “경력”, “자격”, “기술 스택”, “자기소개”, “포트폴리오 링크”.
- 추가로 보이면 좋은 실제형 문구: “지원서류”, “작성일: 2026.05.01”, “이메일”, “전화”, “GitHub”, “프로젝트”, “주요 성과”, “1 / 1”.
- Layout invariants: the resume must stay A4 portrait, typography must remain crisp and readable, section hierarchy must be clearly separated, and the composition must feel like a real PDF resume template rather than a poster or advertisement.
- If the sidebar layout is used, the left area must remain visually narrower than the main content area.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized real-person identity imitation
- Illegible microtext, warped tables, or exaggerated corporate buzzword copy

studio:prompts3:ours-410.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱 카테고리 헤더 배너 디자인. 한식·치킨·중식·일식·디저트·카페·분식·야식 등 카테고리별로 바로 인식되는 앱 상단 프로모션 배너이며, 실제 앱 홈 화면에 들어갈 수 있는 풍성한 프로모션형 카테고리 배너로 제작.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 레이아웃은 가로형 배너 비율로 구성하고, 왼쪽 58~62%는 {대표 음식}이 맛있게 보이는 메인 푸드 비주얼, 오른쪽 38~42%는 {배너 카피}와 주문 유도 UI가 들어가는 헤더 영역으로 분리.
- 배경은 {컬러 톤}을 기반으로 한 카테고리 컬러 패널로 만들고, 매트한 앱 카드 표면 위에 은은한 종이 질감, 소프트 그레인, 살짝 비치는 라운드 패턴을 더해 실제 모바일 배너처럼 보이게.
- 대표 음식은 {대표 음식}이 한눈에 읽히도록 3~4개 주요 음식 오브젝트를 입체적으로 배치하고, 소스 윤기, 튀김 결, 밥알, 토핑, 크림, 김가루, 참깨, 채소 고명 등 카테고리에 맞는 실제 식감 디테일을 살림.
- 음식 주변에는 작은 소스 종지, 젓가락, 포크, 냅킨, 배달 포장 박스 조각, 영수증 모서리, 스티커 라벨 등 배달앱에서 자연스러운 소품을 일부 배치해 현실감을 높임.
- 헤더 텍스트 영역은 상단 카테고리 라벨, 중앙 굵은 카피, 하단 쿠폰·배달 시간·평점 칩이 자연스럽게 이어지는 구조로 구성하고, {카테고리}가 화면 첫 인상에서 즉시 인식되도록 크게 표시.
- 오른쪽 하단에는 작은 CTA 버튼 형태로 ‘지금 주문’, ‘인기 메뉴 보기’, ‘오늘의 할인’ 중 하나를 넣고, 배달앱 UI처럼 둥근 버튼과 아이콘을 사용.
- 작은 일러스트 doodle은 별, 스파클, 손그림 포크/숟가락, 매운맛 불꽃, 달콤한 하트, 바삭한 번개 모양 등 카테고리 감성을 보강하는 요소로 음식과 카피 주변에 리듬감 있게 배치.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background layer: {컬러 톤}을 기반으로 한 카테고리 전용 배경을 채우고, 모서리는 배달앱 UI용 라운드 카드 패널처럼 처리. 배경에는 아주 미세한 프린트 그레인, 반투명 원형 패턴, 카테고리별 아이콘 패턴을 넣어 앱 배너의 밀도를 높임.
2) Main hero zone: {대표 음식}을 중앙-left에 큼직하게 배치하고, 음식 접시 또는 포장 용기가 살짝 비스듬히 놓인 듯한 product editorial composition으로 구성. 일부 음식은 앞뒤로 살짝 겹쳐 깊이감을 만들고, 소스 튐, 김, 참깨, 허브, 설탕 파우더, 치즈 가루 같은 작은 디테일을 더함.
3) Header copy zone: 오른쪽 상단 또는 중앙 상단에 {배너 카피}를 배치하고, 굵은 타이틀과 작은 보조 문구의 위계가 즉시 보이도록 구성. 보조 문구 예시: ‘오늘 주문하면 2,000원 할인’, ‘따뜻하게 도착하는 인기 메뉴’, ‘지금 가장 많이 찾는 맛’.
4) Category cue zone: {카테고리}를 짧은 라벨 또는 pill badge 형태로 상단에 넣고, 옆에는 작은 카테고리 아이콘을 배치. 예: ‘한식 BEST’, ‘치킨 특가’, ‘디저트 픽’, ‘카페 인기’ 같은 짧은 한국어 태그를 함께 사용할 수 있음.
5) Delivery info zone: 하단에는 실제 배달앱 배너처럼 ‘평균 28분 배달’, ‘리뷰 4.8’, ‘쿠폰 적용 가능’, ‘포장 가능’ 같은 작은 정보 칩 2~3개를 둥근 캡슐 형태로 배치.
6) Decorative accents: 음식 주변에 작은 별, 라인, 스파클, 손그림 포크/숟가락 doodle, 쿠폰 조각, 배달 스티커, 미니 영수증 라벨을 배치하여 앱 프로모션 배너 특유의 생동감을 더함.
7) App UI realism: 가장자리에는 실제 앱 화면에 들어간 듯한 카드 그림자, 작고 또렷한 페이지 인디케이터 점 3개, ‘AD’ 또는 ‘추천’ 마이크로 라벨, 할인 쿠폰 태그를 넣어 실사용 배너 느낌을 강화.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for the main headline, Pretendard Medium for subtext, size hint 54–72px for title and 22–28px for secondary text, tight but readable line spacing. Category label and coupon chips use Pretendard SemiBold 18–24px.
- Korean text hierarchy: {배너 카피}는 가장 크게, {카테고리}는 카테고리 pill badge로 명확하게, {대표 음식}은 음식명 라벨 또는 작은 메뉴 태그로 자연스럽게 표시.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}에 맞춘 선명한 카테고리 팔레트 사용. 예: 한식은 red #D43B2E + warm yellow #F2C94C + off-white #FFF6E8, 치킨은 golden yellow #F5C542 + red #E53935 + dark brown #3A2418, 일식은 black #111111 + vermilion #D62828 + ivory #F7F3EA.
- Border/shadow: 음식 오브젝트에는 soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity; 텍스트 카드와 쿠폰 칩에는 얕은 shadow와 1px 하이라이트를 넣어 터치 가능한 앱 UI처럼 보이게.
- Surface finish: 전반은 매끈한 광고용이 아니라 약간의 프린트 질감이 느껴지는 매트한 배너 표면. 음식은 과장된 플라스틱 광택이 아니라 실제 촬영된 듯한 수분감, 바삭함, 따뜻한 김, 소스 농도를 표현.
- Layout detail: {레이아웃}의 방향성을 유지하되, 배달앱에서 흔히 보이는 쿠폰 스티커, 정보 칩, CTA 버튼, 작은 카테고리 아이콘을 함께 배치해 실제 서비스 배너처럼 완성.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm product editorial look, slightly elevated front view with mild perspective, crisp food-commercial framing like a modern app promo shot.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, soft contact shadows under plates, boxes, stickers, and UI chips so the layout feels physically layered.
- Color grade: saturated but clean commercial grade, warm reds and yellows with controlled highlights, no neon bloom, no artificial bokeh wash.
- Food rendering: realistic commercial food photography texture, visible steam only when appropriate, crisp edges on fried items, natural sauce highlights, readable toppings, appetizing but not over-retouched.
- UI finish: rounded mobile-card design, tactile coupon labels, small icons, tiny page dots, micro shadows, clear Korean typography suitable for a 1536x1024 app hero banner.

[6. MOOD]
Fast, reliable food-delivery app hero banner — modern Korean delivery platform editorial with appetizing food realism, lively coupon energy, and a polished commercial UI feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확한 한글로 보여야 함.
  - {카테고리}
  - {배너 카피}
  - {대표 음식}
- Supporting Korean microcopy can be added and must be legible, short, and natural for a delivery app: ‘오늘 주문하면 2,000원 할인’, ‘평균 28분 배달’, ‘리뷰 4.8’, ‘쿠폰 적용 가능’, ‘인기 메뉴 모아보기’, ‘지금 주문’.
- 음식 종류는 해당 카테고리와 일치해야 하며, 한식 배너에 치킨·디저트가 섞이는 등 카테고리 혼합이 보이면 안 됨.
- 배너는 앱 상단 헤더용이므로 {배너 카피}, {카테고리}, CTA 버튼, 쿠폰 정보가 모바일 화면에서도 또렷하게 읽혀야 함.
- {비주얼 컨셉}과 {레이아웃}의 방향을 유지하면서 실제 배달앱 프로모션처럼 음식, 정보 칩, 쿠폰 태그, 작은 UI 요소가 조화롭게 보여야 함.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-409.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱 주문 완료 후의 영수증·주문 확인 화면을 실제 사용자가 받은 화면처럼 사실적으로 보이게 하는 세로형 UI/print mockup 이미지. 스마트폰 앱 캡처 느낌과 살짝 질감이 살아 있는 종이 영수증을 한 화면에 결합해, 주문 직후의 생활감 있는 배달 확인 장면을 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main receipt/order card takes about 68% of the frame height, centered vertically with slight top bias; the card edge is crisp and square-like, while lower edge에는 영수증 종이처럼 미세한 커팅 라인과 아주 약한 말림이 보이게 한다.
- Background is warm off-white to very light gray paper/table surface (#F4F2EE) with realistic fine paper grain, faint shadows, and subtle delivery-context details such as a kraft paper bag corner, a disposable chopstick sleeve, and a tiny sauce packet edge partially visible around the card without covering text.
- Use {비율} as the overall framing guide; keep the receipt large enough for every Korean line to be legible, with the surrounding surface acting as a realistic photographed document environment.
- Apply {UI 톤} to the app-like elements: top status/header bar, order status badge, small action buttons, and receipt dividers should feel like a real Korean delivery-app order confirmation screen rather than a blank template.
- Place {매장명} as the top receipt header, followed by {주문번호·시간}, then {주문 내역}, then {배달 정보}, and end with {사장님 메시지} near the bottom as a small handwritten note.
- Add realistic receipt/app details around the required content: small Korean labels such as “주문 완료”, “결제 완료”, “영수증”, “배달 진행 상황”, “가게 요청사항”, “카드 결제”, a short barcode/QR-style area, app-safe micro icons, subtotal/tax-style divider rows using the same total amount, and a tiny customer-service line like “문의는 앱 고객센터에서 확인하세요”.
- The whole layout should read as one continuous order confirmation receipt block with aligned rows, thin gray divider lines, thermal-paper texture, app UI modules, and believable small-print metadata.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) App header zone (top 8%): include a generic mobile status bar at the very top with tiny time/battery/signal marks, then a Korean screen title “주문 완료” and a small rounded status chip “배달 준비 중”. Keep it integrated with the receipt card rather than a separate device frame.
2) Header zone (next 12%): {매장명} in bold receipt-style Korean text, centered or slightly left-aligned, with small store metadata beneath it such as “배달앱 영수증”, “매장 주문 확인”, and a tiny non-official receipt barcode strip on the right edge.
3) Order info zone (next 18%): {주문번호·시간} in smaller monospaced-like black text, separated by thin gray rules. Add realistic companion labels: “주문 채널 앱 주문”, “결제 수단 카드 결제”, “상태 결제 완료”.
4) Item list zone (middle 30%): {주문 내역} broken into receipt-style rows with clear spacing, left-aligned item names and right-aligned prices. Preserve the exact required item names, quantities, and total amount; add divider labels such as “메뉴”, “금액”, “합계” and a bold final total row.
5) Delivery info zone (next 17%): {배달 정보} presented as compact multiline details, visually similar to an order confirmation panel on a delivery app. Include small generic delivery icons or bullet markers, a simple progress line with Korean steps “접수 → 조리중 → 배달중 → 도착예정”, and a subtle map-pin style label without adding a real address.
6) Message zone (bottom 10%): {사장님 메시지} as a small handwritten-style note on a lightly tinted memo strip, slightly lighter than the main text, with the quote preserved exactly. Add a tiny label “사장님 메시지” above it.
7) Footer and surface details (bottom 5%): include small receipt footer copy such as “감사합니다”, “앱에서 주문 내역을 다시 확인할 수 있어요”, a compact barcode/receipt ID graphic, page-like thermal paper grain, and soft edge shadow showing the card lifted from the background.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for UI-like text, weight 500–700 for headers, 300–400 for body lines; receipt metadata can use a monospaced OCR-like Korean-compatible style; handwritten note can mimic a casual pen style. Size hierarchy should be clear: app title/header 30–36px, store name 34–42px, body 20–24px, metadata 14–18px, note 16–18px.
- Color palette: black #111111 text, gray line #CFCFCF, off-white #F4F2EE background, soft cool gray #E7E7E7 for secondary separators, warm receipt white #FFFDF8, gentle accent derived from {UI 톤} for status chips/buttons while keeping the main receipt readable.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px gray rules, soft drop shadow 0px 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), clean paper edge with slight lift from background, realistic micro creases, paper grain, and subtle thermal-print unevenness.
- Layout details should resemble a real Korean delivery-app order receipt: compact spacing, aligned price column, app-style rounded panels, small icons, tiny barcode area, footer microcopy, and plausible customer-facing labels.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down product/document capture look, equivalent to a 50mm lens at f/5.6 for minimal distortion and crisp text reproduction.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at 45°, very gentle fill from right, natural contact shadows from the receipt card and surrounding delivery objects, no harsh highlights.
- Color grade: neutral white balance with slightly warm paper tone, black text kept deep and legible, realistic Korean app-screenshot + thermal receipt print texture.
- Rendering: high-resolution photorealistic mockup, sharp typography, believable paper fibers, slight edge curl, very fine printing noise, realistic alignment imperfections that still preserve legibility.

[6. MOOD]
Real delivery-app receipt mockup — a clean but lived-in order confirmation scene on a warm tabletop, like a freshly delivered meal receipt captured for an app store preview, customer support guide, or product documentation screen.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함.
  - {매장명}: 혜민이네 분식
  - {주문 내역}: 제육덮밥 9,900 × 1 / 콜라 1,500 / 배달비 3,000 / 총 14,400
  - {주문번호·시간}: 주문번호 #20260429-1428 / 결제 시간 2026.04.29 18:42
  - {배달 정보}: 배달 예상 시간 35분 / 받는 분 김혜민 / 010-XXXX-XXXX
  - {사장님 메시지}: "맛있게 드셔주세요 ❤️" — 작은 손글씨
- All Korean characters must be sharp and unbroken; text should remain fully legible as a real receipt/app mockup.
- Preserve the required order hierarchy and exact prices while enriching only the surrounding UI labels, receipt metadata, barcode-like graphics, and realistic tabletop context.
- Any added Korean microcopy must be short, plausible for a delivery app, and secondary to the required placeholder text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-408.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달 포장 박스와 테이크아웃 패키지를 위한 photoreal branding mockup image.  
E-commerce, portfolio, and brand presentation use with a polished editorial product-photography look, showing the packaging as a real café or deli delivery set ready for customer pickup.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: multiple takeaway package items arranged as a cohesive set, filling about 70% of the frame, with realistic surrounding details that make the packaging feel used in an actual store environment.
- Composition: {패키지 종류} should be displayed as the primary hero set, with {매장 로고} repeated across the packaging in a consistent brand system.
- Surface and background: {배경} with visible paper grain, tabletop texture, soft handling marks, and natural food-service context such as a printed receipt, napkin, sauce cup, wooden stirrer, or small delivery label supporting scale and realism.
- Framing: front-facing and slightly top-down hybrid angle so the box faces, bag faces, cup, sleeve, lid sticker, order label, and small printed details are readable at once.
- Brand system: use {디자인 톤} across every package surface so the set feels unified rather than randomly generated.
- Arrangement: {레이아웃} with layered depth, believable spacing between items, mild overlaps, contact shadows, and small real-world imperfections like folded bag corners, taped seams, and slightly raised sticker edges.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero package cluster: place the largest box in the center or slightly left-of-center, with the paper bag and cup flanking it to create a complete delivery set.
- Secondary items: place the smaller cup, sticker sheet, receipt, napkin, cup sleeve, and sauce container in the foreground or upper-right area so the viewer immediately understands the full packaging lineup.
- Logo application: print {매장 로고} on the box lid, bag front, cup body, sleeve, and delivery sticker with consistent scale and alignment, as if prepared for a real café brand kit.
- Real printed content: include small Korean package details such as “오늘의 포장”, “주문번호 042”, “픽업 12:40”, “따뜻할 때 드세요”, “배달 전용”, “서울시 성동구 성수이로 21”, “02-123-4567”, “@cafe_daily”, and a tiny QR-code style square on the receipt or side label.
- Menu / price microtext: add 3–5 tiny readable menu lines on a receipt or insert card, for example “아메리카노 ₩4,500”, “바질 치킨 샌드위치 ₩8,900”, “수제 쿠키 ₩3,200”, “오늘의 수프 ₩6,500”.
- Material realism: show kraft paper fiber, matte ink absorption, slight fold shadows, embossed creases, box tuck tabs, cup rim thickness, paper bag rope or flat handles, realistic sticker edge thickness, and food-safe paper texture.
- Brand color accents: apply the accent color from {디자인 톤} to key details such as trim lines, stickers, cup sleeve marks, sealing tape, small icons, or menu dividers so the kraft base remains dominant.
- Background integration: keep {배경} softly lit with natural tabletop shadows, visible surface grain, and practical packaging accessories that feel authentic to a takeaway counter.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if text appears on the packaging, render it in Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to bold weight for the logo and compact regular weight for microcopy, with clean print edges and realistic ink spread on paper.
- Color palette: kraft beige, warm off-white, matte black ink, and the brand accent implied by {디자인 톤}; keep saturation print-friendly while allowing the accent to appear on stickers, labels, or small packaging graphics.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity; include layered contact shadows under bags, cups, boxes, labels, and receipt paper for believable physical depth.
- Print finish: matte paper, light fiber texture, crisp die-cut edges, realistic sticker adhesion, subtle scuffs on folded corners, faint pressure marks around box creases, and natural paper cup seams.
- Graphic details: include simple line icons such as cup size, recycling mark, delivery arrow, heat warning, ingredient checkbox, or order-status ticks, designed to match {디자인 톤}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame product photography look, 50mm lens at f/8, slight top-down tilt around 15°, high-resolution studio capture.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, with a clean shadow falloff across the tabletop and mild highlights on paper edges.
- Color grade: natural kraft neutrals with soft warm highlights, controlled contrast, and neutral whites; avoid oversaturated beige or orange cast.
- Texture rendering: emphasize tactile paper fibers, matte printed ink, corrugated edges, cup lid geometry, folded bag seams, sticker thickness, and small dust or crumb-level realism appropriate for a food packaging shoot.

[6. MOOD]
Independent café packaging editorial — resembles a contemporary Korean neighborhood café brand presentation with warm tabletop realism, premium paper goods, and practical delivery-counter details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the packaging should clearly show the brand name in {매장 로고} exactly as intended, with no broken Korean characters.
- Include realistic Korean printed details such as “주문번호 042”, “픽업 12:40”, “따뜻할 때 드세요”, “배달 전용”, “서울시 성동구 성수이로 21”, and prices like “₩4,500” on receipt or insert cards, rendered cleanly and legibly where visible.
- The set must look like one coherent real-world packaging system: box, paper bag, cup, sleeve, delivery sticker, receipt, and small insert card should share the same logo placement logic and color language.
- All printed edges, folds, handles, lids, seams, and sticker contours must be anatomically/materially plausible for real packaging.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Seasonal limited-menu delivery app card for social media and in-app promotion, designed as a vivid square Korean food advertisement with real delivery-app detail, appetizing food photography, and season-specific campaign storytelling.
Korean menu marketing graphic that highlights a hero dish, seasonal motif accents, limited-time pricing, store/app UI microcopy, and quick-scan ordering information for a realistic mobile promotion card.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Square 1:1 layout optimized for 1024x1024 mobile feed and in-app banner use, with the main food hero occupying about 50–55% of the frame, seasonal motif accents and real food-side details around it, and text blocks stacked in a clear app-card hierarchy.
- Center the dish slightly below midpoint so the top area can hold the season/theme headline and campaign label, while the bottom area can hold {가격·기간}, a CTA button, and small delivery-app information.
- Background treatment should change with the season using a realistic tabletop or tray surface: cool white ceramic or pale cyan tile for summer, warm ivory paper with amber highlights for winter, soft pastel mint-pink café surface for spring, and muted brown-gold wood or kraft paper for autumn.
- Add natural food context around the hero dish: small sauce cup, garnish pieces, condensation droplets, napkin corner, disposable spoon/chopsticks, receipt slip, delivery sticker, or seasonal ingredient accents that fit the theme without blocking the headline or price badge.
- Use {시즌·테마}, {메뉴}, {시즌 모티프}, {가격·기간}, {컬러 톤}, {레이아웃} as customizable placeholders while enriching the card with realistic Korean delivery-app micro text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 18%): set {시즌·테마} as the main title in a bold app-promo style. Add a compact campaign line such as "시즌 한정 메뉴", "이번 주 추천", or "오늘 주문 가능" near the title.
2. Store/app info strip (upper side or under header): include realistic microcopy such as "배달 25–35분", "리뷰 4.8", "무료배달 쿠폰", "NEW", and a small handle-style store label like "@season_kitchen" or "우리동네 인기메뉴".
3. Hero zone (center 55%): present {메뉴} as the visual anchor, plated or packaged like a real delivery item with realistic food texture, glossy sauce, crispy edges, visible garnish, steam for warm seasons/winter comfort food, or condensation/chill for summer items. Add a soft natural shadow beneath.
4. Seasonal accent zone (around hero edges): place {시즌 모티프} as graphic stickers, small illustrated badges, or physical accents around the dish, balanced with ingredient crumbs, herbs, ice cubes, citrus slices, snowflake tags, flower petals, autumn leaves, or warm spice details depending on the season.
5. Price/time zone (bottom 15%): display {가격·기간} in a clear badge or pill label, paired with small Korean text such as "한정 판매", "앱 주문 전용", "소진 시 종료".
6. CTA and menu detail zone: add a rounded button reading "지금 주문하기" or "장바구니 담기", plus 2–3 short supporting lines such as "단품", "세트 구성", "사이드 추가 가능", with small price-like micro labels if appropriate.
7. Layout system: follow {레이아웃} with a structured, modular delivery-menu composition that remains legible at thumbnail size, including decorative dividers, small icons, and app-card panels.
8. Color application: adapt the main surface, badge, CTA button, dividers, and accent stickers to {컬러 톤}, using strong contrast for text readability and realistic color harmony with the food.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for headline and body, bold 700–800 for title, medium 500–600 for supporting text, with headline size dominance, compact line spacing, and app-style rounded Korean letterforms.
- Color palette: derive from {컬러 톤}; use season-specific combinations such as summer cyan #67D7E8 + white #FFFFFF, winter amber #D98A3A + red #D94B4B, spring pink #F7A8C9 + mint #BFE8D0, autumn brown #8A5A3C + gold #D8B15A.
- Card styling: rounded delivery-app card panels, subtle 2px border in a slightly darker tint of the palette, soft drop shadow with 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 12% opacity, plus small sticker labels and coupon chips that feel like real app UI.
- Food realism: emphasize real ingredients, tactile packaging, sauce sheen, crispy texture, steam, condensation, sesame seeds, herbs, crumbs, and seasonal garnish details.
- Decorative elements: use tasteful seasonal icons, ingredient illustrations, handwritten-style mini labels, small dotted dividers, coupon tabs, and delivery receipt snippets to make the card feel content-rich and commercially realistic.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down food photography look with a 50mm lens and f/4 for the hero dish, or a 35mm lens if a slightly angled app-card composition is preferred.
- Lighting: soft studio softbox from upper-left at 45°, with a gentle fill from lower-right; add crisp highlights for summer chill or warm glow for winter steam as seasonally appropriate.
- Color grade: clean commercial food-promo grade with season-tuned temperature shifts — cool and bright for summer, warm and saturated for winter, fresh pastel for spring, earthy and golden for autumn.
- Rendering quality: realistic Korean delivery advertisement, sharp readable typography, appetizing food surface detail, balanced UI hierarchy, and polished mobile-commerce finish.

[6. MOOD]
Commercial delivery-app menu card — polished Korean food advertising aesthetic with the clarity of a modern Coupang Eats / Baemin-style seasonal promo graphic, but filled with believable ordering details, appetizing props, coupon chips, and seasonal campaign energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the supplied placeholder values exactly and clearly for {시즌·테마}, {메뉴}, {시즌 모티프}, {가격·기간}, {컬러 톤}, {레이아웃}.
- Include short Korean app-card microcopy such as "시즌 한정 메뉴", "지금 주문하기", "배달 25–35분", "리뷰 4.8", "소진 시 종료" where it fits the design.
- Layout invariant: the food hero must remain the largest element, and the price/time badge must stay clearly separated from the title.
- Seasonal consistency: visual props, food temperature cues, decorative stickers, and color palette must match the chosen seasonal variant without mixing conflicting season cues.
- All Korean text must be clean, correctly spaced, and readable at thumbnail size.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-406.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱에 올리는 영업시간·휴무 안내 카드. 1:1 정사각형 정보형 포스터로, 사용자가 주문 전 운영시간, 휴무일, 배달 마감, 포장 가능 여부, 문의 정보를 즉시 확인할 수 있는 실제 배달앱 매장 공지 이미지처럼 제작한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 중앙 메인 정보 블록이 프레임의 70%를 차지하고, 상단에는 {매장명}을 헤더로 배치한다.
- 전체 이미지는 배달앱 공지 카드 화면처럼 구성한다: 상단 상태 배지, 매장명 헤더, 운영 안내 본문, 하단 주문 전 체크 문구와 매장 연락 정보가 자연스럽게 이어지도록 한다.
- 상단에는 {상태배지}, "TODAY NOTICE", 작은 앱 알림 점, 업데이트 날짜 {업데이트일}, 공지 코드 {공지코드}를 배치해 실제 매장 공지 업로드 화면처럼 보이게 한다.
- 하단에는 영업시간, 휴무일, 배달 시간을 구분된 섹션으로 나누어 세로 정렬하고, 각 섹션에 라벨 탭, 아이콘, 강조 칩, 짧은 안내 문구를 붙인다.
- 배경은 화이트 계열의 매끈한 종이 질감 또는 아주 옅은 그리드 패턴으로 처리하고, 실제 매장 공지판처럼 작은 스티커 라벨, 구분선, 아이콘, 앱 UI 마이크로 요소를 더해 정보 밀도를 높인다.
- 시계·달력 일러스트 + 매장 로고 + 정보 정렬이 조화를 이루도록, 각 정보 블록마다 작은 아이콘과 라벨 탭을 붙여 사용자가 빠르게 구분할 수 있게 한다.
- {비주얼} 요소는 헤더 주변 또는 각 섹션 옆에 작은 아이콘/일러스트로 배치하고, 배달 봉투, 타이머, 캘린더, 오픈 사인, 영수증 메모, 말풍선 안내 스티커 같은 동네 매장 분위기의 그래픽을 함께 사용한다.
- 카드 하단에는 "주문 전 꼭 확인해주세요", "{포장여부}", "{배달지역}", "{문의전화}", "{매장주소}" 같은 현실적인 보조 정보를 작은 글씨로 배치한다.
- 실제 배달앱 카드처럼 하단 유틸리티 바에 "♡ 저장", "↗ 공유", "리뷰 {리뷰평점}", "대표 {대표메뉴}", "{쿠폰문구}"를 넣어 사용자가 앱에서 보는 공지 이미지의 맥락을 살린다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 18%): {매장명}을 가장 크게 배치하고, 왼쪽에는 작은 원형 매장 로고 또는 모노그램, 오른쪽에는 "배달앱 공지" / "TODAY NOTICE" / {상태배지} 배지를 넣는다. 아래에 얇은 구분선과 작은 크레딧 텍스트 "운영 안내 · {업데이트일} 업데이트"를 넣어 제목과 본문을 분리한다.
- Notice meta row: 헤더 바로 아래에 작은 캡슐형 UI로 "공지번호 {공지코드}", "오늘 주문 가능", "대표 {대표메뉴}"를 나란히 배치하고, 작은 알림 벨 아이콘과 체크 아이콘을 더한다.
- Info block 1 (middle 28%): "영업시간" 라벨과 {영업시간}을 한 줄 또는 두 줄로 정돈된 카드 형태로 배치한다. 시계 아이콘, "OPEN" 태그, 작은 강조 문구 "브레이크 타임 확인"을 함께 넣는다.
- Info block 2 (middle 24%): "휴무일" 라벨과 {휴무일}을 대비되는 박스에 넣어 시각적으로 구분한다. 캘린더 아이콘, 월요일 표시 마커, "정기 휴무" 스탬프형 라벨을 함께 배치한다.
- Info block 3 (bottom 18%): "배달 시간" 라벨과 {배달마감정보}를 강조 색상으로 표시해 주문 마감 정보를 빠르게 읽게 한다. 배달 오토바이 또는 종이봉투 아이콘, "LAST ORDER" 태그, "마감 전 여유 주문" 안내 문구를 추가한다.
- Bottom utility strip: 하단 8–10% 영역에 작은 앱 UI 바처럼 "♡ 저장", "↗ 공유", "리뷰 {리뷰평점}", "{문의전화}", "{매장주소}"를 배치해 실제 배달앱 카드처럼 보이게 한다.
- Service chips: 하단 또는 우측 가장자리에는 작은 칩 형태로 "{포장여부}", "{배달지역}", "{쿠폰문구}"를 배치하고, 배달비/거리/포장 아이콘처럼 보이는 마이크로 그래픽을 추가한다.
- Visual accents: {비주얼}을 정보 블록 옆의 선화 아이콘, 캘린더 마크, 시계 마크로 처리하고, 작은 체크 표시, 라벨 스티커, 점선 디바이더, 포인트 컬러 칩을 더해 풍부한 안내 카드 느낌을 만든다.
- Layout guidance: {레이아웃}에 맞춰 모든 텍스트는 중앙 정렬 또는 좌측 정렬 중 하나로 일관되게 유지하고, 섹션 간 간격은 읽기 편하게 조정하되 실제 공지 카드처럼 필요한 보조 정보가 충분히 들어가도록 구성한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, 제목은 Bold 28–34px, 본문은 Medium 18–22px, 숫자/시간 표기는 SemiBold로 강조. 보조 정보와 앱 UI 텍스트는 11–14px 수준의 작은 글씨로 넣는다.
- Color palette: {컬러톤}을 기준으로 화이트 #FFFFFF, 차콜 #2B2B2B, 포인트 컬러 1종(브랜드 시그니처 색상)을 중심으로 사용하고, 보조 배경에는 아주 옅은 크림/그레이 톤과 포인트 컬러의 10–20% 틴트를 섞는다.
- Border/shadow: 카드형 박스에 1px 라인, 아주 약한 6px blur shadow, 10–12% opacity로 또렷하지만 가벼운 느낌 유지. 각 섹션에는 라운드 코너, 얇은 디바이더, 작은 라벨 탭을 사용한다.
- Realistic detail: 실제 배달앱에 업로드된 매장 공지처럼 상단 알림 배지, 업데이트 날짜, 영수증 느낌의 작은 코드 "{공지코드}", 앱 아이콘형 저장/공유 버튼, 문의 전화와 주소 라인을 포함한다.
- Text hierarchy: {매장명}과 시간 정보가 가장 먼저 보이고, 보조 문구는 작은 크기와 낮은 대비로 배치해 정보 우선순위를 분명히 한다.
- Korean UI realism: 숫자, 물결표, 괄호, 콜론, 전화번호 하이픈을 선명하게 렌더링하고, 실제 앱 공지처럼 라벨 색상과 본문 색상을 구분한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic poster style, no photography; clean vector layout with crisp edges and uniform spacing, rendered as a realistic delivery-app announcement card with subtle paper texture and app UI details.
- Lighting: soft studio-like even illumination 느낌의 평면 디자인, 카드 박스와 라벨에는 매우 부드러운 그림자와 은은한 하이라이트를 넣어 실제 디지털 카드가 화면에 떠 있는 듯한 깊이를 준다.
- Color grade: clean white + charcoal base with a single accent tone, print-ready informational palette, {컬러톤}에 맞춘 따뜻한 로컬 매장 분위기.
- Surface detail: 배경에는 가벼운 종이 섬유 질감, 약한 그리드, 작은 점선 디바이더, 영수증 메모 질감, 스티커 라벨의 미세한 그림자를 넣어 배달앱 공지 이미지의 현실감을 높인다.

[6. MOOD]
Korean neighborhood snack shop delivery-app notice card — friendly local store schedule board, practical app notice, warm neighborhood service tone, clear and trustworthy ordering information, realistic mobile commerce announcement.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문자열: "{매장명}", "영업시간", "휴무일", "배달 시간", "{영업시간}", "{휴무일}", "{배달마감정보}".
- 추가로 자연스럽게 표시할 수 있는 한국어 보조 문구: "배달앱 공지", "TODAY NOTICE", "{상태배지}", "주문 전 꼭 확인해주세요", "{포장여부}", "{배달지역}", "운영 안내 · {업데이트일} 업데이트", "{문의전화}", "{매장주소}", "♡ 저장", "↗ 공유", "리뷰 {리뷰평점}", "대표 {대표메뉴}", "{쿠폰문구}", "공지번호 {공지코드}".
- 모든 시간 표기는 숫자와 기호가 깨지지 않도록 선명하게 렌더링한다.
- 레이아웃은 정보형 카드 구조를 유지하고, 텍스트는 과도한 왜곡 없이 명확하게 읽혀야 한다.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean delivery-app loyalty stamp card, compact reward tracker, social-media-ready 1:1 card design.
A practical stamp-progress card for repeated orders, with clear reward milestone, real shop identity, delivery-app contact details, small menu/pricelist content, and believable printed paper presence.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main card fills 88% of the square frame, photographed as a realistic printed loyalty card for a neighborhood snack shop and delivery-app regular-customer program.
- Top header band occupies about 16% of height, reward info block 18%, stamp grid 46%, and shop/menu/contact footer 20%.
- Background uses {컬러 톤} with visible kraft paper fiber texture, tiny ink speckles, faint handling marks, and warm off-white paper highlights.
- Compose the design with practical mobile readability: rounded card corners, thin rule dividers, small sticker-like tags, receipt-style micro text, and a compact app-promo layout that feels used in real delivery packaging.
- Around the card edge, allow subtle contextual tabletop details such as a partial delivery receipt corner, a small red sauce stain, or a blurred chopstick sleeve, while keeping the stamp card as the clear focal subject.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 16%): place the title as a crisp loyalty-card masthead for “혜민이네 분식”, add the handle “@혜민이네”, and include a small date/issue label such as “2026 단골 적립 카드 · VOL.03”. Add a tiny app-style label “배달 단골 전용”.
- Reward strip (upper-middle 18%): show {진행 상태} as a compact progress note, visually separated by a thin rule, stamp-line divider, and small Korean badges like “오늘도 적립 완료” and “포장·배달 공통”. Use {혜택} as the main reward promise.
- Stamp grid (center 46%): render {비주얼} as a 10-cell array, with 3 vivid red stamp marks filled and 7 empty outlined cells. Each cell may have small numerals 01–10, with the first 3 stamped using imperfect ink edges, pressure variance, and slight rotation like hand-applied shop stamps.
- Progress emphasis: make the filled stamps clearly countable, slightly imperfect, and tactile with ink absorption into kraft paper; empty cells should have thin charcoal outlines and faint dotted guide marks.
- Footer info (bottom 20%): set {매장 정보} in a neat small-type block, including “02-XXXX-XXXX”, an address-style line, delivery hours, and contact handle. Add a compact mini menu/pricelist panel with realistic Korean items and prices such as “떡볶이 ₩4,500”, “순대 ₩5,000”, “김밥 ₩3,500”, “튀김 ₩4,000”.
- Include a small non-functional QR-code-like square or app check-in box labeled “적립 확인”, plus tiny save/share/order micro icons drawn as simple UI symbols.
- Reflect {레이아웃} through balanced proportions, practical spacing, strong hierarchy, decorative dividers, and a believable printed coupon-card arrangement.
- Overall composition should feel like a real delivery-app promo loyalty card from an indie neighborhood snack shop, with the stamp system, reward copy, shop identity, menu details, and contact information all contributing to a lived-in printed design.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR mix; title bold 700 at large size, reward text medium 600, body text 500 to regular 400, footer small 300–400 with tight but readable tracking.
- Color palette: kraft beige, red stamp ink, charcoal text, off-white paper highlights; use hex approximations like #D8C3A5, #C73A34, #2E2A27, #F5EFE6.
- Border/shadow: thin charcoal outer line, softly worn card edge, natural paper-shadow 0px 4px 12px 15% opacity, and faint offset ink registration for print realism.
- Add small realistic production details: tiny crop-mark style ticks, receipt-number text, subtle divider ornaments, hand-stamped imperfections, and light paper grain.
- Keep the stamp graphics slightly imperfect, with subtle ink absorption edges and natural pressure variance.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down product mockup look, 50mm lens equivalent at f/5.6 for clean flat composition and minimal perspective distortion.
- Lighting: soft studio light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, even paper texture visibility without harsh shadows.
- Color grade: warm kraft beige with muted red accent and charcoal contrast, slightly desaturated for print-ready editorial clarity.
- Rendering: realistic paper stock, visible fiber, tiny ink bleed, slight corner wear, and natural shadows on a warm tabletop so it reads as a photographed physical card rather than a sterile digital template.

[6. MOOD]
Indie neighborhood 분식집 loyalty card — warm kraft stationery, friendly delivery-app coupon design, casual local-shop charm, and practical Korean snack-bar menu energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: "혜민이네 분식", "@혜민이네", "02-XXXX-XXXX", "현재 3/10 도장", "10번 주문 시 떡볶이 1인분 무료 / 또는 5번 시 음료 무료·VIP 등급".
- Additional readable Korean details may include: "2026 단골 적립 카드", "배달 단골 전용", "오늘도 적립 완료", "적립 확인", "떡볶이 ₩4,500", "순대 ₩5,000", "김밥 ₩3,500", "튀김 ₩4,000", "매일 11:00–22:00".
- Stamp count must clearly read as a 10-cell system with 3 filled and 7 empty when showing {진행 상태}.
- All Korean characters must be clean and unbroken, with no garbled glyphs.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱 리뷰 요청 카드 디자인, 매장 동봉용 미니 인쇄 카드와 1:1 SNS 공유용 정사각 포맷에 맞는 따뜻한 실물감의 그래픽.
고객에게 별점 5점과 한 줄 리뷰를 자연스럽게 부탁하는 안내 카드로, 동네 맛집에서 실제 포장 봉투 안에 넣어줄 법한 친절한 브랜드 톤을 전달.
카드 안에는 리뷰 혜택, 쿠폰 코드, QR 안내, 주문번호 메모, 매장명·주소·연락처, 짧은 감사 문구, 작은 음식 일러스트가 함께 보여 실제 홍보물처럼 완성도 있게 구성.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 중앙 메인 타이포 영역이 프레임의 약 48–52%를 차지하고, 상단에는 {매장명} 라벨과 사장님 인사 비주얼, 하단에는 {혜택·인센티브} 쿠폰 박스·{쿠폰코드}·QR 영역·매장 정보를 안정적으로 배치.
- 배경은 {컬러 톤}을 바탕으로 한 크림 베이지 종이 질감으로 처리하고, 카드 가장자리에는 인쇄물 특유의 미세한 종이 섬유, 살짝 눌린 모서리, 부드러운 그림자를 더해 실제 포장 봉투 안에 들어 있던 카드처럼 보이게 함.
- 텍스트는 중앙 정렬을 기본으로 하되, {레이아웃}에 따라 상단 라벨, 본문, 별점 라인, 혜택 박스, 하단 안내 바가 카드형 인쇄 레이아웃처럼 자연스럽게 이어지도록 구성.
- {요청 메시지}, {혜택·인센티브}, {비주얼}, {대표 메뉴}, {음식 카테고리}를 각각 독립된 시각 요소로 분리하고, 작은 배달 봉투 스티커, 리뷰 별점 라인, 쿠폰 배지, QR 박스, 주문 메모, 매장 연락처 등 현실적인 부가 정보를 함께 배치.
- 카드 하단에는 작은 안내 텍스트로 “리뷰 작성 후 주문번호를 남겨주세요”, “쿠폰코드 {쿠폰코드}”, “{채널핸들}”, “{매장주소}”, “{연락처}” 같은 마이크로 카피를 넣어 실제 매장 카드의 정보 밀도를 살림.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header visual area: 상단 15%에 손 흔드는 사장님 캐릭터 또는 작은 조리 모자 아이콘을 배치하고, 옆에는 “오늘도 따뜻하게 준비했어요”, “{매장명} REVIEW EVENT CARD”, “주문 감사 카드” 라벨, 작은 별 아이콘 2–3개를 함께 배치해 친근한 첫인상 형성.
2) Main message area: 화면 중앙 40–44%에 {요청 메시지}를 굵은 산세리프 타이포로 배치, 자간은 살짝 넓게 두고 한글 가독성을 최우선으로 구성. 바로 아래에는 5개의 노란 별 라인을 크게 넣고, “한 줄 리뷰가 큰 힘이 됩니다”라는 보조 문구와 “{대표 메뉴} 맛있게 드셨나요?”를 작은 크기로 추가.
3) Benefit area: 하단 20–22%에 {혜택·인센티브}를 절취선이 있는 쿠폰 박스 또는 둥근 배지 형태로 넣고, “다음 주문 1,000원 쿠폰”, “쿠폰코드 {쿠폰코드}”, “유효기간 {유효기간}까지”가 읽히도록 숫자와 코드 영역을 강조.
4) QR and action area: 하단 오른쪽에는 실제 스캔 가능한 느낌의 작은 QR 코드 박스를 넣고, 바로 아래에 “{QR문구}” 캡션을 배치. QR 옆에는 “리뷰 작성 후 {주문번호 예시}를 남겨주세요”라는 주문 확인 메모와 작은 체크박스 그래픽을 추가.
5) Decorative area: {비주얼}을 문구 주변의 보조 그래픽으로 사용해 별 5개, {음식 카테고리} 음식 doodle, 배달 봉투, 말풍선, 하트 스티커, 작은 영수증 조각, 손그림 느낌의 포인트를 배치하고, 인쇄 카드에 어울리는 작은 잉크 번짐과 종이 질감을 더함.
6) Layout framing: 전체 카드 테두리는 1px charcoal 라인과 안쪽 점선 쿠폰 라인으로 감싸고, 모서리는 약하게 라운드 처리. 하단 왼쪽에는 {매장명}, {매장주소}, {연락처}, {채널핸들}을 작은 명함형 정보 블록으로 배치.
7) Realistic micro details: 작은 주문 메모처럼 “포장 전 한 번 더 확인했어요”, “리뷰 확인 후 쿠폰은 다음 주문에 사용 가능해요”, “{감사문구}” 같은 짧은 한국어 텍스트를 보조 요소로 넣어 생활감 있는 배달앱 리뷰 요청 카드로 완성.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for 핵심 문구, Pretendard Medium for 혜택 설명, Pretendard Regular for small coupon details and micro captions, size hint 30–44px for main text, 18–24px for benefit headline, 12–16px for support text.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} 기준으로 cream beige #F6EFD9, warm yellow #F5C94A, charcoal #2F2F2F, soft brown #A97B5A, plus subtle off-white paper highlight #FFF8E8.
- Border/shadow: 1px charcoal border, inner dotted coupon divider, rounded coupon badge, shadow는 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 10% opacity의 부드러운 인쇄 카드 그림자.
- Graphic finish: warm risograph-inspired ink texture, slightly imperfect printed edges, tiny paper fibers, hand-drawn icon accents, friendly neighborhood shop aesthetic, realistic small-batch printed flyer feel.
- Information hierarchy: main request phrase first, 5-star line second, coupon amount third, QR/contact/order detail fourth, so the viewer can understand the offer immediately.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat graphic composition, 50mm equivalent framing 느낌의 정돈된 정사각 레이아웃.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left, gentle paper shadow around the card, paper texture is visible but subtle.
- Color grade: warm cream + honey yellow + charcoal, slightly muted like a small neighborhood café or delivery restaurant flyer.
- Render quality: realistic printed-card surface, crisp Korean typography, tactile matte paper, warm editorial food-service promotional design.

[6. MOOD]
소규모 동네 맛집의 손글씨 안내문 같은 친근함과, 따뜻한 카페 플라이어·배달 포장 동봉 카드의 현실적인 인쇄물 감성을 함께 가진 디자인.
고객에게 부담스럽게 강요하기보다, 정성스럽게 만든 음식을 보낸 사장님의 감사 인사처럼 느껴지는 부드럽고 믿음직한 분위기.
작은 쿠폰, QR, 주문번호, 매장 연락처가 들어가 있어 실제 배달 봉투 속에서 꺼낸 리뷰 이벤트 카드처럼 생활감 있고 신뢰감 있게 보이도록 함.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구는 다음과 같음: "맛있게 드셨다면 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 별점 5점 부탁드려요", "별점 5점 + 한 줄 리뷰 시 다음 주문 1,000원 쿠폰".
- Additional Korean text should be short and legible: "리뷰 작성 바로가기", "쿠폰코드 리뷰천원", "유효기간 2026.05.31", "감사합니다 사장님 드림", "@우리동네맛집", "서울시 마포구 동교로 12", "02-1234-5678".
- 별 아이콘은 5개가 명확히 인지되어야 하며, 한글 문구는 깨짐 없이 완전한 형태로 렌더링되어야 함.
- 카드형 인쇄물 비율이 자연스럽고, 메인 요청 문구와 혜택 금액이 다른 정보보다 작아지지 않도록 유지.
- {매장명}, {요청 메시지}, {혜택·인센티브}, {비주얼}, {컬러 톤}, {레이아웃}, {쿠폰코드}, {유효기간}, {대표 메뉴}, {음식 카테고리}, {매장주소}, {연락처}, {채널핸들}, {주문번호 예시}, {QR문구}, {감사문구} placeholders must remain visually represented according to their values.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean delivery-app hygiene and freshness certification card, square social post graphic. Designed to communicate trust, cleanliness, ingredient freshness, and real operational detail at a glance, like a polished in-app trust badge promoted on a food delivery platform.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the main certification area as a 70% hero block, with a compact top label zone, a detailed verification badge area, and a practical bottom information zone.
- Background should feel like a real clean kitchen / sanitized service surface: matte white with very light mint tint, subtle paper texture, faint stainless-steel counter reflection, tiled wall hints, and soft food-service ambience.
- Frame the square card as a premium app UI asset with visible micro-details: small inspection date, badge serial number, checklist rows, tiny QR-code area, delivery-app style status icons, and realistic ingredient accents.
- Use {인증 종류}, {아이콘·심볼}, {비주얼}, {컬러 톤}, {텍스트}, {레이아웃} as the customizable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top label band (12–15%): place a compact trust header area with crisp typography, thin divider rules, small app-card microcopy, and {인증 종류} as the key claim. Include Korean details such as “안심배달 체크”, “최근 점검 2026.05.01”, “VOL. 024”, and “DLV-FRESH”.
- Main icon cluster (center 35%): combine {아이콘·심볼} as a clean platform-style certification badge with check marks, shield geometry, sparkle accents, a circular verification ring, and small badge metadata like “인증번호 DLV-2026-0501”. Make it look like a private delivery-app trust mark, not a government seal.
- Product / kitchen visual zone (middle 25%): render {비주얼} as a bright, hygienic real-world food-service scene with stainless-steel prep surface, gloved hands partially visible, fresh greens, tomatoes, sealed ingredient containers, thermometer tag, sanitizing spray bottle, and neatly folded delivery packaging in the background.
- Supporting text block (lower 15–18%): set {텍스트} in a clear, app-readable layout with short line breaks and strong hierarchy. Add two or three checklist rows with tiny icons: “매장 위생 점수 A”, “매일 신선 재료”, “포장 전 손소독 완료”, plus a small “냉장보관 2℃” freshness tag.
- Bottom utility strip: include a compact QR-code placeholder area, page-style indicator dots, store verification line “오늘의 점검 완료”, and small customer reassurance copy such as “사진·점검기록 기준 업데이트”.
- Layout format (full frame): follow {레이아웃} while maintaining square-card balance; if 1:1, keep the hierarchy centered and vertically stacked with realistic app UI spacing.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, bold 700 for the main claim, medium 500 for supporting text, 26–34px equivalent for headlines and 16–20px for subtext; use 10–12px microtext for serial, date, QR label, and checklist metadata.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} with concrete anchors like #FFFFFF, #EAF8F3, #CFEBDD, #2F3A3D, plus muted mint accent #31B98D and soft gray #A8B6B3; keep contrast crisp and premium-clean.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px cool-gray border, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px at 12% opacity, layered translucent app panels, gentle divider lines, and subtle certificate-style corner ticks.
- Graphic details: add refined line icons for glove, thermometer, leaf, shield, check, package seal, and kitchen hygiene; keep all Korean text sharp and readable on mobile.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm standard product-photo perspective, eye-level with slight top-down tilt, f/4 clarity for clean commercial detail.
- Lighting: bright studio softbox from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, controlled specular highlights on metal and ingredients, natural reflections on stainless steel, soft shadows under ingredient containers and badge panels.
- Color grade: white + mint green + charcoal with fresh commercial neutrality, lightly desaturated and high-key like a polished food-service brand asset.
- Rendering style: photorealistic mixed with refined app UI overlay, realistic textures on paper card, stainless steel, fresh vegetables, disposable gloves, sealed packaging, and printed label stickers.

[6. MOOD]
Premium food-delivery trust badge — polished D2C brand card aesthetic, similar to a clean editorial infographic seen in modern food-tech marketing, with enough inspection details and kitchen context to feel credible and operational.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “매장 위생 점수 A / 매일 신선 재료”.
- Include readable Korean microcopy where appropriate: “안심배달 체크”, “최근 점검 2026.05.01”, “인증번호 DLV-2026-0501”, “포장 전 손소독 완료”, “냉장보관 2℃”, “오늘의 점검 완료”.
- Keep the certification feel factual and trustworthy; the badge must read as a delivery-platform verification card, not an official government document.
- Ensure all icons, QR area, serial text, date stamp, checklist rows, and symbols look modern, legible, and integrated into the square mobile-card design.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-402.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean food delivery app new-menu launch card news series, 5-slide square carousel set for social media and in-app promotion.
Designed to feel like a polished Instagram carousel and delivery-app campaign, combining appetizing spring food photography with practical order information, coupon cues, and page-by-page storytelling.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall format: {레이아웃}, consistent 12-column square grid, repeated top header bar, slide number badge, page dot indicator, and footer micro navigation across all slides.
- Main subject: {신메뉴명} presented as the hero menu item, photographed with realistic rice, spring greens, sesame, gochujang sauce, ceramic bowl, chopsticks, linen napkin, and small side dish details that naturally belong to a Korean meal scene.
- Background treatment: soft off-white paper grain, pale green and ivory panels, soft yellow highlight labels, hand-drawn herb doodles, subtle coupon perforation lines, app-card UI blocks, and food-safe tabletop textures.
- Information design: every slide includes a clear hierarchy with headline, supporting copy, small English subcopy when useful, price or benefit blocks, and realistic microcopy such as store handle, delivery label, event period, and CTA.
- Copy hierarchy: use {텍스트스타일}; main headline must be bold and readable, supporting lines smaller but crisp, with one hand-written accent phrase per slide at most.
- Narrative flow: follow {카드흐름} so the carousel reads as a sequential campaign from launch announcement to food appeal, offer explanation, coupon event, and final order action.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Slide 1 — Launch opener: large headline 신메뉴 OPEN for {신메뉴명}, top label {배달앱표기}, store name {브랜드명}, slide badge 01/05, date stamp {이벤트기간}, spring herb illustration, and page dots showing the first slide active.
2) Slide 2 — Hero food close-up: realistic plated {신메뉴명} in a ceramic bowl, glossy but natural ingredients, visible rice grains, fresh greens, soft boiled egg or seasonal garnish, small caption label 오늘의 봄맛, and slide badge 02/05 with page dots.
3) Slide 3 — Price / discount info: prominent price {가격}, discount block {할인혜택}, comparison-style benefit card, small delivery fee note, app-like rounded information tiles, divider lines, and slide badge 03/05.
4) Slide 4 — Coupon / event slide: coupon ticket graphic for {쿠폰명}, event period {이벤트기간}, usage note 첫 주문·포장 주문 가능, stamp-style visual accent, share/save micro icons, and slide badge 04/05.
5) Slide 5 — CTA close: strong 주문하기 button, {브랜드명} store card, address line {매장주소}, order deadline {주문마감}, hashtag strip {해시태그}, page indicator 05/05, and a final end-card CTA encouraging immediate ordering.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for main copy, 700 weight for headlines, 400–500 weight for body, 28–42px headline scale on 1024px canvas, small hand-drawn accent lettering only for seasonal emphasis.
- Color palette: spring green #7FB77E, ivory #F6F1E6, soft yellow #F2E4A1, deep herb green #2F5D50, warm gray #6E6A63, with occasional red-orange sauce accent #D95B3D.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px separators, rounded cards with 20px radius, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px at 12% opacity, coupon perforation details, UI-style pill buttons, and small sticker labels for price and event cues.
- Text styling: crisp Korean typography, balanced line breaks, short delivery-app microcopy, legible numerals and won symbols, natural hand-drawn accents, readable slide numbers, and consistent footer indicator placement.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio food photography look, 50mm macro at f/4 for close-up panels, top-down 35mm flat-lay feel for info panels, sharp but natural detail.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from right, controlled highlights on the food, realistic ceramic and sauce reflections, warm daylight tone.
- Color grade: fresh spring palette with light cream base, muted greens, pale yellow accents, appetizing herb contrast, and slightly desaturated shadows for app-friendly clarity.

[6. MOOD]
Fresh premium delivery-app editorial — like a modern spring food campaign with a clean commerce UI, warm neighborhood restaurant personality, coupon-card realism, and appetizing Korean home-meal styling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: 배달앱 신메뉴 출시 카드뉴스 시리즈, {신메뉴명}, 신메뉴 OPEN, 주문하기, {가격}, {할인혜택}, {쿠폰명}.
- 각 슬라이드에 01/05, 02/05, 03/05, 04/05, 05/05 중 해당 번호와 하단 페이지 도트를 정확히 넣고, 마지막 장에는 엔드카드 CTA 문구 지금 바로 주문하기를 포함한다.
- 실제 렌더링용 예시 문구를 함께 배치: {브랜드명}, {배달앱표기}, {이벤트기간}, {매장주소}, {주문마감}, {해시태그}.
- 모든 5장은 같은 디자인 시스템, 컬러 팔레트, UI 버튼 스타일, 푸터 위치, 음식 촬영 톤을 공유해야 한다.
- 음식은 자연스럽고 먹음직스럽게 보여야 하며, 밥알·나물·소스·고명 형태가 왜곡되지 않고 가격·쿠폰·CTA 텍스트가 선명해야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled pricing
- Celebrity / real-person composites

studio:prompts3:ours-401.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱 사장님이 고객 리뷰에 남기는 답글/인사 카드용 정사각형 소셜 이미지. 리뷰 감사, 재주문 환영, 생일 축하, 신메뉴 안내, 휴무 알림까지 모두 대응하는 따뜻한 손편지 스타일의 텍스트 카드이며, 실제 음식점에서 포장 봉투 위에 올려 촬영한 듯한 현실적인 감사 메모 비주얼로 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Create a 1:1 square card composition using {레이아웃}: a handwritten reply card placed on warm kraft paper or soft ivory paper, photographed as a realistic top-down stationery flat lay.
- The central message block occupies about 55-60% of the frame and must be the first readable element. Place {사장님 메시지} in the center or slightly upper-left, with natural handwritten line breaks.
- At the top, show {메시지 종류} as a small capsule label, receipt-style tag, or taped memo strip. Add tiny supporting text such as “오늘의 답글 카드”, “소중한 리뷰에 답장드려요”, “ORDER NOTE”, “주문 #A-142”, or “2026.05.01” to make it feel like a real restaurant reply card.
- Place {시그니처} at the lower-right as a small handwritten signature. Nearby, add tiny shop-note details such as “@hyemin_kitchen”, “다음 주문도 따뜻하게 준비할게요”, “배달완료 18:42”, or “Thank you note”.
- Enrich the card with natural restaurant-delivery details: a partial delivery receipt peeking from one edge, a kraft envelope corner, a small paper sticker, washi tape, faint sauce-safe paper texture, a soft coffee/tea ring, tiny heart or steam icons, and a small sketched bowl or spoon illustration.
- Keep the card warm and readable, with believable paper fibers, ink pressure, slight edge curl, subtle tape shadows, and small imperfections that make it feel genuinely handmade by a shop owner.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top label area (10-14%): Render {메시지 종류} in a small handwritten label or thin sans-serif capsule. Add a short date/order strip such as “2026년 5월 1일”, “리뷰 답글”, “주문 메모”, or “No. 0247” beside it. Use a thin dotted divider, masking tape strip, or receipt perforation line under the label.
- Main message area (52-60%): Render {사장님 메시지} as the largest text, using a legible handwritten brush-pen or neat memo style. Use warm charcoal or muted brown ink with slight natural ink spread. Let line spacing feel like a real note written on a card.
- Review context accents: Add a small five-star row “★★★★★”, a tiny caption “리뷰 남겨주셔서 감사합니다”, and a small speech-bubble tag like “단골 환영” or “다음에도 또 만나요” near the message without competing with it.
- Decorative micro-illustration area (corners and edges): Include small food-related doodles based on {비주얼}, such as a steaming bowl, rice spoon, coffee cup, dumpling, chicken box, cake slice, or new-menu sparkle icon. Add subtle heart stickers, star stamps, mini arrows, or hand-drawn underlines.
- Signature area (bottom 12-16%): Place {시그니처} as a handwritten sign-off at the lower-right. Add a tiny flourish, dot, short wave line, or small “사장님 드림” caption if it fits the theme.
- Background finishing: Use tactile kraft/ivory paper texture, visible paper fibers, faint fold marks, soft tape edges, receipt paper grain, warm ink bleed, and slight card shadow to make the image look photographed rather than generated.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard for small labels and receipt-style micro text, Nanum Myeongjo or a warm handwritten brush script for the main note. Use medium to bold weight for readability; header 28-36px equivalent, body 42-60px equivalent on 1024x1024, micro labels 14-22px equivalent.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}을 기준으로 kraft beige #D8C3A5, charcoal #2F2A28, warm amber #C97D3A, paper ivory #F6F1E8, muted brown #8A6A4F, soft blush #E9B8A6, faded green #9BAF8B.
- Border/shadow: Use a thin hand-drawn border in dark brown with slight irregularity, rounded memo-card corners, soft paper shadow 2px y-offset, 10px blur, 10-12% opacity, plus small realistic shadows from tape, stickers, receipt slips, or card edge curl.
- Text hierarchy: {사장님 메시지} must dominate. {메시지 종류} and added labels should support the story like real restaurant stationery details. {시그니처} should feel personal and signed by the owner.
- Graphic details: Use sticker-like tags, dotted dividers, small receipt snippets, short Korean captions, and hand-drawn icons in a warm local-shop style. Avoid corporate app UI; keep it like a physical note prepared for a delivery customer.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat lay look equivalent to a 50mm lens at f/4, clean studio product-photo framing with no distortion.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, visible paper texture, realistic contact shadows under card, tape, receipt, and stickers.
- Color grade: warm paper neutral with amber highlights, slightly desaturated browns, clean cream shadows, subtle analog stationery tone.
- Material realism: kraft paper fibers, ivory memo paper, matte sticker surface, faint receipt thermal-paper texture, natural ink grain, tiny pressure variations in handwriting.

[6. MOOD]
Independent café or neighborhood restaurant owner reply note — a warm delivery-app thank-you card photographed on a real packing table, combining Kinfolk editorial stationery, handmade shop packaging, and friendly Korean handwritten memo aesthetics.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Render {메시지 종류}, {사장님 메시지}, and {시그니처} clearly and exactly as the primary Korean text elements.
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear clearly and correctly when used in the image: “리뷰 감사 / 또는 재주문 환영·생일 축하·신메뉴 안내·휴무 알림”, “맛있게 드셔주셔서 감사합니다 ❤️ / 다음에도 또 뵐게요”, “혜민이네 사장 / 또는 손글씨 사인”.
- Additional small Korean details may include: “오늘의 답글 카드”, “소중한 리뷰 감사합니다”, “주문 #A-142”, “2026.05.01”, “배달완료 18:42”, “단골 환영”, “다음에도 또 만나요”.
- Handwritten text must remain legible, with no broken Korean characters or character reordering.
- Decorative food illustrations, stickers, receipt snippets, and tape details must support the handmade restaurant-card story and must not obscure the main message or signature.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity likeness or celebrity composites

args.default: 크라프트 베이지 + 차콜 + 따뜻한 amber, 손글씨 결

studio:prompts3:ours-400.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱 프로모션용 할인 쿠폰 카드, 1:1 정사각형 마케팅 그래픽.
앱 내 배너, 푸시 이미지, SNS 공유 썸네일로 바로 쓸 수 있는 고급형 쿠폰 비주얼이며, 실제 배달앱 캠페인에 노출되는 듯한 정보 밀도와 현실적인 종이·앱 UI 디테일을 포함한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main coupon card occupies about 78% of the frame, centered as the hero object while still allowing a realistic surrounding scene such as a warm ivory tabletop, soft paper receipt edge, delivery sticker, small sauce cup silhouette, or folded napkin corner to support the food-delivery context.
- Outer canvas uses a premium card presentation with a subtle off-white or light neutral background; add realistic paper grain, faint shadows, layered card thickness, and gentle depth so the coupon feels like a tangible printed/app promo asset.
- Use {레이아웃} to determine whether the card is slightly wider within the square or tightly centered as a compact coupon block.
- Typography and pricing elements should clearly separate headline, discount value, validity, conditions, coupon code, and app-style action cues.
- Include {쿠폰 종류}, {유효기간}, {조건}, {쿠폰 디자인}, {컬러 톤} as the content anchors inside the coupon layout.
- Add small realistic coupon details: app campaign label “DELIVERY COUPON”, issue code “COUPON NO. 0526-VIP”, a tiny barcode or QR-style area, a rounded “쿠폰 받기” button, and subtle microcopy such as “오늘 주문에 바로 적용”.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 18%): short promo title area with a bold coupon label and app-style category chip. Include Korean label text such as “5월 한정 쿠폰팩” and a small English kicker “DELIVERY BENEFIT”.
2. Main discount zone (middle 42%): emphasize {쿠폰 종류} with the largest type size; make the percentage or fixed discount amount the visual focal point. Place supporting short Korean blurbs nearby, for example “첫 주문 고객 전용”, “VIP 멤버십 혜택”, or “생일·재주문 보너스”.
3. Coupon form zone (middle-lower 22%): render {쿠폰 디자인} as a ticket-like shape with rounded corners, dotted or scissor-cut edge cues, perforation marks, layered paper thickness, a small barcode/QR block, and a clean separation from the background.
4. Validity zone (lower 10%): place {유효기간} in smaller but highly legible text, aligned for quick reading; add a small calendar icon-style mark and a date stamp treatment.
5. Conditions zone (bottom 8%): place {조건} as a compact footnote-style line with clear hierarchy, plus realistic fine print such as “앱 결제 시 자동 적용 · 중복 할인 불가” if space allows.
6. Bottom utility strip: include tiny app UI details such as “쿠폰함에 저장됨”, “D-7”, “1회 사용 가능”, and a pill button “지금 주문하기” while preserving the single-card composition.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main body, with extra-bold weight for the discount number and medium/regular weight for details; size hierarchy should feel like 42–64px headline, 18–24px subtext, 14–16px footnote on a 1024px canvas.
- Color palette: base on {컬러 톤}, with premium red (#C62828 / #D32F2F) and gold (#C9A227 / #D4AF37) accents, plus deep charcoal (#1F1F1F) for text and warm ivory (#F7F3EA) for background balance.
- Border/shadow: use a soft drop shadow with 0–6px y-offset, 18px blur, 12–15% opacity; coupon border should be crisp, with subtle inner padding, clean edge definition, realistic rounded-corner paper thickness, and tactile print texture.
- Decorative details may include thin dividers, tiny delivery-route dotted lines, subtle confetti dots, receipt-like numbering, membership badge shapes, and small food delivery icons, all secondary to readability.
- Keep the design premium and realistic: the card should look like a polished retail coupon photographed or rendered for a real app campaign rather than a blank template.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product-card look, simulated as if shot on a Canon EOS R5 with a 50mm f/1.8 at f/4 for a clean editorial render, no extreme perspective.
- Lighting: softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, controlled paper highlights, visible but soft contact shadows under the coupon and surrounding small props.
- Color grade: premium retail promo grade with warm ivory, saturated red, restrained gold, and slightly desaturated neutrals for an upscale membership-coupon feel.
- Material rendering: semi-matte coated paper, slight embossed gold accent on badge/divider areas, crisp ink edges, subtle surface fibers, and realistic print contrast.

[6. MOOD]
Luxury membership promotion graphic — feels like an Aesop-style retail card mixed with a high-end food delivery app campaign visual, with enough coupon-code, date, barcode, and app-action details to feel usable and real.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly and without distortion: “첫주문 30% 할인”, “VIP 5,000원”, “생일·재주문·친구 추천”, “2026.05.31 까지 / 1회 사용 가능”, “최소 주문 12,000원 이상 / 일부 메뉴 제외”.
- Additional Korean text may appear as realistic supporting copy, such as “5월 한정 쿠폰팩”, “쿠폰 받기”, “지금 주문하기”, “앱 결제 시 자동 적용”, “오늘 주문에 바로 적용”, and “D-7”.
- Layout invariants: coupon card must remain a clear single-card composition, with strong hierarchy from discount to validity to conditions.
- Keep all Korean characters crisp, fully legible, and correctly spaced.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-399.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱용 가격 강조 프로모션 카드. {메뉴명}의 정가·할인가·단독가를 한 화면에서 즉시 비교하게 만드는 1:1 정사각형 광고 비주얼로, 실제 배달앱 홈 배너, 매장 상세 페이지, 푸시 광고 소재에 바로 들어갈 만큼 풍부한 음식 디테일과 구매 유도 정보를 포함한다. 가격 숫자, 할인 조건, 매장 신뢰 정보, 주문 CTA가 동시에 읽히는 고전환 모바일 커머스 카드로 제작한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {메뉴명}를 음식 hero로 크게 보여주고, 가격 정보가 시선을 바로 끌도록 우선 배치한다. 윤기, 김, 소스 질감, 밥알, 고명, 반찬, 수저, 배달 용기 뚜껑, 종이 포장 띠, 작은 영수증 조각까지 실제 촬영된 배달 프로모션처럼 자연스럽게 표현한다.
- Layout: {레이아웃} 구성을 따르되, 음식 영역은 전체 프레임의 약 45~55%, 가격 영역은 25~35% 비중으로 설계한다. 나머지 영역에는 {매장명}, 배달 정보, 쿠폰 조건, 리뷰 점수, 주문 수, CTA 버튼, 작은 앱 탭 UI를 배치해 실제 앱 화면의 밀도를 만든다.
- Background: {컬러톤}을 기반으로 한 선명한 단색 또는 약한 그라데이션 배경 위에 종이 쿠폰, 앱 카드 패널, 라운드 가격 스티커, 얇은 속도선, 별/번개/장바구니 아이콘, 점선 쿠폰 절취선, 작은 말풍선 라벨을 더해 상업 광고의 생동감을 만든다.
- Text hierarchy: 화면에서 가장 큰 문자는 {할인가}와 “단독가” 계열 텍스트가 되게 하고, {정가}는 빨간 취소선으로 작게 처리한다. {할인율}, {할인모드}, {쿠폰문구}, {배달정보}는 보조 배지나 캡슐 UI로 묶어 가격 계층을 방해하지 않게 붙인다.
- Flexible placeholders: {메뉴명}, {정가}, {할인가}, {할인율}, {할인모드}, {매장명}, {쿠폰문구}, {배달정보}, {리뷰정보}, {지역라벨}, {CTA문구}, {비주얼}, {컬러톤}, {레이아웃}

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero food zone: {메뉴명}을 먹음직스럽게 중앙 또는 좌측에 크게 배치하고, 접시 가장자리, 밥과 메인 토핑, 반찬 구성, 소스 윤기, 김이 살짝 올라오는 느낌까지 선명하게 보이게 만든다. 음식 아래에는 배달앱 카드처럼 둥근 그림자와 얕은 테이블 표면감을 넣고, 한쪽에는 젓가락, 작은 단무지 컵, 미니 국물 용기, 배달 봉투 모서리를 자연스럽게 배치한다.
2. Price block: “정가 {정가}”를 작게 취소선 처리하고, “회원가 {할인가}” 또는 “배달앱 단독가 {할인가}”를 가장 큰 숫자로 강조한다. 가격 옆에는 {할인율} 스티커를 붙이고, “쿠폰 적용 완료”, “오늘 점심 특가”, “주문 많은 메뉴” 같은 판매 문구를 작게 추가한다.
3. Discount cue: {할인모드} 문구는 작은 배지 또는 캡슐 형태로 붙여 “첫주문”, “회원가”, “한정”, “점심 11~14시” 같은 조건을 빠르게 읽히게 한다. 배지 주변에는 노란 쿠폰 조각, 빨간 알림 핀, 검정색 굵은 라벨을 조합해 배달앱 세일 감성을 강화한다.
4. Store and delivery credibility: 상단 또는 하단 앱 UI 영역에 {매장명}, {리뷰정보}, {배달정보}, {지역라벨}을 넣는다. 예: “리뷰 4.8”, “도착 28~38분”, “배달팁 0원”, “서울 마포구 배달 가능”, “최근 주문 1,240+”처럼 실제 앱에서 보이는 보조 정보를 작은 글씨와 아이콘으로 구성한다.
5. CTA and coupon panel: 하단에는 둥근 사각형 CTA 버튼을 만들고 {CTA문구}를 넣는다. 버튼 주변에는 {쿠폰문구}, “최소주문 12,000원”, “쿠폰 코드 LUNCH99”, “오늘 14:00 종료” 같은 실제 주문 조건을 카드형 패널이나 영수증 라벨로 배치한다.
6. Visual emphasis: {비주얼} 방향에 맞춰 정가에는 빨간 strike-through, 할인가는 고대비의 굵은 숫자, 추가 혜택은 작은 보조 텍스트로 계층을 나눈다. 숫자는 음식보다 앞 레이어에 떠 있는 스티커처럼 보이되, 음식의 윤기와 온기가 가려지지 않도록 한다.
7. Color system: {컬러톤}을 기준으로 강한 대비를 유지하되, 숫자와 할인 라벨이 배경에 묻히지 않도록 명도 차를 크게 둔다. 음식의 따뜻한 갈색·붉은 양념색과 배너의 red/yellow 포인트가 연결되게 조정한다.
8. Layout balance: {레이아웃}의 정보 흐름이 끊기지 않도록 음식 → 정가 → 할인가 → 할인 조건 → 주문 버튼 순서로 읽히게 정렬한다. 상단에는 “오늘의 한끼”, “배달앱 단독가”, “BEST 1”, “찜 2.3만” 같은 작은 앱 UI 정보를 넣어 실제 배달 프로모션 카드의 현실감을 높인다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for main price, Pretendard Bold for sub labels, Noto Sans KR Medium for discount tags; price size should dominate the frame like a retail promo banner. Add compact Korean microcopy in smaller weights for store info, delivery estimate, rating, coupon notes, order count, address label, and CTA.
- Color palette: {컬러톤}을 바탕으로 vivid red #FF2D2D, yellow #FFD400, black #111111, white #FFFFFF를 조합해 강한 배달앱 세일 느낌을 만든다. Food tones should remain appetizing with warm browns, glossy reds, fresh green garnish, natural rice whites, and subtle steam highlights.
- Border/shadow: 숫자와 배지에는 2~4px soft shadow, 10~14px blur, 15~20% opacity를 주고, 필요한 경우 얇은 검은 외곽선을 더해 가독성을 확보한다. App-card panels can use rounded corners, subtle bevel highlights, sticker-like coupon edges, receipt-paper texture, perforated coupon lines, and layered drop shadows for a tangible commercial graphic feel.
- UI realism: 실제 모바일 배달앱 광고처럼 상단 작은 상태 라벨, 매장명 줄, 별점 아이콘, 도착 시간 아이콘, 쿠폰 다운로드 아이콘, 장바구니 버튼, 회색 보조 설명 텍스트를 포함한다. 텍스트는 모두 읽을 수 있는 한국어로 렌더링하고, 주요 가격과 CTA는 손가락으로 누를 수 있을 만큼 크게 보이게 한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm standard food photography look, f/3.5, slight top-front angle for the food hero; text and graphics remain crisp like a commercial key visual.
- Lighting: studio softbox from upper-left at 45° with controlled fill from right, high-contrast specular highlights on food, no blown-out whites. Add believable reflections on sauce, bowl rim, plastic delivery lid edge, glossy sticker badges, and CTA button surface.
- Color grade: vivid commercial grade with saturated reds and yellows, deep blacks, bright whites, clear contrast, and punchy delivery-app advertising finish. Keep the food warm and realistic while the graphic UI feels bold, clean, and clickable.

[6. MOOD]
Fast-food delivery promotion key visual — Korean app banner energy with supermarket sale typography, bold coupon-ad urgency, realistic hot-meal photography, lively sticker graphics, and tappable mobile commerce UI details. The overall mood should feel like a limited-time lunch deal that users would instantly understand and want to order.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: rendered text must include exactly these strings where applicable: “제육덮밥 정식”, “13,000”, “9,900”, “24% OFF”, “첫주문”, “회원가”, “한정”, “점심 11~14시”.
- Add realistic small Korean UI text such as “오늘의 한끼”, “배달앱 단독가”, “쿠폰 적용가”, “배달팁 0원”, “리뷰 4.8”, “도착 28~38분”, “지금 주문하기”, “서울 마포구 배달 가능”, “최근 주문 1,240+”, “최소주문 12,000원”, “쿠폰 코드 LUNCH99”, “오늘 14:00 종료” without overpowering the main price.
- Price readability: the struck-through original price and the discounted price must be clearly distinguishable at a glance, with {할인가} as the largest text element.
- Layout invariant: 1:1 square composition, with one dominant food hero and one dominant price block, optimized for 1024x1024 mobile feed visibility.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or impersonation-style faces
- Misleading medical, legal, or government-style endorsement marks
