studio:prompts3:ours-398.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱용 매장·주방 신뢰 컷, 1:1 정사각형 비주얼로 매장의 청결감, 실제 조리 신뢰도, 포장 운영 흐름을 한눈에 전달하는 실사형 이미지.
상세한 조리 디테일, 실제 운영 중인 주방의 활기, 정돈된 매장 인테리어, 주문 확인과 포장 준비 장면이 함께 보이도록 구성해 앱 썸네일, 매장 소개, 신뢰 배너, 신규 입점 홍보 컷에 바로 쓰기 좋게 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 화면 중심은 {매장 장면}이 차지하고, 주요 시선은 조리대와 핵심 작업 구역에 먼저 머물도록 60% 내외의 비중으로 배치.
- 배경은 실제 배달 매장처럼 보이도록 주방 벽면, 스테인리스 선반, 우드 포인트, 화이트 타일, 작은 메뉴판, 주문 영수증 레일, 포장용 종이백, 소스통, 태블릿 주문 화면을 자연스럽게 포함한다.
- 전경에는 깨끗한 조리대, 정돈된 도구, 신선 식재료, 반쯤 열린 재료 트레이, 작은 계량컵, 완성 접시 또는 포장 용기가 이어지도록 해 운영감과 신뢰감을 동시에 전달.
- {비주얼 디테일}은 포컬 포인트로 넣고, 손·도구·재료의 관계가 명확히 보이도록 구성한다. 예: 집게로 채소를 올리는 손, 팬 가장자리의 윤기, 소스가 담긴 작은 스푼, 칼 옆의 가지런한 야채, 포장 용기에 붙은 라벨.
- 전체 프레이밍은 정사각형에서 안정적인 중앙 집중형 구도이며, 상단에는 작은 매장 사인 또는 메뉴 보드가 읽히고 하단에는 재료와 조리대 질감, 포장 준비 디테일이 풍부하게 보이도록 설계.
- 우측 또는 후면 벽에는 매장 신뢰 정보를 담은 작은 안내 카드와 영수증 클립을 배치한다. 카드에는 {매장명}, {매장 주소}, {매장 연락처}, {대표 메뉴}, {포장 문구}가 실제 매장 인쇄물처럼 보이게 들어간다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area (middle 55%): {매장 장면}을 중심으로 배치하되, 얼굴이 필요 없는 경우에는 셰프의 손, 집게, 팬, 칼, 접시, 포장 용기 같은 도구 중심으로 표현해 위생적이고 전문적인 인상을 강화.
- Detail layer (foreground 20%): {비주얼 디테일}을 앞쪽에 선명하게 두어 재료의 신선함, 표면의 질감, 조리대의 청결 상태가 바로 읽히도록 구성. 야채의 물기, 고기 결, 소스의 점도, 스테인리스 반사, 우드 결이 실제 촬영처럼 보이게 한다.
- Environment layer (background 25%): 주방 후면은 스테인리스, 우드, 화이트 타일, 정돈된 선반, 작은 칠판 메뉴, 주문서 클립, 포장 스테이션 중 여러 요소를 현실적으로 배치한다. 선반에는 소스병, 깨끗한 접시 더미, 라벨이 붙은 재료통, 테이크아웃 컵과 종이백이 보이게 한다.
- Text & signage layer: 작은 메뉴판, 주문 보드, 포장 라벨, 태블릿 주문 화면에 실제 매장용 한국어 정보를 넣는다. 예: “{매장명}”, “오늘 조리”, “{대표 메뉴}”, “수제소스 추가 ₩1,000”, “주문번호 {주문번호}”, “포장 완료 {포장시간}”, “{포장 문구}”, “원산지 안내”, “배달앱 매장·주방 신뢰 컷”. 텍스트는 배경 속 사인과 라벨처럼 자연스럽게 보이게 한다.
- Menu/pricelist layer: 벽면 미니 메뉴판에는 4개 내외의 메뉴와 가격을 포함한다. “직화덮밥 ₩9,500”, “닭갈비덮밥 ₩10,500”, “구운야채 추가 ₩2,000”, “수제소스 추가 ₩1,000”처럼 실제 배달 매장 메뉴판의 가격 체계를 반영한다.
- Trust operation layer: 주문 영수증 레일에는 “주문번호 {주문번호}”, “요청사항: 덜 맵게”, “픽업 예정 12:25” 같은 작은 운영 문구가 보이고, 포장 봉투에는 “안심 포장”, “뜨거움 주의”, “감사합니다” 라벨이 붙어 있게 한다.
- Tone bridge: {컬러 톤}을 전체 톤의 기준으로 적용해 재료색이 탁해지지 않게 하고, 음식과 공간의 색 대비가 또렷하게 드러나도록 조정.
- Light emphasis: {라이팅}을 조리대 상단과 재료 표면에 집중시켜 윤기, 수분감, 청결한 반사를 살리고, 팬·칼·스테인리스 트레이의 하이라이트가 실제 주방 조명처럼 보이게 한다.
- Camera framing: {카메라·렌즈} 기준의 얕은 심도로 전경 디테일을 선명히 하고 배경은 자연스럽게 깊이를 갖게 하며, 실제 매장 촬영처럼 보이되 과한 연출감은 피함.
- Format handling: {비율}에 맞춰 중앙의 조리 구역과 상단 매장 사인, 하단 포장 디테일이 잘리지 않도록 구성하고, 앱 썸네일에서도 핵심 정보가 즉시 읽히는 안정적인 레이아웃 유지.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 이미지 내 텍스트가 들어간다면 Pretendard SemiBold 또는 Noto Sans KR Bold를 기준으로, 작은 정보는 22~28px, 핵심 제목은 34~42px 수준의 단단한 산세리프 스타일. 메뉴판과 주문 영수증의 작은 글씨는 실제 인쇄물처럼 약간의 잉크 번짐과 종이 질감을 허용.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}을 바탕으로 wood brown, clean white, charcoal gray, stainless silver, fresh green 포인트를 사용하고, 음식 재료의 빨강·초록·노랑은 신선하게 보이되 전체 상업 사진 톤과 조화롭게 유지.
- Border/shadow: 필요 시 소프트 드롭 섀도우를 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity 수준으로만 사용해 인위적인 광고 합성 느낌을 줄임. 메뉴판, 영수증, 작은 라벨은 실제 조명에 따른 자연 그림자를 갖게 한다.
- Surface treatment: 조리대는 매트한 우드 또는 무광 스테인리스 느낌으로, 관리가 잘 된 표면의 미세한 사용감과 재질감을 유지한다. 타일 줄눈, 선반 모서리, 칼날 반사, 용기 라벨, 종이 봉투 접힘, 주문 영수증의 열전사 질감 등 세부 묘사를 살린다.
- Real-world props: 위생 장갑, 행주, 깨끗한 트레이, 라벨 스티커, 포장 박스, 종이백, 영수증, 작은 타이머, 원산지 안내 카드, 온도계, 태블릿 주문 화면 같은 실제 매장 소품을 자연스럽게 포함해 신뢰도를 높인다.
- App thumbnail readability: 작은 화면에서도 매장명, 대표 메뉴, 조리 장면, 포장 흐름이 한 번에 읽히도록 밝은 조리대와 진한 메뉴판의 대비를 살리고, 텍스트는 실제 사물 위에 인쇄된 형태로 배치한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Sony A7R V, 35mm f/1.4, ISO 400, f/2.8 느낌의 실사 촬영, 자연스러운 공간감과 음식 디테일이 함께 살아나는 스냅-에디토리얼 톤.
- Lighting: 자연광 + 주방 펜던트 조명 조합, 창가 쪽에서 들어오는 부드러운 확산광과 상부 조명의 따뜻한 amber 빛이 섞인 구조, 하이라이트는 깨끗하게, 그림자는 얇게.
- Color grade: warm wood + clean white + charcoal base에 약한 amber highlight와 muted green accent를 섞어, 위생적이면서도 식욕을 자극하는 절제된 상업 사진 톤.
- Texture fidelity: 음식 표면의 수분감, 야채 단면, 소스 광택, 스테인리스의 은은한 스크래치, 우드 조리대의 결, 종이 영수증의 섬유질, 포장 봉투의 매트한 종이 질감이 실사처럼 표현되도록 한다.

[6. MOOD]
Indie restaurant editorial — Bon Appétit 스튜디오 푸드 촬영과 Aesop 매장 인테리어가 섞인 듯한, 정갈하고 신뢰감 있는 배달앱 비주얼. 실제 점심 피크 직전의 깨끗한 주방, 막 조리한 음식, 태블릿으로 들어온 주문, 라벨이 붙은 포장 용기, 픽업 대기 종이백이 차분하게 이어지는 따뜻한 운영 현장.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 이미지에는 다음 한국어 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: “배달앱 매장·주방 신뢰 컷”, “{매장명}”, “오늘 조리”, “{대표 메뉴}”, “수제소스 추가 ₩1,000”, “주문번호 {주문번호}”, “포장 완료 {포장시간}”, “{포장 문구}”, “원산지 안내”, “{매장 주소}”, “{매장 연락처}”.
- 벽면 미니 메뉴판 또는 카운터 카드에는 “직화덮밥 ₩9,500”, “닭갈비덮밥 ₩10,500”, “구운야채 추가 ₩2,000”, “수제소스 추가 ₩1,000”이 실제 가격표처럼 자연스럽게 배치되어야 함.
- 손이 등장하면 손가락 수는 모두 자연스럽고 정확해야 하며, 과장된 관절 왜곡이나 비정상적인 손 모양이 없어야 함.
- 조리도구, 접시, 식재료, 포장 용기, 메뉴판, 영수증, 태블릿 주문 화면은 실제 크기 비례를 지키고, 청결한 운영 공간처럼 보여야 함.
- 배달앱용 신뢰 컷이므로 실제 매장 사진처럼 자연스러운 조리 순간을 유지하고, 과한 연기, 과장된 미식 광고 표현, 비현실적 증기 연출은 피함.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- 한글 깨짐 또는 읽을 수 없는 한국어 문자
- 가짜 공식 인증 마크, 공공기관 직인, 허위 위생 인증서
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean delivery-app food close-up, mukbang/insta-food tone, texture-forward square hero image for menu browsing.
Create a real photographed menu hero that feels freshly delivered, hot, glossy, and ready to eat, with believable tabletop context, appetizing details, and social-share impact.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main dish occupies about 85–90% of the frame, shot at a slight oblique 45° angle so the food surface, height, steam, and sauce texture are all visible.
- {메뉴} is the clear hero subject, centered or slightly off-center according to {구도·앵글}, with the most delicious bite area placed on the strongest focal point.
- Surround the dish with realistic delivery-food context: a warm tabletop, partial takeout tray or ceramic plate edge, a small sauce cup, chopsticks or spoon partly entering the frame, a folded napkin, and a subtle delivery receipt/sticker near one corner.
- Use {구도·앵글} as the framing logic, keeping the dish dominant edge-to-edge while allowing natural foreground and background details that make the image feel like an authentic Korean delivery-app photo.
- Include small signs of freshness and scale: tiny sesame grains, scallion pieces, chili flakes, oil sheen, condensation on packaging, sauce drips on the rim, or steam wisps where appropriate to {메뉴}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero food area: {메뉴} presented as the dominant focal object, with appetizing plate/bowl/tray edges, visible depth, and a clearly readable serving volume.
- Texture highlight layer: {식감 효과} emphasized across the most appetizing surface zones, especially where cheese, sauce, crispy crust, broth, steam, or gloss naturally catches light.
- Delivery context layer: add a small paper receipt or sticker with short Korean text such as '오늘의 인기 메뉴', '리뷰 4.9', '따뜻할 때 드세요', and a tiny time label like '18:42 픽업완료'; keep it secondary and partially cropped if needed.
- Tabletop realism: include believable surface grain, ceramic shine, paper fibers, foil crinkles, sauce droplets, crumbs, sesame seeds, and subtle utensil reflections.
- Shadow and separation: subject lifted from the background with a controlled contact shadow under the dish and natural occlusion from utensils or packaging, not a dramatic cutout, to preserve realism.
- App-thumbnail readability: maintain a strong central food read at small size, with the highest contrast and sharpest texture on the hero bite area.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if a receipt, delivery sticker, or small label appears, use Pretendard SemiBold 24–32px for Korean text, clean black ink on off-white paper or white ink on a small dark label; text must look printed or sticker-like, not floating over the food.
- Optional Korean microcopy on props: '오늘의 인기 메뉴', '리뷰 4.9', '따뜻할 때 드세요', '배달완료', '주문번호 247'. Keep these small, realistic, and secondary.
- Color palette: deep red #B3262E, cheese yellow #F4D35E, warm brown #6B3F2A, charcoal #1F1F1F, neutral cream #F6F1E8; align overall tone with {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: natural tabletop contact shadow, soft reflections on sauce and ceramic, and layered depth from utensils, packaging, or garnish; no graphic frame treatment is required.
- Food styling: emphasize abundant portions, fresh garnish, glossy sauce, crisp edges, melted or stretched elements, and slight asymmetry that makes the dish feel real rather than studio-perfect.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Hasselblad X2D 100c, 90mm f/2.5, f/2.8, tight close-up with shallow depth of field and crisp focal plane on the most textured bite area.
- Lighting: {라이팅}; strong key light from upper-left at about 45°, with a small warm fill from front-right to keep steam, gloss, sauce highlights, crispy texture, and cheese strands readable.
- Color grade: high-contrast food editorial grade with rich reds, molten yellows, warm browns, creamy highlights, and slightly deepened shadows; preserve natural saturation without neon overshoot.
- Depth of field: shallow but physically believable, with the primary bite area tack sharp and secondary props gently softened, as if captured for a premium delivery-app listing.
- Material realism: sauce viscosity, oil glints, char marks, crispy crumbs, melted cheese, steam haze, condensation, ceramic glaze, paper receipt fibers, and utensil reflections should all feel photographic.

[6. MOOD]
Premium delivery-food editorial — similar to a high-end mukbang thumbnail with Eat This, Not That-level punch and a cinematic Korean food-photography finish.
The image should feel hot, generous, craveable, and freshly opened on a real table right before eating.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: any visible Korean text must be short and correctly formed, such as '오늘의 인기 메뉴', '리뷰 4.9', '따뜻할 때 드세요', '배달완료', or '주문번호 247'.
- Anatomy/layout invariants: the dish must remain the hero; cheese stretch, steam, sauce flow, crispy edges, garnish placement, and highlight reflections must look physically plausible, with no broken food shapes or duplicate mains.
- Preserve {메뉴}, {식감 효과}, {구도·앵글}, {라이팅}, {카메라·렌즈}, {컬러 톤}, and {비율} as the controlling inputs for subject, texture, framing, lighting, equipment intent, palette, and square composition.
- The final image must read instantly as a Korean delivery-app food close-up at 1024x1024, with rich real-world context and appetizing texture detail.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness
- AI-smooth plastic food texture

studio:prompts3:ours-396.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱 추천/랭킹 라벨 카드 디자인. 1:1 정사각형 상품 썸네일로 바로 쓰일 수 있는, 음식 hero + BEST/추천/별점 배지 + 실제 주문 정보가 함께 보이는 매대형 비주얼.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Food hero centered and occupies about 58–65% of the frame, with {음식 히어로} as the main subject, crisp cutout edges, realistic sauce gloss, steam detail, and natural plate shadow.
- Place {라벨 문구} as 1–2 floating badge elements near the top-left and top-right, slightly overlapping the hero edge while keeping the main food readable.
- Add a compact store-info strip near the lower area with {매장명}, {가격 정보}, {배달 정보}, and {보조 카피} so the thumbnail feels like a real delivery-app menu card.
- Background uses {배경 표면} with tactile food-photography context such as subtle wood grain, parchment sheet, sesame flakes, chopsticks, small sauce dish, or folded napkin where appropriate.
- Use {레이아웃} as the guiding structure so the composition feels like an app-ready promotional card rather than a full poster.
- The overall framing should feel compact and thumbnail-friendly, with the label hierarchy, rating, price, and store name clearly visible at small size.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Base layer: build a {배경 표면} surface with realistic tabletop texture, soft contact shadows, a faint app-card panel, and small culinary context elements that support the food category.
- Hero layer: place {음식 히어로} at center with photoreal food detail, visible grains/sauce/meat texture, natural garnish, heat sheen, and a slightly elevated product-shot presentation.
- Primary label layer: render {라벨 문구} as bold badge chips with rounded geometry, positioned at the upper corners or slightly overlapping the hero edge.
- Secondary info layer: add rating and ordering cues such as “⭐ 5.0”, “리뷰 2,483”, “BEST 1위”, “사장님 추천”, “오늘만 할인” as small readable UI-style tags.
- Store strip layer: include {매장명}, {가격 정보}, {배달 정보}, and {보조 카피} in a lower caption bar or pill-shaped info panel with dividers and small icons.
- Accent layer: use {라벨 스타일} to define the badge finish, such as glossy red sticker, warm gold medal tone, embossed reward ribbon, or flat delivery-app UI chip styling.
- Finish layer: apply a market-card polish that feels like an ordering app recommendation tile, with strong food contrast, legible Hangul, natural shadows, and satisfying commercial realism.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, extra bold for badge text, 28–44px equivalent on a 1024px canvas, tight letter spacing, crisp anti-aliased edges; store and delivery info in medium-weight 18–26px equivalent.
- Color palette: use the tones implied by {컬러 톤}, anchored by vivid red, warm gold, clean white, deep charcoal text, realistic food browns, and appetizing garnish greens.
- Badge detail: primary badge should have a strong silhouette, high-contrast white or cream lettering, subtle highlight, inner shadow, and optional small star/crown/check icon.
- UI detail: lower information strip should include small dividers, rounded chips, rating star, review count, delivery time icon, and price emphasis without imitating any specific real app interface.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for badges; food shadow should be tighter and more realistic, with warm tabletop bounce light.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm product photography look, f/4, slightly elevated front angle for a clean menu-card presentation.
- Lighting: soft studio softbox from upper-left with gentle fill from right, controlled specular highlights on sauce, rice grains, glazed meat, and badge surfaces.
- Color grade: photoreal food tones with saturated red-gold accents, neutral whites, and slightly warm contrast for app-thumbnail clarity.
- Rendering quality: high-resolution commercial food photography composite, sharp foreground food texture, readable UI typography, realistic layered shadows, and polished delivery-commerce design.

[6. MOOD]
Commercial delivery-app promo card — friendly, appetizing, high-conversion Korean food thumbnail with reward badges, rating labels, price cues, and a modern online-ordering feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render all visible Korean strings cleanly and legibly, including “BEST 1위”, “사장님 추천”, “⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5.0 만점”, “리뷰 2,483”, “오늘만 할인”, “한정”, “NEW”, {매장명}, {가격 정보}, {배달 정보}, and {보조 카피}.
- The food hero must remain centered and readable even when 1–2 badges overlap the upper corners.
- Badge text must be fully intact, with no broken Hangul, warped strokes, clipped edges, or unreadable star-rating symbols.
- Composition must preserve the app-card hierarchy: food first, recommendation labels second, store/rating/price information third.
- The final image should look like a believable Korean delivery menu thumbnail, not a generic sticker sheet or abstract label mockup.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Overly glossy AI-smooth food textures

studio:prompts3:ours-395.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a realistic, content-rich delivery-app set/combo menu visual for a 1:1 square product detail image and app thumbnail.
The image should make {세트명} feel like a generous, high-value 3-item combo, combining appetizing commercial food photography with a practical Korean delivery-app menu card.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: A hero food arrangement for {세트명}, showing 3 clearly identifiable menu components from {구성} as a complete set deal.
- Placement: The three foods occupy about 70% of the frame with strong appetizing scale; the price and discount information {가격·할인} sits in a separate right-lower information panel, readable like a delivery-app purchase card.
- Background: Use {배경} with realistic tabletop material, warm cloth texture, printed order-paper details, sauce shine, condensation on the cola, and subtle crumbs or sesame details that naturally belong in a food shoot.
- Framing direction: Square front-facing composition with a slight 15° top-down flat-lay angle, keeping the set visually organized while still feeling like a real photographed menu scene.
- Text placement: Place {세트명} in the top 12% header; place {구성}, {가격·할인}, store information, delivery details, and small menu/pricelist snippets in structured UI-style boxes at the bottom and right side.
- Visual ratio: Follow {비율}; balance large food photography with readable app-style information without making the image look empty.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero food area: Arrange 떡볶이 1인분, 김밥 1줄, 콜라 350ml as three distinct components, forming a visual triangle that reads as one complete combo. Use {비주얼 구성} to guide garnish, serving vessels, and appetizing detail.
2) Center emphasis: Put the most substantial main bowl or plate in the central 45% area, with glossy red sauce, visible rice cakes, fish cake slices, scallions, sesame, and steam cues. Place the kimbap and cola slightly lower or to the side for depth and balance.
3) Price label area: Put {가격·할인} inside a red/yellow emphasis box with a clear comparison layout, such as “단품 합계” and “세트가”, using large numeric contrast and a small coupon tag.
4) Supporting details: Display {구성} as a concise Korean subtext near the food or in the bottom info bar, supported by small icons or dividers for “떡볶이”, “김밥”, “콜라”.
5) Delivery-app information: Add realistic Korean UI/menu details including “오늘분식”, “리뷰 4.8”, “찜 2,431”, “배달팁 ₩2,000”, “예상 25–35분”, “최소주문 ₩10,000”, and a small orange button reading “담기”.
6) Menu/pricelist snippet: Include a small side list with 3–4 additional items and prices, for example “참치김밥 ₩4,500”, “치즈떡볶이 ₩6,500”, “튀김모둠 ₩5,000”, “순대 ₩4,500”, separated by decorative thin dividers.
7) Store/contact footer: Add a compact footer line with “서울 마포구 배달로 24”, “02-1234-5678”, and “영업 10:30–22:30” like a real store card.
8) Background finish: Blend bright tabletop photography with printed receipt paper, a small takeout napkin, wooden chopsticks sleeve, sauce cup, and delivery sticker details, keeping all props secondary to the food and text hierarchy.
9) Header text area: Put {세트명} in a bold Korean header, with a small badge such as “인기 세트” or “오늘의 콤보” and a short feature line “든든하게 한 번에”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for {세트명}, Pretendard SemiBold for {구성}, Pretendard ExtraBold for {가격·할인}; header 34–42px, body 20–26px, numeric price larger and heavier. Use small UI microtext at 11–14px for store and delivery details.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, warm wood #D8B98A, off-white #F6F1E8, accent red #E53935, accent yellow #FFC400, dark brown #3A2A1F, guided by {컬러 톤} for the overall mood.
- Border/shadow: Use rounded app-card panels with 8px radius, soft drop shadow 0px 8px 20px 12% opacity, a crisp 1.5px outline on the price box, and subtle inner highlights on coupon and button elements.
- Food styling: Make sauce glossy but natural, rice grains and seaweed texture visible on kimbap, cola label area generic and readable as soda without fake official branding requirements, with condensation droplets for freshness.
- Graphic details: Add small delivery-app style icons, dotted dividers, coupon corner cuts, rating star, quantity marker “3종 구성”, and a barcode-like order strip or receipt number such as “ORDER 0526-247” as realistic supporting elements.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm prime look, f/4.0, top-down to slight 15° angle, commercial food photography framing.
- Lighting: Soft studio softbox from upper-left at 45°, subtle fill from right, crisp highlights on glossy sauce and cola bottle, natural shadows under bowls and paper props, no harsh specular clipping.
- Color grade: Clean warm-neutral grade with saturated food reds, controlled yellows, and slightly desaturated background whites to keep the set premium, appetizing, and readable.
- Material realism: Show ceramic bowl rim, paper menu card fiber, wood grain, napkin folds, plastic cup/bottle reflections, sesame, scallion, sauce thickness, and gentle steam or warmth cues.

[6. MOOD]
A clean but lively Korean delivery-app food card — modern fast-food menu board, realistic tabletop product photography, and premium catalog page combined into one appetizing square thumbnail.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: The following text must appear exactly and legibly:
  - {세트명}
  - {구성}
  - {가격·할인}
- Additional Korean text should look realistic and short, such as “오늘분식”, “인기 세트”, “오늘의 콤보”, “리뷰 4.8”, “배달팁 ₩2,000”, “예상 25–35분”, “담기”, “영업 10:30–22:30”.
- Layout invariants: All 3 food items must be visible in one frame, price information must not overlap the food, and the hierarchy between set name, composition, discount, and delivery details must be immediately clear.
- The visual must clearly communicate a combo/set deal with a strong value proposition while still feeling like a real photographed delivery-app menu image.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-394.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean delivery-app promotional banner for {이벤트 타입}: new menu launch, discount event, OPEN notice, or limited-time campaign. Designed for main feed placement with a bold real food hero, oversized Korean copy, coupon-like retail information, and high-click-through mobile commerce advertising feel.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero food placement: the {비주얼} occupies the left or center 55% of the frame, photographed like a real delivery menu hero with glossy sauce, steam, sesame, garnish, packaging edges, plate or tray details, crisp cutout separation, and a believable soft shadow.
- Copy hierarchy: {메인 카피} is the dominant headline across the upper or right third, with {가격·할인} placed directly below as a prominent price block shaped like a coupon, sticker, or sale tag.
- Time and event info: {기간} sits in a compact ribbon, badge, or corner label with clear contrast and tight padding, supported by small Korean helper copy such as '오늘 주문 가능', '앱 전용 혜택', or '재고 소진 시 종료'.
- Retail detail layer: include realistic delivery-banner information such as store name '맛있는분식 본점', small rating row '★ 4.8 리뷰 2,341', delivery note '배달팁 0원 쿠폰', coupon code 'NEW9900', and CTA button text '지금 주문하기'.
- Background treatment: vivid promotional backdrop using {컬러 톤}, with layered gradient, halftone dots, paper-coupon texture, burst shapes, arrows, sparkles, motion lines, and small sticker labels that support the food and offer.
- Layout framing: follow {레이아웃} structure, keeping essential copy inside a mobile-app crop-aware central area while allowing decorative graphic elements, badges, and food shadows to extend naturally toward the edges.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- 1) Main hero zone: place the featured food in the most visually dominant position, using appetizing commercial food photography with visible texture, sauce sheen, crispy edges, steam wisps, garnish, plate/tray contact shadow, and realistic portion scale.
- 2) Headline zone: set {메인 카피} in very large Korean typography, stacked for readability, with one line emphasizing the launch/event and another line emphasizing the featured menu.
- 3) Price / promo zone: render {가격·할인} in a high-contrast coupon block, torn-ticket tag, rounded badge, or price sticker so the discount is instantly readable at thumbnail size; add small support labels like '앱 주문가', '첫 주문 쿠폰', or 'SET 특가'.
- 4) Event timing zone: include {기간} as a compact supporting label near the headline or promo block, using smaller type but strong contrast, with a calendar icon-style square or ribbon tab.
- 5) Ordering detail zone: add 2–4 small realistic commerce elements such as '포장 가능', '신메뉴 배달 시작', '리뷰 이벤트 진행', '쿠폰 받기', a tiny QR-like decorative block, or a rounded CTA button '바로 담기'.
- 6) Motion accent zone: add sparkle, burst, arrow, confetti, dotted radial graphics, and speed-line effects around the food hero to suggest urgency, freshness, and a delivery-app sale moment.
- 7) Retail polish: keep the composition commercial and app-ready, with strong spacing rhythm, crisp hierarchy, realistic food lighting, legible Korean typography, and visible offer details that make the banner feel like a live campaign asset.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for headline, Pretendard SemiBold for supporting text, 72–120px headline scale feel, 24–40px for secondary labels, tight but readable line spacing; use condensed bold numerals for price and discount.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} as the base direction, with specific combinations such as #E60012 red, #FFD400 yellow, #111111 black, and white #FFFFFF for contrast; if needed, add warm promo accents like #FF7A00 and cream #FFF3D1.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity under the hero food; badges can use thin white outlines, 2px contrasting strokes, dotted coupon borders, or sticker-peel shadows for legibility.
- Graphic treatment: sharp vector-style bursts, sparkle accents, dotted halftone fields, small coupon perforation marks, angled labels, price slashes, and clean sticker-like CTA buttons; keep glow and blur controlled so food texture and text remain crisp.
- Food realism: include small imperfections that make the dish believable — uneven rice grains, sauce pooling, sesame scatter, fried texture, condensation, chili flakes, paper tray fibers, and natural highlights from studio lighting.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial food photography look, 50mm or 85mm lens at f/4, clean studio product framing with shallow but controlled depth separation.
- Lighting: studio softbox from upper-left at 45° with a gentle fill from right, plus a small top kicker to define food texture and glossy highlights; maintain realistic shadows under packaging, chopsticks, tray, and food pieces.
- Color grade: vivid red-yellow-black promotional grade with crisp whites, saturated food tones, and high contrast tuned for mobile banner readability.
- Rendering quality: real-looking delivery food ad composite with photographic food, vector promotion graphics, crisp Korean typesetting, layered stickers, coupon badges, subtle paper/grain texture in the background, and polished e-commerce finish.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy delivery-app launch banner — modern Korean quick-service ad aesthetic with the punchy clarity of a convenience-store promo poster, the immediacy of a mobile coupon, and the appetizing realism of a freshly packed delivery meal ready to order.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: '신메뉴 출시! / 떡볶이 + 김밥 SET', '정가 12,000 → 9,900 (17% 할인)', '2026.04.29 ~ 05.10 한정'
- Add realistic supporting Korean microcopy where space allows: '맛있는분식 본점', '★ 4.8 리뷰 2,341', '배달팁 0원 쿠폰', '앱 전용 혜택', '쿠폰코드 NEW9900', '지금 주문하기'
- All Korean copy must be rendered cleanly with no broken characters, no spacing glitches, and no accidental English substitutions.
- Food hero must look like real edible product photography, with believable texture, temperature, portion size, sauce, garnish, and packaging details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-393.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱의 매장 대표 이미지용 사진. 실제 매장 외관, 간판, 내부 좌석, 주방 일부 중 하나를 선명하고 신뢰감 있게 보여주며, 사용자가 주문 전 매장의 분위기와 청결함, 메뉴 정체성을 빠르게 이해할 수 있는 로컬 식당 홍보 컷.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 주 피사체는 화면의 55~70%를 차지하도록 배치하고, {매장명}과 {업종}의 핵심 정보가 한눈에 들어오게 구성한다.
- {매장모드}에 따라 간판, 외관 파사드, 유리문, 입구 매트, 내부 테이블, 주방 일부, 벽면 메뉴판, 카운터 메뉴 보드가 자연스럽게 함께 보이도록 구성한다.
- 배경은 실제 매장 환경을 살려 벽면 페인트, 유리창 반사, 우드 테이블, 타일 바닥, 금속 손잡이, 메뉴판 종이 질감, 조명 갓의 생활감을 드러낸다.
- 외관 모드에서는 출입문 옆 영업시간 스티커, 배달 픽업 안내, 작은 화분, 입간판, 이웃 가게의 흐릿한 존재감, 보도블록과 햇빛 그림자를 포함해 실제 동네 매장처럼 보이게 한다.
- 내부 모드에서는 테이블 1~2개, 의자, 물컵, 수저통, 냅킨, 벽면 메뉴, 카운터, 주방 스테인리스 일부, 조리 중인 따뜻한 조명 반사를 넣어 운영 중인 매장의 신뢰감을 만든다.
- 시선은 간판과 입구, 또는 대표 좌석과 메뉴판으로 자연스럽게 유도하고, 정사각 프레임 안에서 배달앱 썸네일로 작게 보아도 매장명과 분위기가 읽히도록 한다.
- {대표메뉴}, {비주얼디테일}, {컬러톤}이 자연스럽게 연결되어 ‘실제로 주문 가능한 동네 맛집’처럼 보이는 명확한 대표 사진을 만든다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- 1) Hero area: {매장명}의 대표 장면을 화면 중앙 또는 약간 상단에 배치하고, 간판 또는 내부 핵심 공간이 가장 먼저 보이도록 한다.
- 2) Signage / storefront zone: 간판은 한글이 또렷하게 보이도록 정면에 가깝게 두고, 외관 모드에서는 입구, 유리문, 벽면 로고, 영업시간 스티커, 픽업 안내 문구가 함께 읽히게 한다.
- 3) Real shop information: 유리문이나 작은 안내판에 {주소}, {연락처}, {영업시간}을 자연스럽게 배치하고, 배달앱 대표 사진에 어울리는 실제 매장 안내처럼 보이게 한다.
- 4) Menu and price cues: 내부 또는 입구 근처 메뉴판에 {대표메뉴}와 {메뉴가격}을 3~5개 항목으로 배치하여 업종이 즉시 이해되도록 한다.
- 5) Interior details: 내부 모드에서는 테이블, 의자, 수저통, 냅킨함, 벽면 메뉴판, 카운터, 주방 동선 일부, 따뜻한 조명 반사를 포함해 실제 운영 중인 매장 느낌을 만든다.
- 6) Color anchoring: {컬러톤}을 바탕으로 벽면, 간판, 소품, 조명색, 목재 톤을 통일해 브랜드 인상이 명확하게 남도록 한다.
- 7) Atmosphere cues: {시간대}의 자연광을 반영해 그림자 방향과 하이라이트를 맞추고, 지나치게 연출된 광고 세트보다 생활감 있는 동네 맛집의 실재감을 유지한다.
- 8) Detail priority: {비주얼디테일}을 바탕으로 화분, 입간판, 메뉴 카드, 창문 스티커, 테이블 소품, 배달 픽업 선반 같은 작은 요소를 자연스럽게 배치한다.
- 9) Camera fidelity: {카메라렌즈} 기준의 현실적인 심도와 원근을 유지해 상업 사진처럼 선명하지만 실제 촬영된 매장 사진처럼 보이게 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if any visible Korean signage or menu text appears, use clean Korean sans-serif lettering similar to Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to bold weight, medium-large size, sharp edges.
- Store text hierarchy: main sign uses bold large Korean lettering; menu board uses medium-weight Korean text with clear prices; door stickers and small notices use smaller but still legible Korean type.
- Color palette: warm amber, wood brown, cream, muted beige, soft charcoal, with signature accent colors from {컬러톤}.
- Texture and materials: include realistic glass reflections, painted signboard texture, brushed metal door handle, wood grain, tiled floor, paper menu board, laminated sticker edges, and soft fabric chair surfaces when applicable.
- Border/shadow: subtle natural shadow under awning, table, signage, menu board, and entrance mat; use soft contact shadows, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity.
- Delivery app readability: the image should remain recognizable at thumbnail size, with the store name, shop category, and warm inviting atmosphere visible in a 1024x1024 square crop.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: shot on Sony A7R V, 24-70mm f/2.8 GM at 35mm, ISO 200, f/4, realistic commercial documentary framing.
- Lighting: 낮 자연광 또는 늦은 오후 골든아워 기준, front-left daylight for exterior or soft window light from upper-left for interior, with gentle fill from the opposite side.
- Color grade: warm amber + wood + cream grade with restrained contrast, slightly lifted shadows, clean neutral whites, no oversaturation.
- Framing: square 1024x1024 delivery-app hero crop, eye-level or slightly above eye-level, straight verticals, realistic storefront geometry, crisp focus on sign and entrance or on interior hero table.
- Rendering: high-resolution realistic photo, natural micro-contrast, readable Korean text, believable reflections on glass, no waxy surfaces.

[6. MOOD]
Neighborhood restaurant magazine cover feel — a polished local-food editorial similar to a gentle Kinfolk x food-business brochure aesthetic, but with practical delivery-app trust cues: clean entrance, readable menu, friendly pricing, real operating details, and warm local charm.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the store sign, menu board, door stickers, business hours, and any visible price text must be broken-free and legible in Korean.
- Must visually preserve the chosen {매장명}, {업종}, {매장모드}, and {시간대} lighting logic.
- If signage appears, it should read naturally as a real Korean shop sign, not a fake official institution mark.
- Render these Korean details where composition allows: main sign “{매장명}”, category “{업종}”, menu board “{대표메뉴}”, price line “{메뉴가격}”, door notice “영업시간 {영업시간}”, contact line “문의 {연락처}”, location label “{주소}”, small promo phrase “{홍보문구}”.
- For exterior mode, include a realistic entrance scene with glass door reflections, an A-frame menu board, potted plant, and a small pickup 안내 sticker reading “배달·포장 픽업”.
- For interior mode, include a visible wall menu or counter menu, table setting, warm window light, and a clean but actively used restaurant atmosphere.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity portraits
- Illegible random glyphs used as Korean signage
